A solutions architect must design a solution that resolves these issues and modernizes the application. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway and direct transactions to the AWS Lambda functions as the application layer. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) as the communication layer between application services.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 把事务导向 AWS Lambda 函数作为应用层。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）作为各应用服务之间的通信层。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to analyze the application performance history to determine the servers' peak utilization during the performance failures. Increase the size of the application server's Amazon EC2 instances to meet the peak requirements.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标分析应用程序的历史性能，确定性能故障期间服务器的峰值利用率。加大应用服务器 Amazon EC2 实例的规格以满足峰值需求。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SNS queue length and scale up and down as required.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）处理运行在 Auto Scaling 组中 Amazon EC2 上的各应用服务器之间的消息传递。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控 SNS 队列长度并按需扩缩容。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SQS queue length and scale up when communication failures are detected.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）处理运行在 Auto Scaling 组中 Amazon EC2 上的各应用服务器之间的消息传递。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控 SQS 队列长度，并在检测到通信故障时扩容。

stem_zh:
某公司希望将一个多层应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS 云，以提升应用程序性能。该应用程序由多个应用层组成，各层之间通过 RESTful 服务通信。当某一层过载时，事务会被丢弃。解决方案架构师必须设计一个能解决这些问题并使应用程序现代化的方案。
哪个方案能满足这些要求并且在运维上最高效？

stem_en: A company receives 10 TB of instrumentation data each day from several machines located at a single factory. The data consists of JSON files stored on a storage area network (SAN) in an on-premises data center located within the factory. The company wants to send this data to Amazon S3 where it can be accessed by several additional systems that provide critical near-real-time analytics. A secure transfer is important because the data is considered sensitive. Which solution offers the MOST reliable data transfer?

options.text_en: AWS DataSync over public internet
options.text_zh: 通过公共互联网使用 AWS DataSync

options.text_en: AWS DataSync over AWS Direct Connect
options.text_zh: 通过 AWS Direct Connect 使用 AWS DataSync

options.text_en: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over public internet
options.text_zh: 通过公共互联网使用 AWS Database Migration Service（AWS DMS）

options.text_en: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over AWS Direct Connect
options.text_zh: 通过 AWS Direct Connect 使用 AWS Database Migration Service（AWS DMS）

stem_zh:
某公司每天从位于同一工厂的多台机器接收 10 TB 的仪器数据。这些数据由存储在该工厂内本地数据中心存储区域网络（SAN）上的 JSON 文件组成。公司希望将这些数据发送到 Amazon S3，以便若干提供关键近实时分析的其他系统可以访问。由于数据被视为敏感数据，因此安全传输很重要。
哪个方案提供最可靠的数据传输？

stem_en: A company needs to configure a real-time data ingestion architecture for its application. The company needs an API, a process that transforms data as the data is streamed, and a storage solution for the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 部署一台 Amazon EC2 实例托管一个 API，把数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。创建一个以该 Kinesis 数据流为数据源的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。使用 AWS Lambda 函数转换数据，再用该 Firehose 传输流把数据发送到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to AWS Glue. Stop source/destination checking on the EC2 instance. Use AWS Glue to transform the data and to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 部署一台 Amazon EC2 实例托管一个 API，把数据发送到 AWS Glue。在该 EC2 实例上停用源/目标检查。使用 AWS Glue 转换数据并把数据发送到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway API 把数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。创建一个以该 Kinesis 数据流为数据源的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。使用 AWS Lambda 函数转换数据，再用该 Firehose 传输流把数据发送到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to AWS Glue. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use AWS Glue to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway API 把数据发送到 AWS Glue。使用 AWS Lambda 函数转换数据，再用 AWS Glue 把数据发送到 Amazon S3。

stem_zh:
某公司需要为其应用程序配置一个实时数据摄取架构。公司需要一个 API、一个在数据流式传输过程中对数据进行转换的处理过程，以及一个数据存储方案。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company needs to keep user transaction data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must retain the data for 7 years. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Use DynamoDB point-in-time recovery to back up the table continuously.
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB 时间点恢复持续备份该表。

options.text_en: Use AWS Backup to create backup schedules and retention policies for the table.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Backup 为该表创建备份计划和保留策略。

options.text_en: Create an on-demand backup of the table by using the DynamoDB console. Store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 通过 DynamoDB 控制台创建该表的按需备份。把备份存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并为该存储桶设置 S3 生命周期配置。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to back up the table and to store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数备份该表并把备份存储到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，并为该存储桶设置 S3 生命周期配置。

stem_zh:
某公司需要在一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表中保存用户交易数据。公司必须将数据保留 7 年。
哪个方案在运维上最高效地满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is planning to use an Amazon DynamoDB table for data storage. The company is concerned about cost optimization. The table will not be used on most mornings. In the evenings, the read and write traffic will often be unpredictable. When traffic spikes occur, they will happen very quickly. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Create a DynamoDB table in on-demand capacity mode.
options.text_zh: 以按需容量模式创建 DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Create a DynamoDB table with a global secondary index.
options.text_zh: 创建一张带全局二级索引的 DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Create a DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity and auto scaling.
options.text_zh: 创建一张采用预置容量并启用自动伸缩的 DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Create a DynamoDB table in provisioned capacity mode, and configure it as a global table.
options.text_zh: 以预置容量模式创建 DynamoDB 表，并把它配置为全球表。

stem_zh:
某公司计划使用一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表进行数据存储。公司关注成本优化。该表在大多数上午都不会被使用。到了晚上，读写流量往往不可预测。当流量激增时，会来得非常快。
解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: A company recently signed a contract with an AWS Managed Service Provider (MSP) Partner for help with an application migration initiative. A solutions architect needs ta share an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from an existing AWS account with the MSP Partner's AWS account. The AMI is backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) and uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt EBS volume snapshots. What is the MOST secure way for the solutions architect to share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account?

options.text_en: Make the encrypted AMI and snapshots publicly available. Modify the key policy to allow the MSP Partner's AWS account to use the key.
options.text_zh: 把加密的 AMI 和快照设为公开可用。修改密钥策略，允许 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户使用该密钥。

options.text_en: Modify the launchPermission property of the AMI. Share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account only. Modify the key policy to allow the MSP Partner's AWS account to use the key.
options.text_zh: 修改该 AMI 的 launchPermission 属性。仅把该 AMI 共享给 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户。修改密钥策略，允许 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户使用该密钥。

options.text_en: Modify the launchPermission property of the AMI. Share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account only. Modify the key policy to trust a new KMS key that is owned by the MSP Partner for encryption.
options.text_zh: 修改该 AMI 的 launchPermission 属性。仅把该 AMI 共享给 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户。修改密钥策略，改为信任一个由 MSP 合作伙伴拥有的新 KMS 密钥用于加密。

options.text_en: Export the AMI from the source account to an Amazon S3 bucket in the MSP Partner's AWS account, Encrypt the S3 bucket with a new KMS key that is owned by the MSP Partner. Copy and launch the AMI in the MSP Partner's AWS account.
options.text_zh: 把该 AMI 从源账户导出到 MSP 合作伙伴 AWS 账户中的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。用一个由 MSP 合作伙伴拥有的新 KMS 密钥加密该 S3 存储桶。在 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户中复制并启动该 AMI。

stem_zh:
某公司最近与一家 AWS 托管服务提供商（MSP）合作伙伴签订了合同，以协助其应用程序迁移计划。解决方案架构师需要将一个现有 AWS 账户中的 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）共享给该 MSP 合作伙伴的 AWS 账户。该 AMI 由 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）支持，并使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户托管密钥加密 EBS 卷快照。
解决方案架构师将该 AMI 共享给 MSP 合作伙伴 AWS 账户的最安全方式是什么？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing the cloud architecture for a new application being deployed on AWS. The process should run in parallel while adding and removing application nodes as needed based on the number of jobs to be processed. The processor application is stateless. The solutions architect must ensure that the application is loosely coupled and the job items are durably stored. Which design should the solutions architect use?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon SNS topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch configuration that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch configuration. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on CPU usage.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon SNS 主题来发送待处理的作业。创建一个包含处理器应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。创建一个使用该 AMI 的启动配置，并用它创建 Auto Scaling 组。把该组的伸缩策略设为根据 CPU 使用率增减节点。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon SQS queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch configuration that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch configuration. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on network usage.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon SQS 队列来存放待处理的作业。创建一个包含处理器应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。创建一个使用该 AMI 的启动配置，并用它创建 Auto Scaling 组。把该组的伸缩策略设为根据网络使用量增减节点。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon SQS queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch template that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch template. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on the number of items in the SQS queue.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon SQS 队列来存放待处理的作业。创建一个包含处理器应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。创建一个使用该 AMI 的启动模板，并用它创建 Auto Scaling 组。把该组的伸缩策略设为根据 SQS 队列中的条目数量增减节点。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon SNS topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch template that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch template. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on the number of messages published to the SNS topic.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon SNS 主题来发送待处理的作业。创建一个包含处理器应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。创建一个使用该 AMI 的启动模板，并用它创建 Auto Scaling 组。把该组的伸缩策略设为根据发布到该 SNS 主题的消息数量增减节点。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为一个即将部署到 AWS 的新应用程序设计云架构。该处理过程应并行运行，并根据待处理作业的数量按需增减应用节点。处理器应用程序是无状态的。解决方案架构师必须确保应用程序松耦合，且作业条目被持久存储。
解决方案架构师应采用哪种设计？

stem_en: A company hosts its web applications in the AWS Cloud. The company configures Elastic Load Balancers to use certificates that are imported into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). The company's security team must be notified 30 days before the expiration of each certificate. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Add a rule in ACM to publish a custom message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic every day, beginning 30 days before any certificate will expire.
options.text_zh: 在 ACM 中添加一条规则，从任一证书到期前 30 天起，每天向一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题发布自定义消息。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Config rule that checks for certificates that will expire within 30 days. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to invoke a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) when AWS Config reports a noncompliant resource.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 AWS Config 规则检查将在 30 天内到期的证书。配置 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events），在 AWS Config 报告资源不合规时通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）触发自定义告警。

options.text_en: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to check for certificates that will expire within 30 days. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that is based on Trusted Advisor metrics for check status changes. Configure the alarm to send a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 检查将在 30 天内到期的证书。基于 Trusted Advisor 检查状态变化的指标创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警。配置该告警通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）发送自定义告警。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to detect any certificates that will expire within 30 days. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to send a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则检测将在 30 天内到期的证书。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，由该函数通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）发送自定义告警。

explanation_en: Explanation: AWS Config ships a managed rule specifically for this, acm-certificate-expiration-check, which flags certificates nearing expiration. Wiring that up through EventBridge to SNS meets the requirement without writing custom detection logic in a Lambda function.
explanation_zh: 解析：AWS Config 专门为此提供了一条托管规则 acm-certificate-expiration-check，用于标记临近到期的证书。将其通过 EventBridge 接入 SNS 即可满足要求，而无需在 Lambda 函数中编写自定义检测逻辑。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 云中托管其 Web 应用程序。公司配置 Elastic Load Balancer 使用导入到 AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）中的证书。公司的安全团队必须在每张证书到期前 30 天收到通知。
解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足此要求？

stem_en: A company's dynamic website is hosted using on-premises servers in the United States. The company is launching its product in Europe, and it wants to optimize site loading times for new European users. The site's backend must remain in the United States. The product is being launched in a few days, and an immediate solution is needed. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in us-east-1 and migrate the site to it.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 启动一台 Amazon EC2 实例，并把站点迁移过去。

options.text_en: Move the website to Amazon S3. Use Cross-Region Replication between Regions.
options.text_zh: 把网站迁移到 Amazon S3，并在区域之间使用跨区域复制。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudFront with a custom origin pointing to the on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudFront，并把自定义源站指向这些本地服务器。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy pointing to on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 使用指向本地服务器的 Amazon Route 53 地理位置就近路由策略。

stem_zh:
某公司的动态网站托管在美国的本地服务器上。该公司正在欧洲推出其产品，希望优化新欧洲用户的站点加载时间。站点后端必须仍留在美国。产品将在几天内发布，因此需要一个立即可用的方案。
解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: A company wants to reduce the cost of its existing three-tier web architecture. The web, application, and database servers are running on Amazon EC2 instances for the development, test, and production environments. The EC2 instances average 30% CPU utilization during peak hours and 10% CPU utilization during non-peak hours. The production EC2 instances run 24 hours a day. The development and test EC2 instances run for at least 8 hours each day. The company plans to implement automation to stop the development and test EC2 instances when they are not in use. Which EC2 instance purchasing solution will meet the company's requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 生产 EC2 实例使用 Spot 实例，开发和测试 EC2 实例使用预留实例。

options.text_en: Use Reserved Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use On-Demand Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 生产 EC2 实例使用预留实例，开发和测试 EC2 实例使用按需实例。

options.text_en: Use Spot blocks for the production EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 生产 EC2 实例使用 Spot 块（Spot blocks），开发和测试 EC2 实例使用预留实例。

options.text_en: Use On-Demand Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use Spot blocks for the development and test EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 生产 EC2 实例使用按需实例，开发和测试 EC2 实例使用 Spot 块（Spot blocks）。

stem_zh:
某公司希望降低其现有三层 Web 架构的成本。开发、测试和生产环境的 Web 服务器、应用服务器和数据库服务器都运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些 EC2 实例在高峰时段的平均 CPU 利用率为 30%，非高峰时段为 10%。
生产 EC2 实例每天 24 小时运行。开发和测试 EC2 实例每天至少运行 8 小时。公司计划实施自动化，在开发和测试 EC2 实例不使用时将其停止。
哪种 EC2 实例购买方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足公司要求？

stem_en: A company has a production web application in which users upload documents through a web interface or a mobile app. According to a new regulatory requirement. new documents cannot be modified or deleted after they are stored. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning and S3 Object Lock enabled.
options.text_zh: 把上传的文档存储在一个启用了 S3 版本控制和 S3 Object Lock 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

options.text_en: Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to archive the documents periodically.
options.text_zh: 把上传的文档存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。配置一条 S3 生命周期策略定期归档这些文档。

options.text_en: Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Configure an ACL to restrict all access to read-only.
options.text_zh: 把上传的文档存储在一个启用了 S3 版本控制的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。配置一条 ACL 把所有访问限制为只读。

options.text_en: Store the uploaded documents on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Access the data by mounting the volume in read- only mode.
options.text_zh: 把上传的文档存储在一个 Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）卷上。以只读模式挂载该卷来访问数据。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个生产 Web 应用程序，用户通过 Web 界面或移动应用上传文档。根据一项新的监管要求，新文档在存储后不得被修改或删除。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足此要求？

stem_en: A company has several web servers that need to frequently access a common Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. The company wants a secure method for the web servers to connect to the database while meeting a security requirement to rotate user credentials frequently. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Store the database user credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to access AWS Secrets Manager.
options.text_zh: 把数据库用户凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。授予必要的 IAM 权限，允许 Web 服务器访问 AWS Secrets Manager。

options.text_en: Store the database user credentials in AWS Systems Manager OpsCenter. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to access OpsCenter.
options.text_zh: 把数据库用户凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager OpsCenter 中。授予必要的 IAM 权限，允许 Web 服务器访问 OpsCenter。

options.text_en: Store the database user credentials in a secure Amazon S3 bucket. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to retrieve credentials and access the database.
options.text_zh: 把数据库用户凭证存储在一个安全的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。授予必要的 IAM 权限，允许 Web 服务器检索凭证并访问数据库。

options.text_en: Store the database user credentials in files encrypted with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) on the web server file system. The web server should be able to decrypt the files and access the database.
options.text_zh: 把数据库用户凭证以经 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密的文件形式存储在 Web 服务器文件系统上。Web 服务器应能解密这些文件并访问数据库。

stem_zh:
某公司有多台 Web 服务器需要频繁访问一个共用的 Amazon RDS MySQL 多可用区数据库实例。公司希望有一种安全的方式让 Web 服务器连接到数据库，同时满足频繁轮换用户凭证的安全要求。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts an application on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by an Amazon API Gateway API. The Lambda functions save customer data to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Whenever the company upgrades the database, the Lambda functions fail to establish database connections until the upgrade is complete. The result is that customer data is not recorded for some of the event. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that stores customer data that is created during database upgrades. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon RDS proxy to sit between the Lambda functions and the database. Configure the Lambda functions to connect to the RDS proxy.
options.text_zh: 在 Lambda 函数与数据库之间预置一个 Amazon RDS 代理。配置 Lambda 函数连接到该 RDS 代理。

options.text_en: Increase the run time of the Lambda functions to the maximum. Create a retry mechanism in the code that stores the customer data in the database.
options.text_zh: 把 Lambda 函数的运行时长提高到最大值。在代码中创建重试机制来把客户数据存入数据库。

options.text_en: Persist the customer data to Lambda local storage. Configure new Lambda functions to scan the local storage to save the customer data to the database.
options.text_zh: 把客户数据持久化到 Lambda 本地存储。配置新的 Lambda 函数扫描本地存储，把客户数据保存到数据库。

options.text_en: Store the customer data in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create a new Lambda function that polls the queue and stores the customer data in the database.
options.text_zh: 把客户数据存储在一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）FIFO 队列中。创建一个新的 Lambda 函数轮询该队列，并把客户数据存入数据库。

stem_zh:
某公司在由 Amazon API Gateway API 调用的 AWS Lambda 函数上托管一个应用程序。这些 Lambda 函数将客户数据保存到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库。每当公司升级数据库时，Lambda 函数在升级完成前都无法建立数据库连接。结果是某些事件的客户数据没有被记录。
解决方案架构师需要设计一个方案来存储数据库升级期间产生的客户数据。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A survey company has gathered data for several years from areas in the United States. The company hosts the data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is 3 TB in size and growing. The company has started to share the data with a European marketing firm that has S3 buckets. The company wants to ensure that its data transfer costs remain as low as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure the Requester Pays feature on the company's S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在公司的 S3 存储桶上配置请求方付费（Requester Pays）功能。

options.text_en: Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication from the company's S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.
options.text_zh: 配置从公司 S3 存储桶到该营销公司某个 S3 存储桶的 S3 跨区域复制。

options.text_en: Configure cross-account access for the marketing firm so that the marketing firm has access to the company's S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 为该营销公司配置跨账户访问，使其能够访问公司的 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Configure the company's S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Sync the S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.
options.text_zh: 把公司的 S3 存储桶配置为使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。把该 S3 存储桶同步到该营销公司的某个 S3 存储桶。

stem_zh:
某调查公司多年来从美国各地区收集数据。公司将这些数据存放在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中，容量为 3 TB 且仍在增长。公司已开始与一家拥有 S3 存储桶的欧洲营销公司共享数据。公司希望确保其数据传输成本尽可能低。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon S3 to store its confidential audit documents. The S3 bucket uses bucket policies to restrict access to audit team IAM user credentials according to the principle of least privilege. Company managers are worried about accidental deletion of documents in the S3 bucket and want a more secure solution. What should a solutions architect do to secure the audit documents?

options.text_en: Enable the versioning and MFA Delete features on the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在该 S3 存储桶上启用版本控制和 MFA Delete 功能。

options.text_en: Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the IAM user credentials for each audit team IAM user account.
options.text_zh: 为每个审计团队 IAM 用户账户的 IAM 用户凭证启用多重身份验证（MFA）。

options.text_en: Add an S3 Lifecycle policy to the audit team's IAM user accounts to deny the s3:DeleteObject action during audit dates.
options.text_zh: 为审计团队的 IAM 用户账户添加一条 S3 生命周期策略，在审计日期内拒绝 s3:DeleteObject 操作。

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the S3 bucket and restrict audit team IAM user accounts from accessing the KMS key.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密该 S3 存储桶，并限制审计团队 IAM 用户账户访问该 KMS 密钥。

stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon S3 存储其机密审计文档。该 S3 存储桶使用存储桶策略，按照最小权限原则将访问权限限制给审计团队的 IAM 用户凭证。公司管理层担心 S3 存储桶中的文档被意外删除，希望有一个更安全的方案。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做来保护这些审计文档？

stem_en: A company is using a SQL database to store movie data that is publicly accessible. The database runs on an Amazon RDS Single-AZ DB instance. A script runs queries at random intervals each day to record the number of new movies that have been added to the database. The script must report a final total during business hours. The company's development team notices that the database performance is inadequate for development tasks when the script is running. A solutions architect must recommend a solution to resolve this issue. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例修改为多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Create a read replica of the database. Configure the script to query only the read replica.
options.text_zh: 创建该数据库的只读副本。配置该脚本只查询只读副本。

options.text_en: Instruct the development team to manually export the entries in the database at the end of each day.
options.text_zh: 要求开发团队在每天结束时手动导出数据库中的条目。

options.text_en: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the common queries that the script runs against the database.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存该脚本对数据库运行的常用查询。

stem_zh:
某公司使用一个 SQL 数据库存储可公开访问的电影数据。该数据库运行在一个 Amazon RDS 单可用区数据库实例上。有一个脚本每天以随机间隔运行查询，记录新增到数据库中的电影数量。该脚本必须在工作时间内报告最终总数。
公司的开发团队注意到，当该脚本运行时，数据库性能不足以支撑开发任务。解决方案架构师必须推荐一个方案来解决此问题。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足此要求？

stem_en: A company has applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. One of the applications needs to call the Amazon S3 API to store and read objects. According to the company's security regulations, no traffic from the applications is allowed to travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an S3 gateway endpoint.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 S3 网关终端节点。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket in a private subnet.
options.text_zh: 在私有子网中创建一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket in the same AWS Region as the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 在与这些 EC2 实例相同的 AWS 区域中创建一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Configure a NAT gateway in the same subnet as the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 在与这些 EC2 实例相同的子网中配置一个 NAT 网关。

stem_zh:
某公司有一些运行在 VPC 内 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。其中一个应用程序需要调用 Amazon S3 API 来存储和读取对象。根据公司的安全规定，不允许任何来自这些应用程序的流量经由互联网传输。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is storing sensitive user information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to provide secure access to this bucket from the application tier running on Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Configure a VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 within the VPC.
options.text_zh: 在该 VPC 内为 Amazon S3 配置一个 VPC 网关终端节点。

options.text_en: Create a bucket policy to make the objects in the S3 bucket public.
options.text_zh: 创建一条存储桶策略，把该 S3 存储桶中的对象设为公开。

options.text_en: Create a bucket policy that limits access to only the application tier running in the VPC.
options.text_zh: 创建一条存储桶策略，仅限运行在该 VPC 中的应用层访问。

options.text_en: Create an IAM user with an S3 access policy and copy the IAM credentials to the EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 创建一个带 S3 访问策略的 IAM 用户，并把该 IAM 凭证复制到 EC2 实例上。

options.text_en: Create a NAT instance and have the EC2 instances use the NAT instance to access the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一台 NAT 实例，让这些 EC2 实例经由该 NAT 实例访问 S3 存储桶。

stem_zh:
某公司将敏感用户信息存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司希望从运行在 VPC 内 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用层安全地访问该存储桶。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来实现这一点？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs an on-premises application that is powered by a MySQL database. The company is migrating the application to AWS to increase the application's elasticity and availability. The current architecture shows heavy read activity on the database during times of normal operation. Every 4 hours, the company's development team pulls a full export of the production database to populate a database in the staging environment. During this period, users experience unacceptable application latency. The development team is unable to use the staging environment until the procedure completes. A solutions architect must recommend replacement architecture that alleviates the application latency issue. The replacement architecture also must give the development team the ability to continue using the staging environment without delay. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ Aurora Replicas for production. Populate the staging database by implementing a backup and restore process that uses the mysqldump utility.
options.text_zh: 生产环境使用带多可用区 Aurora 副本的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。通过基于 mysqldump 工具的备份恢复流程填充预发布数据库。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ Aurora Replicas for production. Use database cloning to create the staging database on-demand.
options.text_zh: 生产环境使用带多可用区 Aurora 副本的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。使用数据库克隆按需创建预发布数据库。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ deployment and read replicas for production. Use the standby instance for the staging database.
options.text_zh: 生产环境使用带多可用区部署和只读副本的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。把备用实例用作预发布数据库。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ deployment and read replicas for production. Populate the staging database by implementing a backup and restore process that uses the mysqldump utility.
options.text_zh: 生产环境使用带多可用区部署和只读副本的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。通过基于 mysqldump 工具的备份恢复流程填充预发布数据库。

stem_zh:
某公司运行一个由 MySQL 数据库驱动的本地应用程序。公司正在将该应用程序迁移到 AWS，以提升应用程序的弹性和可用性。
当前架构显示，在正常运行期间数据库上有大量读操作。每隔 4 小时，公司的开发团队会拉取一份生产数据库的完整导出，用于填充预发布环境中的数据库。在此期间，用户会遇到无法接受的应用程序延迟。在该过程完成之前，开发团队无法使用预发布环境。
解决方案架构师必须推荐一个能缓解应用程序延迟问题的替代架构。该替代架构还必须让开发团队能够不受延误地继续使用预发布环境。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing an application where users upload small files into Amazon S3. After a user uploads a file, the file requires one-time simple processing to transform the data and save the data in JSON format for later analysis. Each file must be processed as quickly as possible after it is uploaded. Demand will vary. On some days, users will upload a high number of files. On other days, users will upload a few files or no files. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon EMR to read text files from Amazon S3. Run processing scripts to transform the data. Store the resulting JSON file in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon EMR 从 Amazon S3 读取文本文件。运行处理脚本转换数据，把生成的 JSON 文件存储到一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon S3 to send an event notification to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use Amazon EC2 instances to read from the queue and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon S3 向一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列发送事件通知。使用 Amazon EC2 实例从队列读取并处理数据，把生成的 JSON 文件存储到 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon S3 to send an event notification to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use an AWS Lambda function to read from the queue and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon S3 向一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列发送事件通知。使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数从队列读取并处理数据，把生成的 JSON 文件存储到 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to send an event to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams when a new file is uploaded. Use an AWS Lambda function to consume the event from the stream and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events），在有新文件上传时向 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 发送事件。使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数从流中消费事件并处理数据，把生成的 JSON 文件存储到一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中。

stem_zh:
某公司正在设计一个应用程序，用户可以将小文件上传到 Amazon S3。用户上传文件后，该文件需要经过一次性的简单处理，以转换数据并以 JSON 格式保存，供以后分析。
每个文件在上传后必须尽快被处理。需求会有波动。有些日子用户会上传大量文件，另一些日子用户只上传少量文件或不上传文件。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: An application allows users at a company's headquarters to access product data. The product data is stored in an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. The operations team has isolated an application performance slowdown and wants to separate read traffic from write traffic. A solutions architect needs to optimize the application's performance quickly. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Change the existing database to a Multi-AZ deployment. Serve the read requests from the primary Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把现有数据库改为多可用区部署。由主可用区处理读请求。

options.text_en: Change the existing database to a Multi-AZ deployment. Serve the read requests from the secondary Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把现有数据库改为多可用区部署。由辅助可用区处理读请求。

options.text_en: Create read replicas for the database. Configure the read replicas with half of the compute and storage resources as the source database.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库创建只读副本。为只读副本配置源数据库一半的计算和存储资源。

options.text_en: Create read replicas for the database. Configure the read replicas with the same compute and storage resources as the source database.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库创建只读副本。为只读副本配置与源数据库相同的计算和存储资源。

stem_zh:
某应用程序允许公司总部的用户访问产品数据。产品数据存储在一个 Amazon RDS MySQL 数据库实例中。运维团队已定位到应用程序性能下降的问题，希望将读流量与写流量分离。解决方案架构师需要快速优化应用程序性能。
解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: An Amazon EC2 administrator created the following policy associated with an IAM group containing several users: What is the effect of this policy?

options.text_en: Users can terminate an EC2 instance in any AWS Region except us-east-1.
options.text_zh: 用户可以在除 us-east-1 之外的任何 AWS 区域终止 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Users can terminate an EC2 instance with the IP address 10.100.100.1 in the us-east-1 Region.
options.text_zh: 用户可以在 us-east-1 区域终止 IP 地址为 10.100.100.1 的 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Users can terminate an EC2 instance in the us-east-1 Region when the user's source IP is 10.100.100.254.
options.text_zh: 当用户的源 IP 为 10.100.100.254 时，用户可以在 us-east-1 区域终止 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Users cannot terminate an EC2 instance in the us-east-1 Region when the user's source IP is 10.100.100.254.
options.text_zh: 当用户的源 IP 为 10.100.100.254 时，用户不能在 us-east-1 区域终止 EC2 实例。

stem_zh: 一位 Amazon EC2 管理员创建了以下策略，并将其关联到一个包含多名用户的 IAM 组：该策略的效果是什么？

stem_en: A company has a large Microsoft SharePoint deployment running on-premises that requires Microsoft Windows shared file storage. The company wants to migrate this workload to the AWS Cloud and is considering various storage options. The storage solution must be highly available and integrated with Active Directory for access control. Which solution will satisfy these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon EFS storage and set the Active Directory domain for authentication.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon EFS 存储，并设置用于身份验证的 Active Directory 域。

options.text_en: Create an SMB file share on an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway in two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 在两个可用区中的 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关上创建 SMB 文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and configure Microsoft Windows Server to mount it as a volume.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，并配置 Microsoft Windows Server 把它挂载为卷。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system on AWS and set the Active Directory domain for authentication.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS 上创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，并设置用于身份验证的 Active Directory 域。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个大型的 Microsoft SharePoint 本地部署，需要 Microsoft Windows 共享文件存储。公司希望将该工作负载迁移到 AWS 云，并正在考虑各种存储选项。存储方案必须高可用，并与 Active Directory 集成以进行访问控制。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An image-processing company has a web application that users use to upload images. The application uploads the images into an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has set up S3 event notifications to publish the object creation events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The SQS queue serves as the event source for an AWS Lambda function that processes the images and sends the results to users through email. Users report that they are receiving multiple email messages for every uploaded image. A solutions architect determines that SQS messages are invoking the Lambda function more than once, resulting in multiple email messages. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Set up long polling in the SQS queue by increasing the ReceiveMessage wait time to 30 seconds.
options.text_zh: 把 ReceiveMessage 等待时间提高到 30 秒，在该 SQS 队列上启用长轮询。

options.text_en: Change the SQS standard queue to an SQS FIFO queue. Use the message deduplication ID to discard duplicate messages.
options.text_zh: 把该 SQS 标准队列改为 SQS FIFO 队列。使用消息去重 ID 丢弃重复消息。

options.text_en: Increase the visibility timeout in the SQS queue to a value that is greater than the total of the function timeout and the batch window timeout.
options.text_zh: 把该 SQS 队列的可见性超时时间提高到大于函数超时时间与批处理窗口超时时间之和的值。

options.text_en: Modify the Lambda function to delete each message from the SQS queue immediately after the message is read before processing.
options.text_zh: 修改该 Lambda 函数，在读取消息后、处理之前就立即从 SQS 队列中删除该消息。

explanation_en: timeout.
stem_zh:
某图像处理公司有一个供用户上传图片的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将图片上传到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司已设置 S3 事件通知，将对象创建事件发布到一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）标准队列。该 SQS 队列作为一个 AWS Lambda 函数的事件源，该函数处理图片并通过电子邮件将结果发送给用户。
用户报告称，每上传一张图片都会收到多封电子邮件。解决方案架构师确定 SQS 消息多次调用了 Lambda 函数，导致产生多封邮件。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最少的运维开销解决这个问题？

stem_en: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in an on-premises data center. The company needs the ability to use Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关。创建一个使用所需客户端协议的文件共享，把应用服务器连接到该文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.text_zh: 创建一台 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。在该实例上安装并配置 Windows 文件共享角色，把应用服务器连接到该文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system, and configure it to support Lustre. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）文件系统并配置其支持 Lustre。把该文件系统挂载到源服务器，再把应用服务器连接到该文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。把该文件系统挂载到源服务器，再把应用服务器连接到该文件系统。

stem_zh:
某公司正在为一个托管在本地数据中心的游戏应用程序实施共享存储方案。公司需要能够使用 Lustre 客户端访问数据。该方案必须是全托管的。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company's containerized application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to download security certificates before it can communicate with other business applications. The company wants a highly secure solution to encrypt and decrypt the certificates in near real time. The solution also needs to store data in highly available storage after the data is encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create AWS Secrets Manager secrets for encrypted certificates. Manually update the certificates as needed. Control access to the data by using fine-grained IAM access.
options.text_zh: 为加密证书创建 AWS Secrets Manager 密钥。按需手动更新证书。通过细粒度 IAM 访问控制数据访问权限。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Python cryptography library to receive and perform encryption operations. Store the function in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使用 Python cryptography 库接收并执行加密操作。把该函数存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Allow the EC2 role to use the KMS key for encryption operations. Store the encrypted data on Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户托管密钥。允许 EC2 角色使用该 KMS 密钥执行加密操作。把加密后的数据存储在 Amazon S3 上。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Allow the EC2 role to use the KMS key for encryption operations. Store the encrypted data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户托管密钥。允许 EC2 角色使用该 KMS 密钥执行加密操作。把加密后的数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷上。

explanation_en: operations. Store the encrypted data on Amazon S3.
stem_zh:
某公司的容器化应用程序运行在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序需要先下载安全证书，才能与其他业务应用程序通信。公司希望有一个高度安全的方案来近实时地加密和解密这些证书。该方案还需要在数据被加密后将其存储在高可用的存储中。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a VPC with public and private subnets. The VPC and subnets use IPv4 CIDR blocks. There is one public subnet and one private subnet in each of three Availability Zones (AZs) for high availability. An internet gateway is used to provide internet access for the public subnets. The private subnets require access to the internet to allow Amazon EC2 instances to download software updates. What should the solutions architect do to enable Internet access for the private subnets?

options.text_en: Create three NAT gateways, one for each public subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ.
options.text_zh: 创建三个 NAT 网关，每个可用区的公有子网中各一个。为每个可用区创建一张私有路由表，把非 VPC 流量转发到该可用区的 NAT 网关。

options.text_en: Create three NAT instances, one for each private subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT instance in its AZ.
options.text_zh: 创建三台 NAT 实例，每个可用区的私有子网中各一台。为每个可用区创建一张私有路由表，把非 VPC 流量转发到该可用区的 NAT 实例。

options.text_en: Create a second internet gateway on one of the private subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the private internet gateway.
options.text_zh: 在其中一个私有子网上创建第二个互联网网关。更新私有子网的路由表，把非 VPC 流量转发到该私有互联网网关。

options.text_en: Create an egress-only internet gateway on one of the public subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the egress-only Internet gateway.
options.text_zh: 在其中一个公有子网上创建一个仅出口互联网网关。更新私有子网的路由表，把非 VPC 流量转发到该仅出口互联网网关。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个包含公有子网和私有子网的 VPC。该 VPC 和子网使用 IPv4 CIDR 块。为实现高可用性，在三个可用区（AZ）中各有一个公有子网和一个私有子网。使用互联网网关为公有子网提供互联网访问。私有子网需要访问互联网，以便 Amazon EC2 实例下载软件更新。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能为私有子网启用互联网访问？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate an on-premises data center to AWS. The data center hosts an SFTP server that stores its data on an NFS-based file system. The server holds 200 GB of data that needs to be transferred. The server must be hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance that uses an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to automate this task? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Launch the EC2 instance into the same Availability Zone as the EFS file system.
options.text_zh: 把该 EC2 实例启动到与该 EFS 文件系统相同的可用区中。

options.text_en: Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center.
options.text_zh: 在本地数据中心安装一个 AWS DataSync 代理。

options.text_en: Create a secondary Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume on the EC2 instance for the data.
options.text_zh: 在该 EC2 实例上为数据创建一个辅助 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷。

options.text_en: Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data to the EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 手动使用操作系统的复制命令把数据推送到该 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to create a suitable location configuration for the on-premises SFTP server.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync 为本地 SFTP 服务器创建合适的位置配置。

stem_zh:
某公司希望将一个本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该数据中心托管着一台 SFTP 服务器，其数据存储在基于 NFS 的文件系统上。该服务器上有 200 GB 数据需要传输。该服务器必须托管在一台使用 Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）文件系统的 Amazon EC2 实例上。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来自动化此任务？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company has an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs every day at the same time. The job processes XML data that is in an Amazon S3 bucket. New data is added to the S3 bucket every day. A solutions architect notices that AWS Glue is processing all the data during each run. What should the solutions architect do to prevent AWS Glue from reprocessing old data?

options.text_en: Edit the job to use job bookmarks.
options.text_zh: 编辑该作业以使用作业书签（job bookmarks）。

options.text_en: Edit the job to delete data after the data is processed.
options.text_zh: 编辑该作业，在数据处理完成后删除数据。

options.text_en: Edit the job by setting the NumberOfWorkers field to 1.
options.text_zh: 编辑该作业，把 NumberOfWorkers 字段设为 1。

options.text_en: Use a FindMatches machine learning (ML) transform.
options.text_zh: 使用 FindMatches 机器学习（ML）转换。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个 AWS Glue 提取、转换和加载（ETL）作业，每天在同一时间运行。该作业处理位于一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中的 XML 数据。每天都会有新数据添加到该 S3 存储桶。一位解决方案架构师注意到 AWS Glue 在每次运行时都会处理全部数据。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能防止 AWS Glue 重复处理旧数据？

stem_en: A solutions architect must design a highly available infrastructure for a website. The website is powered by Windows web servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The solutions architect must implement a solution that can mitigate a large-scale DDoS attack that originates from thousands of IP addresses. Downtime is not acceptable for the website. Which actions should the solutions architect take to protect the website from such an attack? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use AWS Shield Advanced to stop the DDoS attack.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Shield Advanced 阻止该 DDoS 攻击。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to automatically block the attackers.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon GuardDuty 自动封禁攻击者。

options.text_en: Configure the website to use Amazon CloudFront for both static and dynamic content.
options.text_zh: 配置该网站对静态内容和动态内容都使用 Amazon CloudFront。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to automatically add attacker IP addresses to VPC network ACLs.
options.text_zh: 使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数自动把攻击者 IP 地址加入 VPC 网络 ACL。

options.text_en: Use EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group with a target tracking scaling policy that is set to 80% CPU utilization.
options.text_zh: 在 Auto Scaling 组中使用 EC2 Spot 实例，并设置目标为 80% CPU 利用率的目标跟踪伸缩策略。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师必须为一个网站设计高可用基础设施。该网站由运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Windows Web 服务器驱动。解决方案架构师必须实施一个方案，以缓解来自数千个 IP 地址的大规模 DDoS 攻击。该网站不能接受停机。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来保护网站免受此类攻击？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is preparing to deploy a new serverless workload. A solutions architect must use the principle of least privilege to configure permissions that will be used to run an AWS Lambda function. An Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule will invoke the function. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and * as the principal.
options.text_zh: 为该函数添加一个执行角色，操作为 lambda:InvokeFunction，主体为 *。

options.text_en: Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: lambda.amazonaws.com as the principal.
options.text_zh: 为该函数添加一个执行角色，操作为 lambda:InvokeFunction，主体为 Service: lambda.amazonaws.com。

options.text_en: Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:* as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the principal.
options.text_zh: 为该函数添加一条基于资源的策略，操作为 lambda:*，主体为 Service: events.amazonaws.com。

options.text_en: Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the principal.
options.text_zh: 为该函数添加一条基于资源的策略，操作为 lambda:InvokeFunction，主体为 Service: events.amazonaws.com。

stem_zh:
某公司正准备部署一个新的无服务器工作负载。解决方案架构师必须遵循最小权限原则来配置运行一个 AWS Lambda 函数所需的权限。一条 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则将调用该函数。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is preparing to store confidential data in Amazon S3. For compliance reasons, the data must be encrypted at rest. Encryption key usage must be logged for auditing purposes. Keys must be rotated every year. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.text_en: Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
options.text_zh: 使用客户提供密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-C）

options.text_en: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）

options.text_en: Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with manual rotation
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS），手动轮换

options.text_en: Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with automatic rotation
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS），自动轮换

stem_zh:
某公司正准备在 Amazon S3 中存储机密数据。出于合规原因，数据必须静态加密。加密密钥的使用情况必须被记录以供审计。密钥必须每年轮换。
哪个方案能满足这些要求且在运维上最高效？

stem_en: A bicycle sharing company is developing a multi-tier architecture to track the location of its bicycles during peak operating hours. The company wants to use these data points in its existing analytics platform. A solutions architect must determine the most viable multi-tier option to support this architecture. The data points must be accessible from the REST API. Which action meets these requirements for storing and retrieving location data?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Athena with Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 将 Amazon Athena 与 Amazon S3 配合使用。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda.
options.text_zh: 将 Amazon API Gateway 与 AWS Lambda 配合使用。

options.text_en: Use Amazon QuickSight with Amazon Redshift.
options.text_zh: 将 Amazon QuickSight 与 Amazon Redshift 配合使用。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway with Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics.
options.text_zh: 将 Amazon API Gateway 与 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 配合使用。

stem_zh:
某自行车共享公司正在开发一个多层架构，用于在运营高峰时段跟踪其自行车的位置。公司希望在其现有的分析平台中使用这些数据点。解决方案架构师必须确定支撑该架构的最可行的多层方案。这些数据点必须可以通过 REST API 访问。
哪个操作能满足这些存储和检索位置数据的要求？

stem_en: A company has an automobile sales website that stores its listings in a database on Amazon RDS. When an automobile is sold, the listing needs to be removed from the website and the data must be sent to multiple target systems. Which design should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for the targets to consume.
options.text_zh: 创建一个在 Amazon RDS 上的数据库被更新时触发的 AWS Lambda 函数，把信息发送到一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列供各目标系统消费。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for the targets to consume.
options.text_zh: 创建一个在 Amazon RDS 上的数据库被更新时触发的 AWS Lambda 函数，把信息发送到一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）FIFO 队列供各目标系统消费。

options.text_en: Subscribe to an RDS event notification and send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue fanned out to multiple Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.
options.text_zh: 订阅 RDS 事件通知，发送到一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列，再扇出到多个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。使用 AWS Lambda 函数更新各目标系统。

options.text_en: Subscribe to an RDS event notification and send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic fanned out to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.
options.text_zh: 订阅 RDS 事件通知，发送到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题，再扇出到多个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列。使用 AWS Lambda 函数更新各目标系统。

explanation_en: Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.
stem_zh:
某公司有一个汽车销售网站，其在售信息存储在 Amazon RDS 上的数据库中。当一辆汽车售出时，需要从网站上移除该在售信息，并且必须将数据发送到多个目标系统。
解决方案架构师应推荐哪种设计？

stem_en: A company needs to store data in Amazon S3 and must prevent the data from being changed. The company wants new objects that are uploaded to Amazon S3 to remain unchangeable for a nonspecific amount of time until the company decides to modify the objects. Only specific users in the company's AWS account can have the ability 10 delete the objects. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an S3 Glacier vault. Apply a write-once, read-many (WORM) vault lock policy to the objects.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 S3 Glacier 保管库。对这些对象应用一次写入、多次读取（WORM）的保管库锁定策略。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled. Enable versioning. Set a retention period of 100 years. Use governance mode as the S3 bucket’s default retention mode for new objects.
options.text_zh: 创建一个启用了 S3 Object Lock 的 S3 存储桶。启用版本控制。设置 100 年的保留期。把治理模式（governance mode）设为该 S3 存储桶对新对象的默认保留模式。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket. Use AWS CloudTrail to track any S3 API events that modify the objects. Upon notification, restore the modified objects from any backup versions that the company has.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 S3 存储桶。使用 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪任何修改对象的 S3 API 事件。收到通知后，从公司持有的任意备份版本恢复被修改的对象。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled. Enable versioning. Add a legal hold to the objects. Add the s3:PutObjectLegalHold permission to the IAM policies of users who need to delete the objects.
options.text_zh: 创建一个启用了 S3 Object Lock 的 S3 存储桶。启用版本控制。为对象添加合法保留（legal hold）。为需要删除对象的用户的 IAM 策略添加 s3:PutObjectLegalHold 权限。

stem_zh:
某公司需要在 Amazon S3 中存储数据，并且必须防止数据被更改。公司希望上传到 Amazon S3 的新对象在一段不确定的时间内保持不可更改，直到公司决定修改这些对象为止。只有公司 AWS 账户中的特定用户才能拥有删除这些对象的权限。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A social media company allows users to upload images to its website. The website runs on Amazon EC2 instances. During upload requests, the website resizes the images to a standard size and stores the resized images in Amazon S3. Users are experiencing slow upload requests to the website. The company needs to reduce coupling within the application and improve website performance. A solutions architect must design the most operationally efficient process for image uploads. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Configure the application to upload images to S3 Glacier.
options.text_zh: 配置应用程序把图片上传到 S3 Glacier。

options.text_en: Configure the web server to upload the original images to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 配置 Web 服务器把原始图片上传到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Configure the application to upload images directly from each user's browser to Amazon S3 through the use of a presigned URL
options.text_zh: 配置应用程序通过预签名 URL 直接从每位用户的浏览器把图片上传到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Configure S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded. Use the function to resize the image.
options.text_zh: 配置 S3 事件通知，在有图片上传时调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用该函数调整图片尺寸。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to resize uploaded images.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，按计划调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调整已上传图片的尺寸。

stem_zh:
某社交媒体公司允许用户向其网站上传图片。该网站运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。在上传请求期间，网站会将图片调整为标准尺寸，并将调整后的图片存储在 Amazon S3 中。用户在向网站上传时遇到速度缓慢的问题。
公司需要降低应用程序内部的耦合并提升网站性能。解决方案架构师必须为图片上传设计一个在运维上最高效的流程。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company recently migrated a message processing system to AWS. The system receives messages into an ActiveMQ queue running on an Amazon EC2 instance. Messages are processed by a consumer application running on Amazon EC2. The consumer application processes the messages and writes results to a MySQL database running on Amazon EC2. The company wants this application to be highly available with low operational complexity. Which architecture offers the HIGHEST availability?

options.text_en: Add a second ActiveMQ server to another Availability Zone. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 在另一个可用区中增加第二台 ActiveMQ 服务器。在另一个可用区中增加一台消费者 EC2 实例。把 MySQL 数据库复制到另一个可用区。

options.text_en: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon MQ，并跨两个可用区配置主/备代理。在另一个可用区中增加一台消费者 EC2 实例。把 MySQL 数据库复制到另一个可用区。

options.text_en: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon MQ，并跨两个可用区配置主/备代理。在另一个可用区中增加一台消费者 EC2 实例。使用启用了多可用区的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。

options.text_en: Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an Auto Scaling group for the consumer EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon MQ，并跨两个可用区配置主/备代理。为消费者 EC2 实例跨两个可用区添加一个 Auto Scaling 组。使用启用了多可用区的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。

stem_zh:
某公司最近将一个消息处理系统迁移到了 AWS。该系统将消息接收到运行在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 ActiveMQ 队列中。消息由运行在 Amazon EC2 上的消费者应用程序处理。该消费者应用程序处理消息并将结果写入运行在 Amazon EC2 上的 MySQL 数据库。公司希望该应用程序在运维复杂度较低的前提下具备高可用性。
哪种架构提供最高的可用性？

stem_en: A company hosts a containerized web application on a fleet of on-premises servers that process incoming requests. The number of requests is growing quickly. The on-premises servers cannot handle the increased number of requests. The company wants to move the application to AWS with minimum code changes and minimum development effort. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS Fargate on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run the containerized web application with Service Auto Scaling. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）上使用 AWS Fargate 运行该容器化 Web 应用程序，并启用服务 Auto Scaling。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发传入请求。

options.text_en: Use two Amazon EC2 instances to host the containerized web application. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
options.text_zh: 使用两台 Amazon EC2 实例托管该容器化 Web 应用程序。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发传入请求。

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda with a new code that uses one of the supported languages. Create multiple Lambda functions to support the load. Use Amazon API Gateway as an entry point to the Lambda functions.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda，用其支持的某种语言重写代码。创建多个 Lambda 函数以支撑负载。使用 Amazon API Gateway 作为这些 Lambda 函数的入口。

options.text_en: Use a high performance computing (HPC) solution such as AWS ParallelCluster to establish an HPC cluster that can process the incoming requests at the appropriate scale.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS ParallelCluster 等高性能计算（HPC）方案搭建一个 HPC 集群，以适当的规模处理传入请求。

stem_zh:
某公司在一组本地服务器上托管一个容器化 Web 应用程序来处理传入请求。请求数量正在快速增长。本地服务器已无法处理增加的请求量。公司希望以最少的代码改动和最少的开发工作量将该应用程序迁移到 AWS。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses 50 TB of data for reporting. The company wants to move this data from on premises to AWS. A custom application in the company’s data center runs a weekly data transformation job. The company plans to pause the application until the data transfer is complete and needs to begin the transfer process as soon as possible. The data center does not have any available network bandwidth for additional workloads. A solutions architect must transfer the data and must configure the transformation job to continue to run in the AWS Cloud. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to move the data. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync 迁移数据。使用 AWS Glue 创建一个自定义转换作业。

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowcone device to move the data. Deploy the transformation application to the device.
options.text_zh: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备迁移数据。把转换应用程序部署到该设备上。

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Copy the data to the device. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
options.text_zh: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge 存储优化型设备。把数据复制到该设备。使用 AWS Glue 创建一个自定义转换作业。

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device that includes Amazon EC2 compute. Copy the data to the device. Create a new EC2 instance on AWS to run the transformation application.
options.text_zh: 订购一台包含 Amazon EC2 计算能力的 AWS Snowball Edge 存储优化型设备。把数据复制到该设备。在 AWS 上新建一台 EC2 实例来运行转换应用程序。

stem_zh:
某公司有 50 TB 数据用于报表。公司希望将这些数据从本地迁移到 AWS。公司数据中心中的一个自定义应用程序每周运行一次数据转换作业。公司计划在数据传输完成前暂停该应用程序，并且需要尽快开始传输过程。
该数据中心没有可用于额外工作负载的网络带宽。解决方案架构师必须传输这些数据，并且必须配置该转换作业使其继续在 AWS 云中运行。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has created an image analysis application in which users can upload photos and add photo frames to their images. The users upload images and metadata to indicate which photo frames they want to add to their images. The application uses a single Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon DynamoDB to store the metadata. The application is becoming more popular, and the number of users is increasing. The company expects the number of concurrent users to vary significantly depending on the time of day and day of week. The company must ensure that the application can scale to meet the needs of the growing user base. Which solution meats these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos and metadata in DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 处理照片。把照片和元数据都存储在 DynamoDB 中。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to process the photos and to store the photos and metadata.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 处理照片，并存储照片和元数据。

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos in Amazon S3. Retain DynamoDB to store the metadata.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 处理照片。把照片存储在 Amazon S3 中，继续用 DynamoDB 存储元数据。

options.text_en: Increase the number of EC2 instances to three. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to store the photos and metadata.
options.text_zh: 把 EC2 实例数量增加到三台。使用预置 IOPS SSD（io2）Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷存储照片和元数据。

stem_zh:
某公司创建了一个图像分析应用程序，用户可以上传照片并为图像添加相框。用户上传图像和元数据，以指明希望为图像添加哪种相框。该应用程序使用单台 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储元数据。
该应用程序越来越受欢迎，用户数量不断增加。公司预计并发用户数会随一天中的时段和一周中的日期而显著变化。公司必须确保该应用程序能够扩展以满足不断增长的用户群需求。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A medical records company is hosting an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes customer data files that are stored on Amazon S3. The EC2 instances are hosted in public subnets. The EC2 instances access Amazon S3 over the internet, but they do not require any other network access. A new requirement mandates that the network traffic for file transfers take a private route and not be sent over the internet. Which change to the network architecture should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the route table for the public subnets to send traffic to Amazon S3 through the NAT gateway.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 NAT 网关。配置公有子网的路由表，让发往 Amazon S3 的流量经由该 NAT 网关。

options.text_en: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances to restrict outbound traffic so that only traffic to the S3 prefix list is permitted.
options.text_zh: 配置这些 EC2 实例的安全组以限制出站流量，只允许发往 S3 前缀列表的流量。

options.text_en: Move the EC2 instances to private subnets. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3, and link the endpoint to the route table for the private subnets.
options.text_zh: 把 EC2 实例迁移到私有子网。为 Amazon S3 创建一个 VPC 终端节点，并把该终端节点关联到私有子网的路由表。

options.text_en: Remove the internet gateway from the VPC. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection, and route traffic to Amazon S3 over the Direct Connect connection.
options.text_zh: 从该 VPC 移除互联网网关。建立一条 AWS Direct Connect 连接，让发往 Amazon S3 的流量经由该 Direct Connect 连接。

stem_zh:
某医疗记录公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个应用程序。该应用程序处理存储在 Amazon S3 上的客户数据文件。这些 EC2 实例托管在公有子网中。EC2 实例通过互联网访问 Amazon S3，但它们不需要任何其他网络访问。
一项新要求规定，文件传输的网络流量必须走私有路径，不得经由互联网发送。
解决方案架构师应推荐对网络架构做哪些更改以满足此要求？

stem_en: A company uses a popular content management system (CMS) for its corporate website. However, the required patching and maintenance are burdensome. The company is redesigning its website and wants anew solution. The website will be updated four times a year and does not need to have any dynamic content available. The solution must provide high scalability and enhanced security. Which combination of changes will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudFront in front of the website to use HTTPS functionality.
options.text_zh: 在网站前面配置 Amazon CloudFront 以使用 HTTPS 功能。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL in front of the website to provide HTTPS functionality.
options.text_zh: 在网站前面部署一个 AWS WAF web ACL 以提供 HTTPS 功能。

options.text_en: Create and deploy an AWS Lambda function to manage and serve the website content.
options.text_zh: 创建并部署一个 AWS Lambda 函数来管理和提供网站内容。

options.text_en: Create the new website and an Amazon S3 bucket. Deploy the website on the S3 bucket with static website hosting enabled.
options.text_zh: 创建新网站和一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。启用静态网站托管，把网站部署在该 S3 存储桶上。

options.text_en: Create the new website. Deploy the website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 创建新网站。使用一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组来部署该网站。

stem_zh:
某公司为其企业网站使用一款流行的内容管理系统（CMS）。但所需的补丁和维护工作负担沉重。公司正在重新设计其网站，希望有一个新方案。该网站每年更新四次，不需要提供任何动态内容。该方案必须提供高可扩展性和增强的安全性。
哪些更改组合能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company stores its application logs in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A new policy requires the company to store all application logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) in near-real time. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription to stream the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.text_zh: 配置一个 CloudWatch Logs 订阅，把日志流式传输到 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function. Use the log group to invoke the function to write the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。用该日志组调用此函数，把日志写入 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the log group as the delivery streams sources. Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) as the delivery stream's destination.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。把该日志组配置为传输流的数据源，把 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）配置为传输流的目标。

options.text_en: Install and configure Amazon Kinesis Agent on each application server to deliver the logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Configure Kinesis Data Streams to deliver the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.text_zh: 在每台应用服务器上安装并配置 Amazon Kinesis Agent，把日志传输到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。再配置 Kinesis Data Streams 把日志传输到 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）。

explanation_en: Explanation: CloudWatch Logs supports a native subscription filter that streams straight to OpenSearch Service, so routing through Kinesis Data Firehose is an unnecessary extra hop for this requirement.
explanation_zh: 解析：CloudWatch Logs 原生支持直接流式传输到 OpenSearch Service 的订阅筛选条件，因此对于此需求来说，经由 Kinesis Data Firehose 中转是多余的一跳。
stem_zh:
某公司将其应用程序日志存储在一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组中。一项新政策要求公司近实时地将所有应用程序日志存储到 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）中。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足此要求？

stem_en: A company is building a web-based application running on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. The web application will provide access to a repository of text documents totaling about 900 TB in size. The company anticipates that the web application will experience periods of high demand. A solutions architect must ensure that the storage component for the text documents can scale to meet the demand of the application at all times. The company is concerned about the overall cost of the solution. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）

options.text_en: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
options.text_zh: Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）

options.text_en: Amazon S3
options.text_zh: Amazon S3

stem_zh:
某公司正在构建一个基于 Web 的应用程序，运行在多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 Web 应用程序将提供对一个文本文档库的访问，总容量约为 900 TB。公司预计该 Web 应用程序会经历高需求时段。解决方案架构师必须确保这些文本文档的存储组件能够随时扩展以满足应用程序需求。公司关注方案的整体成本。
哪个存储方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A global company is using Amazon API Gateway to design REST APIs for its loyalty club users in the us-east-1 Region and the ap-southeast-2 Region. A solutions architect must design a solution to protect these API Gateway managed REST APIs across multiple accounts from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?

options.text_en: Set up AWS WAF in both Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
options.text_zh: 在两个区域中都设置 AWS WAF。把区域性 web ACL 与某个 API 阶段关联。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Firewall Manager in both Regions. Centrally configure AWS WAF rules.
options.text_zh: 在两个区域中都设置 AWS Firewall Manager。集中配置 AWS WAF 规则。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Shield in bath Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
options.text_zh: 在两个区域中都设置 AWS Shield。把区域性 web ACL 与某个 API 阶段关联。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Shield in one of the Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
options.text_zh: 在其中一个区域设置 AWS Shield。把区域性 web ACL 与某个 API 阶段关联。

stem_zh:
某跨国公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway，为其位于 us-east-1 区域和 ap-southeast-2 区域的会员俱乐部用户设计 REST API。解决方案架构师必须设计一个方案，保护这些跨多个账户的 API Gateway 托管 REST API 免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击。
哪个方案能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-west- 2 Region. Most of the company's users are located in the United States and Europe. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the solution. The company launches and configures three EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region and adds the EC2 instances as targets for a new NLB. Which solution can the company use to route traffic to all the EC2 instances?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，把请求路由到两个 NLB 之一。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以该 Route 53 记录作为分配的源站。

options.text_en: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个标准加速器。在 us-west-2 和 eu-west-1 创建终端节点组，把这两个 NLB 作为终端节点添加进去。

options.text_en: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.
options.text_zh: 为这六台 EC2 实例挂载弹性 IP 地址。创建一条 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，把请求路由到六台 EC2 实例之一。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以该 Route 53 记录作为分配的源站。

options.text_en: Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
options.text_zh: 用两个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）替换这两个 NLB。创建一条 Amazon Route 53 延迟路由策略，把请求路由到两个 ALB 之一。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以该 Route 53 记录作为分配的源站。

explanation_en:
endpoints for the endpoint groups.

Explanation: 
| Option | Why eliminated                      |
| ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| A      | CloudFront doesn’t support DNS      |
| B      | ✅ Correct — TCP/UDP, global, HA     |
| C      | Fragile, wrong protocol, CloudFront |
| D      | ALB + CloudFront breaks DNS         |
explanation_zh:
解析：
| 选项 | 排除原因                            |
| ---- | ----------------------------------- |
| A    | CloudFront 不支持 DNS               |
| B    | ✅ 正确 —— 支持 TCP/UDP、全球、高可用 |
| C    | 脆弱、协议不对、用了 CloudFront     |
| D    | ALB + CloudFront 会破坏 DNS         |
stem_zh:
某公司在 us-west-2 区域的一个 Network Load Balancer（NLB）之后的三台 Amazon EC2 实例上实施了一套自管理的 DNS 方案。公司的大多数用户位于美国和欧洲。公司希望提升该方案的性能和可用性。公司在 eu-west-1 区域启动并配置了三台 EC2 实例，并将这些 EC2 实例作为新 NLB 的目标添加。
公司可以使用哪个方案将流量路由到所有这些 EC2 实例？

stem_en: A company is running an online transaction processing (OLTP) workload on AWS. This workload uses an unencrypted Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Daily database snapshots are taken from this instance. What should a solutions architect do to ensure the database and snapshots are always encrypted moving forward?

options.text_en: Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot.
options.text_zh: 加密最新数据库快照的一份副本。通过恢复该加密快照来替换现有的数据库实例。

options.text_en: Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB instance.
options.text_zh: 创建一个新的加密 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷并把快照复制进去。在该数据库实例上启用加密。

options.text_en: Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing DB instance.
options.text_zh: 复制快照并使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）启用加密。把加密后的快照恢复到现有数据库实例。

options.text_en: Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS).
options.text_zh: 把快照复制到一个使用带 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）托管密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行一个联机事务处理（OLTP）工作负载。该工作负载使用一个未加密的、采用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。每天都会从该实例生成数据库快照。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能确保今后数据库和快照始终处于加密状态？

stem_en: A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications. What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?

options.text_en: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
options.text_zh: 使用多重身份验证（MFA）保护加密密钥。

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）保护加密密钥。

options.text_en: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）创建、存储和分配加密密钥。

options.text_en: Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.
options.text_zh: 使用一条 IAM 策略限制拥有访问权限的用户范围，以保护加密密钥。

stem_zh:
某公司希望构建一套可扩展的密钥管理基础设施，以支持需要在其应用程序中加密数据的开发人员。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做来减轻运维负担？

stem_en: A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination. There has been an increase in traffic recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit. What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?

options.text_en: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）创建一份新的 SSL 证书。在每台实例上安装该 ACM 证书。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。把 SSL 证书迁移到该 S3 存储桶。配置这些 EC2 实例引用该存储桶来完成 SSL 终止。

options.text_en: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 再创建一台 EC2 实例作为代理服务器。把 SSL 证书迁移到这台新实例，并配置它把连接转发到现有的 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM.
options.text_zh: 把该 SSL 证书导入 AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）。创建一个带 HTTPS 侦听器的 Application Load Balancer，使用来自 ACM 的 SSL 证书。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个托管在两台 Amazon EC2 实例上的动态 Web 应用程序。公司拥有自己的 SSL 证书，该证书部署在每台实例上以执行 SSL 终止。
最近流量有所增加，运维团队确定 SSL 加解密导致 Web 服务器的计算能力达到上限。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做来提升应用程序性能？

stem_en: A company has a highly dynamic batch processing job that uses many Amazon EC2 instances to complete it. The job is stateless in nature, can be started and stopped at any given time with no negative impact, and typically takes upwards of 60 minutes total to complete. The company has asked a solutions architect to design a scalable and cost-effective solution that meets the requirements of the job. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Implement EC2 Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 采用 EC2 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances.
options.text_zh: 购买 EC2 预留实例。

options.text_en: Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances.
options.text_zh: 采用 EC2 按需实例。

options.text_en: Implement the processing on AWS Lambda.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Lambda 上实现该处理过程。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个高度动态的批处理作业，使用许多 Amazon EC2 实例来完成。该作业本质上是无状态的，可以在任意时刻启动和停止而不会产生负面影响，通常总共需要 60 分钟以上才能完成。公司请解决方案架构师设计一个可扩展且具有成本效益的方案，以满足该作业的需求。
解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: A company runs its two-tier ecommerce website on AWS. The web tier consists of a load balancer that sends traffic to Amazon EC2 instances. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS DB instance. The EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance should not be exposed to the public internet. The EC2 instances require internet access to complete payment processing of orders through a third-party web service. The application must be highly available. Which combination of configuration options will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.text_zh: 使用 Auto Scaling 组在私有子网中启动 EC2 实例。在私有子网中部署一个 RDS 多可用区数据库实例。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 VPC，跨两个可用区包含两个私有子网和两个 NAT 网关。在私有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。
