options.text_en: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.text_zh: 使用 Auto Scaling 组跨两个可用区在公有子网中启动 EC2 实例。在私有子网中部署一个 RDS 多可用区数据库实例。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 VPC，跨两个可用区包含一个公有子网、一个私有子网和两个 NAT 网关。在该公有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 VPC，跨两个可用区包含两个公有子网、两个私有子网和两个 NAT 网关。在这些公有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。

stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行其两层电子商务网站。Web 层由一个将流量发送到 Amazon EC2 实例的负载均衡器组成。数据库层使用一个 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。EC2 实例和 RDS 数据库实例都不应暴露给公共互联网。EC2 实例需要访问互联网，以便通过第三方 Web 服务完成订单的支付处理。该应用程序必须高可用。
哪些配置选项组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to reduce a company's storage costs. All the company's data is in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. The company must keep all data for at least 25 years. Data from the most recent 2 years must be highly available and immediately retrievable. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately.
options.text_zh: 设置一条 S3 生命周期策略，立即把对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
options.text_zh: 设置一条 S3 生命周期策略，在 2 年后把对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。启用归档选项以确保数据被归档到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
options.text_zh: 设置一条 S3 生命周期策略，立即把对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access（S3 One Zone-IA），并在 2 年后转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要实施一个方案来降低公司的存储成本。公司的所有数据都在 Amazon S3 Standard 存储类中。公司必须将所有数据至少保存 25 年。最近 2 年的数据必须高可用且能够立即检索。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A media company is evaluating the possibility of moving its systems to the AWS Cloud. The company needs at least 10 TB of storage with the maximum possible I/O performance for video processing, 300 TB of very durable storage for storing media content, and 900 TB of storage to meet requirements for archival media that is not in use anymore. Which set of services should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EBS 获得最高性能，用 Amazon S3 做持久数据存储，用 Amazon S3 Glacier 做归档存储

options.text_en: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EBS 获得最高性能，用 Amazon EFS 做持久数据存储，用 Amazon S3 Glacier 做归档存储

options.text_en: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 for archival storage
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EC2 实例存储获得最高性能，用 Amazon EFS 做持久数据存储，用 Amazon S3 做归档存储

options.text_en: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EC2 实例存储获得最高性能，用 Amazon S3 做持久数据存储，用 Amazon S3 Glacier 做归档存储

explanation_en: Note: this one is genuinely disputed in the community and I could not find a fully authoritative answer key. The case for D (instance store): local NVMe instance store bypasses the network and can outperform EBS, matching "maximum possible" I/O. The case for A (Amazon EBS instead of instance store): instance store is ephemeral (data lost on stop/terminate), which may conflict with the durability expectations implied elsewhere in the question, and EBS io2 Block Express also offers very high IOPS. Treat this answer with lower confidence than the others in this file.
explanation_zh: 注：这道题在社区中确实存在争议，我未能找到完全权威的答案。支持 D（实例存储）的理由：本地 NVMe 实例存储绕过网络，性能可以超过 EBS，符合"尽可能高"的 I/O 要求。支持 A（用 Amazon EBS 代替实例存储）的理由：实例存储是临时性的（停止或终止实例时数据会丢失），这可能与题目其他部分隐含的持久性预期相冲突，而且 EBS io2 Block Express 同样能提供极高的 IOPS。请以低于本文件中其他答案的置信度看待此答案。
stem_zh:
某媒体公司正在评估将其系统迁移到 AWS 云的可能性。公司需要至少 10 TB 具有尽可能高的 I/O 性能的存储用于视频处理，需要 300 TB 高持久性存储用于存放媒体内容，还需要 900 TB 存储以满足存放不再使用的归档媒体的需求。
解决方案架构师应推荐哪组服务来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to run applications in containers in the AWS Cloud. These applications are stateless and can tolerate disruptions within the underlying infrastructure. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Spot 实例来运行应用程序容器。

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）托管节点组中使用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中使用按需实例来运行应用程序容器。

options.text_en: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）托管节点组中使用按需实例。

stem_zh:
某公司希望在 AWS 云中以容器方式运行应用程序。这些应用程序是无状态的，能够容忍底层基础设施内部的中断。公司需要一个能最大限度降低成本和运维开销的方案。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is running a multi-tier web application on premises. The web application is containerized and runs on a number of Linux hosts connected to a PostgreSQL database that contains user records. The operational overhead of maintaining the infrastructure and capacity planning is limiting the company's growth. A solutions architect must improve the application's infrastructure. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora。

options.text_en: Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把该 Web 应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例上托管。

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content.
options.text_zh: 为该 Web 应用程序的内容设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

options.text_en: Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database.
options.text_zh: 在该 Web 应用程序与 PostgreSQL 数据库之间设置 Amazon ElastiCache。

options.text_en: Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).
options.text_zh: 把该 Web 应用程序迁移到使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）的 AWS Fargate 上托管。

stem_zh:
某公司在本地运行一个多层 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序已容器化，运行在若干 Linux 主机上，并连接到一个包含用户记录的 PostgreSQL 数据库。维护基础设施和容量规划的运维开销正在限制公司的发展。解决方案架构师必须改进该应用程序的基础设施。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合来实现这一点？（选择两项。）

stem_en: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zonas. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%. What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?

options.text_en: Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 使用简单伸缩策略动态伸缩该 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 使用目标跟踪策略动态伸缩该 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function ta update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity.
options.text_zh: 使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数更新该 Auto Scaling 组的期望容量。

options.text_en: Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 使用计划伸缩操作来扩容和缩容该 Auto Scaling 组。

stem_zh:
某应用程序运行在跨多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些实例运行在一个位于 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中。当 EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率达到或接近 40% 时，该应用程序性能最佳。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能在该组的所有实例上保持理想性能？

stem_en: A company is developing a file-sharing application that will use an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The company wants to serve all the files through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company does not want the files to be accessible through direct navigation to the S3 URL. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access.
options.text_zh: 为每个 S3 存储桶单独编写策略，只授予 CloudFront 访问的读取权限。

options.text_en: Create an IAM user. Grant the user read permission to objects in the S3 bucket. Assign the user to CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 IAM 用户。授予该用户对 S3 存储桶中对象的读取权限，并把该用户分配给 CloudFront。

options.text_en: Write an S3 bucket policy that assigns the CloudFront distribution ID as the Principal and assigns the target S3 bucket as the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.text_zh: 编写一条 S3 存储桶策略，把 CloudFront 分配 ID 指定为 Principal，把目标 S3 存储桶指定为 Amazon 资源名称（ARN）。

options.text_en: Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket permissions so that only the OAI has read permission.
options.text_zh: 创建一个源访问身份（OAI）。把该 OAI 分配给该 CloudFront 分配。配置 S3 存储桶权限，使只有该 OAI 拥有读取权限。

stem_zh:
某公司正在开发一个文件共享应用程序，将使用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶进行存储。公司希望通过一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配来提供所有文件。公司不希望这些文件可以通过直接访问 S3 URL 来获取。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company’s website provides users with downloadable historical performance reports. The website needs a solution that will scale to meet the company’s website demands globally. The solution should be cost-effective, limit the provisioning of infrastructure resources, and provide the fastest possible response time. Which combination should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3
options.text_zh: Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3

options.text_en: AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
options.text_zh: AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB

options.text_en: Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.text_zh: Application Load Balancer 配合 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling

options.text_en: Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers
options.text_zh: Amazon Route 53 配合内部 Application Load Balancer

stem_zh:
某公司的网站为用户提供可下载的历史绩效报告。该网站需要一个能够在全球范围内扩展以满足网站需求的方案。该方案应具有成本效益，尽量减少基础设施资源的预置，并提供尽可能快的响应时间。
解决方案架构师应推荐哪种组合来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs an Oracle database on premises. As part of the company’s migration to AWS, the company wants to upgrade the database to the most recent available version. The company also wants to set up disaster recovery (DR) for the database. The company needs to minimize the operational overhead for normal operations and DR setup. The company also needs to maintain access to the database's underlying operating system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 Oracle 数据库迁移到一台 Amazon EC2 实例。设置到另一个 AWS 区域的数据库复制。

options.text_en: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。启用跨区域自动备份，把快照复制到另一个 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle。在另一个 AWS 区域为该数据库创建只读副本。

options.text_en: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。在另一个可用区创建一个备用数据库。

stem_zh:
某公司在本地运行一个 Oracle 数据库。作为向 AWS 迁移的一部分，公司希望将该数据库升级到可用的最新版本。公司还希望为该数据库设置灾难恢复（DR）。公司需要尽量降低日常运维和 DR 设置的运维开销。公司还需要保持对数据库底层操作系统的访问权限。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing and new data by using SL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data requires encryption and must be replicated to a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region kays (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.text_zh: 创建一个新的 S3 存储桶并把数据加载进去。使用 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）把加密对象复制到另一个区域的 S3 存储桶。使用带 AWS KMS 多区域密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。

options.text_en: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.
options.text_zh: 创建一个新的 S3 存储桶并把数据加载进去。使用 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）把加密对象复制到另一个区域的 S3 存储桶。使用带 AWS KMS 多区域密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。

options.text_en: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把数据加载到现有 S3 存储桶。使用 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）把加密对象复制到另一个区域的 S3 存储桶。使用带 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。

options.text_en: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把数据加载到现有 S3 存储桶。使用 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）把加密对象复制到另一个区域的 S3 存储桶。使用带 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。

stem_zh:
某公司希望将其应用程序迁移到无服务器方案。该无服务器方案需要使用 SQL 分析现有数据和新数据。公司将数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。数据需要加密，并且必须复制到另一个 AWS 区域。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the provider's VPC. According to the company’s security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The connection must be initiated only from the company’s VPC. Which solution will mast these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service.
options.text_zh: 在公司 VPC 与提供商 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接。更新路由表以连接到目标服务。

options.text_en: Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
options.text_zh: 请提供商在其 VPC 中创建一个虚拟专用网关。使用 AWS PrivateLink 连接到目标服务。

options.text_en: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPUpdate the route table to connect to the target service.
options.text_zh: 在公司 VPC 的公有子网中创建一个 NAT 网关。更新路由表以连接到目标服务。

options.text_en: Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
options.text_zh: 请提供商为目标服务创建一个 VPC 终端节点服务。使用 AWS PrivateLink 连接到目标服务。

stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行工作负载。公司需要连接到一家外部提供商的服务。该服务托管在提供商的 VPC 中。根据公司安全团队的要求，该连接必须是私有的，且必须限制为仅访问目标服务。连接只能从公司的 VPC 发起。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is migrating its on-premises PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The on-premises database must remain online and accessible during the migration. The Aurora database must remain synchronized with the on-premises database. Which combination of actions must a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create an ongoing replication task.
options.text_zh: 创建一个持续复制任务。

options.text_en: Create a database backup of the on-premises database.
options.text_zh: 创建本地数据库的数据库备份。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication server.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Database Migration Service（AWS DMS）复制服务器。

options.text_en: Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT).
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool（AWS SCT）转换数据库架构。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则来监控数据库同步。

stem_zh:
某公司正在将其本地 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。本地数据库在迁移期间必须保持在线且可访问。Aurora 数据库必须与本地数据库保持同步。
解决方案架构师必须采取哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company uses AWS Organizations to create dedicated AWS accounts for each business unit to manage each business unit's account independently upon request. The root email recipient missed a notification that was sent to the root user email address of one account. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications are not missed. Future notifications must be limited to account administrators. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure the company’s email server to forward notification email messages that are sent to the AWS account root user email address to all users in the organization.
options.text_zh: 配置公司的邮件服务器，把发送到 AWS 账户 root 用户邮箱地址的通知邮件转发给组织内所有用户。

options.text_en: Configure all AWS account root user email addresses as distribution lists that go to a few administrators who can respond to alerts. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
options.text_zh: 把所有 AWS 账户 root 用户的邮箱地址配置为通讯组列表，指向少数几位能够响应告警的管理员。在 AWS Organizations 控制台中或以编程方式配置 AWS 账户的备用联系人。

options.text_en: Configure all AWS account root user email messages to be sent to one administrator who is responsible for monitoring alerts and forwarding those alerts to the appropriate groups.
options.text_zh: 把所有 AWS 账户 root 用户的邮件都发送给一位管理员，由他负责监控告警并转发给相应的团队。

options.text_en: Configure all existing AWS accounts and all newly created accounts to use the same root user email address. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
options.text_zh: 把所有现有 AWS 账户和新建账户都配置为使用同一个 root 用户邮箱地址。在 AWS Organizations 控制台中或以编程方式配置 AWS 账户的备用联系人。

explanation_en: Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
explanation_zh: 在 AWS Organizations 控制台中或以编程方式配置 AWS 账户的备用联系人。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS Organizations 为每个业务部门创建专用的 AWS 账户，以便按请求独立管理各业务部门的账户。某个账户的 root 用户邮箱收件人漏看了一封发送到该 root 用户邮箱地址的通知。公司希望确保今后所有通知都不会被漏看。今后的通知必须仅限于账户管理员。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs its ecommerce application on AWS. Every new order is published as a massage in a RabbitMQ queue that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a single Availability Zone. These messages are processed by a different application that runs on a separate EC2 instance. This application stores the details in a PostgreSQL database on another EC2 instance. All the EC2 instances are in the same Availability Zone. The company needs to redesign its architecture to provide the highest availability with the least operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database.
options.text_zh: 把该队列迁移到 Amazon MQ 上的一对冗余（主/备）RabbitMQ 实例。为托管该应用程序的 EC2 实例创建一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。再为托管 PostgreSQL 数据库的 EC2 实例创建另一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
options.text_zh: 把该队列迁移到 Amazon MQ 上的一对冗余（主/备）RabbitMQ 实例。为托管该应用程序的 EC2 实例创建一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。把数据库迁移到运行在多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上。

options.text_en: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
options.text_zh: 为托管 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 实例创建一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。再为托管该应用程序的 EC2 实例创建另一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。把数据库迁移到运行在多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上。

options.text_en: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create a third Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database
options.text_zh: 为托管 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 实例创建一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。再为托管该应用程序的 EC2 实例创建另一个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组。第三个跨多可用区的 Auto Scaling 组用于托管 PostgreSQL 数据库的 EC2 实例。

stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行其电子商务应用程序。每个新订单都会作为一条消息发布到运行在单个可用区中某台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 RabbitMQ 队列。这些消息由运行在另一台 EC2 实例上的另一个应用程序处理。该应用程序将详细信息存储到又一台 EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库中。所有 EC2 实例都在同一个可用区中。
公司需要重新设计其架构，以最少的运维开销提供最高的可用性。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A reporting team receives files each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The reporting team manually reviews and copies the files from this initial S3 bucket to an analysis S3 bucket each day at the same time to use with Amazon QuickSight. Additional teams are starting to send more files in larger sizes to the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team wants to move the files automatically analysis S3 bucket as the files enter the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team also wants to use AWS Lambda functions to run pattern-matching code on the copied data. In addition, the reporting team wants to send the data files to a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Lambda 函数把文件复制到分析用 S3 存储桶。为分析用 S3 存储桶创建 S3 事件通知，把 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为事件通知的目标，事件类型配置为 s3:ObjectCreated:Put。

options.text_en: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Lambda 函数把文件复制到分析用 S3 存储桶。配置分析用 S3 存储桶向 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）发送事件通知。在 EventBridge（CloudWatch Events）中配置一条 ObjectCreated 规则，把 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该规则的目标。

options.text_en: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.text_zh: 在两个 S3 存储桶之间配置 S3 复制。为分析用 S3 存储桶创建 S3 事件通知，把 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为事件通知的目标，事件类型配置为 s3:ObjectCreated:Put。

options.text_en: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.
options.text_zh: 在两个 S3 存储桶之间配置 S3 复制。配置分析用 S3 存储桶向 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）发送事件通知。在 EventBridge（CloudWatch Events）中配置一条 ObjectCreated 规则，把 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该规则的目标。

explanation_en:
Configure an EventBridge rule for the s3:ObjectCreated:Put event to invoke an AWS Lambda function for pattern-matching and to start the pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines.

Explanation: S3 replication removes the need for a custom Lambda function to copy files (least operational overhead). A plain S3 event notification can only target SNS, SQS, Lambda, or EventBridge directly — it cannot target SageMaker Pipelines. Routing through EventBridge is what lets a single ObjectCreated event fan out to both the pattern-matching Lambda function and the SageMaker Pipelines pipeline.
explanation_zh:
为 s3:ObjectCreated:Put 事件配置一条 EventBridge 规则，用于调用一个进行模式匹配的 AWS Lambda 函数，并启动 Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 中的流水线。

解析：S3 复制免去了编写自定义 Lambda 函数来复制文件的需要（运维开销最少）。普通的 S3 事件通知只能直接以 SNS、SQS、Lambda 或 EventBridge 为目标——它无法直接以 SageMaker Pipelines 为目标。经由 EventBridge 中转，才能让单个 ObjectCreated 事件同时扇出到模式匹配 Lambda 函数和 SageMaker Pipelines 流水线。
stem_zh:
某报表团队每天在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中接收文件。报表团队每天在同一时间手动审查并将文件从这个初始 S3 存储桶复制到一个分析用 S3 存储桶，以便与 Amazon QuickSight 配合使用。更多团队开始向初始 S3 存储桶发送数量更多、体积更大的文件。
报表团队希望在文件进入初始 S3 存储桶时自动将其移动到分析用 S3 存储桶。报表团队还希望使用 AWS Lambda 函数对复制后的数据运行模式匹配代码。此外，报表团队希望将数据文件发送到 Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 中的一条流水线。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to help a company optimize the cost of running an application on AWS. The application will use Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda for compute within the architecture. The EC2 instances will run the data ingestion layer of the application. EC2 usage will be sporadic and unpredictable. Workloads that run on EC2 instances can be interrupted at any time. The application front end will run on Fargate, and Lambda will serve the API layer. The front-end utilization and API layer utilization will be predictable over the course of the next year. Which combination of purchasing options will provide the MOST cost-effective solution for hosting this application? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer
options.text_zh: 数据摄取层使用 Spot 实例

options.text_en: Use On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer
options.text_zh: 数据摄取层使用按需实例

options.text_en: Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.
options.text_zh: 为前端和 API 层购买 1 年期的 Compute Savings Plan。

options.text_en: Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved instances for the data ingestion layer.
options.text_zh: 为数据摄取层购买 1 年期全预付（All Upfront）预留实例。

options.text_en: Purchase a 1-year EC2 instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.
options.text_zh: 为前端和 API 层购买 1 年期的 EC2 实例 Savings Plan。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要帮助某公司优化在 AWS 上运行应用程序的成本。该应用程序在架构中将使用 Amazon EC2 实例、AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 作为计算资源。
EC2 实例将运行该应用程序的数据摄取层。EC2 的使用是零星且不可预测的。运行在 EC2 实例上的工作负载可以在任意时刻被中断。应用程序前端将运行在 Fargate 上，Lambda 将承载 API 层。前端和 API 层的使用率在未来一年内是可预测的。
哪种购买选项组合能为托管该应用程序提供最具成本效益的方案？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across the world as quickly as possible. How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?

options.text_en: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin.
options.text_zh: 在单个 AWS 区域部署该应用程序栈。使用 Amazon CloudFront 并指定该 ALB 为源站，来提供所有静态和动态内容。

options.text_en: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
options.text_zh: 在两个 AWS 区域部署该应用程序栈。使用 Amazon Route 53 延迟路由策略，从最近区域的 ALB 提供所有内容。

options.text_en: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB.
options.text_zh: 在单个 AWS 区域部署该应用程序栈。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供静态内容，动态内容直接由该 ALB 提供。

options.text_en: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
options.text_zh: 在两个 AWS 区域部署该应用程序栈。使用 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，从最近区域的 ALB 提供所有内容。

stem_zh:
某公司运营一个基于 Web 的门户，为用户提供全球突发新闻、本地警报和天气更新。该门户通过混合使用静态和动态内容为每位用户提供个性化视图。内容通过 HTTPS 由运行在 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后某台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 API 服务器提供。公司希望该门户尽可能快地将这些内容提供给全球用户。
解决方案架构师应如何设计该应用程序，以确保所有用户的延迟最低？

stem_en: A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modified Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based traffic. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route traffic to the nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS Application Auto Scaling.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Route 53 把请求转发到一个 Application Load Balancer。在 AWS Application Auto Scaling 中使用 AWS Lambda 运行该应用程序。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS Application Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 把请求转发到一个 Network Load Balancer。在一个 AWS Application Auto Scaling 组中使用 AWS Lambda 运行该应用程序。

options.text_en: Configure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator 把请求转发到一个 Network Load Balancer。在一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例运行该应用程序。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon API Gateway 把请求转发到一个 Application Load Balancer。在一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例运行该应用程序。

stem_zh:
某游戏公司正在设计一个高可用架构。该应用程序运行在一个修改过的 Linux 内核上，仅支持基于 UDP 的流量。公司需要前端层提供尽可能好的用户体验。该层必须具有低延迟、将流量路由到最近的边缘站点，并为进入应用程序端点提供静态 IP 地址。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
options.text_zh: 把该应用程序托管在 AWS Lambda 上。把应用程序与 Amazon API Gateway 集成。

options.text_en: Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Amplify 托管该应用程序。把应用程序连接到一个与 AWS Lambda 集成的 Amazon API Gateway API。

options.text_en: Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets.
options.text_zh: 把该应用程序托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。设置一个 Application Load Balancer，以某个 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例作为目标。

options.text_en: Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target.
options.text_zh: 把该应用程序托管在 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）上。设置一个 Application Load Balancer，以 Amazon ECS 作为目标。

stem_zh:
某公司希望将其现有的本地单体应用程序迁移到 AWS。公司希望尽可能保留前端代码和后端代码。但公司希望将该应用程序拆分为更小的应用程序。每个应用程序将由不同的团队管理。公司需要一个高度可扩展且运维开销最小的方案。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company recently started using Amazon Aurora as the data store for its global ecommerce application. When large reports are run, developers report that the ecommerce application is performing poorly. After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadIOPS and CPUUtilizalion metrics are spiking when monthly reports run. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.text_en: Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift.
options.text_zh: 把每月报表迁移到 Amazon Redshift。

options.text_en: Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.
options.text_zh: 把每月报表迁移到一个 Aurora 只读副本。

options.text_en: Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class.
options.text_zh: 把该 Aurora 数据库迁移到更大的实例类型。

options.text_en: Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance.
options.text_zh: 提高该 Aurora 实例上的预置 IOPS。

stem_zh:
某公司最近开始使用 Amazon Aurora 作为其全球电子商务应用程序的数据存储。开发人员报告称，在运行大型报表时电子商务应用程序性能不佳。在查看 Amazon CloudWatch 中的指标后，一位解决方案架构师发现，在运行月度报表时 ReadIOPS 和 CPUUtilization 指标出现峰值。
最具成本效益的方案是什么？

stem_en: A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics software is written in PHP and uses a MySQL database. The analytics software, the web server that provides PHP, and the database server are all hosted on the EC2 instance. The application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。为该 Web 应用程序创建一个 AMI。用该 AMI 启动第二台 EC2 按需实例。使用一个 Application Load Balancer 把负载分发到每台 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。为该 Web 应用程序创建一个 AMI。用该 AMI 启动第二台 EC2 按需实例。使用 Amazon Route 53 加权路由把负载分发到这两台 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来停止该 EC2 实例并更改实例类型。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，在 CPU 利用率超过 75% 时调用该 Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例。为该 Web 应用程序创建一个 AMI。把该 AMI 应用到一个启动模板。用该启动模板创建一个 Auto Scaling 组。把启动模板配置为使用 Spot 队列（Spot Fleet）。为该 Auto Scaling 组附加一个 Application Load Balancer。

explanation_en: Explanation: Aurora costs more than a standard RDS for MySQL instance, which is unnecessary here since the requirement is cost-effective seamless scaling, not Aurora's extra performance headroom. A Spot Fleet is also a poor fit for a production website that needs reliable, seamless scaling, since Spot Instances can be interrupted at any time — On-Demand instances in the Auto Scaling group are the safer, still-affordable choice.
explanation_zh: 解析：Aurora 的成本高于标准的 RDS for MySQL 实例，在此处并无必要，因为需求是具有成本效益的无缝扩展，而不是 Aurora 提供的额外性能余量。Spot 队列同样不适合一个需要可靠、无缝扩展的生产网站，因为 Spot 实例随时可能被中断——Auto Scaling 组中的按需实例是更稳妥且依然实惠的选择。
stem_zh:
某公司在单台 Amazon EC2 按需实例上托管一个网站分析应用程序。该分析软件用 PHP 编写，并使用 MySQL 数据库。分析软件、提供 PHP 的 Web 服务器和数据库服务器全都托管在这台 EC2 实例上。该应用程序在繁忙时段出现性能下降迹象，并返回 5xx 错误。公司需要让该应用程序能够无缝扩展。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a stateless web application in production on a group of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application experiences heavy usage during an 8-hour period each business day. Application usage is moderate and steady overnight. Application usage is low during weekends. The company wants to minimize its EC2 costs without affecting the availability of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances for the entire workload.
options.text_zh: 整个工作负载都使用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.text_zh: 基线用量使用预留实例。应用程序所需的任何额外容量使用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Use On-Demand Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.text_zh: 基线用量使用按需实例。应用程序所需的任何额外容量使用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Use Dedicated Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use On-Demand Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.text_zh: 基线用量使用专用实例（Dedicated Instances）。应用程序所需的任何额外容量使用按需实例。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Application Load Balancer 之后的一组 Amazon EC2 按需实例上运行一个无状态 Web 应用程序（生产环境）。该应用程序在每个工作日的 8 小时时段内使用量很大。夜间使用量中等且平稳。周末使用量很低。
公司希望在不影响应用程序可用性的前提下最大限度降低其 EC2 成本。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company needs to retain application log files for a critical application for 10 years. The application team regularly accesses logs from the past month for troubleshooting, but logs older than 1 month are rarely accessed. The application generates more than 10 TB of logs per month. Which storage option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 把日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Backup 把超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 把日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 S3 生命周期策略把超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 把日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。使用 AWS Backup 把超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 把日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。使用 Amazon S3 生命周期策略把超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

stem_zh:
某公司需要将一个关键应用程序的日志文件保留 10 年。应用团队会定期访问过去一个月的日志以排查问题，但超过 1 个月的日志很少被访问。该应用程序每月产生超过 10 TB 的日志。
哪个存储选项能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a data ingestion workflow that includes the following components: An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that receives notifications about new data deliveries An AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the data The ingestion workflow occasionally fails because of network connectivity issues. When failure occurs, the corresponding data is not ingested unless the company manually reruns the job. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all notifications are eventually processed?

options.text_en: Configure the Lambda function for deployment across multiple Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 把该 Lambda 函数配置为跨多个可用区部署。

options.text_en: Modify the Lambda function's configuration to increase the CPU and memory allocations for the function.
options.text_zh: 修改该 Lambda 函数的配置，增加分配给该函数的 CPU 和内存。

options.text_en: Configure the SNS topic’s retry strategy to increase both the number of retries and the wait time between retries.
options.text_zh: 配置该 SNS 主题的重试策略，同时增加重试次数和两次重试之间的等待时间。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the on-failure destination. Modify the Lambda function to process messages in the queue.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列作为失败时的目标（on-failure destination）。修改该 Lambda 函数以处理队列中的消息。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个数据摄取工作流，包含以下组件：
一个接收新数据投递通知的 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题
一个处理并存储数据的 AWS Lambda 函数
该摄取工作流偶尔会因网络连接问题而失败。发生故障时，除非公司手动重新运行作业，否则相应的数据不会被摄取。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能确保所有通知最终都被处理？

stem_en: A company has a service that produces event data. The company wants to use AWS to process the event data as it is received. The data is written in a specific order that must be maintained throughout processing. The company wants to implement a solution that minimizes operational overhead. How should a solutions architect accomplish this?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）FIFO 队列来存放消息。设置一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理队列中的消息。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题来投递包含待处理负载的通知。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数作为订阅者。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）标准队列来存放消息。设置一个 AWS Lambda 函数独立地处理队列中的消息。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题来投递包含待处理负载的通知。配置一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列作为订阅者。

stem_zh:
某公司有一项产生事件数据的服务。公司希望使用 AWS 在收到事件数据时立即进行处理。数据是按特定顺序写入的，该顺序在整个处理过程中必须保持。公司希望实施一个能最大限度降低运维开销的方案。
解决方案架构师应如何实现这一点？

stem_en: A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. The company does not need to take action if CPU utilization increases to more than 50% for a short burst of time. However, if the CPU utilization increases to more than 50% and read IOPS on the disk are high at the same time, the company needs to act as soon as possible. The solutions architect also must reduce false alarms. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.
options.text_zh: 在可行的地方创建 Amazon CloudWatch 复合告警。

options.text_en: Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly.
options.text_zh: 创建 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板来可视化这些指标，以便快速响应问题。

options.text_en: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm.
options.text_zh: 创建 Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canary 来监控该应用程序并发出告警。

options.text_en: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.
options.text_zh: 在可行的地方创建带多个指标阈值的单个 Amazon CloudWatch 指标告警。

stem_zh:
某公司正在将一个应用程序从本地服务器迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。作为迁移设计要求的一部分，解决方案架构师必须实施基础设施指标告警。如果 CPU 利用率只是短时间突增到 50% 以上，公司无需采取行动。但如果 CPU 利用率超过 50% 的同时磁盘读 IOPS 也很高，公司需要尽快采取行动。解决方案架构师还必须减少误报。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company's compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap- northeast-3.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Control Tower 实施数据驻留护栏，拒绝互联网访问，并拒绝访问除 ap-northeast-3 以外的所有 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS WAF 中使用规则来阻止互联网访问。在 AWS 账户设置中拒绝访问除 ap-northeast-3 以外的所有 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Organizations 配置服务控制策略（SCP），阻止 VPC 获得互联网访问。拒绝访问除 ap-northeast-3 以外的所有 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
options.text_zh: 在每个 VPC 的网络 ACL 中创建一条出站规则，拒绝来自 0.0.0.0/0 的所有流量。为每个用户创建一个 IAM 策略，阻止其使用 ap-northeast-3 以外的任何 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Config 启用托管规则，以检测互联网网关并告警，以及检测在 ap-northeast-3 之外部署的新资源并告警。

stem_zh:
某公司希望将其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。根据公司的合规要求，公司只能使用 ap-northeast-3 区域。不允许公司管理员将 VPC 连接到互联网。
哪些方案能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company uses a three-tier web application to provide training to new employees. The application is accessed for only 12 hours every day. The company is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store information and wants to minimize costs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an IAM policy for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager. Create an IAM role for the policy. Update the trust relationship of the role. Set up automatic start and stop for the DB instance.
options.text_zh: 为 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 配置一个 IAM 策略。为该策略创建一个 IAM 角色。更新该角色的信任关系。为该数据库实例设置自动启动和停止。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache cluster that gives users the ability to access the data from the cache when the DB instance is stopped. Invalidate the cache after the DB instance is started.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 缓存集群，使用户能在该数据库实例停止时从缓存访问数据。该数据库实例启动后使缓存失效。

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Create an IAM role that grants access to Amazon RDS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance. Configure a cron job to start and stop the EC2 instance on the desired schedule.
options.text_zh: 启动一台 Amazon EC2 实例。创建一个授予访问 Amazon RDS 权限的 IAM 角色。把该角色附加到该 EC2 实例。配置一个 cron 作业按所需计划启动和停止该 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Create AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the DB instance. Create Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled rules to invoke the Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions as event targets for the rules.
options.text_zh: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数来启动和停止该数据库实例。创建 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）计划规则来调用这些 Lambda 函数。把这些 Lambda 函数配置为这些规则的事件目标。

stem_zh:
某公司使用一个三层 Web 应用程序为新员工提供培训。该应用程序每天仅被访问 12 小时。公司使用一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例存储信息，并希望尽量降低成本。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company sells ringtones created from clips of popular songs. The files containing the ringtones are stored in Amazon S3 Standard and are at least 128 KB in size. The company has millions of files, but downloads are infrequent for ringtones older than 90 days. The company needs to save money on storage while keeping the most accessed files readily available for its users. Which action should the company take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for the initial storage tier of the objects.
options.text_zh: 把这些对象的初始存储层配置为 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access（S3 Standard-IA）。

options.text_en: Move the files to S3 Intelligent-Tiering and configure it to move objects to a less expensive storage tier after 90 days.
options.text_zh: 把这些文件移动到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，并把它配置为在 90 天后把对象移动到更便宜的存储层。

options.text_en: Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.
options.text_zh: 配置 S3 清单（S3 Inventory）来管理这些对象，并在 90 天后把它们移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access（S3 Standard-IA）。

options.text_en: Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.
options.text_zh: 实施一个 S3 生命周期策略，在 90 天后把这些对象从 S3 Standard 移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access（S3 Standard-IA）。

stem_zh:
某公司销售由热门歌曲片段制作的铃声。包含铃声的文件存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 中，每个文件至少 128 KB。公司拥有数百万个文件，但超过 90 天的铃声下载并不频繁。公司需要在节省存储费用的同时，让访问最频繁的文件对用户保持随时可用。
公司应采取哪个操作以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company needs to save the results from a medical trial to an Amazon S3 repository. The repository must allow a few scientists to add new files and must restrict all other users to read-only access. No users can have the ability to modify or delete any files in the repository. The company must keep every file in the repository for a minimum of 1 year after its creation date. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode with a legal hold of 1 year.
options.text_zh: 使用治理模式（governance mode）的 S3 Object Lock，并设置为期 1 年的合法保留（legal hold）。

options.text_en: Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with a retention period of 365 days.
options.text_zh: 使用合规模式（compliance mode）的 S3 Object Lock，保留期为 365 天。

options.text_en: Use an IAM role to restrict all users from deleting or changing objects in the S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to only allow the IAM role.
options.text_zh: 使用一个 IAM 角色来限制所有用户删除或更改该 S3 存储桶中的对象。使用一个 S3 存储桶策略只允许该 IAM 角色。

options.text_en: Configure the S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function every time an object is added. Configure the function to track the hash of the saved object so that modified objects can be marked accordingly.
options.text_zh: 配置该 S3 存储桶，使其每次添加对象时都调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该函数跟踪已保存对象的哈希值，以便相应地标记被修改过的对象。

stem_zh:
某公司需要将一项医学试验的结果保存到一个 Amazon S3 存储库中。该存储库必须允许少数科学家添加新文件，并且必须将所有其他用户限制为只读访问。任何用户都不能修改或删除存储库中的任何文件。公司必须将存储库中的每个文件自创建之日起至少保留 1 年。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A large media company hosts a web application on AWS. The company wants to start caching confidential media files so that users around the world will have reliable access to the files. The content is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The company must deliver the content quickly, regardless of where the requests originate geographically. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync 把这些 S3 存储桶连接到该 Web 应用程序。

options.text_en: Deploy AWS Global Accelerator to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.text_zh: 部署 AWS Global Accelerator 把这些 S3 存储桶连接到该 Web 应用程序。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon CloudFront to connect the S3 buckets to CloudFront edge servers.
options.text_zh: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 把这些 S3 存储桶连接到 CloudFront 边缘服务器。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）把这些 S3 存储桶连接到该 Web 应用程序。

stem_zh:
某大型媒体公司在 AWS 上托管一个 Web 应用程序。公司希望开始缓存机密媒体文件，以便全球用户都能可靠地访问这些文件。内容存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。无论请求来自哪个地理位置，公司都必须快速交付内容。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company produces batch data that comes from different databases. The company also produces live stream data from network sensors and application APIs. The company needs to consolidate all the data into one place for business analytics. The company needs to process the incoming data and then stage the data in different Amazon S3 buckets. Teams will later run one-time queries and import the data into a business intelligence tool to show key performance indicators (KPIs). Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Athena 做一次性查询。使用 Amazon QuickSight 为 KPI 创建控制面板。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 做一次性查询。使用 Amazon QuickSight 为 KPI 创建控制面板。

options.text_en: Create custom AWS Lambda functions to move the individual records from the databases to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.text_zh: 创建自定义 AWS Lambda 函数，把各条记录从这些数据库移动到一个 Amazon Redshift 集群。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the data into JSON format. Load the data into multiple Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) clusters.
options.text_zh: 使用一个 AWS Glue 提取、转换、加载（ETL）作业把数据转换为 JSON 格式。把数据加载到多个 Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）集群中。

options.text_en: Use blueprints in AWS Lake Formation to identify the data that can be ingested into a data lake. Use AWS Glue to crawl the source, extract the data, and load the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lake Formation 中的蓝图（blueprints）识别可以摄取到数据湖的数据。使用 AWS Glue 爬取数据源、提取数据，并以 Apache Parquet 格式把数据加载到 Amazon S3。

stem_zh:
某公司产生来自不同数据库的批量数据。公司还产生来自网络传感器和应用程序 API 的实时流数据。公司需要将所有数据整合到一处以进行业务分析。公司需要处理传入的数据，然后将数据暂存到不同的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。各团队之后会运行一次性查询，并将数据导入商业智能工具以展示关键绩效指标（KPI）。
哪些步骤组合能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company must store all the data for 5 years and must delete all the data after 5 years. The company also must indefinitely keep audit logs of actions that are performed within the database. Currently, the company has automated backups configured for Aurora. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Take a manual snapshot of the DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库集群创建一个手动快照。

options.text_en: Create a lifecycle policy for the automated backups.
options.text_zh: 为自动备份创建一个生命周期策略。

options.text_en: Configure automated backup retention for 5 years.
options.text_zh: 把自动备份的保留期配置为 5 年。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs export for the DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库集群配置 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 导出。

options.text_en: Use AWS Backup to take the backups and to keep the backups for 5 years.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Backup 执行备份，并把备份保留 5 年。

explanation_en: D and E
explanation_zh: D 和 E
stem_zh:
某公司将数据存储在一个 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群中。公司必须将所有数据保存 5 年，并在 5 年后删除所有数据。公司还必须无限期保留数据库内所执行操作的审计日志。目前，公司已为 Aurora 配置了自动备份。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A solutions architect is optimizing a website for an upcoming musical event. Videos of the performances will be streamed in real time and then will be available on demand. The event is expected to attract a global online audience. Which service will improve the performance of both the real-time and on-demand streaming?

options.text_en: Amazon CloudFront
options.text_zh: Amazon CloudFront

options.text_en: AWS Global Accelerator
options.text_zh: AWS Global Accelerator

options.text_en: Amazon Route 53
options.text_zh: Amazon Route 53

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为一场即将举行的音乐活动优化网站。演出视频将实时流式直播，之后还将提供点播。预计该活动会吸引全球在线观众。

哪项服务能同时提升实时流和点播流的性能？

stem_en: A company is running a publicly accessible serverless application that uses Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The application’s traffic recently spiked due to fraudulent requests from botnets. Which steps should a solutions architect take to block requests from unauthorized users? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create a usage plan with an API key that is shared with genuine users only.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用 API 密钥的使用计划，该密钥只与真实用户共享。

options.text_en: Integrate logic within the Lambda function to ignore the requests from fraudulent IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 在该 Lambda 函数中加入逻辑，忽略来自欺诈性 IP 地址的请求。

options.text_en: Implement an AWS WAF rule to target malicious requests and trigger actions to filter them out.
options.text_zh: 实施一条 AWS WAF 规则来针对恶意请求，并触发动作把它们过滤掉。

options.text_en: Convert the existing public API to a private API. Update the DNS records to redirect users to the new API endpoint.
options.text_zh: 把现有的公有 API 转换为私有 API。更新 DNS 记录，把用户重定向到新的 API 端点。

options.text_en: Create an IAM role for each user attempting to access the API. A user will assume the role when making the API call.
options.text_zh: 为每个尝试访问该 API 的用户创建一个 IAM 角色。用户在发起 API 调用时担任该角色。

stem_zh:
某公司正在运行一个可公开访问的无服务器应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda。由于来自僵尸网络的欺诈性请求，该应用程序的流量最近出现激增。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤来阻止未经授权用户的请求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: An ecommerce company hosts its analytics application in the AWS Cloud. The application generates about 300 MB of data each month. The data is stored in JSON format. The company is evaluating a disaster recovery solution to back up the data. The data must be accessible in milliseconds if it is needed, and the data must be kept for 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
options.text_zh: Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Glacier
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 Glacier

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Standard
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 Standard

options.text_en: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
options.text_zh: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL

stem_zh:
某电商公司在 AWS 云中托管其分析应用程序。该应用程序每月产生约 300 MB 数据。数据以 JSON 格式存储。公司正在评估一个灾难恢复方案来备份这些数据。数据在需要时必须能在毫秒级内访问，并且必须保留 30 天。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a small Python application that processes JSON documents and outputs the results to an on-premises SQL database. The application runs thousands of times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud. The company needs a highly available solution that maximizes scalability and minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Run the Python code on multiple Amazon EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 把这些 JSON 文档放到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。在多台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行该 Python 代码来处理这些文档。把结果存储在一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中。

options.text_en: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs the Python code to process the documents as they arrive in the S3 bucket. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 把这些 JSON 文档放到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在文档到达该 S3 存储桶时运行该 Python 代码来处理它们。把结果存储在一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中。

options.text_en: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi-Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.
options.text_zh: 把这些 JSON 文档放到一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷上。使用 EBS 多重挂载（Multi-Attach）功能把该卷挂载到多台 Amazon EC2 实例。在这些 EC2 实例上运行该 Python 代码来处理这些文档。把结果存储在一个 Amazon RDS 数据库实例上。

options.text_en: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Deploy the Python code as a container on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that is configured with the Amazon EC2 launch type. Use the container to process the SQS messages. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.
options.text_zh: 把这些 JSON 文档作为消息放入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列。把该 Python 代码以容器形式部署到一个配置为 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群上。用该容器处理这些 SQS 消息。把结果存储在一个 Amazon RDS 数据库实例上。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个小型 Python 应用程序，用于处理 JSON 文档并将结果输出到本地的 SQL 数据库。该应用程序每天运行数千次。公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 AWS 云。公司需要一个高可用方案，最大化可扩展性并最小化运维开销。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to use high performance computing (HPC) infrastructure on AWS for financial risk modeling. The company’s HPC workloads run on Linux. Each HPC workflow runs on hundreds of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances, is short-lived, and generates thousands of output files that are ultimately stored in persistent storage for analytics and long-term future use. The company seeks a cloud storage solution that permits the copying of on-premises data to long-term persistent storage to make data available for processing by all EC2 instances. The solution should also be a high performance file system that is integrated with persistent storage to read and write datasets and output files. Which combination of AWS services meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon FSx for Lustre integrated with Amazon S3
options.text_zh: 与 Amazon S3 集成的 Amazon FSx for Lustre

options.text_en: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server integrated with Amazon S3
options.text_zh: 与 Amazon S3 集成的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Glacier integrated with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.text_zh: 与 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）集成的 Amazon S3 Glacier

options.text_en: Amazon S3 bucket with a VPC endpoint integrated with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp2) volume
options.text_zh: 带 VPC 端点的 Amazon S3 存储桶，与一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）通用型 SSD（gp2）卷集成

stem_zh:
某公司希望在 AWS 上使用高性能计算（HPC）基础设施进行金融风险建模。公司的 HPC 工作负载运行在 Linux 上。每个 HPC 工作流运行在数百台 Amazon EC2 Spot 实例上，生命周期短暂，会生成数千个输出文件，这些文件最终存储在持久存储中以供分析和长期未来使用。
公司寻求一种云存储方案，允许将本地数据复制到长期持久存储中，使数据可供所有 EC2 实例处理。该方案还应是一个与持久存储集成的高性能文件系统，用于读写数据集和输出文件。
哪种 AWS 服务组合能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is building a containerized application on premises and decides to move the application to AWS. The application will have thousands of users soon after it is deployed. The company is unsure how to manage the deployment of containers at scale. The company needs to deploy the containerized application in a highly available architecture that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the AWS Fargate launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.
options.text_zh: 把容器镜像存储在一个 Amazon Elastic Container Registry（Amazon ECR）仓库中。使用采用 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群来运行这些容器。使用目标跟踪根据需求自动扩缩。

options.text_en: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Amazon EC2 launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.
options.text_zh: 把容器镜像存储在一个 Amazon Elastic Container Registry（Amazon ECR）仓库中。使用采用 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群来运行这些容器。使用目标跟踪根据需求自动扩缩。

options.text_en: Store container images in a repository that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Run the containers on EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Monitor the average CPU utilization in Amazon CloudWatch. Launch new EC2 instances as needed.
options.text_zh: 把容器镜像存储在运行于一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的仓库中。在分布于多个可用区的 EC2 实例上运行这些容器。在 Amazon CloudWatch 中监控平均 CPU 利用率。按需启动新的 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the container image. Launch EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale out EC2 instances when the average CPU utilization threshold is breached.
options.text_zh: 创建一个包含该容器镜像的 Amazon EC2 Amazon 机器映像（AMI）。在跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中启动 EC2 实例。使用一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，在平均 CPU 利用率突破阈值时横向扩展 EC2 实例。

stem_zh:
某公司正在本地构建一个容器化应用程序，并决定将该应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序部署后不久就会有数千名用户。公司不确定如何大规模管理容器部署。公司需要以高可用架构部署该容器化应用程序，同时最大限度降低运维开销。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has two applications: a sender application that sends messages with payloads to be processed and a processing application intended to receive the messages with payloads. The company wants to implement an AWS service to handle messages between the two applications. The sender application can send about 1,000 messages each hour. The messages may take up to 2 days to be processed: If the messages fail to process, they must be retained so that they do not impact the processing of any remaining messages. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. Configure both applications to use the instance. Store, process, and delete the messages, respectively.
options.text_zh: 设置一台运行 Redis 数据库的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置两个应用程序都使用该实例，分别完成消息的存储、处理和删除。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream to receive the messages from the sender application. Integrate the processing application with the Kinesis Client Library (KCL).
options.text_zh: 使用一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流从发送方应用程序接收消息。把处理方应用程序与 Kinesis Client Library（KCL）集成。

options.text_en: Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure a dead-letter queue to collect the messages that failed to process.
options.text_zh: 把发送方应用程序和处理方应用程序与一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列集成。配置一个死信队列来收集处理失败的消息。

options.text_en: Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive notifications to process. Integrate the sender application to write to the SNS topic.
options.text_zh: 让处理方应用程序订阅一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题，以接收待处理的通知。把发送方应用程序集成为向该 SNS 主题写入。

stem_zh: 某公司有两个应用程序：一个发送方应用程序，负责发送带有待处理负载的消息；一个处理方应用程序，用于接收这些带负载的消息。该公司希望采用一项 AWS 服务来处理这两个应用程序之间的消息。发送方应用程序每小时大约可发送 1,000 条消息。消息最多可能需要 2 天才能处理完。如果消息处理失败，必须予以保留，使其不影响其余消息的处理。哪个解决方案能满足这些要求且运营效率最高？

stem_en: A solutions architect must design a solution that uses Amazon CloudFront with an Amazon S3 origin to store a static website. The company’s security policy requires that all website traffic be inspected by AWS WAF. How should the solutions architect comply with these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an S3 bucket policy to accept requests coming from the AWS WAF Amazon Resource Name (ARN) only.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 S3 存储桶策略，只接受来自 AWS WAF 的 Amazon 资源名称（ARN）的请求。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward all incoming requests to AWS WAF before requesting content from the S3 origin.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon CloudFront，把所有传入请求先转发给 AWS WAF，然后再向 S3 源请求内容。

options.text_en: Configure a security group that allows Amazon CloudFront IP addresses to access Amazon S3 only. Associate AWS WAF to CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 配置一个安全组，只允许 Amazon CloudFront 的 IP 地址访问 Amazon S3。把 AWS WAF 关联到 CloudFront。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to use an origin access identity (OAI) to restrict access to the S3 bucket. Enable AWS WAF on the distribution.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3 使用源访问身份（OAI）来限制对该 S3 存储桶的访问。在该分配上启用 AWS WAF。

stem_zh: 某解决方案架构师必须设计一个方案，使用 Amazon CloudFront 搭配 Amazon S3 源来托管一个静态网站。该公司的安全策略要求所有网站流量都必须由 AWS WAF 检查。该解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

stem_en: Organizers for a global event want to put daily reports online as static HTML pages. The pages are expected to generate millions of views from users around the world. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. A solutions architect has been asked to design an efficient and effective solution. Which action should the solutions architect take to accomplish this?

options.text_en: Generate presigned URLs for the files.
options.text_zh: 为这些文件生成预签名 URL。

options.text_en: Use cross-Region replication to all Regions.
options.text_zh: 使用跨区域复制把数据复制到所有区域。

options.text_en: Use the geoproximity feature of Amazon Route 53.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Route 53 的地理位置就近路由（geoproximity）功能。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudFront with the S3 bucket as its origin.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudFront，并以该 S3 存储桶作为其源。

stem_zh:
某全球活动的组织方希望将每日报告以静态 HTML 页面的形式发布到网上。预计这些页面将产生来自全球用户的数百万次浏览。文件存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。有人请一位解决方案架构师设计一个高效且有效的方案。
解决方案架构师应采取哪个操作来实现这一点？

stem_en: A company runs a production application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads the data from an Amazon SQS queue and processes the messages in parallel. The message volume is unpredictable and often has intermittent traffic. This application should continually process messages without any downtime. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use Spot Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
options.text_zh: 完全使用 Spot 实例来应对所需的最大容量。

options.text_en: Use Reserved Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
options.text_zh: 完全使用预留实例来应对所需的最大容量。

options.text_en: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use Spot Instances to handle additional capacity.
options.text_zh: 基线容量使用预留实例，额外容量使用 Spot 实例来应对。

options.text_en: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use On-Demand Instances to handle additional capacity.
options.text_zh: 基线容量使用预留实例，额外容量使用按需实例来应对。

stem_zh:
某公司在一组 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个生产应用程序。该应用程序从一个 Amazon SQS 队列读取数据并并行处理消息。消息量不可预测，且常常呈间歇性流量。该应用程序应持续处理消息，不能有任何停机。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A security team wants to limit access to specific services or actions in all of the team’s AWS accounts. All accounts belong to a large organization in AWS Organizations. The solution must be scalable and there must be a single point where permissions can be maintained. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.text_en: Create an ACL to provide access to the services or actions.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 ACL 来提供对这些服务或操作的访问权限。

options.text_en: Create a security group to allow accounts and attach it to user groups.
options.text_zh: 创建一个安全组来允许这些账户，并把它附加到用户组。

options.text_en: Create cross-account roles in each account to deny access to the services or actions.
options.text_zh: 在每个账户中创建跨账户角色，以拒绝对这些服务或操作的访问。

options.text_en: Create a service control policy in the root organizational unit to deny access to the services or actions.
options.text_zh: 在根组织单元（root OU）中创建一个服务控制策略，以拒绝对这些服务或操作的访问。

stem_zh: 某安全团队希望在该团队的所有 AWS 账户中限制对特定服务或操作的访问。所有账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中的一个大型组织。该方案必须可扩展，并且必须有一个统一的权限维护入口。解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能实现这一点？

stem_en: A company is concerned about the security of its public web application due to recent web attacks. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect must reduce the risk of DDoS attacks against the application. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Add an Amazon Inspector agent to the ALB.
options.text_zh: 为该 ALB 添加一个 Amazon Inspector 代理。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Macie to prevent attacks.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Macie 来阻止攻击。

options.text_en: Enable AWS Shield Advanced to prevent attacks.
options.text_zh: 启用 AWS Shield Advanced 来阻止攻击。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor the ALB.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon GuardDuty 来监控该 ALB。

stem_zh:
由于近期发生的 Web 攻击，某公司担心其公共 Web 应用程序的安全性。该应用程序使用一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）。解决方案架构师必须降低该应用程序遭受 DDoS 攻击的风险。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足此要求？

stem_en: A company’s web application is running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The company recently changed its policy, which now requires the application to be accessed from one specific country only. Which configuration will meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 配置这些 EC2 实例的安全组。

options.text_en: Configure the security group on the Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 在该 Application Load Balancer 上配置安全组。

options.text_en: Configure AWS WAF on the Application Load Balancer in a VPC.
options.text_zh: 在 VPC 中的该 Application Load Balancer 上配置 AWS WAF。

options.text_en: Configure the network ACL for the subnet that contains the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 配置包含这些 EC2 实例的子网的网络 ACL。

stem_zh: 某公司的 Web 应用程序运行在一个 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司最近修改了策略，现在要求只能从某一个特定国家访问该应用程序。哪种配置能满足这一要求？

stem_en: A company provides an API to its users that automates inquiries for tax computations based on item prices. The company experiences a larger number of inquiries during the holiday season only that cause slower response times. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that is scalable and elastic. What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.text_en: Provide an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance performs the required computations when the API request is made.
options.text_zh: 提供一个托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 API。当发起 API 请求时，由该 EC2 实例执行所需的计算。

options.text_en: Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that accepts the item names. API Gateway passes item names to AWS Lambda for tax computations.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个接受商品名称的 REST API。API Gateway 把商品名称传给 AWS Lambda 进行税额计算。

options.text_en: Create an Application Load Balancer that has two Amazon EC2 instances behind it. The EC2 instances will compute the tax on the received item names.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer，其后有两台 Amazon EC2 实例。这些 EC2 实例根据收到的商品名称计算税额。

options.text_en: Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that connects with an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. API Gateway accepts and passes the item names to the EC2 instance for tax computations.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个 REST API，让它与托管在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 API 相连。API Gateway 接收商品名称并把它们传给该 EC2 实例进行税额计算。

stem_zh:
某公司向其用户提供一个 API，基于商品价格自动进行税费计算查询。公司仅在节假日季节会遇到查询量大幅增加，导致响应时间变慢。解决方案架构师需要设计一个可扩展且具有弹性的方案。
解决方案架构师应该怎么做来实现这一点？

stem_en: A solutions architect is creating a new Amazon CloudFront distribution for an application. Some of the information submitted by users is sensitive. The application uses HTTPS but needs another layer of security. The sensitive information should.be protected throughout the entire application stack, and access to the information should be restricted to certain applications. Which action should the solutions architect take?

options.text_en: Configure a CloudFront signed URL.
options.text_zh: 配置 CloudFront 签名 URL。

options.text_en: Configure a CloudFront signed cookie.
options.text_zh: 配置 CloudFront 签名 Cookie。

options.text_en: Configure a CloudFront field-level encryption profile.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 CloudFront 字段级加密配置文件。

options.text_en: Configure CloudFront and set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to HTTPS Only for the Viewer Protocol Policy.
options.text_zh: 配置 CloudFront，并把「查看器协议策略」（Viewer Protocol Policy）对应的「源协议策略」（Origin Protocol Policy）设置为仅 HTTPS。

explanation_en: Explanation: Field-level encryption keeps specific sensitive fields encrypted with a public key all the way from the viewer through to the origin and any backend systems, so only applications holding the matching private key can decrypt them. Signed URLs/cookies (A, B) only restrict access to content, and HTTPS-only origin policy (D) protects data in transit but not throughout the whole application stack.
explanation_zh: 解析：字段级加密使用公钥对特定敏感字段加密，从访问者一路到源站及任何后端系统都保持加密状态，因此只有持有对应私钥的应用程序才能解密。签名 URL/签名 Cookie（A、B）只能限制对内容的访问，而仅 HTTPS 的源站策略（D）保护的是传输中的数据，而非整个应用程序栈。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为一个应用程序创建新的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。用户提交的某些信息是敏感的。该应用程序使用 HTTPS，但还需要另一层安全防护。敏感信息应在整个应用程序栈中受到保护，并且对该信息的访问应限制在特定应用程序范围内。
解决方案架构师应采取哪个操作？

stem_en: A gaming company hosts a browser-based application on AWS. The users of the application consume a large number of videos and images that are stored in Amazon S3. This content is the same for all users. The application has increased in popularity, and millions of users worldwide accessing these media files. The company wants to provide the files to the users while reducing the load on the origin. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator in front of the web servers.
options.text_zh: 在这些 Web 服务器前面部署一个 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在该 S3 存储桶前面部署一个 Amazon CloudFront Web 分配。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis instance in front of the web servers.
options.text_zh: 在这些 Web 服务器前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 实例。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance in front of the web servers.
options.text_zh: 在这些 Web 服务器前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 实例。

stem_zh:
某游戏公司在 AWS 上托管一个基于浏览器的应用程序。该应用程序的用户会消费大量存储在 Amazon S3 中的视频和图片。这些内容对所有用户都是相同的。
该应用程序越来越受欢迎，全球有数百万用户访问这些媒体文件。公司希望在向用户提供文件的同时减轻源站的负载。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a multi-tier application that runs six front-end web servers in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect needs to modify the infrastructure to be highly available without modifying the application. Which architecture should the solutions architect choose that provides high availability?

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，在两个区域中各使用三台实例。

options.text_en: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 修改该 Auto Scaling 组，在两个可用区中各使用三台实例。

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 模板，用它可以在另一个区域中快速创建更多实例。

options.text_en: Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier.
options.text_zh: 把这些 Amazon EC2 实例前面的 ALB 改为轮询（round-robin）配置，以便把流量均衡到 Web 层。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个多层应用程序，在单个可用区中的一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组内运行六台前端 Web 服务器，位于一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后。解决方案架构师需要在不修改应用程序的前提下改造基础设施以实现高可用。
解决方案架构师应选择哪种架构来提供高可用性？

stem_en: An ecommerce company has an order-processing application that uses Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. During a recent sales event, a sudden surge in customer orders occurred. Some customers experienced timeouts, and the application did not process the orders of those customers. A solutions architect determined that the CPU utilization and memory utilization were high on the database because of a large number of open connections. The solutions architect needs to prevent the timeout errors while making the least possible changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function. Modify the database to be a global database in multiple AWS Regions.
options.text_zh: 为该 Lambda 函数配置预置并发（provisioned concurrency）。把该数据库改为跨多个 AWS 区域的全局数据库。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the database. Modify the Lambda function to use the RDS Proxy endpoint instead of the database endpoint.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 为该数据库创建一个代理。修改该 Lambda 函数，使其使用 RDS Proxy 端点而不是数据库端点。

options.text_en: Create a read replica for the database in a different AWS Region. Use query string parameters in API Gateway to route traffic to the read replica.
options.text_zh: 在另一个 AWS 区域为该数据库创建一个只读副本。在 API Gateway 中使用查询字符串参数把流量路由到该只读副本。

options.text_en: Migrate the data from Aurora PostgreSQL to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Modify the Lambda function to use the DynamoDB table.
