The solution does not need to handle the load when the primary infrastructure is healthy. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy the application with the required infrastructure elements in place. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora Replica in a second AWS Region.
options.text_zh: 部署该应用并预先准备好所需的基础设施要素。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-被动故障转移。在第二个 AWS 区域创建一个 Aurora 副本。

options.text_en: Host a scaled-down deployment of the application in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora Replica in the second Region.
options.text_zh: 在第二个 AWS 区域托管一份缩减规模的应用部署。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-主动故障转移。在第二个区域创建一个 Aurora 副本。

options.text_en: Replicate the primary infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora database that is restored from the latest snapshot.
options.text_zh: 在第二个 AWS 区域复制一套主基础设施。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-主动故障转移。创建一个由最新快照恢复而来的 Aurora 数据库。

options.text_en: Back up data with AWS Backup. Use the backup to create the required infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora second primary instance in the second Region.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 备份数据。用该备份在第二个 AWS 区域创建所需的基础设施。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-被动故障转移。在第二个区域创建一个 Aurora 第二主实例。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个全球 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora 中。公司需要创建一个灾难恢复方案，可以容忍最多 30 分钟的停机和潜在的数据丢失。当主基础设施健康时，该方案无需承担负载。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a web server running on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Elastic IP address. The default security group is assigned to the EC2 instance. The default network ACL has been modified to block all traffic. A solutions architect needs to make the web server accessible from everywhere on port 443. Which combination of steps will accomplish this task? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 创建一个安全组，其规则允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 443 端口流量。

options.text_en: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 创建一个安全组，其规则允许发往目标 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 443 端口流量。

options.text_en: Update the network ACL to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 更新网络 ACL，允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 443 端口流量。

options.text_en: Update the network ACL to allow inbound/outbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 更新网络 ACL，允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的入站以及发往目标 0.0.0.0/0 的出站 TCP 443 端口流量。

options.text_en: Update the network ACL to allow inbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP port 32768-65535 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 更新网络 ACL，允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的入站 TCP 443 端口流量，以及发往目标 0.0.0.0/0 的出站 TCP 32768-65535 端口流量。

explanation_en: E. Update the network ACL to allow inbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP port 32768-65535 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
explanation_zh: E. 更新网络 ACL，允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 443 入站流量，以及到目标 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 32768-65535 出站流量。
stem_zh:
某公司有一台 Web 服务器，运行在公有子网中一台带弹性 IP 地址的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 EC2 实例被分配了默认安全组。默认网络 ACL 已被修改为阻止所有流量。解决方案架构师需要让该 Web 服务器可以在 443 端口上被任何地方访问。

哪些步骤组合能完成此任务？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company’s application is having performance issues. The application is stateful and needs to complete in-memory tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The company used AWS CloudFormation to deploy infrastructure and used the M5 EC2 instance family. As traffic increased, the application performance degraded. Users are reporting delays when the users attempt to access the application. Which solution will resolve these issues in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: Replace the EC2 instances with T3 EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Make the changes by using the AWS Management Console.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例替换为运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 T3 型 EC2 实例。通过 AWS 管理控制台做这些改动。

options.text_en: Modify the CloudFormation templates to run the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. Increase the desired capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group manually when an increase is necessary.
options.text_zh: 修改 CloudFormation 模板，让 EC2 实例运行在一个 Auto Scaling 组中。需要扩容时手动提高该 Auto Scaling 组的期望容量和最大容量。

options.text_en: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch built-in EC2 memory metrics to track the application performance for future capacity planning.
options.text_zh: 修改 CloudFormation 模板。把这些 EC2 实例替换为 R5 型 EC2 实例。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 内置的 EC2 内存指标跟踪应用性能，供后续容量规划使用。

options.text_en: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to generate custom application latency metrics for future capacity planning.
options.text_zh: 修改 CloudFormation 模板。把这些 EC2 实例替换为 R5 型 EC2 实例。在这些 EC2 实例上部署 Amazon CloudWatch 代理，生成自定义的应用延迟指标，供后续容量规划使用。

stem_zh:
某公司的应用程序存在性能问题。该应用程序是有状态的，需要在 Amazon EC2 实例上完成内存中的任务。公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署基础设施，并使用了 M5 EC2 实例系列。随着流量增加，应用程序性能下降。用户反映在尝试访问该应用程序时出现延迟。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式解决这些问题？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a new API using Amazon API Gateway that will receive requests from users. The volume of requests is highly variable; several hours can pass without receiving a single request. The data processing will take place asynchronously, but should be completed within a few seconds after a request is made. Which compute service should the solutions architect have the API invoke to deliver the requirements at the lowest cost?

options.text_en: An AWS Glue job
options.text_zh: 一个 AWS Glue 作业

options.text_en: An AWS Lambda function
options.text_zh: 一个 AWS Lambda 函数

options.text_en: A containerized service hosted in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.text_zh: 一个托管在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上的容器化服务

options.text_en: A containerized service hosted in Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2
options.text_zh: 一个托管在 Amazon ECS 搭配 Amazon EC2 上的容器化服务

explanation_en: AWS Lambda supports asynchronous invocation, which is suitable for scenarios where data processing can take place independently of the API request and complete within a few seconds. This aligns with the requirement of processing data asynchronously.
explanation_zh: AWS Lambda 支持异步调用，适用于数据处理可以独立于 API 请求进行并在几秒内完成的场景。这符合异步处理数据的要求。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个新的 API，用于接收用户请求。请求量波动很大；可能连续数小时收不到一个请求。数据处理将以异步方式进行，但应在请求发出后几秒内完成。

解决方案架构师应让该 API 调用哪种计算服务，才能以最低成本满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs an application on a group of Amazon Linux EC2 instances. For compliance reasons, the company must retain all application log files for 7 years. The log files will be analyzed by a reporting tool that must be able to access all the files concurrently. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

options.text_en: Amazon EC2 instance store
options.text_zh: Amazon EC2 实例存储

options.text_en: Amazon S3
options.text_zh: Amazon S3

explanation_en: S3 is a highly durable and scalable object storage service. It is designed for high availability and can store large amounts of data. S3 is cost-effective for long-term storage, and its pricing is based on the amount of data stored.
explanation_zh: S3 是一项高度持久且可扩展的对象存储服务。它专为高可用性设计，可存储海量数据。S3 对于长期存储具有成本效益，其定价基于所存储的数据量。
stem_zh:
某公司在一组 Amazon Linux EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。出于合规原因，公司必须将所有应用程序日志文件保留 7 年。这些日志文件将由一个报表工具进行分析，该工具必须能够并发访问所有文件。

哪个存储方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company’s AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company’s AWS account. How should a solutions architect grant this access to the vendor?

options.text_en: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.text_zh: 在该公司账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，把访问权限委派给该供应商的 IAM 角色。为该角色附加相应的 IAM 策略，赋予供应商所需的权限。

options.text_en: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.text_zh: 在该公司账户中创建一个 IAM 用户，为其设置满足密码复杂度要求的密码。为该用户附加相应的 IAM 策略，赋予供应商所需的权限。

options.text_en: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.text_zh: 在该公司账户中创建一个 IAM 组。把供应商账户中该工具的 IAM 用户加入这个组。为该组附加相应的 IAM 策略，赋予供应商所需的权限。

options.text_en: Create a new identity provider by choosing “AWS account” as the provider type in the IAM console. Supply the vendor’s AWS account ID and user name. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the new provider for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.text_zh: 在 IAM 控制台中选择「AWS account」作为提供方类型，新建一个身份提供方。填入该供应商的 AWS 账户 ID 和用户名。为这个新提供方附加相应的 IAM 策略，赋予供应商所需的权限。

explanation_en:
IAM roles allow you to delegate access to resources in your AWS account to another AWS account. In this case, you can create a role in your account and grant the vendor's IAM role permission to assume that role.

By doing this, the vendor can use temporary security credentials obtained by assuming the role to access resources in your account. This ensures that the vendor doesn't need IAM credentials from your account.
explanation_zh:
IAM 角色允许你将自己 AWS 账户中资源的访问权限委派给另一个 AWS 账户。在这种情况下，你可以在自己的账户中创建一个角色，并授予供应商的 IAM 角色代入该角色的权限。

这样一来，供应商就可以使用通过代入该角色获得的临时安全凭证来访问你账户中的资源。这确保了供应商不需要来自你账户的 IAM 凭证。
stem_zh:
某公司聘请了一家外部供应商在公司的 AWS 账户中开展工作。该供应商使用一个托管在其自有 AWS 账户中的自动化工具。该供应商没有对公司 AWS 账户的 IAM 访问权限。

解决方案架构师应如何将此访问权限授予该供应商？

stem_en: A company has deployed a Java Spring Boot application as a pod that runs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) in private subnets. The application needs to write data to an Amazon DynamoDB table. A solutions architect must ensure that the application can interact with the DynamoDB table without exposing traffic to the internet. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.text_zh: 把一个具备足够权限的 IAM 角色附加给该 EKS pod。

options.text_en: Attach an IAM user that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.text_zh: 把一个具备足够权限的 IAM 用户附加给该 EKS pod。

options.text_en: Allow outbound connectivity to the DynamoDB table through the private subnets’ network ACLs.
options.text_zh: 在这些私有子网的网络 ACL 中放通到该 DynamoDB 表的出站连接。

options.text_en: Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 为 DynamoDB 创建一个 VPC 端点。

options.text_en: Embed the access keys in the Java Spring Boot code.
options.text_zh: 把访问密钥内嵌到 Java Spring Boot 代码中。

explanation_en:
D. Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. Most Voted

This IAM role should have the necessary permissions to interact with DynamoDB. You can attach the IAM role to the pod using Kubernetes service account annotations or other mechanisms.

By creating a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB, you allow your EKS pods to access DynamoDB directly within the AWS network without traversing the public internet. This enhances security and reduces the risk of exposure.
explanation_zh:
D. 为 DynamoDB 创建一个 VPC 终端节点。（票数最高）

该 IAM 角色应具备与 DynamoDB 交互所需的权限。你可以通过 Kubernetes 服务账户注解或其他机制将该 IAM 角色附加到 Pod。

通过为 DynamoDB 创建 VPC 终端节点，你可以让 EKS Pod 在 AWS 网络内部直接访问 DynamoDB，而无需经过公共互联网。这增强了安全性并降低了暴露风险。
stem_zh:
某公司已将一个 Java Spring Boot 应用程序作为 Pod 部署在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）上运行。该应用程序需要向一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表写入数据。解决方案架构师必须确保该应用程序能够与该 DynamoDB 表交互，且不将流量暴露到互联网。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来实现这一目标？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company recently migrated its web application to AWS by rehosting the application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The company wants to redesign its application architecture to be highly available and fault tolerant. Traffic must reach all running EC2 instances randomly. Which combination of steps should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Route 53 故障转移路由策略。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Route 53 加权路由策略。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Route 53 多值应答路由策略。

options.text_en: Launch three EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and one instance in another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 启动三台 EC2 实例：两台在一个可用区，一台在另一个可用区。

options.text_en: Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 启动四台 EC2 实例：两台在一个可用区，另两台在另一个可用区。

stem_zh: 某公司最近把其 Web 应用迁移到了 AWS，做法是把应用平迁到单个 AWS 区域内的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司希望重新设计应用架构，使其高可用且具备容错能力。流量必须随机到达所有正在运行的 EC2 实例。该公司应该采取以下哪几步组合来满足这些需求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A media company collects and analyzes user activity data on premises. The company wants to migrate this capability to AWS. The user activity data store will continue to grow and will be petabytes in size. The company needs to build a highly available data ingestion solution that facilitates on-demand analytics of existing data and new data with SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把活动数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。配置该数据流把数据投递到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.text_zh: 把活动数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 投递流。配置该投递流把数据投递到一个 Amazon Redshift 集群。

options.text_en: Place activity data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon S3 to run an AWS Lambda function on the data as the data arrives in the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把活动数据放入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 Amazon S3 在数据到达该存储桶时对数据运行一个 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Create an ingestion service on Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Configure the service to forward data to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database.
options.text_zh: 在分布于多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 实例上创建一个接入服务。配置该服务把数据转发到一个多可用区的 Amazon RDS 数据库。

explanation_en:
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose: It is a fully managed service that simplifies the delivery of streaming data to destinations such as Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, or Amazon Elasticsearch Service. It handles the scaling, buffering, and delivery of data.

Amazon Redshift: It is a fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service. It is optimized for high-performance analysis using standard SQL queries.

Least Operational Overhead: Kinesis Data Firehose takes care of many operational aspects, including scaling and buffering, reducing the operational overhead on your part. Configuring it to deliver data to Amazon Redshift provides a streamlined and managed solution.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose：这是一项全托管服务，简化了将流数据传输到 Amazon S3、Amazon Redshift 或 Amazon Elasticsearch Service 等目标的过程。它负责处理数据的扩展、缓冲和传输。

Amazon Redshift：这是一项全托管的 PB 级数据仓库服务。它针对使用标准 SQL 查询进行高性能分析进行了优化。

运维开销最少：Kinesis Data Firehose 承担了许多运维方面的工作，包括扩展和缓冲，从而减轻了你这边的运维开销。将其配置为向 Amazon Redshift 传输数据，可提供一个流畅的托管方案。
stem_zh:
某媒体公司在本地收集并分析用户活动数据。公司希望将这一能力迁移到 AWS。用户活动数据存储将持续增长，规模将达到 PB 级。公司需要构建一个高可用的数据摄取方案，便于使用 SQL 对现有数据和新数据进行按需分析。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company collects data from thousands of remote devices by using a RESTful web services application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance receives the raw data, transforms the raw data, and stores all the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The number of remote devices will increase into the millions soon. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue to process the raw data in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Glue 处理 Amazon S3 中的原始数据。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to different EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Route 53 把流量路由到不同的 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Add more EC2 instances to accommodate the increasing amount of incoming data.
options.text_zh: 增加更多 EC2 实例以应对不断增长的传入数据量。

options.text_en: Send the raw data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Use EC2 instances to process the data.
options.text_zh: 把原始数据发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)。用 EC2 实例来处理这些数据。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway to send the raw data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to use the data stream as a source to deliver the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 把原始数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 以该数据流为源，把数据投递到 Amazon S3。

explanation_en:
E. Use Amazon API Gateway to send the raw data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to use the data stream as a source to deliver the data to Amazon S3.

A. It automatically discovers the schema of the data and generates ETL code to transform it.

E. API Gateway can be used to receive the raw data from the remote devices via RESTful web services. It provides a scalable and managed infrastructure to handle the incoming requests. The data can then be sent to an Amazon Kinesis data stream, which is a highly scalable and durable real-time data streaming service. From there, Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose can be configured to use the data stream as a source and deliver the transformed data to Amazon S3. This combination of services allows for the seamless ingestion and processing of data while minimizing operational overhead.
explanation_zh:
E. 使用 Amazon API Gateway 将原始数据发送到一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 以该数据流为源，将数据传输到 Amazon S3。

A. 它会自动发现数据的架构并生成用于转换的 ETL 代码。

E. API Gateway 可用于通过 RESTful Web 服务接收来自远程设备的原始数据。它提供可扩展的托管基础设施来处理传入请求。随后数据可以被发送到 Amazon Kinesis 数据流，这是一项高度可扩展且持久的实时数据流服务。之后可以配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 以该数据流为源，将转换后的数据传输到 Amazon S3。这种服务组合能够无缝地摄取和处理数据，同时最大限度降低运维开销。
stem_zh:
某公司使用运行在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 RESTful Web 服务应用程序，从数千台远程设备收集数据。该 EC2 实例接收原始数据、转换原始数据，并将所有数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。远程设备的数量很快将增加到数百万台。公司需要一个高度可扩展且运维开销最小的方案。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company needs to retain its AWS CloudTrail logs for 3 years. The company is enforcing CloudTrail across a set of AWS accounts by using AWS Organizations from the parent account. The CloudTrail target S3 bucket is configured with S3 Versioning enabled. An S3 Lifecycle policy is in place to delete current objects after 3 years. After the fourth year of use of the S3 bucket, the S3 bucket metrics show that the number of objects has continued to rise. However, the number of new CloudTrail logs that are delivered to the S3 bucket has remained consistent. Which solution will delete objects that are older than 3 years in the MOST cost-effective manner?

options.text_en: Configure the organization’s centralized CloudTrail trail to expire objects after 3 years.
options.text_zh: 配置该组织的集中式 CloudTrail 跟踪，让对象在 3 年后过期。

options.text_en: Configure the S3 Lifecycle policy to delete previous versions as well as current versions.
options.text_zh: 配置 S3 生命周期策略，同时删除以前的版本和当前版本。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to enumerate and delete objects from Amazon S3 that are older than 3 years.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，枚举并删除 Amazon S3 中超过 3 年的对象。

options.text_en: Configure the parent account as the owner of all objects that are delivered to the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把父账户配置为投递到该 S3 存储桶的所有对象的所有者。

explanation_en: S3 Lifecycle Policy: Enabling S3 versioning allows you to use a lifecycle policy to manage both current and previous versions of objects in the bucket. By configuring the S3 Lifecycle policy to delete objects older than 3 years, it will automatically delete both the current and previous versions that meet the specified criteria.
explanation_zh: S3 生命周期策略：启用 S3 版本控制后，你可以使用生命周期策略管理存储桶中对象的当前版本和以前的版本。通过配置 S3 生命周期策略删除超过 3 年的对象，它会自动删除符合指定条件的当前版本和以前的版本。
stem_zh:
某公司需要将其 AWS CloudTrail 日志保留 3 年。公司通过父账户使用 AWS Organizations 在一组 AWS 账户中强制启用 CloudTrail。CloudTrail 的目标 S3 存储桶已启用 S3 版本控制。已设置一条 S3 生命周期策略，在 3 年后删除当前版本的对象。

在使用该 S3 存储桶的第四年之后，S3 存储桶指标显示对象数量仍在持续上升。然而，投递到该 S3 存储桶的新 CloudTrail 日志数量却保持稳定。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式删除超过 3 年的对象？

stem_en: A company has an API that receives real-time data from a fleet of monitoring devices. The API stores this data in an Amazon RDS DB instance for later analysis. The amount of data that the monitoring devices send to the API fluctuates. During periods of heavy traffic, the API often returns timeout errors. After an inspection of the logs, the company determines that the database is not capable of processing the volume of write traffic that comes from the API. A solutions architect must minimize the number of connections to the database and must ensure that data is not lost during periods of heavy traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Increase the size of the DB instance to an instance type that has more available memory.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例扩大到内存更多的实例类型。

options.text_en: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ DB instance. Configure the application to write to all active RDS DB instances.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例改为多可用区数据库实例。配置应用向所有处于活动状态的 RDS 数据库实例写入。

options.text_en: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SQS invokes to write data from the queue to the database.
options.text_zh: 修改该 API，把传入数据写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。用一个由 Amazon SQS 触发的 AWS Lambda 函数把数据从队列写入数据库。

options.text_en: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SNS invokes to write data from the topic to the database.
options.text_zh: 修改该 API，把传入数据写入一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。用一个由 Amazon SNS 触发的 AWS Lambda 函数把数据从该主题写入数据库。

explanation_en:
Amazon SQS: SQS is a fully managed message queuing service that decouples the components of a cloud application. It acts as a buffer between the API and the database, allowing for better handling of varying write traffic.

AWS Lambda: Using Lambda to process the data from the SQS queue helps in efficiently managing the connection to the database. Lambda functions can be scaled automatically based on the incoming workload.
explanation_zh:
Amazon SQS：SQS 是一项全托管的消息队列服务，用于解耦云应用程序的各个组件。它在 API 和数据库之间充当缓冲区，从而更好地应对波动的写入流量。

AWS Lambda：使用 Lambda 处理来自 SQS 队列的数据，有助于高效管理到数据库的连接。Lambda 函数可以根据传入的工作负载自动伸缩。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个 API，接收来自一组监控设备的实时数据。该 API 将这些数据存储在一个 Amazon RDS 数据库实例中以供后续分析。监控设备发送到该 API 的数据量会波动。在流量高峰期，该 API 经常返回超时错误。

在检查日志后，公司确定该数据库无法处理来自 API 的写入流量。解决方案架构师必须尽量减少到数据库的连接数，并且必须确保在流量高峰期不丢失数据。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company manages its own Amazon EC2 instances that run MySQL databases. The company is manually managing replication and scaling as demand increases or decreases. The company needs a new solution that simplifies the process of adding or removing compute capacity to or from its database tier as needed. The solution also must offer improved performance, scaling, and durability with minimal effort from operations. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora MySQL.
options.text_zh: 把这些数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless（Aurora MySQL 版）。

options.text_en: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.text_zh: 把这些数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless（Aurora PostgreSQL 版）。

options.text_en: Combine the databases into one larger MySQL database. Run the larger database on larger EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把这些数据库合并成一个更大的 MySQL 数据库。在更大的 EC2 实例上运行这个大数据库。

options.text_en: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group for the database tier. Migrate the existing databases to the new environment.
options.text_zh: 为数据库层创建一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。把现有数据库迁移到这个新环境。

explanation_en: Amazon Aurora Serverless: Aurora Serverless is an on-demand, auto-scaling configuration for Amazon Aurora. It automatically adjusts the database capacity based on actual consumption, enabling seamless scaling without manual intervention. It is a fully managed service, reducing operational overhead.
explanation_zh: Amazon Aurora Serverless：Aurora Serverless 是 Amazon Aurora 的一种按需自动伸缩配置。它会根据实际消耗自动调整数据库容量，无需人工干预即可无缝伸缩。它是一项全托管服务，可降低运维开销。
stem_zh:
某公司自行管理运行 MySQL 数据库的 Amazon EC2 实例。随着需求的增减，公司在手动管理复制和伸缩。公司需要一个新方案，简化按需为其数据库层增加或移除计算容量的过程。该方案还必须以最少的运维投入提供更好的性能、扩展性和持久性。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is concerned that two NAT instances in use will no longer be able to support the traffic needed for the company’s application. A solutions architect wants to implement a solution that is highly available, fault tolerant, and automatically scalable. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in the same Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 移除这两台 NAT 实例，用同一个可用区内的两个 NAT 网关替代。

options.text_en: Use Auto Scaling groups with Network Load Balancers for the NAT instances in different Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 为分布在不同可用区的 NAT 实例配合使用 Auto Scaling 组和 Network Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in different Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 移除这两台 NAT 实例，用位于不同可用区的两个 NAT 网关替代。

options.text_en: Replace the two NAT instances with Spot Instances in different Availability Zones and deploy a Network Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 把这两台 NAT 实例替换为分布在不同可用区的 Spot 实例，并部署一个 Network Load Balancer。

explanation_en:
NAT Gateway: NAT Gateways are managed, highly available, and scalable components provided by AWS. They are designed to handle the network address translation for instances in private subnets. By deploying NAT gateways in different Availability Zones, you ensure high availability.

Benefits of NAT Gateway:
Managed Service: NAT Gateway is a fully managed service, reducing operational overhead.
High Availability: Deploying NAT gateways in different Availability Zones ensures fault tolerance and high availability.
Automatically Scalable: NAT Gateways automatically scale based on the traffic volume, eliminating the need for manual adjustments.
explanation_zh:
NAT 网关：NAT 网关是 AWS 提供的托管、高可用且可扩展的组件。它们专为处理私有子网中实例的网络地址转换而设计。通过在不同可用区部署 NAT 网关，你可以确保高可用性。

NAT 网关的优势：
托管服务：NAT 网关是全托管服务，可降低运维开销。
高可用性：在不同可用区部署 NAT 网关可确保容错和高可用。
自动伸缩：NAT 网关会根据流量自动伸缩，无需手动调整。
stem_zh:
某公司担心正在使用的两台 NAT 实例将无法再支撑公司应用程序所需的流量。解决方案架构师希望实施一个高可用、容错且能自动伸缩的方案。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that has an Elastic IP address in VPC A. The application requires access to a database in VPC B. Both VPCs are in the same AWS account. Which solution will provide the required access MOST securely?

options.text_en: Create a DB instance security group that allows all traffic from the public IP address of the application server in VPC A.
options.text_zh: 创建一个数据库实例安全组，允许来自 VPC A 中应用服务器公有 IP 地址的所有流量。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC peering connection between VPC A and VPC B.
options.text_zh: 在 VPC A 和 VPC B 之间配置一条 VPC 对等连接。

options.text_en: Make the DB instance publicly accessible. Assign a public IP address to the DB instance.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例设为可公开访问，并为它分配一个公有 IP 地址。

options.text_en: Launch an EC2 instance with an Elastic IP address into VPC B. Proxy all requests through the new EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 在 VPC B 中启动一台带弹性 IP 地址的 EC2 实例。所有请求都通过这台新 EC2 实例代理转发。

explanation_en: VPC peering allows direct connectivity between two VPCs. This solution enables communication between instances in VPC A and VPC B using private IP addresses. It does not require public IP addresses or the exposure of databases to the public internet.
explanation_zh: VPC 对等连接允许两个 VPC 之间直接连通。该方案使 VPC A 和 VPC B 中的实例能够使用私有 IP 地址通信。它不需要公有 IP 地址，也不会将数据库暴露到公共互联网。
stem_zh:
某应用程序运行在 VPC A 中一台带弹性 IP 地址的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序需要访问 VPC B 中的一个数据库。两个 VPC 位于同一个 AWS 账户中。

哪个方案能最安全地提供所需的访问？

stem_en: A company runs demonstration environments for its customers on Amazon EC2 instances. Each environment is isolated in its own VPC. The company’s operations team needs to be notified when RDP or SSH access to an environment has been established.

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights to create AWS Systems Manager OpsItems when RDP or SSH access is detected.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights，在检测到 RDP 或 SSH 访问时创建 AWS Systems Manager OpsItems。

options.text_en: Configure the EC2 instances with an IAM instance profile that has an IAM role with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy attached.
options.text_zh: 为这些 EC2 实例配置一个 IAM 实例配置文件，其中的 IAM 角色附加了 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略。

options.text_en: Publish VPC flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create required metric filters. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm with a notification action for when the alarm is in the ALARM state.
options.text_zh: 把 VPC 流日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建所需的指标筛选器。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 指标告警，并配置告警进入 ALARM 状态时的通知动作。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to listen for events of type EC2 Instance State-change Notification. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a target. Subscribe the operations team to the topic.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则来监听 EC2 Instance State-change Notification 类型的事件。把一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题配置为目标。让运维团队订阅该主题。

explanation_en:
The correct option for notifying the operations team when RDP or SSH access to an environment has been established is:

C. Publish VPC flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create required metric filters. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm with a notification action for when the alarm is in the ALARM state.

Here's why:

VPC Flow Logs:** VPC flow logs capture information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. This includes information about accepted and rejected connections. To monitor RDP or SSH access, you can analyze these logs.

CloudWatch Logs:** By publishing VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, you can analyze the logs using metric filters to extract relevant information.

Metric Filters:** Create metric filters to match the patterns corresponding to RDP or SSH access in the CloudWatch Logs. For example, you can create metric filters that look for specific keywords or patterns related to RDP or SSH connections.
CloudWatch Metric Alarm:** Set up CloudWatch metric alarms based on the metric filters. When the alarm is triggered (indicating that RDP or SSH access has been detected), it can take a notification action, such as sending a notification to the operations team via Amazon SNS.
explanation_zh:
在有人建立到某个环境的 RDP 或 SSH 访问时通知运维团队的正确选项是：

C. 将 VPC 流日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建所需的指标筛选条件。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 指标告警，并设置在告警处于 ALARM 状态时执行通知操作。

原因如下：

VPC 流日志：** VPC 流日志会捕获进出你 VPC 中网络接口的 IP 流量信息，其中包括已接受和已拒绝连接的信息。要监控 RDP 或 SSH 访问，你可以分析这些日志。

CloudWatch Logs：** 通过将 VPC 流日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs，你可以使用指标筛选条件分析日志以提取相关信息。

指标筛选条件：** 创建指标筛选条件，以匹配 CloudWatch Logs 中对应 RDP 或 SSH 访问的模式。例如，你可以创建查找与 RDP 或 SSH 连接相关的特定关键字或模式的指标筛选条件。
CloudWatch 指标告警：** 基于这些指标筛选条件设置 CloudWatch 指标告警。当告警被触发时（表明检测到 RDP 或 SSH 访问），它可以执行通知操作，例如通过 Amazon SNS 向运维团队发送通知。
stem_zh: 某公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上为客户运行演示环境。每个环境都隔离在各自的 VPC 中。该公司的运维团队需要在有人通过 RDP 或 SSH 接入某个环境时收到通知。

stem_en: A solutions architect has created a new AWS account and must secure AWS account root user access. Which combination of actions will accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Ensure the root user uses a strong password.
options.text_zh: 确保根用户使用强密码。

options.text_en: Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user.
options.text_zh: 为根用户启用多重身份验证 (MFA)。

options.text_en: Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把根用户的访问密钥存放在一个加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

options.text_en: Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions.
options.text_zh: 把根用户加入一个拥有管理员权限的组。

options.text_en: Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document.
options.text_zh: 用内联策略文档给根用户授予所需权限。

explanation_en:
Using a strong, complex password for the root user is a fundamental security practice. This helps protect the account from unauthorized access.
Enabling MFA adds an additional layer of security. Even if someone manages to obtain the root user's password, they would still need the second factor (e.g., a mobile device or hardware token) to successfully authenticate.
explanation_zh:
为 root 用户使用强且复杂的密码是一项基本的安全实践。这有助于保护账户免遭未经授权的访问。
启用 MFA 增加了一层额外的安全防护。即使有人设法获得了 root 用户的密码，他们仍需要第二重因素（例如移动设备或硬件令牌）才能成功通过身份验证。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师创建了一个新的 AWS 账户，必须保护 AWS 账户 root 用户的访问。

哪些操作组合能实现这一点？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is building a new web-based customer relationship management application. The application will use several Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application will also use an Amazon Aurora database. All data for the application must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) certificates on the ALB to encrypt data in transit. Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest.
options.text_zh: 在 ALB 上使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 证书来加密传输中的数据。使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 加密静态的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。

options.text_en: Use the AWS root account to log in to the AWS Management Console. Upload the company’s encryption certificates. While in the root account, select the option to turn on encryption for all data at rest and in transit for the account.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS 根账户登录 AWS 管理控制台。上传公司的加密证书。在根账户中选择为该账户所有静态数据和传输中数据开启加密的选项。

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest. Attach an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密静态的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。为 ALB 附加一张 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 证书来加密传输中的数据。

options.text_en: Use BitLocker to encrypt all data at rest. Import the company’s TLS certificate keys to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Attach the KMS keys to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.
options.text_zh: 使用 BitLocker 加密所有静态数据。把公司的 TLS 证书密钥导入 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)。把这些 KMS 密钥附加到 ALB 上来加密传输中的数据。

explanation_en:
Using AWS KMS to encrypt EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest is a good practice. You can specify a KMS key when creating these resources to ensure data encryption.

Attaching an ACM certificate to the ALB allows you to use HTTPS, which encrypts data in transit between clients and the ALB. This ensures secure communication over the network.
explanation_zh:
使用 AWS KMS 对 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储进行静态加密是一个好做法。你可以在创建这些资源时指定 KMS 密钥以确保数据加密。

为 ALB 附加 ACM 证书使你能够使用 HTTPS，从而加密客户端与 ALB 之间传输的数据。这确保了网络上的安全通信。
stem_zh:
某公司正在构建一个新的基于 Web 的客户关系管理应用程序。该应用程序将使用位于 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后、由 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷支持的多台 Amazon EC2 实例。该应用程序还将使用一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库。该应用程序的所有数据在静态和传输过程中都必须加密。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is moving its on-premises Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The database has several applications that write to the same tables. The applications need to be migrated one by one with a month in between each migration. Management has expressed concerns that the database has a high number of reads and writes. The data must be kept in sync across both databases throughout the migration. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 做初始迁移。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 创建一个变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制任务，并用表映射选中所有表。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 做初始迁移。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 创建一个「全量加载 + 变更数据捕获 (CDC)」复制任务，并用表映射选中所有表。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a memory optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool 配合 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，采用内存优化型复制实例。创建一个「全量加载 + 变更数据捕获 (CDC)」复制任务，并用表映射选中所有表。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a compute optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select the largest tables.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool 配合 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，采用计算优化型复制实例。创建一个「全量加载 + 变更数据捕获 (CDC)」复制任务，并用表映射选中最大的那几张表。

stem_zh: 某公司正在把其本地的 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。该数据库有多个应用会写入同一批表。这些应用需要逐个迁移，每两次迁移之间间隔一个月。管理层担心该数据库的读写量很高。在整个迁移过程中，两个数据库的数据必须保持同步。解决方案架构师应该推荐什么？

stem_en: A company has a three-tier application for image sharing. The application uses an Amazon EC2 instance for the front-end layer, another EC2 instance for the application layer, and a third EC2 instance for a MySQL database. A solutions architect must design a scalable and highly available solution that requires the least amount of change to the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use AWS Lambda functions for the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 托管前端层。用 AWS Lambda 函数承担应用层。把数据库迁移到一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。用 Amazon S3 存储并分发用户的图片。

options.text_en: Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS DB instance with multiple read replicas to serve users’ images.
options.text_zh: 为前端层和应用层使用带负载均衡的多可用区 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境。把数据库迁移到一个带多个只读副本的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例，由它来分发用户的图片。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use a fleet of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group for the application layer. Move the database to a memory optimized instance type to store and serve users’ images.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 托管前端层。用一个 Auto Scaling 组中的一批 EC2 实例承担应用层。把数据库迁移到内存优化型实例类型上，用它存储并分发用户的图片。

options.text_en: Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.
options.text_zh: 为前端层和应用层使用带负载均衡的多可用区 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境。把数据库迁移到一个多可用区的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。用 Amazon S3 存储并分发用户的图片。

explanation_en:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk provides an easy way to deploy and manage applications. By using Multi-AZ environments, the front-end and application layers can automatically scale and provide high availability across multiple Availability Zones (AZs).
Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB Instance:
Moving the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance ensures high availability and automatic failover in the event of a failure in one Availability Zone.
Amazon S3 for Storing and Serving Images:
Using Amazon S3 for storing and serving users' images is a scalable and cost-effective solution. S3 is designed for high durability and availability, making it suitable for serving static content like images.
explanation_zh:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk 提供了一种部署和管理应用程序的简便方式。通过使用多可用区环境，前端层和应用层可以自动伸缩，并跨多个可用区（AZ）提供高可用性。
Amazon RDS 多可用区数据库实例：
将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS 多可用区数据库实例可确保高可用性，并在某个可用区发生故障时自动故障转移。
使用 Amazon S3 存储和提供图片：
使用 Amazon S3 存储和提供用户图片是一种可扩展且具有成本效益的方案。S3 专为高持久性和高可用性设计，因此适合提供图片等静态内容。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个用于图片共享的三层应用程序。该应用程序使用一台 Amazon EC2 实例作为前端层，另一台 EC2 实例作为应用层，第三台 EC2 实例运行 MySQL 数据库。解决方案架构师必须设计一个可扩展且高可用的方案，并且对应用程序的改动尽可能少。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An application running on an Amazon EC2 instance in VPC-A needs to access files in another EC2 instance in VPC-B. Both VPCs are in separate AWS accounts. The network administrator needs to design a solution to configure secure access to EC2 instance in VPC-B from VPC-A. The connectivity should not have a single point of failure or bandwidth concerns. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set up a VPC peering connection between VPC-A and VPC-B.
options.text_zh: 在 VPC-A 和 VPC-B 之间建立一条 VPC 对等连接。

options.text_en: Set up VPC gateway endpoints for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B.
options.text_zh: 为运行在 VPC-B 中的那台 EC2 实例设置 VPC 网关端点。

options.text_en: Attach a virtual private gateway to VPC-B and set up routing from VPC-A.
options.text_zh: 为 VPC-B 挂接一个虚拟专用网关，并从 VPC-A 配置路由。

options.text_en: Create a private virtual interface (VIF) for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B and add appropriate routes from VPC-A.
options.text_zh: 为运行在 VPC-B 中的那台 EC2 实例创建一个私有虚拟接口 (VIF)，并从 VPC-A 添加相应的路由。

explanation_en: A VPC peering connection allows secure communication between instances in different VPCs using private IP addresses without the need for internet gateways, VPN connections, or NAT devices. By setting it up, the application running in VPC-A can directly access the EC2 in VPC-B without going through the public internet or any single point of failure.
explanation_zh: VPC 对等连接允许不同 VPC 中的实例使用私有 IP 地址进行安全通信，无需互联网网关、VPN 连接或 NAT 设备。建立该连接后，运行在 VPC-A 中的应用程序可以直接访问 VPC-B 中的 EC2，无需经过公共互联网或任何单点故障环节。
stem_zh:
运行在 VPC-A 中一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序需要访问 VPC-B 中另一台 EC2 实例上的文件。两个 VPC 位于不同的 AWS 账户中。网络管理员需要设计一个方案，配置从 VPC-A 到 VPC-B 中 EC2 实例的安全访问。该连接不应存在单点故障或带宽方面的顾虑。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to experiment with individual AWS accounts for its engineer team. The company wants to be notified as soon as the Amazon EC2 instance usage for a given month exceeds a specific threshold for each account. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use Cost Explorer to create a daily report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.text_zh: 使用 Cost Explorer 创建一份按服务分类的每日成本报告。按 EC2 实例筛选该报告。配置 Cost Explorer 在超过阈值时通过 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 发送通知。

options.text_en: Use Cost Explorer to create a monthly report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.text_zh: 使用 Cost Explorer 创建一份按服务分类的每月成本报告。按 EC2 实例筛选该报告。配置 Cost Explorer 在超过阈值时通过 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 发送通知。

options.text_en: Use AWS Budgets to create a cost budget for each account. Set the period to monthly. Set the scope to EC2 instances. Set an alert threshold for the budget. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Budgets 为每个账户创建一个成本预算。把周期设为按月。把范围设为 EC2 实例。为该预算设置告警阈值。配置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，在超过阈值时接收通知。

options.text_en: Use AWS Cost and Usage Reports to create a report with hourly granularity. Integrate the report data with Amazon Athena. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an Athena query. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 创建一份按小时粒度的报告。把报告数据与 Amazon Athena 集成。使用 Amazon EventBridge 定时触发一个 Athena 查询。配置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，在超过阈值时接收通知。

explanation_en: AWS Budgets is a cost management service that allows you to set custom cost and usage budgets that alert you when you exceed your thresholds. In this case, you can create a monthly budget specifically for EC2 instances, and when the usage exceeds the defined threshold, it triggers an alert.
explanation_zh: AWS Budgets 是一项成本管理服务，允许你设置自定义的成本和使用量预算，在超过阈值时向你发出告警。在这种情况下，你可以专门为 EC2 实例创建一个月度预算，当使用量超过设定的阈值时就会触发告警。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为其工程团队试行独立的 AWS 账户。公司希望在某个账户在指定月份的 Amazon EC2 实例使用量超过特定阈值时立即收到通知。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最具成本效益的方式满足此要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to design a new microservice for a company’s application. Clients must be able to call an HTTPS endpoint to reach the microservice. The microservice also must use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to authenticate calls. The solutions architect will write the logic for this microservice by using a single AWS Lambda function that is written in Go 1.x. Which solution will deploy the function in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure the method to use the Lambda function. Enable IAM authentication on the API.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API。把该方法配置为使用这个 Lambda 函数。在该 API 上启用 IAM 身份验证。

options.text_en: Create a Lambda function URL for the function. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.
options.text_zh: 为该函数创建一个 Lambda 函数 URL。把身份验证类型指定为 AWS_IAM。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to Lambda@Edge. Integrate IAM authentication logic into the Lambda@Edge function.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。把该函数部署到 Lambda@Edge。在该 Lambda@Edge 函数中集成 IAM 身份验证逻辑。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to CloudFront Functions. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。把该函数部署为 CloudFront Functions。把身份验证类型指定为 AWS_IAM。

explanation_en: Explanation: A Lambda function URL gives the function its own HTTPS endpoint directly, with no separate API Gateway resource to create or manage. Setting the auth type to AWS_IAM satisfies the IAM-authentication requirement, making this the more operationally efficient option compared to fronting the function with a full API Gateway REST API.
explanation_zh: 解析：Lambda 函数 URL 直接为函数提供了自己的 HTTPS 端点，无需另外创建或管理 API Gateway 资源。将身份验证类型设为 AWS_IAM 即可满足 IAM 身份验证的要求，因此相比在函数前面架设一个完整的 API Gateway REST API，这是运维上更高效的选项。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要为某公司的应用程序设计一个新的微服务。客户端必须能够调用一个 HTTPS 端点来访问该微服务。该微服务还必须使用 AWS Identity and Access Management（IAM）对调用进行身份验证。解决方案架构师将使用单个用 Go 1.x 编写的 AWS Lambda 函数来实现该微服务的逻辑。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式部署该函数？

stem_en: A company previously migrated its data warehouse solution to AWS. The company also has an AWS Direct Connect connection. Corporate office users query the data warehouse using a visualization tool. The average size of a query returned by the data warehouse is 50 MB and each webpage sent by the visualization tool is approximately 500 KB. Result sets returned by the data warehouse are not cached. Which solution provides the LOWEST data transfer egress cost for the company?

options.text_en: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over the internet.
options.text_zh: 把可视化工具部署在本地，直接通过互联网查询数据仓库。

options.text_en: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse. Access it over the internet.
options.text_zh: 把可视化工具部署在与数据仓库相同的 AWS 区域，通过互联网访问它。

options.text_en: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same AWS Region.
options.text_zh: 把可视化工具部署在本地，在同一个 AWS 区域的接入点上通过 Direct Connect 连接直接查询数据仓库。

options.text_en: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse and access it over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same Region.
options.text_zh: 把可视化工具部署在与数据仓库相同的 AWS 区域，并在同一区域的接入点上通过 Direct Connect 连接访问它。

explanation_en: Hosting the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse and accessing it over a Direct Connect connection within the same Region minimizes data transfer costs. Since the data warehouse and the visualization tool are in the same Region, the data transfer between them doesn't incur the usual costs associated with data leaving the AWS network.
explanation_zh: 将可视化工具托管在与数据仓库相同的 AWS 区域中，并在同一区域内通过 Direct Connect 连接访问，可最大限度降低数据传输成本。由于数据仓库和可视化工具位于同一区域，它们之间的数据传输不会产生数据离开 AWS 网络时通常会产生的费用。
stem_zh:
某公司此前已将其数据仓库方案迁移到 AWS。公司还拥有一条 AWS Direct Connect 连接。公司办公室用户使用一个可视化工具查询数据仓库。数据仓库返回的查询结果平均大小为 50 MB，可视化工具发送的每个网页约为 500 KB。数据仓库返回的结果集不做缓存。

哪个方案能为公司提供最低的数据传出（egress）成本？

stem_en: An online learning company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company maintains its student records in a PostgreSQL database. The company needs a solution in which its data is available and online across multiple AWS Regions at all times. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to a PostgreSQL cluster on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 集群。

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with the Multi-AZ feature turned on.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到一个开启了多可用区功能的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Create a read replica in another Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。在另一个区域创建一个只读副本。

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Set up DB snapshots to be copied to another Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。设置把数据库快照复制到另一个区域。

explanation_en: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL allows you to create read replicas in different AWS Regions. This provides cross-Region availability and redundancy. Additionally, it allows you to offload read traffic from the primary database.
explanation_zh: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 允许你在不同的 AWS 区域中创建只读副本。这提供了跨区域可用性和冗余。此外，它还允许你从主数据库分流读流量。
stem_zh:
某在线学习公司正在迁移到 AWS 云。公司将其学生记录保存在一个 PostgreSQL 数据库中。公司需要一个方案，使其数据始终在多个 AWS 区域中可用并保持在线。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts its web application on AWS using seven Amazon EC2 instances. The company requires that the IP addresses of all healthy EC2 instances be returned in response to DNS queries. Which policy should be used to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Simple routing policy
options.text_zh: 简单路由策略

options.text_en: Latency routing policy
options.text_zh: 延迟路由策略

options.text_en: Multivalue routing policy
options.text_zh: 多值路由策略

options.text_en: Geolocation routing policy
options.text_zh: 地理位置路由策略

explanation_en:
The multivalue routing policy returns multiple healthy IP addresses for the resource in response to DNS queries. This is suitable for distributing traffic across multiple resources, such as EC2 instances, and meeting the specified requirement.

Simple Routing: Gives one answer (IP address).
Latency Routing: Considers the fastest route but still gives one answer.
Multivalue Routing: Gives multiple answers (multiple IP addresses).
Geolocation Routing: Directs based on user location but typically gives one answer.
explanation_zh:
多值应答路由策略会在响应 DNS 查询时返回该资源的多个健康 IP 地址。这适合在多个资源（例如 EC2 实例）之间分发流量，并满足题目所述要求。

简单路由：给出一个答案（IP 地址）。
延迟路由：考虑最快的路径，但仍只给出一个答案。
多值应答路由：给出多个答案（多个 IP 地址）。
地理位置路由：根据用户位置进行导向，但通常只给出一个答案。
stem_zh:
某公司使用七台 Amazon EC2 实例在 AWS 上托管其 Web 应用程序。公司要求在响应 DNS 查询时返回所有健康 EC2 实例的 IP 地址。

应使用哪种策略来满足此要求？

stem_en: A medical research lab produces data that is related to a new study. The lab wants to make the data available with minimum latency to clinics across the country for their on-premises, file-based applications. The data files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that has read-only permissions for each clinic. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic
options.text_zh: 在每家诊所本地以虚拟机 (VM) 形式部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关。

options.text_en: Migrate the files to each clinic’s on-premises applications by using AWS DataSync for processing.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync 把文件迁移到每家诊所的本地应用中进行处理。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic.
options.text_zh: 在每家诊所本地以虚拟机 (VM) 形式部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。

options.text_en: Attach an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to each clinic’s on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 把一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统挂载到每家诊所的本地服务器上。

explanation_en: This option provides a way to present an S3 bucket as a file system to on-premises applications. Each clinic can deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway as a VM on-premises, allowing them to access the data in the S3 bucket as if it were local files. It minimizes latency because the data is cached locally, and read-only permissions can be controlled at the S3 bucket level.
explanation_zh: 此选项提供了一种将 S3 存储桶以文件系统形式呈现给本地应用程序的方式。每家诊所都可以在本地以 VM 形式部署 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关，从而像访问本地文件一样访问 S3 存储桶中的数据。由于数据在本地缓存，因此延迟最小；同时可以在 S3 存储桶级别控制只读权限。
stem_zh:
某医学研究实验室产出与一项新研究相关的数据。实验室希望以最小的延迟将这些数据提供给全国各地诊所的本地文件型应用程序使用。数据文件存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中，每家诊所对该存储桶都有只读权限。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is using a content management system that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance contains both the web server and the database software. The company must make its website platform highly available and must enable the website to scale to meet user demand. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Move the database to Amazon RDS, and enable automatic backups. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer in the Availability Zone, and set the two instances as targets.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS，并启用自动备份。在同一个可用区手动再启动一台 EC2 实例。在该可用区配置一个 Application Load Balancer，把这两台实例设为目标。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora instance with a read replica in the same Availability Zone as the existing EC2 instance. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer, and set the two EC2 instances as targets.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Amazon Aurora 实例，并在与现有 EC2 实例相同的可用区创建一个只读副本。在同一个可用区手动再启动一台 EC2 实例。配置一个 Application Load Balancer，把这两台 EC2 实例设为目标。

options.text_en: Move the database to Amazon Aurora with a read replica in another Availability Zone. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora，并在另一个可用区创建一个只读副本。从该 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。在两个可用区中配置一个 Application Load Balancer。挂接一个跨这两个可用区、使用该 AMI 的 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Move the database to a separate EC2 instance, and schedule backups to Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the original EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一台独立的 EC2 实例，并安排备份到 Amazon S3。从原来那台 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。在两个可用区中配置一个 Application Load Balancer。挂接一个跨这两个可用区、使用该 AMI 的 Auto Scaling 组。

explanation_en: This option provides both high availability and scalability. Using Amazon Aurora with a read replica in another Availability Zone ensures data redundancy and failover capabilities. Configuring an Application Load Balancer across two Availability Zones and using Auto Scaling allows for scalability.
explanation_zh: 此选项同时提供高可用性和可扩展性。使用 Amazon Aurora 并在另一个可用区创建只读副本可确保数据冗余和故障转移能力。跨两个可用区配置 Application Load Balancer 并使用 Auto Scaling 则实现了可扩展性。
stem_zh:
某公司正在使用一个运行在单台 Amazon EC2 实例上的内容管理系统。该 EC2 实例同时包含 Web 服务器和数据库软件。公司必须使其网站平台具备高可用性，并且必须让网站能够扩展以满足用户需求。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is launching an application on AWS. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to direct traffic to at least two Amazon EC2 instances in a single target group. The instances are in an Auto Scaling group for each environment. The company requires a development environment and a production environment. The production environment will have periods of high traffic. Which solution will configure the development environment MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Reconfigure the target group in the development environment to have only one EC2 instance as a target.
options.text_zh: 重新配置开发环境中的目标组，只保留一台 EC2 实例作为目标。

options.text_en: Change the ALB balancing algorithm to least outstanding requests.
options.text_zh: 把 ALB 的负载均衡算法改为最少未完成请求数 (least outstanding requests)。

options.text_en: Reduce the size of the EC2 instances in both environments.
options.text_zh: 把两个环境中 EC2 实例的规格都调小。

options.text_en: Reduce the maximum number of EC2 instances in the development environment’s Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 降低开发环境 Auto Scaling 组中 EC2 实例的最大数量。

explanation_en: For a development environment, where high availability and scalability might not be as critical as in production, having only one EC2 instance as a target in the target group could be a cost-effective solution. This reduces the number of running instances in the development environment when compared to production.
explanation_zh: 对于开发环境来说，高可用性和可扩展性可能不像生产环境那样关键，因此在目标组中仅保留一台 EC2 实例作为目标可以是一种具有成本效益的方案。与生产环境相比，这减少了开发环境中运行的实例数量。
stem_zh:
某公司正在 AWS 上启动一个应用程序。该应用程序使用一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）将流量导向单个目标组中的至少两台 Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例在每个环境中都位于一个 Auto Scaling 组内。公司需要一个开发环境和一个生产环境。生产环境会有高流量时段。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式配置开发环境？

stem_en: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances are in private subnets. A solutions architect implements an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) and specifies the EC2 instances as the target group. However, the internet traffic is not reaching the EC2 instances. How should the solutions architect reconfigure the architecture to resolve this issue?

options.text_en: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet to allow internet traffic.
options.text_zh: 把该 ALB 替换为 Network Load Balancer。在一个公有子网中配置一个 NAT 网关来放通互联网流量。

options.text_en: Move the EC2 instances to public subnets. Add a rule to the EC2 instances’ security groups to allow outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例移到公有子网。在 EC2 实例的安全组中添加一条规则，允许出站流量到 0.0.0.0/0。

options.text_en: Update the route tables for the EC2 instances’ subnets to send 0.0.0.0/0 traffic through the internet gateway route. Add a rule to the EC2 instances’ security groups to allow outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.
options.text_zh: 更新这些 EC2 实例所在子网的路由表，把 0.0.0.0/0 的流量经由互联网网关路由。在 EC2 实例的安全组中添加一条规则，允许出站流量到 0.0.0.0/0。

options.text_en: Create public subnets in each Availability Zone. Associate the public subnets with the ALB. Update the route tables for the public subnets with a route to the private subnets.
options.text_zh: 在每个可用区创建公有子网。把这些公有子网关联到该 ALB。更新公有子网的路由表，添加一条通往私有子网的路由。

explanation_en: This option involves creating public subnets for the ALB, allowing it to receive internet traffic. The EC2 instances can remain in private subnets. This approach follows the best practice of using public subnets for internet-facing components like ALBs.
explanation_zh: 此选项涉及为 ALB 创建公有子网，使其能够接收互联网流量。EC2 实例可以继续留在私有子网中。这种做法遵循了对 ALB 等面向互联网的组件使用公有子网的最佳实践。
stem_zh:
某公司在多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用程序。这些 EC2 实例位于私有子网中。一位解决方案架构师部署了一个面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer（ALB），并将这些 EC2 实例指定为目标组。然而，互联网流量并未到达这些 EC2 实例。

解决方案架构师应如何重新配置架构以解决此问题？

stem_en: A company has deployed a database in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Due to increased transactions, the database support team is reporting slow reads against the DB instance and recommends adding a read replica. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take before implementing this change? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Enable binlog replication on the RDS primary node.
options.text_zh: 在 RDS 主节点上启用 binlog 复制。

options.text_en: Choose a failover priority for the source DB instance.
options.text_zh: 为源数据库实例选择故障转移优先级。

options.text_en: Allow long-running transactions to complete on the source DB instance.
options.text_zh: 让源数据库实例上长时间运行的事务先跑完。

options.text_en: Create a global table and specify the AWS Regions where the table will be available.
options.text_zh: 创建一个全局表，并指定该表将在哪些 AWS 区域可用。

options.text_en: Enable automatic backups on the source instance by setting the backup retention period to a value other than 0.
options.text_zh: 在源实例上启用自动备份，把备份保留期设为 0 以外的值。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 中部署了一个数据库。由于事务量增加，数据库支持团队报告该数据库实例读取速度慢，并建议添加只读副本。

在实施此更改之前，解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs analytics software on Amazon EC2 instances. The software accepts job requests from users to process data that has been uploaded to Amazon S3. Users report that some submitted data is not being processed Amazon CloudWatch reveals that the EC2 instances have a consistent CPU utilization at or near 100%. The company wants to improve system performance and scale the system based on user load. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a copy of the instance. Place all instances behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 创建该实例的副本。把所有实例放到一个 Application Load Balancer 之后。

options.text_en: Create an S3 VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the software to reference the endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个 S3 VPC 端点。更新软件使其引用该端点。

options.text_en: Stop the EC2 instances. Modify the instance type to one with a more powerful CPU and more memory. Restart the instances.
options.text_zh: 停止这些 EC2 实例。把实例类型改为 CPU 更强、内存更大的型号。然后重新启动实例。

options.text_en: Route incoming requests to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling group based on queue size. Update the software to read from the queue.
options.text_zh: 把传入请求路由到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)。配置一个基于队列长度伸缩的 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。更新软件使其从队列读取。

explanation_en: This option addresses the issue by offloading incoming requests to an SQS queue, allowing for decoupling of processing and scaling based on queue size. This helps improve system performance and allows for scaling based on user load.
explanation_zh: 此选项通过将传入请求卸载到 SQS 队列来解决问题，实现处理过程的解耦并基于队列大小进行伸缩。这有助于提升系统性能，并允许根据用户负载进行伸缩。
stem_zh: 某公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行分析软件。该软件接收用户提交的作业请求，处理已上传到 Amazon S3 的数据。用户反馈有部分提交的数据没有被处理。Amazon CloudWatch 显示这些 EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率持续处于或接近 100%。该公司希望提升系统性能，并根据用户负载伸缩系统。解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a media application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which AWS solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。创建一个使用所需客户端协议的文件共享。把应用服务器连接到该文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Configure tapes to use Amazon S3. Connect the application server to the tape gateway.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway 磁带网关。把磁带配置为使用 Amazon S3。把应用服务器连接到该磁带网关。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.text_zh: 创建一台 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。在该实例上安装并配置 Windows 文件共享角色。把应用服务器连接到该文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。把该文件系统挂载到源服务器上。把应用服务器连接到该文件系统。

explanation_en: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a fully managed file storage service that supports the SMB protocol. It provides a native Windows file system experience and is designed to be accessed by SMB clients. This option meets the requirements for a fully managed shared storage solution accessible via SMB.
explanation_zh: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是一项支持 SMB 协议的全托管文件存储服务。它提供原生的 Windows 文件系统体验，专为通过 SMB 客户端访问而设计。此选项满足了通过 SMB 访问的全托管共享存储方案的要求。
stem_zh:
249 主题 1
某公司正在为一个托管在 AWS 云中的媒体应用程序实施共享存储方案。公司需要能够使用 SMB 客户端访问数据。该方案必须是全托管的。

哪个 AWS 方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company’s security team requests that network traffic be captured in VPC Flow Logs. The logs will be frequently accessed for 90 days and then accessed intermittently. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements when configuring the logs?

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudWatch as the target. Set the CloudWatch log group with an expiration of 90 days
options.text_zh: 把 Amazon CloudWatch 作为目标。把该 CloudWatch 日志组的过期时间设为 90 天。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis as the target. Configure the Kinesis stream to always retain the logs for 90 days.
options.text_zh: 把 Amazon Kinesis 作为目标。配置该 Kinesis 流始终保留日志 90 天。

options.text_en: Use AWS CloudTrail as the target. Configure CloudTrail to save to an Amazon S3 bucket, and enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.text_zh: 把 AWS CloudTrail 作为目标。配置 CloudTrail 保存到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，并启用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 as the target. Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the logs to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days.
options.text_zh: 把 Amazon S3 作为目标。启用 S3 生命周期策略，在 90 天后把日志转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

explanation_en: Amazon S3 is a scalable and cost-effective object storage service. Enabling an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition logs to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days is a suitable solution. This approach allows you to store the logs in a cost-effective manner, automatically moving them to a lower-cost storage class after the initial 90 days.
explanation_zh: Amazon S3 是一项可扩展且具有成本效益的对象存储服务。启用 S3 生命周期策略在 90 天后将日志转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access（S3 Standard-IA）是一个合适的方案。这种做法让你能够以具有成本效益的方式存储日志，在最初的 90 天之后自动将其移动到成本更低的存储类。
stem_zh:
某公司的安全团队要求在 VPC 流日志中捕获网络流量。这些日志在 90 天内会被频繁访问，之后则间歇性访问。

解决方案架构师在配置这些日志时应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An Amazon EC2 instance is located in a private subnet in a new VPC. This subnet does not have outbound internet access, but the EC2 instance needs the ability to download monthly security updates from an outside vendor. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.
options.text_zh: 创建一个互联网网关并挂接到该 VPC。配置私有子网的路由表，把该互联网网关作为默认路由。

options.text_en: Create a NAT gateway, and place it in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT gateway as the default route.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 NAT 网关并放在一个公有子网中。配置私有子网的路由表，把该 NAT 网关作为默认路由。

options.text_en: Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT instance as the default route.
options.text_zh: 创建一台 NAT 实例，放在该 EC2 实例所在的同一个子网中。配置私有子网的路由表，把该 NAT 实例作为默认路由。

options.text_en: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.
options.text_zh: 创建一个互联网网关并挂接到该 VPC。再创建一台 NAT 实例，放在该 EC2 实例所在的同一个子网中。配置私有子网的路由表，把该互联网网关作为默认路由。

explanation_en: NAT gateways are designed to provide outbound internet access for instances in private subnets. Placing a NAT gateway in a public subnet and configuring the private subnet's route table to use the NAT gateway as the default route allows the EC2 instance to download security updates while maintaining security.
explanation_zh: NAT 网关专为向私有子网中的实例提供出站互联网访问而设计。将 NAT 网关放在公有子网中，并配置私有子网的路由表以该 NAT 网关作为默认路由，可让该 EC2 实例在保持安全的同时下载安全更新。
stem_zh:
某台 Amazon EC2 实例位于一个新 VPC 的私有子网中。该子网没有出站互联网访问，但该 EC2 实例需要能够从一家外部供应商下载每月安全更新。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to design a system to store client case files. The files are core company assets and are important. The number of files will grow over time. The files must be simultaneously accessible from multiple application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The solution must have built-in redundancy. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要设计一个系统来存储客户案件文件。这些文件是公司的核心资产，非常重要。文件数量会随时间增长。

这些文件必须能被运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的多台应用服务器同时访问。该方案必须具备内置冗余。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect has created two IAM policies: Policy1 and Policy2. Both policies are attached to an IAM group. A cloud engineer is added as an IAM user to the IAM group. Which action will the cloud engineer be able to perform?

options.text_en: Deleting IAM users
options.text_zh: 删除 IAM 用户

options.text_en: Deleting directories
options.text_zh: 删除目录

options.text_en: Deleting Amazon EC2 instances
options.text_zh: 删除 Amazon EC2 实例

options.text_en: Deleting logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs
options.text_zh: 删除 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志

stem_zh: 解决方案架构师创建了两个 IAM 策略：Policy1 和 Policy2。这两个策略都附加到了同一个 IAM 组上。一名云工程师作为 IAM 用户被加入该 IAM 组。这名云工程师能够执行下列哪项操作？

stem_en: A company is reviewing a recent migration of a three-tier application to a VPC. The security team discovers that the principle of least privilege is not being applied to Amazon EC2 security group ingress and egress rules between the application tiers. What should a solutions architect do to correct this issue?

options.text_en: Create security group rules using the instance ID as the source or destination.
options.text_zh: 用实例 ID 作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。

options.text_en: Create security group rules using the security group ID as the source or destination.
options.text_zh: 用安全组 ID 作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。

options.text_en: Create security group rules using the VPC CIDR blocks as the source or destination.
options.text_zh: 用 VPC CIDR 块作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。

options.text_en: Create security group rules using the subnet CIDR blocks as the source or destination.
options.text_zh: 用子网 CIDR 块作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。

explanation_en: Using security group IDs allows for dynamic and flexible configuration. Referencing security groups directly in rules ensures that instances associated with those security groups, regardless of their individual IDs, are included. This approach aligns with the principle of least privilege and simplifies rule management.
explanation_zh: 使用安全组 ID 可实现动态且灵活的配置。在规则中直接引用安全组可确保与这些安全组关联的实例（无论其各自的 ID 为何）都被包含在内。这种做法符合最小权限原则，并简化了规则管理。
stem_zh:
某公司正在复查最近将一个三层应用程序迁移到 VPC 的工作。安全团队发现，应用各层之间的 Amazon EC2 安全组入站和出站规则没有遵循最小权限原则。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来纠正此问题？

stem_en: A company has an ecommerce checkout workflow that writes an order to a database and calls a service to process the payment. Users are experiencing timeouts during the checkout process. When users resubmit the checkout form, multiple unique orders are created for the same desired transaction. How should a solutions architect refactor this workflow to prevent the creation of multiple orders?

options.text_en: Configure the web application to send an order message to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Set the payment service to retrieve the message from Kinesis Data Firehose and process the order.
options.text_zh: 配置该 Web 应用把订单消息发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。让支付服务从 Kinesis Data Firehose 取出消息并处理订单。

options.text_en: Create a rule in AWS CloudTrail to invoke an AWS Lambda function based on the logged application path request. Use Lambda to query the database, call the payment service, and pass in the order information.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一条规则，根据记录到的应用路径请求调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。用 Lambda 查询数据库、调用支付服务并传入订单信息。

options.text_en: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Set the payment service to poll Amazon SNS, retrieve the message, and process the order.
options.text_zh: 把订单存入数据库。把含有订单号的消息发送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)。让支付服务轮询 Amazon SNS、取出消息并处理订单。

options.text_en: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the payment service to retrieve the message and process the order. Delete the message from the queue.
options.text_zh: 把订单存入数据库。把含有订单号的消息发送到一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列。让支付服务取出消息并处理订单，然后从队列中删除该消息。

explanation_en:
Storing the order in the database first ensures that the order information is saved, even if the payment processing is delayed or fails.
Sending a message to an SQS FIFO queue with the order number ensures that the processing is idempotent. If the same order number is sent multiple times, SQS guarantees that the messages are processed in order and only once.
explanation_zh:
先将订单存入数据库可确保即使支付处理延迟或失败，订单信息也已保存。
向 SQS FIFO 队列发送带订单号的消息可确保处理具有幂等性。如果同一订单号被多次发送，SQS 可保证消息按顺序处理且仅处理一次。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个电子商务结账工作流，会将订单写入数据库并调用一项服务来处理支付。用户在结账过程中遇到超时。当用户重新提交结账表单时，同一笔期望的交易会创建出多个不同的订单。

解决方案架构师应如何重构此工作流以防止创建多个订单？

stem_en: A solutions architect is implementing a document review application using an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The solution must prevent accidental deletion of the documents and ensure that all versions of the documents are available. Users must be able to download, modify, and upload documents. Which combination of actions should be taken to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Enable a read-only bucket ACL.
options.text_zh: 启用只读的存储桶 ACL。

options.text_en: Enable versioning on the bucket.
options.text_zh: 为该存储桶启用版本控制。

options.text_en: Attach an IAM policy to the bucket.
options.text_zh: 为该存储桶附加一个 IAM 策略。

options.text_en: Enable MFA Delete on the bucket.
options.text_zh: 为该存储桶启用 MFA Delete。

options.text_en: Encrypt the bucket using AWS KMS.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS KMS 加密该存储桶。

explanation_en:
D. Enable MFA Delete on the bucket.
B. allows multiple versions of objects in the S3 bucket to be stored. This ensures that all versions of the documents are available, even if they are accidentally overwritten or deleted.

D. adds an extra layer of protection against accidental deletion of objects in the bucket. With MFA Delete enabled, a user would need to provide an additional authentication factor to successfully delete objects from the bucket. This helps prevent accidental or unauthorized deletions and provides an extra level of security for critical documents.
explanation_zh:
D. 在该存储桶上启用 MFA Delete。
B. 允许在 S3 存储桶中存储对象的多个版本。这确保了文档的所有版本都可用，即使被意外覆盖或删除也是如此。

D. 为存储桶中对象的意外删除增加了一层额外保护。启用 MFA Delete 后，用户需要提供额外的身份验证因素才能成功删除存储桶中的对象。这有助于防止意外或未经授权的删除，并为关键文档提供了额外的安全层级。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在实施一个文档审阅应用程序，使用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶进行存储。该方案必须防止文档被意外删除，并确保文档的所有版本都可用。用户必须能够下载、修改和上传文档。

应采取哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is building a solution that will report Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling events across all the applications in an AWS account. The company needs to use a serverless solution to store the EC2 Auto Scaling status data in Amazon S3. The company then will use the data in Amazon S3 to provide near-real-time updates in a dashboard. The solution must not affect the speed of EC2 instance launches. How should the company move the data to Amazon S3 to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use an Amazon CloudWatch metric stream to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标流把 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。把数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 启动一个 Amazon EMR 集群来收集 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据，并把数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。把数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule. Configure the Lambda function to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data directly to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，按计划调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数把 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据直接发送到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Use a bootstrap script during the launch of an EC2 instance to install Amazon Kinesis Agent. Configure Kinesis Agent to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 在 EC2 实例启动时用引导脚本安装 Amazon Kinesis Agent。配置 Kinesis Agent 收集 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据并把数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。把数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。

stem_zh: 某公司正在构建一套方案，用来上报某个 AWS 账户中所有应用的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 事件。该公司需要用无服务器方案把 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据存储到 Amazon S3。之后公司会用 Amazon S3 中的数据在仪表板上提供准实时更新。该方案不能影响 EC2 实例的启动速度。该公司应该如何把数据搬到 Amazon S3 才能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company has an application that places hundreds of .csv files into an Amazon S3 bucket every hour. The files are 1 GB in size. Each time a file is uploaded, the company needs to convert the file to Apache Parquet format and place the output file into an S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to download the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function for each S3 PUT event.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，下载这些 .csv 文件、把它们转换成 Parquet 格式，并把输出文件放到一个 S3 存储桶中。对每个 S3 PUT 事件调用该 Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Create an Apache Spark job to read the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the Spark job.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Apache Spark 作业来读取这些 .csv 文件、把它们转换成 Parquet 格式，并把输出文件放到一个 S3 存储桶中。为每个 S3 PUT 事件创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来触发该 Spark 作业。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Glue table and an AWS Glue crawler for the S3 bucket where the application places the .csv files. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically use Amazon Athena to query the AWS Glue table, convert the query results into Parquet format, and place the output files into an S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 为应用放置 .csv 文件的那个 S3 存储桶创建一张 AWS Glue 表和一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序。定时触发一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用 Amazon Athena 定期查询该 AWS Glue 表，把查询结果转换成 Parquet 格式，并把输出文件放到一个 S3 存储桶中。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Parquet format and place the output files into an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the ETL job.
