A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to automate the scalability of the application. The solution must optimize the cost of the architecture and must ensure that the application has enough CPU resources when surges occur. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters the ALARM state when the CPUUtilization metric is less than 20%. Create an AWS Lambda function that the CloudWatch alarm invokes to terminate one of the EC2 instances in the ALB target group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，当 CPUUtilization 指标低于 20% 时进入 ALARM 状态。创建一个由该 CloudWatch 告警触发的 AWS Lambda 函数，终止 ALB 目标组中的一台 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set a target tracking scaling policy that is based on the ASGAverageCPUUtilization metric. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, the maximum instances to 6, and the target value to 50%. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。选择现有的 ALB 作为负载均衡器、现有的目标组作为目标组。设置一条基于 ASGAverageCPUUtilization 指标的目标跟踪伸缩策略。把最小实例数设为 2、期望容量设为 3、最大实例数设为 6、目标值设为 50%。把这些 EC2 实例加入该 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, and the maximum instances to 6. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。选择现有的 ALB 作为负载均衡器、现有的目标组作为目标组。把最小实例数设为 2、期望容量设为 3、最大实例数设为 6。把这些 EC2 实例加入该 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Create two Amazon CloudWatch alarms. Configure the first CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization metric is below 20%. Configure the second CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization matric is above 50%. Configure the alarms to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an email message. After receiving the message, log in to decrease or increase the number of EC2 instances that are running.
options.text_zh: 创建两个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警。把第一个告警配置为在平均 CPUUtilization 指标低于 20% 时进入 ALARM 状态。把第二个告警配置为在平均 CPUUtilization 指标高于 50% 时进入 ALARM 状态。配置这两个告警发布到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题以发送邮件。收到邮件后登录去减少或增加正在运行的 EC2 实例数量。

explanation_en:
Option B utilizes EC2 Auto Scaling, which automatically adjusts the number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group based on the specified target tracking scaling policy.
By setting a target tracking scaling policy based on the ASGAverageCPUUtilization metric with a target value of 50%, the Auto Scaling group will dynamically adjust the number of instances to maintain an average CPU utilization close to the target value.
This solution provides scalability when needed, ensures that there are enough CPU resources during surges, and optimizes costs by automatically adjusting the capacity based on demand.
explanation_zh:
选项 B 利用了 EC2 Auto Scaling，它会根据指定的目标跟踪伸缩策略自动调整 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例数量。
通过设置基于 ASGAverageCPUUtilization 指标、目标值为 50% 的目标跟踪伸缩策略，该 Auto Scaling 组会动态调整实例数量，使平均 CPU 利用率保持在接近目标值的水平。
该方案在需要时提供可扩展性，确保流量激增期间有足够的 CPU 资源，并通过根据需求自动调整容量来优化成本。
stem_zh: 某公司把一个应用部署在五台 Amazon EC2 实例上。一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 通过目标组把流量分发到这些实例。大多数时候每台实例的平均 CPU 使用率都低于 10%，偶尔会飙升到 65%。解决方案架构师需要实现一套方案来自动化该应用的可伸缩性。该方案必须优化架构成本，同时确保流量激增时应用有足够的 CPU 资源。哪个方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company is running a critical business application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group and access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The design did not pass an operational review because the EC2 instances and the DB instance are all located in a single Availability Zone. A solutions architect must update the design to use a second Availability Zone. Which solution will make the application highly available?

options.text_en: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.
options.text_zh: 在每个可用区各预置一个子网。配置该 Auto Scaling 组把 EC2 实例分散到两个可用区。配置该数据库实例连接到各个网络。

options.text_en: Provision two subnets that extend across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.
options.text_zh: 预置两个横跨两个可用区的子网。配置该 Auto Scaling 组把 EC2 实例分散到两个可用区。配置该数据库实例连接到各个网络。

options.text_en: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.text_zh: 在每个可用区各预置一个子网。配置该 Auto Scaling 组把 EC2 实例分散到两个可用区。把该数据库实例配置为多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Provision a subnet that extends across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.text_zh: 预置一个横跨两个可用区的子网。配置该 Auto Scaling 组把 EC2 实例分散到两个可用区。把该数据库实例配置为多可用区部署。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个业务关键应用程序。这些 EC2 实例运行在一个 Auto Scaling 组中，并访问一个 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。

由于这些 EC2 实例和数据库实例全部位于单个可用区，该设计未能通过运维评审。解决方案架构师必须更新设计以使用第二个可用区。

哪个方案能使该应用程序具备高可用性？

stem_en: A research laboratory needs to process approximately 8 TB of data. The laboratory requires sub-millisecond latencies and a minimum throughput of 6 GBps for the storage subsystem. Hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux will distribute and process the data. Which solution will meet the performance requirements?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Sat each volume’ tiering policy to ALL. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the fila system on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统。把每个卷的分层策略设为 ALL。把原始数据导入该文件系统。在这些 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent SSD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存放原始数据。创建一个使用持久化 SSD 存储的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。勾选从 Amazon S3 导入数据、向 Amazon S3 导出数据的选项。在这些 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent HDD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存放原始数据。创建一个使用持久化 HDD 存储的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。勾选从 Amazon S3 导入数据、向 Amazon S3 导出数据的选项。在这些 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume’s tiering policy to NONE. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统。把每个卷的分层策略设为 NONE。把原始数据导入该文件系统。在这些 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。

explanation_en:
Amazon FSx for Lustre is a high-performance file system designed for use with compute-intensive workloads. It provides sub-millisecond latencies and is well-suited for scenarios where high throughput is required.
Using persistent SSD storage for the Amazon FSx for Lustre file system ensures that it meets the minimum throughput requirement of 6 GBps.
Storing the raw data in an Amazon S3 bucket allows for scalable and durable storage, and the integration with FSx for Lustre allows seamless importing and exporting of data to and from S3.
This solution is designed to provide the required performance characteristics for processing large amounts of data with hundreds of EC2 instances.
explanation_zh:
Amazon FSx for Lustre 是一款专为计算密集型工作负载设计的高性能文件系统。它提供亚毫秒级延迟，非常适合需要高吞吐量的场景。
为 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统使用持久化 SSD 存储可确保满足至少 6 GBps 的吞吐量要求。
将原始数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中可提供可扩展且持久的存储，与 FSx for Lustre 的集成则允许无缝地在 S3 之间导入和导出数据。
该方案旨在为数百台 EC2 实例处理大量数据提供所需的性能特性。
stem_zh:
某研究实验室需要处理约 8 TB 的数据。该实验室要求存储子系统具有亚毫秒级延迟和至少 6 GBps 的吞吐量。数百台运行 Amazon Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例将分发并处理这些数据。

哪个方案能满足这些性能要求？

stem_en: A company needs to migrate a legacy application from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud because of hardware capacity constraints. The application runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application’s database storage continues to grow over time. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 把应用层迁移到 Amazon EC2 Spot 实例。把数据存储层迁移到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS On-Demand Instances.
options.text_zh: 把应用层迁移到 Amazon EC2 预留实例。把数据存储层迁移到 Amazon RDS 按需实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances.
options.text_zh: 把应用层迁移到 Amazon EC2 预留实例。把数据存储层迁移到 Amazon Aurora 预留实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS Reserved Instances.
options.text_zh: 把应用层迁移到 Amazon EC2 按需实例。把数据存储层迁移到 Amazon RDS 预留实例。

explanation_en:
Using Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances for the application layer provides cost savings compared to On-Demand Instances while ensuring availability for the 24/7 runtime.
Migrating the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances provides a fully managed relational database service with automatic scaling capabilities. Amazon Aurora is designed for high performance and cost efficiency.
Reserved Instances provide cost savings compared to On-Demand Instances over an extended period, making them suitable for applications with continuous operation.
Amazon Aurora, being a fully managed service, offloads much of the operational overhead associated with managing a traditional database, making it a cost-effective choice for growing database storage.
explanation_zh:
对应用层使用 Amazon EC2 预留实例，与按需实例相比可节省成本，同时确保 7×24 小时运行时的可用性。
将数据存储层迁移到 Amazon Aurora 预留实例，可提供具备自动扩展能力的全托管关系数据库服务。Amazon Aurora 专为高性能和成本效益而设计。
在较长时间跨度上，预留实例相比按需实例可节省成本，因此适合持续运行的应用程序。
Amazon Aurora 作为全托管服务，免去了管理传统数据库所带来的大量运维开销，对于不断增长的数据库存储来说是一个具有成本效益的选择。
stem_zh:
由于硬件容量限制，某公司需要将一个遗留应用程序从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS 云。该应用程序每周 7 天、每天 24 小时运行。该应用程序的数据库存储会随时间持续增长。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A university research laboratory needs to migrate 30 TB of data from an on-premises Windows file server to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The laboratory has a 1 Gbps network link that many other departments in the university share. The laboratory wants to implement a data migration service that will maximize the performance of the data transfer. However, the laboratory needs to be able to control the amount of bandwidth that the service uses to minimize the impact on other departments. The data migration must take place within the next 5 days. Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: AWS Snowcone
options.text_zh: AWS Snowcone

options.text_en: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.text_zh: Amazon FSx File Gateway

options.text_en: AWS DataSync
options.text_zh: AWS DataSync

options.text_en: AWS Transfer Family
options.text_zh: AWS Transfer Family

explanation_en:
AWS DataSync is a fully managed data transfer service that can be used to simplify, automate, and accelerate copying large amounts of data between on-premises storage systems and Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, or Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
With AWS DataSync, you can control the bandwidth to minimize the impact on other departments by configuring the maximum bandwidth that the data transfer service is allowed to use.
AWS DataSync is designed for high-speed data transfers, and it can take advantage of the available network bandwidth to maximize performance.
AWS DataSync can be quickly set up and configured for the migration, allowing the laboratory to meet the 5-day migration timeline.
explanation_zh:
AWS DataSync 是一项全托管的数据传输服务，可用于简化、自动化和加速在本地存储系统与 Amazon S3、Amazon EFS 或 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 之间复制大量数据。
使用 AWS DataSync，你可以通过配置该数据传输服务允许使用的最大带宽来控制带宽，从而尽量减少对其他部门的影响。
AWS DataSync 专为高速数据传输而设计，能够充分利用可用网络带宽以最大化性能。
AWS DataSync 可以快速设置和配置以进行迁移，使实验室能够满足 5 天的迁移时限。
stem_zh: 某大学研究实验室需要把 30 TB 数据从本地的 Windows 文件服务器迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。该实验室有一条 1 Gbps 的网络链路，校内许多其他院系也共用这条链路。实验室希望采用一种能最大化传输性能的数据迁移服务，但同时需要能控制该服务占用的带宽，以尽量减少对其他院系的影响。这次数据迁移必须在未来 5 天内完成。哪个 AWS 方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company wants to create a mobile app that allows users to stream slow-motion video clips on their mobile devices. Currently, the app captures video clips and uploads the video clips in raw format into an Amazon S3 bucket. The app retrieves these video clips directly from the S3 bucket. However, the videos are large in their raw format. Users are experiencing issues with buffering and playback on mobile devices. The company wants to implement solutions to maximize the performance and scalability of the app while minimizing operational overhead. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching.
options.text_zh: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 做内容分发和缓存。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AW'S Regions in other S3 buckets.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync 把视频文件跨 AWS 区域复制到其他 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 把视频文件转换成更合适的格式。

options.text_en: Deploy an Auto Sealing group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching.
options.text_zh: 在 Local Zones 中部署一个 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组来做内容分发和缓存。

options.text_en: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组，把视频文件转换成更合适的格式。

explanation_en:
C. Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.

Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that can distribute your video content globally, reducing latency and improving the speed of delivery.
CloudFront can cache the video content at edge locations, which helps in minimizing the load on the S3 bucket and improves playback performance for users.

Amazon Elastic Transcoder can convert the raw video files into more appropriate formats suitable for streaming, reducing the size of the videos.
By using Elastic Transcoder, you can create different versions of the video files optimized for different devices, bitrates, and resolutions, which can significantly improve the playback experience on mobile devices
explanation_zh:
C. 使用 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 将视频文件转换为更合适的格式。

Amazon CloudFront 是一项内容分发网络（CDN）服务，可在全球范围内分发你的视频内容，降低延迟并提升交付速度。
CloudFront 可以在边缘站点缓存视频内容，这有助于减轻 S3 存储桶的负载并提升用户的播放性能。

Amazon Elastic Transcoder 可以将原始视频文件转换为更适合流式播放的格式，减小视频体积。
通过使用 Elastic Transcoder，你可以创建针对不同设备、码率和分辨率优化的多个视频版本，这能显著改善移动设备上的播放体验。
stem_zh:
某公司希望创建一款移动应用，让用户可以在移动设备上流式播放慢动作视频片段。目前，该应用采集视频片段并以原始格式上传到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。该应用直接从 S3 存储桶获取这些视频片段。然而，原始格式的视频体积很大。

用户在移动设备上遇到缓冲和播放问题。公司希望实施方案以最大化该应用的性能和可扩展性，同时最大限度降低运维开销。

哪些方案组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is launching a new application deployed on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster and is using the Fargate launch type for ECS tasks. The company is monitoring CPU and memory usage because it is expecting high traffic to the application upon its launch. However, the company wants to reduce costs when utilization decreases. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale at certain periods based on previous traffic patterns.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling，根据以往的流量规律在特定时段进行伸缩。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to scale Amazon ECS based on metric breaches that trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.text_zh: 在指标越界触发 Amazon CloudWatch 告警时，用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来伸缩 Amazon ECS。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with simple scaling policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.text_zh: 在 ECS 指标越界触发 Amazon CloudWatch 告警时，用带简单伸缩策略的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 进行伸缩。

options.text_en: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling with target tracking policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.text_zh: 在 ECS 指标越界触发 Amazon CloudWatch 告警时，用带目标跟踪策略的 AWS Application Auto Scaling 进行伸缩。

explanation_en:
AWS Application Auto Scaling is a service that can automatically adjust the number of running ECS tasks or services based on specified CloudWatch metrics.
Target tracking policies allow you to set a target value for a specific metric, and AWS Application Auto Scaling automatically adjusts the desired task count to maintain the target.
By using target tracking policies, you can ensure that the ECS cluster scales up or down based on the application's demand while maintaining a balance between cost efficiency and performance.
explanation_zh:
AWS Application Auto Scaling 是一项可根据指定的 CloudWatch 指标自动调整运行中 ECS 任务或服务数量的服务。
目标跟踪策略允许你为特定指标设置目标值，AWS Application Auto Scaling 会自动调整期望任务数以维持该目标。
通过使用目标跟踪策略，你可以确保 ECS 集群根据应用程序需求扩容或缩容，同时在成本效益与性能之间保持平衡。
stem_zh:
某公司正在推出一个部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群上的新应用程序，并为 ECS 任务使用 Fargate 启动类型。公司正在监控 CPU 和内存使用情况，因为预计应用程序上线时会有高流量。但公司希望在利用率下降时降低成本。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

stem_en: A company recently created a disaster recovery site in a different AWS Region. The company needs to transfer large amounts of data back and forth between NFS file systems in the two Regions on a periodic basis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync。

options.text_en: Use AWS Snowball devices.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备。

options.text_en: Set up an SFTP server on Amazon EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon EC2 上搭建一台 SFTP 服务器。

options.text_en: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)。

explanation_en: If we want to transfer large amount of data we can used AWS Datasync.
explanation_zh: 如果我们要传输大量数据，可以使用 AWS DataSync。
stem_zh:
某公司最近在另一个 AWS 区域创建了一个灾难恢复站点。公司需要定期在两个区域的 NFS 文件系统之间来回传输大量数据。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which AWS solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS DataSync 任务，把数据以可挂载文件系统的形式共享出来。把该文件系统挂载到应用服务器上。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.text_zh: 创建一台 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。在该实例上安装并配置 Windows 文件共享角色。把应用服务器连接到该文件共享。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。把该文件系统挂载到源服务器上。把应用服务器连接到该文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Assign an IAM role to the application to grant access to the S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the application server.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。给该应用分配一个 IAM 角色以授予对该 S3 存储桶的访问权限。把该 S3 存储桶挂载到应用服务器上。

explanation_en:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a fully managed file storage service that is compatible with the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol, making it suitable for use with SMB clients, including Windows-based systems.
With Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, you can create a file system that can be mounted on application servers, providing shared storage for the gaming application.
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server handles the management aspects such as server provisioning, maintenance, and backups, making it a fully managed solution.
explanation_zh:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是一项与服务器消息块（SMB）协议兼容的全托管文件存储服务，因此适合与包括 Windows 系统在内的 SMB 客户端配合使用。
使用 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server，你可以创建一个可挂载到应用服务器上的文件系统，为游戏应用程序提供共享存储。
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 负责服务器预置、维护和备份等管理工作，因此是一个全托管方案。
stem_zh:
某公司正在为一个托管在 AWS 云中的游戏应用程序设计共享存储方案。公司需要能够使用 SMB 客户端访问数据。该方案必须是全托管的。

哪个 AWS 方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to run an in-memory database for a latency-sensitive application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes more than 100,000 transactions each minute and requires high network throughput. A solutions architect needs to provide a cost- effective network design that minimizes data transfer charges. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Launch all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with cluster strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把所有 EC2 实例启动在同一个 AWS 区域内的同一个可用区。启动 EC2 实例时指定一个采用集群 (cluster) 策略的置放群组。

options.text_en: Launch all EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with partition strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把所有 EC2 实例启动在同一个 AWS 区域内的不同可用区。启动 EC2 实例时指定一个采用分区 (partition) 策略的置放群组。

options.text_en: Deploy an Auto Scaling group to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones based on a network utilization target.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Auto Scaling 组，按网络利用率目标在不同可用区启动 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Deploy an Auto Scaling group with a step scaling policy to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 部署一个带步进伸缩策略的 Auto Scaling 组，在不同可用区启动 EC2 实例。

explanation_en:
A placement group is a logical grouping of instances within a single Availability Zone. The "cluster" strategy for placement groups places instances in close proximity to each other, providing low-latency, high-throughput communication between instances.
By launching all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region, you minimize data transfer charges because data transfer within the same Availability Zone is not subject to additional costs.
explanation_zh:
置放群组是单个可用区内实例的逻辑分组。置放群组的"集群"策略会将实例放置在彼此非常靠近的位置，从而在实例之间提供低延迟、高吞吐量的通信。
通过在同一 AWS 区域内的同一可用区中启动所有 EC2 实例，你可以最大限度降低数据传输费用，因为同一可用区内的数据传输不会产生额外费用。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的一个延迟敏感型应用程序运行内存数据库。该应用程序每分钟处理超过 100,000 笔事务，并需要高网络吞吐量。解决方案架构师需要提供一个具有成本效益的网络设计，最大限度降低数据传输费用。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company that primarily runs its application servers on premises has decided to migrate to AWS. The company wants to minimize its need to scale its Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) storage on premises. The company wants only its recently accessed data to remain stored locally. Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon S3 File Gateway
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 File Gateway

options.text_en: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.text_zh: AWS Storage Gateway 磁带网关

options.text_en: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes
options.text_zh: AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关的存储卷 (stored volumes)

options.text_en: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes
options.text_zh: AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关的缓存卷 (cached volumes)

explanation_en:
AWS Storage Gateway provides a hybrid cloud storage service that enables on-premises applications to use cloud storage seamlessly.
Volume Gateway offers two modes: cached volumes and stored volumes.
In the cached volumes mode, the entire dataset is stored in Amazon S3, and the most frequently accessed data is cached on-premises. This allows the company to keep recently accessed data locally, minimizing the need for on-premises scaling.
explanation_zh:
AWS Storage Gateway 提供一项混合云存储服务，使本地应用程序能够无缝使用云存储。
卷网关提供两种模式：缓存卷和存储卷。
在缓存卷模式下，整个数据集存储在 Amazon S3 中，而访问最频繁的数据缓存在本地。这使公司能够将最近访问的数据保留在本地，最大限度减少本地扩展的需求。
stem_zh:
某公司主要在本地运行其应用服务器，现已决定迁移到 AWS。公司希望尽量减少在本地扩展其 Internet 小型计算机系统接口（iSCSI）存储的需求。公司希望只将最近访问的数据保留在本地。

公司应使用哪个 AWS 方案来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has multiple AWS accounts that use consolidated billing. The company runs several active high performance Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances for 90 days. The company’s finance team has access to AWS Trusted Advisor in the consolidated billing account and all other AWS accounts. The finance team needs to use the appropriate AWS account to access the Trusted Advisor check recommendations for RDS. The finance team must review the appropriate Trusted Advisor check to reduce RDS costs. Which combination of steps should the finance team take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the account where the RDS instances are running.
options.text_zh: 使用运行这些 RDS 实例的那个账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议。

options.text_en: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the consolidated billing account to see all RDS instance checks at the same time.
options.text_zh: 使用合并账单主账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议，以便一次性查看所有 RDS 实例的检查项。

options.text_en: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.
options.text_zh: 查看 Trusted Advisor 的「Amazon RDS 预留实例优化」检查项。

options.text_en: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.
options.text_zh: 查看 Trusted Advisor 的「Amazon RDS 空闲数据库实例」检查项。

options.text_en: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization.
options.text_zh: 查看 Trusted Advisor 的「Amazon Redshift 预留节点优化」检查项。

stem_zh:
某公司有多个使用合并账单的 AWS 账户。公司运行多个活跃的高性能 Amazon RDS for Oracle 按需数据库实例，为期 90 天。公司的财务团队可以在合并账单账户和所有其他 AWS 账户中访问 AWS Trusted Advisor。

财务团队需要使用相应的 AWS 账户来访问 RDS 的 Trusted Advisor 检查建议。财务团队必须查看相应的 Trusted Advisor 检查项以降低 RDS 成本。

财务团队应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to optimize storage costs. The solutions architect must identify any Amazon S3 buckets that are no longer being accessed or are rarely accessed. Which solution will accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard for advanced activity metrics.
options.text_zh: 使用 S3 Storage Lens 控制面板的高级活动指标来分析存储桶访问模式。

options.text_en: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 dashboard in the AWS Management Console.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS 管理控制台中的 S3 控制面板来分析存储桶访问模式。

options.text_en: Turn on the Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes metric for buckets. Analyze bucket access patterns by using the metrics data with Amazon Athena.
options.text_zh: 为这些存储桶开启 Amazon CloudWatch 的 BucketSizeBytes 指标。用 Amazon Athena 分析这些指标数据来了解存储桶访问模式。

options.text_en: Turn on AWS CloudTrail for S3 object monitoring. Analyze bucket access patterns by using CloudTrail logs that are integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.text_zh: 为 S3 对象监控开启 AWS CloudTrail。用与 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 集成的 CloudTrail 日志来分析存储桶访问模式。

explanation_en:
S3 Storage Lens is a feature of Amazon S3 that provides a detailed set of reports and metrics to help you understand, analyze, and optimize your storage usage.
The S3 Storage Lens dashboard provides advanced activity metrics, including insights into access patterns, data transfer, and other storage-related activities.
By using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard, you can easily identify buckets that are no longer being accessed or are rarely accessed without the need for additional setup or operational overhead.
explanation_zh:
S3 Storage Lens 是 Amazon S3 的一项功能，提供一整套详细的报告和指标，帮助你理解、分析和优化存储使用情况。
S3 Storage Lens 仪表板提供高级活动指标，包括对访问模式、数据传输和其他存储相关活动的洞察。
通过使用 S3 Storage Lens 仪表板，你可以轻松识别不再被访问或很少被访问的存储桶，而无需额外的设置或运维开销。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要优化存储成本。解决方案架构师必须识别出任何不再被访问或很少被访问的 Amazon S3 存储桶。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销实现这一目标？

stem_en: A company sells datasets to customers who do research in artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML). The datasets are large, formatted files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. The company hosts a web application that the customers use to purchase access to a given dataset. The web application is deployed on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. After a purchase is made, customers receive an S3 signed URL that allows access to the files. The customers are distributed across North America and Europe. The company wants to reduce the cost that is associated with data transfers and wants to maintain or improve performance. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the existing S3 bucket. Direct customer requests to the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.text_zh: 在现有 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration。把客户请求导向 S3 Transfer Acceleration 端点。继续用 S3 签名 URL 做访问控制。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the existing S3 bucket as the origin. Direct customer requests to the CloudFront URL. Switch to CloudFront signed URLs for access control.
options.text_zh: 部署一个以现有 S3 存储桶为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。把客户请求导向 CloudFront URL。改用 CloudFront 签名 URL 做访问控制。

options.text_en: Set up a second S3 bucket in the eu-central-1 Region with S3 Cross-Region Replication between the buckets. Direct customer requests to the closest Region. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.text_zh: 在 eu-central-1 区域再建一个 S3 存储桶，并在两个存储桶之间设置 S3 跨区域复制。把客户请求导向最近的区域。继续用 S3 签名 URL 做访问控制。

options.text_en: Modify the web application to enable streaming of the datasets to end users. Configure the web application to read the data from the existing S3 bucket. Implement access control directly in the application.
options.text_zh: 改造该 Web 应用，支持把数据集以流式方式传给最终用户。配置该 Web 应用从现有 S3 存储桶读取数据。直接在应用中实现访问控制。

explanation_en:
Amazon CloudFront: CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that distributes content globally with low latency and high data transfer speeds. It helps reduce data transfer costs and improves performance by caching content at edge locations.
S3 Bucket as the Origin: By configuring the existing S3 bucket as the origin for CloudFront, you allow CloudFront to cache and serve the datasets from edge locations around the world.
CloudFront Signed URLs: CloudFront provides the ability to generate signed URLs, allowing you to control access to your content. You can use CloudFront signed URLs for access control, providing a secure way for customers to access datasets.
explanation_zh:
Amazon CloudFront：CloudFront 是一项内容分发网络（CDN）服务，以低延迟和高数据传输速度在全球范围内分发内容。它通过在边缘站点缓存内容来降低数据传输成本并提升性能。
以 S3 存储桶为源站：通过将现有 S3 存储桶配置为 CloudFront 的源站，你可以让 CloudFront 从世界各地的边缘站点缓存并提供这些数据集。
CloudFront 签名 URL：CloudFront 提供生成签名 URL 的能力，让你可以控制对内容的访问。你可以使用 CloudFront 签名 URL 进行访问控制，为客户提供安全的数据集访问方式。
stem_zh:
某公司向从事人工智能和机器学习（AI/ML）研究的客户销售数据集。这些数据集是大型的格式化文件，存储在 us-east-1 区域的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司托管着一个 Web 应用程序，客户通过它购买对特定数据集的访问权限。该 Web 应用程序部署在一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的多台 Amazon EC2 实例上。购买完成后，客户会收到一个 S3 签名 URL，用于访问这些文件。

客户分布在北美和欧洲。公司希望降低与数据传输相关的成本，同时保持或提升性能。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is using AWS to design a web application that will process insurance quotes. Users will request quotes from the application. Quotes must be separated by quote type, must be responded to within 24 hours, and must not get lost. The solution must maximize operational efficiency and must minimize maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type. Configure the web application to send messages to the proper data stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL) to pool messages from its own data stream.
options.text_zh: 按报价类型创建多个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。配置该 Web 应用把消息发送到对应的数据流。配置每组后端应用服务器使用 Kinesis Client Library (KCL) 从各自的数据流中取消息。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for each quote type. Subscribe the Lambda function to its associated SNS topic. Configure the application to publish requests for quotes to the appropriate SNS topic.
options.text_zh: 为每种报价类型各创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。把 Lambda 函数订阅到与之对应的 SNS 主题。配置该应用把报价请求发布到相应的 SNS 主题。

options.text_en: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure SNS message filtering to publish messages to the proper SQS queue based on the quote type. Configure each backend application server to use its own SQS queue.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。让多个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列订阅该 SNS 主题。配置 SNS 消息筛选，按报价类型把消息发布到相应的 SQS 队列。配置每台后端应用服务器使用自己的 SQS 队列。

options.text_en: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams based on the quote type to deliver data streams to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Configure the application to send messages to the proper delivery stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to search for the messages from OpenSearch Service and process them accordingly.
options.text_zh: 按报价类型创建多个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 投递流，把数据流投递到一个 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群。配置该应用把消息发送到相应的投递流。配置每组后端应用服务器从 OpenSearch Service 中检索消息并做相应处理。

stem_zh:
某公司正在使用 AWS 设计一个处理保险报价的 Web 应用程序。用户将向该应用程序请求报价。报价必须按报价类型分开，必须在 24 小时内得到响应，并且不得丢失。该方案必须最大化运维效率并最大限度减少维护工作。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an application that runs on several Amazon EC2 instances. Each EC2 instance has multiple Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) data volumes attached to it. The application’s EC2 instance configuration and data need to be backed up nightly. The application also needs to be recoverable in a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application’s EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Region.
options.text_zh: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，安排每晚对该应用的 EBS 卷做快照，并把快照复制到另一个区域。

options.text_en: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EC2 instances as resources.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份计划执行每晚备份。把备份复制到另一个区域。把该应用的 EC2 实例添加为资源。

options.text_en: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EBS volumes as resources.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份计划执行每晚备份。把备份复制到另一个区域。把该应用的 EBS 卷添加为资源。

options.text_en: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，安排每晚对该应用的 EBS 卷做快照，并把快照复制到另一个可用区。

explanation_en:
AWS Backup: AWS Backup is a fully managed backup service that centralizes and automates the backup of data across AWS services. It provides a simple and efficient way to back up your EC2 instances and their associated EBS volumes.
Backup Plan: With AWS Backup, you can create backup plans to define when and how your backups are performed. Backup plans allow you to schedule nightly backups and define retention policies.
Explanation: Adding only the EBS volumes as resources backs up the data but not the instance configuration, so recovery would mean manually rebuilding the EC2 instance and reattaching volumes. Adding the EC2 instances themselves as resources backs up the instance and its attached volumes together, in one operationally simpler recovery step.
explanation_zh:
AWS Backup：AWS Backup 是一项全托管备份服务，可集中并自动化跨 AWS 服务的数据备份。它提供了一种简单高效的方式来备份你的 EC2 实例及其关联的 EBS 卷。
备份计划：使用 AWS Backup，你可以创建备份计划来定义备份的执行时间和方式。备份计划允许你安排每晚备份并定义保留策略。
解析：仅将 EBS 卷添加为资源只能备份数据而非实例配置，因此恢复时需要手动重建 EC2 实例并重新挂载卷。将 EC2 实例本身添加为资源，则会将实例及其挂载的卷一并备份，恢复时只需一个运维上更简单的步骤。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个运行在多台 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。每台 EC2 实例都挂载了多个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）数据卷。该应用程序的 EC2 实例配置和数据需要每晚备份。该应用程序还需要能够在另一个 AWS 区域中恢复。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is building a mobile app on AWS. The company wants to expand its reach to millions of users. The company needs to build a platform so that authorized users can watch the company’s content on their mobile devices. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Publish content to a public Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stream content.
options.text_zh: 把内容发布到一个公有 Amazon S3 存储桶。用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥来分发流式内容。

options.text_en: Set up IPsec VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.
options.text_zh: 在移动应用与 AWS 环境之间建立 IPsec VPN 来分发流式内容。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudFront，提供签名 URL 来分发流式内容。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Client VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.
options.text_zh: 在移动应用与 AWS 环境之间建立 AWS Client VPN 来分发流式内容。

explanation_en:
Amazon CloudFront: CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service provided by AWS. It accelerates the delivery of content by caching it at edge locations globally, reducing latency for end-users.
Signed URLs: CloudFront supports the generation of signed URLs, which can be used to control access to content. You can create time-limited URLs with specific permissions, allowing only authorized users to access the content.
explanation_zh:
Amazon CloudFront：CloudFront 是 AWS 提供的一项内容分发网络（CDN）服务。它通过在全球边缘站点缓存内容来加速内容交付，降低最终用户的延迟。
签名 URL：CloudFront 支持生成签名 URL，可用于控制对内容的访问。你可以创建具有特定权限的限时 URL，只允许已授权用户访问内容。
stem_zh:
某公司正在 AWS 上构建一款移动应用。公司希望将其覆盖范围扩大到数百万用户。公司需要构建一个平台，使已授权用户能够在其移动设备上观看公司的内容。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an on-premises MySQL database used by the global sales team with infrequent access patterns. The sales team requires the database to have minimal downtime. A database administrator wants to migrate this database to AWS without selecting a particular instance type in anticipation of more users in the future. Which service should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Amazon Aurora MySQL
options.text_zh: Amazon Aurora MySQL

options.text_en: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL
options.text_zh: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL

options.text_en: Amazon Redshift Spectrum
options.text_zh: Amazon Redshift Spectrum

options.text_en: Amazon RDS for MySQL
options.text_zh: Amazon RDS for MySQL

explanation_en: Amazon Aurora Serverless: Aurora Serverless is a fully managed, on-demand, and auto-scaling relational database engine provided by AWS. It is suitable for infrequent access patterns and allows the database to automatically start up, shut down, and scale capacity based on actual usage.
explanation_zh: Amazon Aurora Serverless：Aurora Serverless 是 AWS 提供的一款全托管、按需、自动伸缩的关系数据库引擎。它适合访问不频繁的模式，可让数据库根据实际使用情况自动启动、关闭并伸缩容量。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个由全球销售团队使用的本地 MySQL 数据库，访问模式并不频繁。销售团队要求该数据库停机时间最短。一位数据库管理员希望将该数据库迁移到 AWS，并且考虑到未来用户会增多，不想指定某个特定的实例类型。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪项服务？

stem_en: A company experienced a breach that affected several applications in its on-premises data center. The attacker took advantage of vulnerabilities in the custom applications that were running on the servers. The company is now migrating its applications to run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement a solution that actively scans for vulnerabilities on the EC2 instances and sends a report that details the findings. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy AWS Shield to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Create an AWS Lambda function to log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.text_zh: 部署 AWS Shield 来扫描这些 EC2 实例的漏洞。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数把发现的问题记录到 AWS CloudTrail。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon Macie and AWS Lambda functions to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.text_zh: 部署 Amazon Macie 和 AWS Lambda 函数来扫描这些 EC2 实例的漏洞。把发现的问题记录到 AWS CloudTrail。

options.text_en: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty. Deploy the GuardDuty agents to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.
options.text_zh: 启用 Amazon GuardDuty。把 GuardDuty 代理部署到这些 EC2 实例上。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，自动生成并分发详述这些发现项的报告。

options.text_en: Turn on Amazon Inspector. Deploy the Amazon Inspector agent to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.
options.text_zh: 启用 Amazon Inspector。把 Amazon Inspector 代理部署到这些 EC2 实例上。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，自动生成并分发详述这些发现项的报告。

stem_zh:
某公司经历了一次安全入侵，影响了其本地数据中心的多个应用程序。攻击者利用了运行在服务器上的自定义应用程序中的漏洞。公司现在正将其应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。公司希望实施一个方案，主动扫描 EC2 实例上的漏洞并发送详细说明发现结果的报告。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run a script to poll for and process messages in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The company wants to reduce operational costs while maintaining its ability to process a growing number of messages that are added to the queue. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Increase the size of the EC2 instance to process messages faster.
options.text_zh: 把该 EC2 实例规格调大，以更快地处理消息。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when the instance is underutilized.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 在该 EC2 实例利用率偏低时把它关掉。

options.text_en: Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.
options.text_zh: 把该 EC2 实例上的脚本迁移到使用相应运行时的 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 按需运行该脚本。

explanation_en:
AWS Lambda: Lambda is a serverless computing service that allows you to run code without provisioning or managing servers. It automatically scales based on the number of incoming requests.
Cost-Efficiency: With Lambda, you only pay for the compute time consumed during code execution. This can be more cost-effective than running and maintaining an EC2 instance, especially for sporadic or event-driven workloads.
Automatic Scaling: Lambda automatically scales based on the number of incoming events. As the number of messages in the SQS queue grows, Lambda can scale out to handle the increased workload.
Event-Driven: Lambda is well-suited for event-driven architectures, making it a good fit for scenarios where messages are added to an SQS queue.
explanation_zh:
AWS Lambda：Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，让你无需预置或管理服务器即可运行代码。它会根据传入请求的数量自动伸缩。
成本效益：使用 Lambda 时，你只需为代码执行期间消耗的计算时间付费。这可能比运行和维护一台 EC2 实例更具成本效益，尤其是对零星或事件驱动的工作负载而言。
自动伸缩：Lambda 会根据传入事件的数量自动伸缩。随着 SQS 队列中消息数量的增长，Lambda 可以横向扩展以应对增加的工作负载。
事件驱动：Lambda 非常适合事件驱动架构，因此很适合消息被添加到 SQS 队列的场景。
stem_zh:
某公司使用一台 Amazon EC2 实例运行脚本，轮询并处理一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列中的消息。公司希望降低运维成本，同时保持处理不断增加的入队消息的能力。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses a legacy application to produce data in CSV format. The legacy application stores the output data in Amazon S3. The company is deploying a new commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) application that can perform complex SQL queries to analyze data that is stored in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 only. However, the COTS application cannot process the .csv files that the legacy application produces. The company cannot update the legacy application to produce data in another format. The company needs to implement a solution so that the COTS application can use the data that the legacy application produces. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs on a schedule. Configure the ETL job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in Amazon Redshift.
options.text_zh: 创建一个按计划运行的 AWS Glue 提取、转换、加载 (ETL) 作业。配置该 ETL 作业处理这些 .csv 文件，并把处理后的数据存入 Amazon Redshift。

options.text_en: Develop a Python script that runs on Amazon EC2 instances to convert the .csv files to .sql files. Invoke the Python script on a cron schedule to store the output files in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 开发一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Python 脚本，把 .csv 文件转换成 .sql 文件。用 cron 定时调用该 Python 脚本，把输出文件存到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use an S3 event to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in the DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。用 S3 事件触发该 Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数执行提取、转换、加载 (ETL) 作业来处理这些 .csv 文件，并把处理后的数据存入该 DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EventBridge to launch an Amazon EMR cluster on a weekly schedule. Configure the EMR cluster to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in an Amazon Redshift table.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 按每周计划启动一个 Amazon EMR 集群。配置该 EMR 集群执行提取、转换、加载 (ETL) 作业来处理这些 .csv 文件，并把处理后的数据存入一张 Amazon Redshift 表。

stem_zh:
某公司使用一个遗留应用程序以 CSV 格式生成数据。该遗留应用程序将输出数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。公司正在部署一个新的商用现成（COTS）应用程序，它可以执行复杂的 SQL 查询，但只能分析存储在 Amazon Redshift 和 Amazon S3 中的数据。然而，该 COTS 应用程序无法处理遗留应用程序生成的 .csv 文件。

公司无法更新遗留应用程序以生成其他格式的数据。公司需要实施一个方案，使该 COTS 应用程序能够使用遗留应用程序生成的数据。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company recently migrated its entire IT environment to the AWS Cloud. The company discovers that users are provisioning oversized Amazon EC2 instances and modifying security group rules without using the appropriate change control process. A solutions architect must devise a strategy to track and audit these inventory and configuration changes. Which actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing.
options.text_zh: 启用 AWS CloudTrail 并用它做审计。

options.text_en: Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 为这些 Amazon EC2 实例使用数据生命周期策略。

options.text_en: Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard.
options.text_zh: 启用 AWS Trusted Advisor 并参考其安全控制面板。

options.text_en: Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes.
options.text_zh: 启用 AWS Config 并创建用于审计与合规的规则。

options.text_en: Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CloudFormation 模板还原之前的资源配置。

explanation_en:
D. Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes.

A. Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing. CloudTrail provides event history of your AWS account activity, including actions taken through the AWS Management Console, AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), and AWS SDKs and APIs. By enabling CloudTrail, the company can track user activity and changes to AWS resources, and monitor compliance with internal policies and external regulations.

D. Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes. AWS Config provides a detailed inventory of the AWS resources in your account, and continuously records changes to the configurations of those resources. By creating rules in AWS Config, the company can automate the evaluation of resource configurations against desired state, and receive alerts when configurations drift from compliance.
explanation_zh:
D. 启用 AWS Config 并创建用于审计和合规目的的规则。

A. 启用 AWS CloudTrail 并将其用于审计。CloudTrail 提供你 AWS 账户活动的事件历史，包括通过 AWS 管理控制台、AWS 命令行界面（CLI）以及 AWS SDK 和 API 执行的操作。通过启用 CloudTrail，公司可以跟踪用户活动和对 AWS 资源的更改，并监控对内部政策和外部法规的合规情况。

D. 启用 AWS Config 并创建用于审计和合规目的的规则。AWS Config 提供你账户中 AWS 资源的详细清单，并持续记录这些资源配置的变更。通过在 AWS Config 中创建规则，公司可以自动化地将资源配置与期望状态进行比对评估，并在配置偏离合规时收到告警。
stem_zh:
某公司最近将其整个 IT 环境迁移到了 AWS 云。公司发现用户在未走适当变更控制流程的情况下预置超规格的 Amazon EC2 实例并修改安全组规则。解决方案架构师必须制定一个策略来跟踪和审计这些资产清单与配置的变更。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company has hundreds of Amazon EC2 Linux-based instances in the AWS Cloud. Systems administrators have used shared SSH keys to manage the instances. After a recent audit, the company’s security team is mandating the removal of all shared keys. A solutions architect must design a solution that provides secure access to the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of administrative overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 连接这些 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to generate one-time SSH keys on demand.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 按需生成一次性 SSH 密钥。

options.text_en: Allow shared SSH access to a set of bastion instances. Configure all other instances to allow only SSH access from the bastion instances.
options.text_zh: 对一组堡垒机实例开放共享 SSH 访问。把其他所有实例配置为只允许来自堡垒机的 SSH 访问。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon Cognito custom authorizer to authenticate users. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate a temporary SSH key.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Cognito 自定义授权方来认证用户。调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数生成临时 SSH 密钥。

explanation_en: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager: AWS Systems Manager provides a service called Session Manager that allows you to securely connect to your EC2 instances without the need for an external bastion host or direct access to the instances. Session Manager uses IAM roles for authentication and provides an auditable and controlled way to access instances.
explanation_zh: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager：AWS Systems Manager 提供一项名为 Session Manager 的服务，让你无需外部堡垒机或对实例的直接访问即可安全地连接到 EC2 实例。Session Manager 使用 IAM 角色进行身份验证，并提供可审计且受控的实例访问方式。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 云中有数百台基于 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例。系统管理员一直使用共享 SSH 密钥来管理这些实例。在最近一次审计后，公司的安全团队强制要求移除所有共享密钥。解决方案架构师必须设计一个方案，提供对这些 EC2 实例的安全访问。

哪个方案能以最少的管理开销满足此要求？

stem_en: A company is using a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances to ingest data from on-premises data sources. The data is in JSON format and ingestion rates can be as high as 1 MB/s. When an EC2 instance is rebooted, the data in-flight is lost. The company’s data science team wants to query ingested data in near-real time. Which solution provides near-real-time data querying that is scalable with minimal data loss?

options.text_en: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Use Kinesis Data Analytics to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把数据发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams，用 Kinesis Data Analytics 查询数据。

options.text_en: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon Redshift as the destination. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把数据发布到以 Amazon Redshift 为目标的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据。

options.text_en: Store ingested data in an EC2 instance store. Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon S3 as the destination. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把接入的数据存放在 EC2 实例存储中。把数据发布到以 Amazon S3 为目标的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。

options.text_en: Store ingested data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Publish data to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Subscribe to the Redis channel to query the data.
options.text_zh: 把接入的数据存放在一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。把数据发布到 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。订阅该 Redis 频道来查询数据。

explanation_en:
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams: It is a scalable and durable real-time data streaming service. It allows you to ingest, buffer, and process streaming data in real time. In this scenario, you can publish data to a Kinesis Data Stream from your EC2 instances.

Kinesis Data Analytics: It provides an SQL-like language for querying and analyzing data in real time. You can use Kinesis Data Analytics to process and analyze the ingested data directly within the Kinesis pipeline.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams：这是一项可扩展且持久的实时数据流服务。它允许你实时摄取、缓冲和处理流数据。在此场景中，你可以从 EC2 实例向 Kinesis 数据流发布数据。

Kinesis Data Analytics：它提供一种类 SQL 语言，用于实时查询和分析数据。你可以使用 Kinesis Data Analytics 直接在 Kinesis 管道内处理和分析已摄取的数据。
stem_zh:
某公司正使用一组 Amazon EC2 实例从本地数据源摄取数据。数据为 JSON 格式，摄取速率最高可达 1 MB/s。当某台 EC2 实例重启时，传输中的数据会丢失。公司的数据科学团队希望近实时地查询已摄取的数据。

哪个方案能提供可扩展且数据丢失最少的近实时数据查询？

stem_en: What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all objects uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket are encrypted?

options.text_en: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set.
options.text_zh: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 请求没有设置 s3:x-amz-acl 请求头，就拒绝。

options.text_en: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set to private.
options.text_zh: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 请求没有把 s3:x-amz-acl 请求头设为 private，就拒绝。

options.text_en: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an aws:SecureTransport header set to true.
options.text_zh: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 请求没有把 aws:SecureTransport 设为 true，就拒绝。

options.text_en: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an x-amz-server-side-encryption header set.
options.text_zh: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 请求没有设置 x-amz-server-side-encryption 请求头，就拒绝。

explanation_en: x-amz-server-side-encryption header: This header specifies the server-side encryption algorithm to be used for the object. If an object is uploaded without the x-amz-server-side-encryption header or with an incorrect value, it can be denied.
explanation_zh: x-amz-server-side-encryption 标头：该标头指定对象要使用的服务器端加密算法。如果对象上传时未带该标头或值不正确，则可以被拒绝。
stem_zh: 解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能确保上传到某个 Amazon S3 存储桶的所有对象都被加密？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a multi-tier application for a company. The application's users upload images from a mobile device. The application generates a thumbnail of each image and returns a message to the user to confirm that the image was uploaded successfully. The thumbnail generation can take up to 60 seconds, but the company wants to provide a faster response time to its users to notify them that the original image was received. The solutions architect must design the application to asynchronously dispatch requests to the different application tiers. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 编写一个自定义 AWS Lambda 函数来生成缩略图并提醒用户。把图片上传过程作为事件源来触发该 Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Step Functions 工作流。配置 Step Functions 负责各应用层之间的编排，并在缩略图生成完成时提醒用户。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 消息队列。图片上传时，向该 SQS 队列投递一条消息用于生成缩略图。通过应用内消息告知用户图片已收到。

options.text_en: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete.
options.text_zh: 创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知主题和订阅。用一个订阅在图片上传完成后触发应用生成缩略图。用第二个订阅在缩略图生成完成后通过推送通知告知用户的移动应用。

explanation_en: Amazon SQS (Simple Queue Service): SQS is a fully managed message queuing service that enables decoupling of the components of a cloud application. By creating an SQS message queue, the image upload process can place messages in the queue for thumbnail generation.
explanation_zh: Amazon SQS（Simple Queue Service）：SQS 是一项全托管的消息队列服务，可实现云应用程序各组件的解耦。通过创建 SQS 消息队列，图片上传过程可以将消息放入队列以待生成缩略图。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为某公司设计一个多层应用程序。该应用程序的用户从移动设备上传图片。应用程序为每张图片生成缩略图，并向用户返回消息确认图片上传成功。

生成缩略图最多可能需要 60 秒，但公司希望更快地响应用户，通知他们原始图片已收到。解决方案架构师必须设计该应用程序，以异步方式向不同的应用层派发请求。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company’s facility has badge readers at every entrance throughout the building. When badges are scanned, the readers send a message over HTTPS to indicate who attempted to access that particular entrance. A solutions architect must design a system to process these messages from the sensors. The solution must be highly available, and the results must be made available for the company’s security team to analyze. Which system architecture should the solutions architect recommend?

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to serve as the HTTPS endpoint and to process the messages. Configure the EC2 instance to save the results to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 启动一台 Amazon EC2 实例作为 HTTPS 端点并处理这些消息。配置该 EC2 实例把结果保存到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an HTTPS endpoint in Amazon API Gateway. Configure the API Gateway endpoint to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon API Gateway 中创建一个 HTTPS 端点。配置该 API Gateway 端点调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理消息，并把结果保存到一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Route 53 to direct incoming sensor messages to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Route 53 把传入的传感器消息导向一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数处理消息并把结果保存到一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure a Site-to-Site VPN connection from the facility network to the VPC so that sensor data can be written directly to an S3 bucket by way of the VPC endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个网关 VPC 端点。配置一条从该场所网络到该 VPC 的 Site-to-Site VPN 连接，使传感器数据能经由该 VPC 端点直接写入 S3 存储桶。

stem_zh:
某公司的场所在整栋建筑的每个入口都装有工牌读卡器。工牌被刷时，读卡器会通过 HTTPS 发送一条消息，表明是谁尝试进入该入口。

解决方案架构师必须设计一个系统来处理来自这些传感器的消息。该方案必须高可用，并且结果必须可供公司安全团队分析。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪种系统架构？

stem_en: A company wants to implement a disaster recovery plan for its primary on-premises file storage volume. The file storage volume is mounted from an Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) device on a local storage server. The file storage volume holds hundreds of terabytes (TB) of data. The company wants to ensure that end users retain immediate access to all file types from the on-premises systems without experiencing latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the company's existing infrastructure?

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon S3 File Gateway as a virtual machine (VM) that is hosted on premises. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Modify existing applications to access the files through the NFS protocol. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and mount the S3 bucket that contains the files.
options.text_zh: 以本地托管的虚拟机 (VM) 形式预置一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway。把本地缓存设为 10 TB。改造现有应用，改用 NFS 协议访问文件。灾难恢复时，预置一台 Amazon EC2 实例并挂载存放这些文件的 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Use a data backup solution to back up all existing data to a virtual tape library. Configure the data backup solution to run nightly after the initial backup is complete. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and restore the data to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume from the volumes in the virtual tape library.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway 磁带网关。用数据备份方案把所有现有数据备份到虚拟磁带库。配置该备份方案在首次备份完成后每晚运行。灾难恢复时，预置一台 Amazon EC2 实例，并从虚拟磁带库中的卷把数据恢复到一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。

options.text_en: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Mount the Volume Gateway cached volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关缓存卷。把本地缓存设为 10 TB。通过 iSCSI 把该卷网关缓存卷挂载到现有文件服务器，并把所有文件复制到该存储卷。为该存储卷配置定时快照。灾难恢复时，把快照恢复成一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并把该 EBS 卷挂载到一台 Amazon EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume with the same amount of disk space as the existing file storage volume. Mount the Volume Gateway stored volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 预置一个与现有文件存储卷容量相同的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关存储卷。通过 iSCSI 把该卷网关存储卷挂载到现有文件服务器，并把所有文件复制到该存储卷。为该存储卷配置定时快照。灾难恢复时，把快照恢复成一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并把该 EBS 卷挂载到一台 Amazon EC2 实例。

explanation_en: Explanation: A cached volume only keeps the most frequently accessed data locally — anything not in cache has to be fetched from S3 first, adding latency, so it fails the "immediate access to all file types" requirement. A stored volume keeps the entire dataset on-premises (with async backup to S3), giving true zero-latency access to every file.
explanation_zh: 解析：缓存卷只在本地保留访问最频繁的数据——任何不在缓存中的内容都必须先从 S3 获取，这会增加延迟，因此不满足"立即访问所有类型文件"的要求。存储卷则将整个数据集保留在本地（并异步备份到 S3），从而对每个文件都实现真正的零延迟访问。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为其主要的本地文件存储卷实施灾难恢复计划。该文件存储卷是从本地存储服务器上的一个 Internet 小型计算机系统接口（iSCSI）设备挂载的。该文件存储卷保存着数百 TB 的数据。

公司希望确保最终用户能够从本地系统立即访问所有类型的文件而不出现延迟。

哪个方案能在对公司现有基础设施改动最少的情况下满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is hosting a web application from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon Cognito as an identity provider to authenticate users and return a JSON Web Token (JWT) that provides access to protected resources that are stored in another S3 bucket. Upon deployment of the application, users report errors and are unable to access the protected content. A solutions architect must resolve this issue by providing proper permissions so that users can access the protected content. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content.
options.text_zh: 更新 Amazon Cognito 身份池，使其代入相应的 IAM 角色以访问受保护内容。

options.text_en: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content.
options.text_zh: 更新 S3 ACL，允许该应用访问受保护内容。

options.text_en: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content.
options.text_zh: 把该应用重新部署到 Amazon S3，以避免 S3 存储桶的最终一致性读取影响用户访问受保护内容。

options.text_en: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content.
options.text_zh: 更新 Amazon Cognito 池，在身份池中使用自定义属性映射，并授予用户访问受保护内容的相应权限。

explanation_en:
Amazon Cognito Identity Pool: When users authenticate through Amazon Cognito, they assume roles that determine their access to AWS resources. By updating the Cognito identity pool, you can configure it to assume the proper IAM role that has the necessary permissions to access the protected content stored in the S3 bucket.

IAM Role Permissions: The IAM role associated with the identity pool should have the required permissions (e.g., S3 getObject permissions) to access the protected content in the S3 bucket.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Cognito 身份池：当用户通过 Amazon Cognito 完成身份验证后，他们会代入决定其对 AWS 资源访问权限的角色。通过更新 Cognito 身份池，你可以将其配置为代入具有访问 S3 存储桶中受保护内容所需权限的相应 IAM 角色。

IAM 角色权限：与该身份池关联的 IAM 角色应具备访问 S3 存储桶中受保护内容所需的权限（例如 S3 getObject 权限）。
stem_zh:
某公司正从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶托管一个 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon Cognito 作为身份提供商来验证用户身份，并返回一个 JSON Web Token（JWT），用于访问存储在另一个 S3 存储桶中的受保护资源。

应用程序部署后，用户报告出现错误且无法访问受保护内容。解决方案架构师必须通过提供适当的权限来解决此问题，使用户能够访问受保护内容。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An image hosting company uploads its large assets to Amazon S3 Standard buckets. The company uses multipart upload in parallel by using S3 APIs and overwrites if the same object is uploaded again. For the first 30 days after upload, the objects will be accessed frequently. The objects will be used less frequently after 30 days, but the access patterns for each object will be inconsistent. The company must optimize its S3 storage costs while maintaining high availability and resiliency of stored assets. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把资产转移到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

options.text_en: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 S3 生命周期策略来清理未完成的分段上传。

options.text_en: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 S3 生命周期策略来清理过期的对象删除标记。

options.text_en: Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把资产转移到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

options.text_en: Move assets to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把资产转移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

explanation_en:
B. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads.

Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days: This option is suitable for objects with unknown or changing access patterns. S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between two access tiers (frequent and infrequent access) based on changing access patterns. It helps optimize costs by automatically selecting the most cost-effective tier for each object.

Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads: This is a good practice to clean up any incomplete multipart uploads, which can consume additional storage space without contributing to the actual objects. Cleaning up incomplete uploads helps manage storage costs efficiently.
explanation_zh:
B. 配置一条 S3 生命周期策略来清理未完成的分段上传。

在 30 天后将资产移动到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering：此选项适用于访问模式未知或多变的对象。S3 Intelligent-Tiering 会根据访问模式的变化自动在两个访问层（频繁访问和不频繁访问）之间移动对象。它通过自动为每个对象选择最具成本效益的层来帮助优化成本。

配置一条 S3 生命周期策略来清理未完成的分段上传：这是一个好做法，用于清理任何未完成的分段上传，它们会占用额外存储空间却对实际对象没有贡献。清理未完成的上传有助于高效管理存储成本。
stem_zh:
某图片托管公司将其大型资产上传到 Amazon S3 Standard 存储桶。公司通过 S3 API 并行使用分段上传，并在再次上传同一对象时进行覆盖。上传后的前 30 天内，这些对象会被频繁访问。30 天后访问频率降低，但每个对象的访问模式并不一致。公司必须优化其 S3 存储成本，同时保持所存资产的高可用性和弹性。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A solutions architect must secure a VPC network that hosts Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances contain highly sensitive data and run in a private subnet. According to company policy, the EC2 instances that run in the VPC can access only approved third-party software repositories on the internet for software product updates that use the third party’s URL. Other internet traffic must be blocked. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups.
options.text_zh: 更新该私有子网的路由表，把出站流量路由到一个 AWS Network Firewall 防火墙。配置域名列表规则组。

options.text_en: Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets.
options.text_zh: 设置一个 AWS WAF Web ACL。创建一组自定义规则，按源和目标 IP 地址范围集筛选流量请求。

options.text_en: Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs.
options.text_zh: 实施严格的入站安全组规则。配置一条出站规则，通过指定 URL 只允许流量发往互联网上已授权的软件仓库。

options.text_en: Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances. Direct all outbound traffic to the ALB. Use a URL-based rule listener in the ALB’s target group for outbound access to the internet.
options.text_zh: 在这些 EC2 实例前面配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。把所有出站流量导向该 ALB。在该 ALB 目标组中使用基于 URL 的规则侦听器来实现对互联网的出站访问。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师必须保护一个托管 Amazon EC2 实例的 VPC 网络。这些 EC2 实例包含高度敏感的数据，运行在私有子网中。根据公司政策，运行在该 VPC 中的 EC2 实例只能通过第三方 URL 访问互联网上经批准的第三方软件仓库以进行软件产品更新。其他互联网流量必须被阻止。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is hosting a three-tier ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The company hosts the website on Amazon S3 and integrates the website with an API that handles sales requests. The company hosts the API on three Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The API consists of static and dynamic front-end content along with backend workers that process sales requests asynchronously. The company is expecting a significant and sudden increase in the number of sales requests during events for the launch of new products. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure that all the requests are processed successfully?

options.text_en: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Increase the number of EC2 instances to handle the increase in traffic.
options.text_zh: 为动态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。增加 EC2 实例数量以应对流量增长。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Place the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on network traffic.
options.text_zh: 为静态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。把这些 EC2 实例放入一个 Auto Scaling 组，按网络流量启动新实例。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Add an Amazon ElastiCache instance in front of the ALB to reduce traffic for the API to handle.
options.text_zh: 为动态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。在该 ALB 前面加一个 Amazon ElastiCache 实例，以减轻 API 需要处理的流量。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive requests from the website for later processing by the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 为静态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。添加一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列接收来自网站的请求，供 EC2 实例稍后处理。

explanation_en:
Amazon CloudFront for Static Content: By using CloudFront, you can distribute static content (like images, stylesheets) globally, reducing latency for end-users and offloading some of the traffic from your backend instances.

Auto Scaling Group: An Auto Scaling group allows you to automatically adjust the number of EC2 instances to handle changes in demand. By placing the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group, you can dynamically scale the number of instances based on network traffic, ensuring that the application can handle increased load during events.
explanation_zh:
用 Amazon CloudFront 承载静态内容：通过使用 CloudFront，你可以在全球范围内分发静态内容（如图片、样式表），降低最终用户的延迟，并从后端实例卸载部分流量。

Auto Scaling 组：Auto Scaling 组允许你自动调整 EC2 实例数量以应对需求变化。通过将 EC2 实例放入 Auto Scaling 组，你可以根据网络流量动态伸缩实例数量，确保应用程序能够在活动期间应对增加的负载。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 云中托管一个三层电子商务应用程序。公司将网站托管在 Amazon S3 上，并将网站与一个处理销售请求的 API 集成。公司将该 API 托管在一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的三台 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 API 由静态和动态前端内容以及异步处理销售请求的后端工作进程组成。

公司预计在新品发布活动期间销售请求数量会显著且突然地增加。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么，以确保所有请求都被成功处理？

stem_en: A security audit reveals that Amazon EC2 instances are not being patched regularly. A solutions architect needs to provide a solution that will run regular security scans across a large fleet of EC2 instances. The solution should also patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule and provide a report of each instance’s patch status. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set up Amazon Macie to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up a cron job on each EC2 instance to patch the instance on a regular schedule.
options.text_zh: 设置 Amazon Macie 扫描这些 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。在每台 EC2 实例上设置 cron 作业，按固定计划给实例打补丁。

options.text_en: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty in the account. Configure GuardDuty to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.text_zh: 在该账户中启用 Amazon GuardDuty。配置 GuardDuty 扫描这些 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 按固定计划给 EC2 实例打补丁。

options.text_en: Set up Amazon Detective to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.text_zh: 设置 Amazon Detective 扫描这些 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置一条 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，按固定计划给 EC2 实例打补丁。

options.text_en: Turn on Amazon Inspector in the account. Configure Amazon Inspector to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.text_zh: 在该账户中启用 Amazon Inspector。配置 Amazon Inspector 扫描这些 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 按固定计划给 EC2 实例打补丁。

stem_zh:
一次安全审计发现 Amazon EC2 实例没有被定期打补丁。解决方案架构师需要提供一个方案，对大量 EC2 实例定期运行安全扫描。该方案还应按固定计划为 EC2 实例打补丁，并提供每台实例补丁状态的报告。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is planning to store data on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must encrypt the data at rest. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Create a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable encryption for the DB instances.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建一个密钥。为这些数据库实例启用加密。

options.text_en: Create an encryption key. Store the key in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the key to encrypt the DB instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个加密密钥，把密钥存放在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。用该密钥加密这些数据库实例。

options.text_en: Generate a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中生成一张证书。用该证书为这些数据库实例启用 SSL/TLS。

options.text_en: Generate a certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中生成一张证书。用该证书为这些数据库实例启用 SSL/TLS。

explanation_en:
By creating a key in AWS KMS and enabling encryption for the RDS DB instances, you ensure that the data at rest is encrypted using the specified key.

AWS RDS supports encryption at rest, and you can use AWS KMS to manage the encryption keys. When you enable encryption for an RDS DB instance, you can specify a KMS key to use for encryption.
explanation_zh:
通过在 AWS KMS 中创建密钥并为 RDS 数据库实例启用加密，你可以确保静态数据使用指定的密钥加密。

AWS RDS 支持静态加密，你可以使用 AWS KMS 管理加密密钥。为 RDS 数据库实例启用加密时，你可以指定用于加密的 KMS 密钥。
stem_zh:
某公司计划将数据存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库实例上。公司必须对数据进行静态加密。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足此要求？

stem_en: A company must migrate 20 TB of data from a data center to the AWS Cloud within 30 days. The company’s network bandwidth is limited to 15 Mbps and cannot exceed 70% utilization. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Snowball.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Snowball。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync。

options.text_en: Use a secure VPN connection.
options.text_zh: 使用安全的 VPN 连接。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration。

explanation_en: AWS Snowball is a physical data transport solution that helps customers transfer large amounts of data into and out of AWS. It addresses challenges associated with large-scale data transfers, particularly when network constraints, transfer times, or security concerns make online data transfer less practical.
explanation_zh: AWS Snowball 是一种物理数据传输方案，帮助客户将大量数据传入和传出 AWS。它解决了大规模数据传输相关的难题，尤其是在网络限制、传输时间或安全顾虑使得在线数据传输不太可行的情况下。
stem_zh:
某公司必须在 30 天内将 20 TB 数据从数据中心迁移到 AWS 云。公司的网络带宽限制为 15 Mbps，且利用率不能超过 70%。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company needs to provide its employees with secure access to confidential and sensitive files. The company wants to ensure that the files can be accessed only by authorized users. The files must be downloaded securely to the employees’ devices. The files are stored in an on-premises Windows file server. However, due to an increase in remote usage, the file server is running out of capacity. . Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Migrate the file server to an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet. Configure the security group to limit inbound traffic to the employees’ IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 把该文件服务器迁移到公有子网中的一台 Amazon EC2 实例。配置安全组，把入站流量限制为员工的 IP 地址。

options.text_en: Migrate the files to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Integrate the Amazon FSx file system with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure AWS Client VPN.
options.text_zh: 把这些文件迁移到一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。把该 Amazon FSx 文件系统与本地 Active Directory 集成。配置 AWS Client VPN。

options.text_en: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a private VPC endpoint. Create a signed URL to allow download.
options.text_zh: 把这些文件迁移到 Amazon S3，并创建一个私有 VPC 端点。创建签名 URL 以允许下载。

options.text_en: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a public VPC endpoint. Allow employees to sign on with AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
options.text_zh: 把这些文件迁移到 Amazon S3，并创建一个公有 VPC 端点。允许员工用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 登录。

explanation_en:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server: It is a fully managed file storage service built on Windows Server. It is designed to be integrated with on-premises Active Directory, allowing for a seamless extension of your existing directory and authentication infrastructure to the AWS Cloud.

Integrate with On-Premises Active Directory: With Amazon FSx, you can integrate the file system with your on-premises Active Directory, ensuring that the same user accounts and permissions are used both on-premises and in the cloud.
explanation_zh:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server：这是一项构建在 Windows Server 之上的全托管文件存储服务。它被设计为可与本地 Active Directory 集成，从而将你现有的目录和身份验证基础设施无缝扩展到 AWS 云。

与本地 Active Directory 集成：使用 Amazon FSx，你可以将文件系统与本地 Active Directory 集成，确保在本地和云中使用相同的用户账户和权限。
stem_zh:
某公司需要为其员工提供对机密和敏感文件的安全访问。公司希望确保这些文件只能由已授权用户访问。文件必须安全地下载到员工的设备上。

这些文件存储在一台本地 Windows 文件服务器上。然而，由于远程使用增加，该文件服务器容量即将耗尽。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company’s application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. On the first day of every month at midnight, the application becomes much slower when the month-end financial calculation batch runs. This causes the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances to immediately peak to 100%, which disrupts the application. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure the application is able to handle the workload and avoid downtime?

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB.
options.text_zh: 在该 ALB 前面配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

options.text_en: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization.
options.text_zh: 配置一条基于 CPU 利用率的 EC2 Auto Scaling 简单伸缩策略。

options.text_en: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.
options.text_zh: 按月度日程配置一条 EC2 Auto Scaling 计划伸缩策略。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon ElastiCache to remove some of the workload from the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon ElastiCache，把一部分负载从这些 EC2 实例上卸下来。

explanation_en:
By configuring a scheduled scaling policy, the EC2 Auto Scaling group can proactively launch additional EC2 instances before the CPU utilization peaks to 100%. This will ensure that the application can handle the workload during the month-end financial calculation batch, and avoid any disruption or downtime.
