Configuring a simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization or adding Amazon CloudFront distribution or Amazon ElastiCache will not directly address the issue of handling the monthly peak workload.
explanation_zh:
通过配置计划伸缩策略，EC2 Auto Scaling 组可以在 CPU 利用率飙升到 100% 之前主动启动额外的 EC2 实例。这将确保应用程序能够在月末财务计算批处理期间应对该工作负载，并避免任何中断或停机。

配置基于 CPU 利用率的简单伸缩策略，或添加 Amazon CloudFront 分配或 Amazon ElastiCache，都无法直接解决应对月度峰值工作负载的问题。
stem_zh:
某公司的应用程序运行在一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些实例运行在跨多个可用区的一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中。每月第一天午夜运行月末财务计算批处理时，该应用程序会变得非常慢。这会导致 EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率立即飙升到 100%，从而中断应用程序。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么，以确保应用程序能够应对该工作负载并避免停机？

stem_en: A company wants to give a customer the ability to use on-premises Microsoft Active Directory to download files that are stored in Amazon S3. The customer’s application uses an SFTP client to download the files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead and no changes to the customer’s application?

options.text_en: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 设置 AWS Transfer Family 的 SFTP。配置集成的 Active Directory 身份验证。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.text_zh: 设置 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，把本地客户端与 Amazon S3 同步。配置集成的 Active Directory 身份验证。

options.text_en: Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
options.text_zh: 设置 AWS DataSync，用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 在本地位置与 S3 位置之间同步。

options.text_en: Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
options.text_zh: 设置一台带 SFTP 的 Windows 版 Amazon EC2 实例，把本地客户端与 Amazon S3 连起来。集成 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)。

explanation_en:
AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3: AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service that allows you to set up an SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol) service for Amazon S3. It enables you to transfer files directly to and from Amazon S3 using the SFTP protocol.

Integrated Active Directory Authentication: AWS Transfer Family allows you to configure authentication with Microsoft Active Directory. By integrating with Active Directory, you can provide users with seamless access to S3 resources using their existing credentials without modifying their applications.
explanation_zh:
为 Amazon S3 设置带 SFTP 的 AWS Transfer Family：AWS Transfer Family 是一项全托管服务，允许你为 Amazon S3 搭建 SFTP（安全文件传输协议）服务。它使你能够使用 SFTP 协议直接向 Amazon S3 传输文件或从中获取文件。

集成的 Active Directory 身份验证：AWS Transfer Family 允许你配置与 Microsoft Active Directory 的身份验证。通过与 Active Directory 集成，你可以让用户使用其现有凭证无缝访问 S3 资源，而无需修改他们的应用程序。
stem_zh:
某公司希望让某位客户能够使用本地 Microsoft Active Directory 下载存储在 Amazon S3 中的文件。该客户的应用程序使用 SFTP 客户端下载文件。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销、且无需更改客户应用程序的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is experiencing sudden increases in demand. The company needs to provision large Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The instances will run in an Auto Scaling group. The company needs a solution that provides minimum initialization latency to meet the demand. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Use the aws ec2 register-image command to create an AMI from a snapshot. Use AWS Step Functions to replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 用 aws ec2 register-image 命令从快照创建 AMI。用 AWS Step Functions 替换 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。

options.text_en: Enable Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore on a snapshot. Provision an AMI by using the snapshot. Replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group with the new AMI.
options.text_zh: 对某个快照启用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快速快照还原。用该快照预置一个 AMI。用新 AMI 替换 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。

options.text_en: Enable AMI creation and define lifecycle rules in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM). Create an AWS Lambda function that modifies the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 中启用 AMI 创建并定义生命周期规则。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来修改 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Backup lifecycle policies that provision AMIs. Configure Auto Scaling group capacity limits as an event source in EventBridge.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EventBridge 触发预置 AMI 的 AWS Backup 生命周期策略。把 Auto Scaling 组的容量上限配置为 EventBridge 中的事件源。

explanation_en:
Amazon EBS Fast Snapshot Restore: Enabling fast snapshot restore allows you to provision Amazon EBS volumes based on snapshots with faster performance. This is particularly useful when creating AMIs from snapshots, as it reduces the time it takes to create EBS volumes from those snapshots.

Minimum Initialization Latency: Fast snapshot restore helps in minimizing initialization latency as it provides a way to quickly create EBS volumes from snapshots.

Provisioning AMI from Snapshot: You can create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from an Amazon EBS snapshot. This allows you to capture a point-in-time snapshot of the file system, and then use that snapshot to create new instances.
explanation_zh:
Amazon EBS 快速快照恢复：启用快速快照恢复可让你以更快的性能基于快照预置 Amazon EBS 卷。这在从快照创建 AMI 时特别有用，因为它缩短了从这些快照创建 EBS 卷所需的时间。

最小初始化延迟：快速快照恢复提供了从快照快速创建 EBS 卷的方式，因此有助于将初始化延迟降至最低。

从快照预置 AMI：你可以从 Amazon EBS 快照创建 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。这使你能够捕获文件系统的时间点快照，然后使用该快照创建新实例。
stem_zh:
某公司正经历需求的突然增长。公司需要从一个 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）预置大型 Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例将运行在一个 Auto Scaling 组中。公司需要一个初始化延迟最小的方案来满足需求。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company’s IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.text_en: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.text_zh: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密密钥。用 AWS Secrets Manager 创建一个使用该 KMS 密钥、内含相应凭证的新密钥项。把该密钥项与该 Aurora 数据库集群关联。配置 14 天的自定义轮换周期。

options.text_en: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建两个参数：一个字符串类型的参数存用户名，一个 SecureString 类型的参数存密码。为密码参数选择 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密，并在应用层加载这两个参数。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数每 14 天轮换一次密码。

options.text_en: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.text_zh: 把含凭证的文件存放在一个经 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。在应用层的所有 EC2 实例上挂载该 EFS 文件系统。限制该文件的访问权限，使应用能读取该文件、只有超级用户能修改它。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数每 14 天轮换一次 Aurora 中的密钥，并把新凭证写入该文件。

options.text_en: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把含凭证的文件存放在一个经 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中，供应用加载凭证。让应用定期下载该文件，以确保使用的是正确的凭证。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数每 14 天轮换一次 Aurora 凭证，并把新凭证上传到 S3 存储桶中的该文件。

explanation_en: A proposes to create a new AWS KMS encryption key and use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Then, the secret will be associated with the Aurora DB cluster, and a custom rotation period of 14 days will be configured. AWS Secrets Manager will automate the process of rotating the database credentials, which will reduce the operational effort required to meet the IT security guidelines.
explanation_zh: 选项 A 建议创建一个新的 AWS KMS 加密密钥，并使用 AWS Secrets Manager 创建一个使用该 KMS 密钥且包含相应凭证的新密钥。然后将该密钥与 Aurora 数据库集群关联，并配置 14 天的自定义轮换周期。AWS Secrets Manager 会自动化轮换数据库凭证的过程，从而减少满足 IT 安全准则所需的运维工作量。
stem_zh:
某公司托管一个多层 Web 应用程序，使用一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群进行存储。应用层托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司的 IT 安全准则要求数据库凭证必须加密并每 14 天轮换一次。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最少的运维工作量满足此要求？

stem_en: A company has deployed a web application on AWS. The company hosts the backend database on Amazon RDS for MySQL with a primary DB instance and five read replicas to support scaling needs. The read replicas must lag no more than 1 second behind the primary DB instance. The database routinely runs scheduled stored procedures. As traffic on the website increases, the replicas experience additional lag during periods of peak load. A solutions architect must reduce the replication lag as much as possible. The solutions architect must minimize changes to the application code and must minimize ongoing operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Replace the read replicas with Aurora Replicas, and configure Aurora Auto Scaling. Replace the stored procedures with Aurora MySQL native functions.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL。把只读副本换成 Aurora 副本，并配置 Aurora Auto Scaling。把存储过程替换为 Aurora MySQL 原生函数。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the database. Modify the application to check the cache before the application queries the database. Replace the stored procedures with AWS Lambda functions.
options.text_zh: 在数据库前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。改造应用，使其在查询数据库之前先查缓存。把存储过程替换为 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to a MySQL database that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Choose large, compute optimized EC2 instances for all replica nodes. Maintain the stored procedures on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 MySQL 数据库。所有副本节点都选用大规格的计算优化型 EC2 实例。存储过程仍保留在这些 EC2 实例上。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Provision a large number of read capacity units (RCUs) to support the required throughput, and configure on-demand capacity scaling. Replace the stored procedures with DynamoDB streams.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。预置大量读取容量单位 (RCU) 以支撑所需吞吐，并配置按需容量伸缩。把存储过程替换为 DynamoDB 流。

explanation_en:
Amazon Aurora MySQL: Aurora Replicas in Amazon Aurora MySQL are designed to have minimal replication lag compared to traditional MySQL read replicas. Aurora is built for high performance and low replication lag, making it a suitable choice for reducing lag in read replicas.

Aurora Auto Scaling: Aurora Auto Scaling allows you to automatically adjust the number of Aurora Replicas based on actual application usage. This ensures that you have the right amount of read capacity during periods of peak load, minimizing replication lag.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Aurora MySQL：与传统 MySQL 只读副本相比，Amazon Aurora MySQL 中的 Aurora 副本被设计为具有极小的复制延迟。Aurora 专为高性能和低复制延迟而构建，因此是减少只读副本延迟的合适选择。

Aurora Auto Scaling：Aurora Auto Scaling 允许你根据实际应用使用情况自动调整 Aurora 副本的数量。这可确保在峰值负载期间拥有恰当的读取容量，从而将复制延迟降到最低。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上部署了一个 Web 应用程序。公司将后端数据库托管在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 上，包含一个主数据库实例和五个只读副本以支持扩展需求。只读副本落后于主数据库实例的时间不得超过 1 秒。该数据库会例行运行计划的存储过程。

随着网站流量增加，副本在峰值负载期间出现额外的延迟。解决方案架构师必须尽可能减少复制延迟。解决方案架构师必须尽量减少对应用程序代码的改动，并尽量减少持续的运维开销。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) plan for a high-volume software as a service (SaaS) platform. All data for the platform is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The DR plan must replicate data to a secondary AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use MySQL binary log replication to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Provision one DB instance for the Aurora cluster in the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 用 MySQL 二进制日志复制到第二区域的一个 Aurora 集群。在第二区域为该 Aurora 集群预置一个数据库实例。

options.text_en: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. When setup is complete, remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库集群设置 Aurora 全局数据库。设置完成后，把第二区域中的数据库实例删掉。

options.text_en: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 持续把数据复制到第二区域的一个 Aurora 集群。然后把第二区域中的数据库实例删掉。

options.text_en: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. Specify a minimum of one DB instance in the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库集群设置 Aurora 全局数据库。在第二区域指定至少一个数据库实例。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师必须为一个高流量的软件即服务（SaaS）平台制定灾难恢复（DR）计划。该平台的所有数据都存储在一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群中。

该 DR 计划必须将数据复制到第二个 AWS 区域。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. Management says the application must be made more secure with the least amount of programming effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建密钥。配置应用从 AWS KMS 加载数据库凭证。启用自动密钥轮换。

options.text_en: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secret Manager.
options.text_zh: 在该 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用用户创建凭证，并把凭证存入 AWS Secrets Manager。配置应用从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来轮换 Secrets Manager 中的凭证。

options.text_en: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager.
options.text_zh: 在该 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用用户创建凭证，并把凭证存入 AWS Secrets Manager。配置应用从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。用 Secrets Manager 为该 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用用户设置凭证轮换计划。

options.text_en: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store.
options.text_zh: 在该 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用用户创建凭证，并把凭证存入 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store。配置应用从 Parameter Store 加载数据库凭证。用 Parameter Store 为该 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用用户设置凭证轮换计划。

explanation_en: C is a valid solution for securing the custom application with the least amount of programming effort. It involves creating credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and storing them in AWS Secrets Manager. The application can then be configured to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Additionally, the solution includes setting up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager, which will automatically rotate the credentials at a specified interval without requiring any programming effort.
explanation_zh: 选项 C 是以最少编程工作量保护该自定义应用程序的有效方案。它包括在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证并将其存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。随后可以配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。此外，该方案还包括使用 Secrets Manager 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置凭证轮换计划，这将按指定间隔自动轮换凭证，而无需任何编程工作。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个内嵌凭证的自定义应用程序，用于从一个 Amazon RDS MySQL 数据库实例检索信息。管理层表示，必须以最少的编程工作量提升该应用程序的安全性。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A media company hosts its website on AWS. The website application’s architecture includes a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a database that is hosted on Amazon Aurora. The company’s cybersecurity team reports that the application is vulnerable to SQL injection. How should the company resolve this issue?

options.text_en: Use AWS WAF in front of the ALB. Associate the appropriate web ACLs with AWS WAF.
options.text_zh: 在该 ALB 前面使用 AWS WAF。为 AWS WAF 关联相应的 Web ACL。

options.text_en: Create an ALB listener rule to reply to SQL injections with a fixed response.
options.text_zh: 创建一条 ALB 侦听器规则，对 SQL 注入返回固定响应。

options.text_en: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.
options.text_zh: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced 来自动阻断所有 SQL 注入尝试。

options.text_en: Set up Amazon Inspector to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Inspector 来自动阻断所有 SQL 注入尝试。

explanation_en:
AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall): AWS WAF is designed to protect web applications from common web exploits, including SQL injection. It allows you to create web access control lists (web ACLs) to define rules that filter and monitor HTTP traffic to your application.

Associating Web ACLs with AWS WAF: By using AWS WAF in front of the ALB, you can define rules to block or allow web requests based on conditions that you specify. This includes protection against SQL injection attempts. AWS WAF provides a range of conditions and rulesets that you can use to mitigate common security threats.
explanation_zh:
AWS WAF（Web 应用防火墙）：AWS WAF 旨在保护 Web 应用免受常见 Web 漏洞攻击，包括 SQL 注入。它允许你创建 Web 访问控制列表（Web ACL），定义规则来过滤和监控发往应用程序的 HTTP 流量。

将 Web ACL 与 AWS WAF 关联：通过在 ALB 前使用 AWS WAF，你可以定义规则，根据你指定的条件阻止或允许 Web 请求。这包括防御 SQL 注入尝试。AWS WAF 提供一系列条件和规则集，可用于缓解常见的安全威胁。
stem_zh:
某媒体公司在 AWS 上托管其网站。该网站应用程序的架构包括一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的一组 Amazon EC2 实例，以及一个托管在 Amazon Aurora 上的数据库。公司的网络安全团队报告称该应用程序易受 SQL 注入攻击。

公司应如何解决此问题？

stem_en: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake that is governed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create a visualization in Amazon QuickSight by joining the data in the data lake with operational data that is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company wants to enforce column-level authorization so that the company’s marketing team can access only a subset of columns in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon EMR to ingest the data directly from the database to the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EMR 把数据从数据库直接接入 QuickSight 的 SPICE 引擎，只包含所需的列。

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue Studio to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Attach an IAM policy to the QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Glue Studio 把数据从数据库接入 S3 数据湖。给 QuickSight 用户附加 IAM 策略来实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中以 Amazon S3 作为数据源。

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create a materialized view for the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column- level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Glue Elastic Views 在 Amazon S3 中为该数据库创建物化视图。创建 S3 存储桶策略，对 QuickSight 用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中以 Amazon S3 作为数据源。

options.text_en: Use a Lake Formation blueprint to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.
options.text_zh: 用 Lake Formation 蓝图把数据从数据库接入 S3 数据湖。用 Lake Formation 对 QuickSight 用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中以 Amazon Athena 作为数据源。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个由 AWS Lake Formation 治理的 Amazon S3 数据湖。公司希望在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建一个可视化视图，将数据湖中的数据与存储在 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库中的运营数据进行联接。公司希望强制实施列级授权，使公司的营销团队只能访问数据库中的部分列。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A transaction processing company has weekly scripted batch jobs that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The number of transactions can vary, but the baseline CPU utilization that is noted on each run is at least 60%. The company needs to provision the capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run. Currently, engineers complete this task by manually modifying the Auto Scaling group parameters. The company does not have the resources to analyze the required capacity trends for the Auto Scaling group counts. The company needs an automated way to modify the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on the CPU utilization metric. Set the target value for the metric to 60%.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组创建一条动态伸缩策略。把该策略配置为按 CPU 利用率指标伸缩，指标目标值设为 60%。

options.text_en: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Set the appropriate desired capacity, minimum capacity, and maximum capacity. Set the recurrence to weekly. Set the start time to 30 minutes before the batch jobs run.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组创建一条计划伸缩策略。设置合适的期望容量、最小容量和最大容量。把重复周期设为每周。把开始时间设为批处理作业运行前 30 分钟。

options.text_en: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the scaling metric to CPU utilization. Set the target value for the metric to 60%. In the policy, set the instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before the jobs run.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组创建一条预测性伸缩策略。把该策略配置为按预测结果伸缩。把伸缩指标设为 CPU 利用率，指标目标值设为 60%。在该策略中设置实例在作业运行前 30 分钟预先启动。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke an AWS Lambda function when the CPU utilization metric value for the Auto Scaling group reaches 60%. Configure the Lambda function to increase the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity and maximum capacity by 20%.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件，在该 Auto Scaling 组的 CPU 利用率指标达到 60% 时调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数把该 Auto Scaling 组的期望容量和最大容量都提高 20%。

explanation_en: In general, if you have regular patterns of traffic increases and applications that take a long time to initialize, you should consider using predictive scaling. Predictive scaling can help you scale faster by launching capacity in advance of forecasted load, compared to using only dynamic scaling, which is reactive in nature.
explanation_zh: 一般来说，如果你的流量增长有规律可循，且应用程序初始化耗时较长，就应考虑使用预测性伸缩。与本质上属于被动响应的动态伸缩相比，预测性伸缩可以在预测负载到来之前提前启动容量，从而帮助你更快地完成扩容。
stem_zh:
某交易处理公司有每周运行的脚本化批处理作业，运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些 EC2 实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。交易数量可能会有波动，但每次运行时观察到的基线 CPU 利用率至少为 60%。公司需要在作业运行前 30 分钟预置容量。

目前，工程师通过手动修改 Auto Scaling 组参数来完成此任务。公司没有资源来分析 Auto Scaling 组实例数所需的容量趋势。公司需要一种自动修改 Auto Scaling 组期望容量的方式。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a company’s disaster recovery (DR) architecture. The company has a MySQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet with scheduled backup. The DR design needs to include multiple AWS Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Migrate the MySQL database to multiple EC2 instances. Configure a standby EC2 instance in the DR Region. Turn on replication.
options.text_zh: 把该 MySQL 数据库迁移到多台 EC2 实例上。在灾备区域配置一台备用 EC2 实例。开启复制。

options.text_en: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS. Use a Multi-AZ deployment. Turn on read replication for the primary DB instance in the different Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 把该 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS，采用多可用区部署。为不同可用区中的主数据库实例开启只读复制。

options.text_en: Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon Aurora global database. Host the primary DB cluster in the primary Region. Host the secondary DB cluster in the DR Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora 全局数据库。主数据库集群放在主区域，辅助数据库集群放在灾备区域。

options.text_en: Store the scheduled backup of the MySQL database in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR). Use the data backup to restore the database in the DR Region.
options.text_zh: 把该 MySQL 数据库的定时备份存放在一个配置了 S3 跨区域复制 (CRR) 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。灾难时用该数据备份在灾备区域恢复数据库。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计某公司的灾难恢复（DR）架构。公司有一个 MySQL 数据库，运行在私有子网中的一台 Amazon EC2 实例上，并配有计划备份。该 DR 设计需要包含多个 AWS 区域。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a Java application that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to parse messages. The application cannot parse messages that are larger than 256 KB in size. The company wants to implement a solution to give the application the ability to parse messages as large as 50 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.text_en: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java，把大于 256 KB 的消息存放到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EventBridge to post large messages from the application instead of Amazon SQS.
options.text_zh: 让应用改用 Amazon EventBridge 而不是 Amazon SQS 来投递大消息。

options.text_en: Change the limit in Amazon SQS to handle messages that are larger than 256 KB.
options.text_zh: 修改 Amazon SQS 的限制，使其能处理大于 256 KB 的消息。

options.text_en: Store messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure Amazon SQS to reference this location in the messages.
options.text_zh: 把大于 256 KB 的消息存放在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。配置 Amazon SQS 在消息中引用该位置。

explanation_en:
Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java: This library is specifically designed to handle larger messages in Amazon SQS by transparently offloading them to Amazon S3. It allows you to send a reference to the S3 object in the SQS message while keeping the actual payload in S3.

Minimal Code Changes: Using the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java requires minimal changes to the existing code. Developers need to integrate the library, and the library itself handles the details of storing and retrieving large messages from Amazon S3.
explanation_zh:
Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java：该库专门用于处理 Amazon SQS 中的较大消息，方法是透明地将它们卸载到 Amazon S3。它允许你在 SQS 消息中发送对 S3 对象的引用，而将实际负载保存在 S3 中。

代码改动极少：使用 Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java 只需对现有代码做极少改动。开发人员只需集成该库，库本身会处理在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索大消息的细节。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个 Java 应用程序，使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）解析消息。该应用程序无法解析大于 256 KB 的消息。公司希望实施一个方案，让该应用程序能够解析大至 50 MB 的消息。

哪个方案能以最少的代码改动满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to restrict access to the content of one of its main web applications and to protect the content by using authorization techniques available on AWS. The company wants to implement a serverless architecture and an authentication solution for fewer than 100 users. The solution needs to integrate with the main web application and serve web content globally. The solution must also scale as the company's user base grows while providing the lowest login latency possible. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Cognito 做身份验证。用 Lambda@Edge 做授权。用 Amazon CloudFront 面向全球分发该 Web 应用。

options.text_en: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 做身份验证。用 AWS Lambda 做授权。用 Application Load Balancer 面向全球分发该 Web 应用。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Cognito 做身份验证。用 AWS Lambda 做授权。用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 面向全球分发该 Web 应用。

options.text_en: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 做身份验证。用 Lambda@Edge 做授权。用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 面向全球分发该 Web 应用。

explanation_en:
Amazon Cognito for Authentication: Amazon Cognito is a fully managed service for user identity and access control. It provides easy integration for authentication with a serverless architecture and supports a user pool for fewer than 100 users.

Lambda@Edge for Authorization: Lambda@Edge allows you to run custom code in response to CloudFront events, including authorization. You can implement authorization logic at the edge locations closest to the end-users, providing low-latency access.

Amazon CloudFront for Content Delivery: Amazon CloudFront is a global content delivery network (CDN) that integrates seamlessly with Lambda@Edge. CloudFront can serve the web application globally, distributing content from edge locations for low-latency access.
explanation_zh:
用 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证：Amazon Cognito 是一项全托管的用户身份和访问控制服务。它便于与无服务器架构集成以实现身份验证，并支持面向不到 100 名用户的用户池。

用 Lambda@Edge 进行授权：Lambda@Edge 允许你运行自定义代码来响应 CloudFront 事件，包括授权。你可以在距离最终用户最近的边缘站点实现授权逻辑，从而提供低延迟访问。

用 Amazon CloudFront 进行内容分发：Amazon CloudFront 是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可与 Lambda@Edge 无缝集成。CloudFront 可以在全球范围内提供该 Web 应用程序，从边缘站点分发内容以实现低延迟访问。
stem_zh:
某公司希望限制对其某个主要 Web 应用程序内容的访问，并使用 AWS 上可用的授权技术保护该内容。公司希望为不到 100 名用户实施无服务器架构和身份验证方案。该方案需要与主 Web 应用程序集成，并在全球范围内提供 Web 内容。该方案还必须随着公司用户群的增长而扩展，同时提供尽可能低的登录延迟。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an aging network-attached storage (NAS) array in its data center. The NAS array presents SMB shares and NFS shares to client workstations. The company does not want to purchase a new NAS array. The company also does not want to incur the cost of renewing the NAS array’s support contract. Some of the data is accessed frequently, but much of the data is inactive. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that migrates the data to Amazon S3, uses S3 Lifecycle policies, and maintains the same look and feel for the client workstations. The solutions architect has identified AWS Storage Gateway as part of the solution. Which type of storage gateway should the solutions architect provision to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Volume Gateway
options.text_zh: 卷网关 (Volume Gateway)

options.text_en: Tape Gateway
options.text_zh: 磁带网关 (Tape Gateway)

options.text_en: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.text_zh: Amazon FSx File Gateway

options.text_en: Amazon S3 File Gateway
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 File Gateway

explanation_en: Amazon S3 File Gateway provides on-premises applications with access to virtually unlimited cloud storage using NFS and SMB file interfaces. It seamlessly moves frequently accessed data to a low-latency cache while storing colder data in Amazon S3, using S3 Lifecycle policies to transition data between storage classes over tim
explanation_zh: Amazon S3 File Gateway 通过 NFS 和 SMB 文件接口，为本地应用程序提供对几乎无限的云存储的访问。它会无缝地将频繁访问的数据移动到低延迟缓存中，同时将较冷的数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 S3 生命周期策略随时间在存储类之间转换数据。
stem_zh:
某公司数据中心里有一台老化的网络附加存储（NAS）阵列。该 NAS 阵列向客户端工作站提供 SMB 共享和 NFS 共享。公司不想购买新的 NAS 阵列，也不想承担续订该 NAS 阵列支持合同的费用。其中一部分数据被频繁访问，但大部分数据处于不活跃状态。

解决方案架构师需要实施一个方案，将数据迁移到 Amazon S3，使用 S3 生命周期策略，并为客户端工作站保持相同的使用体验。解决方案架构师已确定 AWS Storage Gateway 是方案的一部分。

解决方案架构师应预置哪种类型的存储网关来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect has standardized the company on a particular instance family and various instance sizes based on the current needs of the company. The company wants to maximize cost savings for the application over the next 3 years. The company needs to be able to change the instance family and sizes in the next 6 months based on application popularity and usage. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Compute Savings Plan
options.text_zh: Compute Savings Plan（计算类节省计划）

options.text_en: EC2 Instance Savings Plan
options.text_zh: EC2 Instance Savings Plan（EC2 实例类节省计划）

options.text_en: Zonal Reserved Instances
options.text_zh: 可用区预留实例 (Zonal Reserved Instances)

options.text_en: Standard Reserved Instances
options.text_zh: 标准预留实例 (Standard Reserved Instances)

explanation_en: Compute Savings Plans provide significant cost savings over On-Demand pricing in exchange for a commitment to a consistent amount of compute usage (measured in $/hr) for a 1 or 3 year period. They offer flexibility by allowing you to switch between instance families, sizes, and AZs (Availability Zones) while still benefiting from the savings plan pricing. This aligns well with the company's requirement to change instance family and sizes based on application needs.
explanation_zh: Compute Savings Plans 通过承诺在 1 年或 3 年期内保持一定量的计算使用（以美元/小时计量），提供相对于按需定价的显著成本节约。它们提供灵活性，允许你在实例系列、规格和可用区（AZ）之间切换，同时仍享受节省计划的价格。这与公司需要根据应用需求更改实例系列和规格的要求非常契合。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。一位解决方案架构师已根据公司当前的需求，将公司统一到某个特定的实例系列和各种实例规格上。

公司希望在未来 3 年内为该应用程序实现最大的成本节约。公司需要能够在未来 6 个月内根据应用程序的受欢迎程度和使用情况更改实例系列和规格。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company collects data from a large number of participants who use wearable devices. The company stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table and uses applications to analyze the data. The data workload is constant and predictable. The company wants to stay at or below its forecasted budget for DynamoDB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use provisioned mode and DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA). Reserve capacity for the forecasted workload.
options.text_zh: 使用预置模式和 DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA)。为预测的工作负载预留容量。

options.text_en: Use provisioned mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs).
options.text_zh: 使用预置模式。指定读取容量单位 (RCU) 和写入容量单位 (WCU)。

options.text_en: Use on-demand mode. Set the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) high enough to accommodate changes in the workload.
options.text_zh: 使用按需模式。把读取容量单位 (RCU) 和写入容量单位 (WCU) 设得足够高，以应对负载变化。

options.text_en: Use on-demand mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) with reserved capacity.
options.text_zh: 使用按需模式。指定带预留容量的读取容量单位 (RCU) 和写入容量单位 (WCU)。

explanation_en: In provisioned mode, you provision a specific amount of read and write capacity, which allows you to manage costs more effectively based on your expected workload. This approach is suitable when your workload is predictable, as you can provision the capacity to meet your known requirements. DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (Option A) is designed for cost savings on long-term storage and retrieval of infrequently accessed data, and it might not be the best fit for a constant and predictable workload.
explanation_zh: 在预置模式下，你预置特定数量的读写容量，从而可以根据预期工作负载更有效地管理成本。当你的工作负载可预测时，这种方式很合适，因为你可以按已知需求预置容量。DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access（选项 A）专为长期存储和检索不常访问数据的成本节约而设计，可能并不最适合稳定且可预测的工作负载。
stem_zh:
某公司从大量使用可穿戴设备的参与者处收集数据。公司将数据存储在一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，并使用应用程序分析这些数据。数据工作负载稳定且可预测。公司希望将 DynamoDB 的开销保持在其预测预算之内或以下。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores confidential data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database in the ap-southeast-3 Region. The database is encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. The company was recently acquired and must securely share a backup of the database with the acquiring company’s AWS account in ap-southeast-3. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a database snapshot. Copy the snapshot to a new unencrypted snapshot. Share the new snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.text_zh: 创建一个数据库快照。把该快照复制成一个新的未加密快照。把新快照共享给收购方公司的 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Create a database snapshot. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key policy. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.text_zh: 创建一个数据库快照。把收购方公司的 AWS 账户加入该 KMS 密钥策略。把快照共享给收购方公司的 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Create a database snapshot that uses a different AWS managed KMS key. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key alias. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company's AWS account.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用不同 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥的数据库快照。把收购方公司的 AWS 账户加入该 KMS 密钥别名。把快照共享给收购方公司的 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Create a database snapshot. Download the database snapshot. Upload the database snapshot to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.text_zh: 创建一个数据库快照。把该数据库快照下载下来。再把它上传到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新该 S3 存储桶策略，允许收购方公司的 AWS 账户访问。

explanation_en:
sharing encrypted snapshots involves granting permission not only on the snapshot itself but also on the underlying AWS Key Management Service (KMS) key used for encryption.
By adding the acquiring company's AWS account to the KMS key policy, you ensure that they have the necessary permissions to decrypt and access the snapshot.
Sharing the snapshot with the acquiring company's AWS account completes the process, allowing them to restore the database from the shared snapshot.
explanation_zh:
共享加密快照不仅需要授予对快照本身的权限，还需要授予对用于加密的 AWS Key Management Service（KMS）密钥的权限。
通过将收购方公司的 AWS 账户添加到 KMS 密钥策略中，你可以确保他们拥有解密和访问该快照所需的权限。
将该快照共享给收购方公司的 AWS 账户即可完成整个过程，使他们能够从共享的快照恢复数据库。
stem_zh:
某公司将机密数据存储在 ap-southeast-3 区域的一个 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中。该数据库使用一个 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户托管密钥加密。该公司最近被收购，必须将该数据库的备份安全地共享给收购方公司位于 ap-southeast-3 的 AWS 账户。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses a 100 GB Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance in the us-east-1 Region to store customer transactions. The company needs high availability and automatic recovery for the DB instance. The company must also run reports on the RDS database several times a year. The report process causes transactions to take longer than usual to post to the customers’ accounts. The company needs a solution that will improve the performance of the report process. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例从单可用区实例改为多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 对当前数据库实例做快照。把该快照恢复到另一个可用区中的新 RDS 部署。

options.text_en: Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica.
options.text_zh: 在另一个可用区创建该数据库实例的只读副本。把所有报表请求都指向该只读副本。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to RDS Custom.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 RDS Custom。

options.text_en: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window.
options.text_zh: 用 RDS Proxy 把报表请求限制在维护窗口内。

explanation_en:
Enabling Multi-AZ deployment provides high availability by replicating the database to a standby instance in another Availability Zone. This helps in automatic failover and recovery in case of a primary instance failure.
C. Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica:

By creating a read replica in a different Availability Zone, you offload the reporting workload from the primary instance, reducing the impact on transaction processing. Read replicas can be used to scale read-heavy workloads and improve overall performance.
explanation_zh:
启用多可用区部署可通过将数据库复制到另一个可用区中的备用实例来提供高可用性。这有助于在主实例发生故障时自动故障转移和恢复。
C. 在另一个可用区创建该数据库实例的只读副本。将所有报表请求指向该只读副本：

通过在另一个可用区创建只读副本，你可以将报表工作负载从主实例卸载，减少对交易处理的影响。只读副本可用于扩展读密集型工作负载并提升整体性能。
stem_zh:
某公司在 us-east-1 区域使用一个 100 GB 的 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 单可用区数据库实例来存储客户交易。公司需要该数据库实例具备高可用性和自动恢复能力。

公司每年还要在该 RDS 数据库上运行几次报表。报表处理过程会导致交易过账到客户账户的时间比平常更长。公司需要一个能提升报表处理性能的方案。

哪些步骤组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is moving its data management application to AWS. The company wants to transition to an event-driven architecture. The architecture needs to be more distributed and to use serverless concepts while performing the different aspects of the workflow. The company also wants to minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Build out the workflow in AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Glue 中构建该工作流。用 AWS Glue 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理各工作流步骤。

options.text_en: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Step Functions to invoke the workflow steps on the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Step Functions 中构建该工作流。把应用部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上。用 Step Functions 在这些 EC2 实例上触发各工作流步骤。

options.text_en: Build out the workflow in Amazon EventBridge. Use EventBridge to invoke AWS Lambda functions on a schedule to process the workflow steps.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中构建该工作流。用 EventBridge 按计划调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理各工作流步骤。

options.text_en: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine. Use the state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Step Functions 中构建该工作流。用 Step Functions 创建一个状态机。用该状态机调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理各工作流步骤。

explanation_en:
AWS Step Functions allows you to coordinate the components of distributed applications using visual workflows. It is a fully managed service, which means you don't need to worry about operational overhead.

State machines in AWS Step Functions enable you to define the workflow of your application by specifying a series of steps. Each step can invoke an AWS Lambda function, among other things.

AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service, and it automatically scales with the workload. This aligns with the goal of using serverless concepts and minimizing operational overhead.
explanation_zh:
AWS Step Functions 允许你使用可视化工作流协调分布式应用程序的各个组件。它是一项全托管服务，这意味着你无需担心运维开销。

AWS Step Functions 中的状态机使你能够通过指定一系列步骤来定义应用程序的工作流。每个步骤都可以调用 AWS Lambda 函数等。

AWS Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，会随工作负载自动伸缩。这与使用无服务器理念并最大限度降低运维开销的目标一致。
stem_zh:
某公司正在将其数据管理应用程序迁移到 AWS。公司希望转向事件驱动架构。该架构需要更加分布式，并在执行工作流的不同环节时使用无服务器理念。公司还希望最大限度降低运维开销。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing the network for an online multi-player game. The game uses the UDP networking protocol and will be deployed in eight AWS Regions. The network architecture needs to minimize latency and packet loss to give end users a high-quality gaming experience. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Setup a transit gateway in each Region. Create inter-Region peering attachments between each transit gateway.
options.text_zh: 在每个区域各设置一个中转网关。在各中转网关之间创建跨区域对等连接附件。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator，在每个区域设置 UDP 侦听器和端点组。

options.text_en: Set up Amazon CloudFront with UDP turned on. Configure an origin in each Region.
options.text_zh: 配置开启 UDP 的 Amazon CloudFront。在每个区域配置一个源站。

options.text_en: Set up a VPC peering mesh between each Region. Turn on UDP for each VPC.
options.text_zh: 在各区域之间建立全互联的 VPC 对等网状连接。为每个 VPC 开启 UDP。

explanation_en:
AWS Global Accelerator is designed to improve the availability and performance of applications by using static IP addresses (Anycast) and directing traffic over the AWS global network. It provides low-latency and high-performance routing, making it well-suited for applications with a global user base, such as multi-player games.

By setting up UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region with AWS Global Accelerator, you can efficiently route traffic to the nearest game servers, reducing latency and improving the overall gaming experience.
explanation_zh:
AWS Global Accelerator 旨在通过使用静态 IP 地址（任播）并将流量导向 AWS 全球网络来提升应用程序的可用性和性能。它提供低延迟、高性能的路由，因此非常适合像多人游戏这样拥有全球用户群的应用程序。

通过使用 AWS Global Accelerator 在每个区域设置 UDP 侦听器和终端节点组，你可以高效地将流量路由到最近的游戏服务器，从而降低延迟并提升整体游戏体验。
stem_zh:
某公司正在为一款在线多人游戏设计网络。该游戏使用 UDP 网络协议，将部署在八个 AWS 区域。该网络架构需要最大限度降低延迟和丢包率，以便为最终用户提供高质量的游戏体验。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts a three-tier web application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. The web application uses a self-managed MySQL database that is hosted on an EC2 instance to store data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The MySQL database currently uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volume. The company expects traffic of 1,000 IOPS for both reads and writes at peak traffic. The company wants to minimize any disruptions, stabilize performance, and reduce costs while retaining the capacity for double the IOPS. The company wants to move the database tier to a fully managed solution that is highly available and fault tolerant. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with an io2 Block Express EBS volume.
options.text_zh: 使用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例，搭配 io2 Block Express EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with a General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume.
options.text_zh: 使用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例，搭配通用型 SSD (gp2) EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 的各访问层。

options.text_en: Use two large EC2 instances to host the database in active-passive mode.
options.text_zh: 用两台大规格 EC2 实例以主备模式承载该数据库。

stem_zh:
某公司在单个可用区中的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个三层 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序使用托管在一台 EC2 实例上的自管理 MySQL 数据库，将数据存储在一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷中。该 MySQL 数据库目前使用一个 1 TB 的预置 IOPS SSD（io2）EBS 卷。公司预计在流量高峰时读写各需 1,000 IOPS。

公司希望尽量减少任何中断、稳定性能并降低成本，同时保留支持双倍 IOPS 的容量能力。公司希望将数据库层迁移到一个高可用且容错的全托管方案上。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The company notices an increase in application errors that result from database connection timeouts during times of peak traffic or unpredictable traffic. The company needs a solution that reduces the application failures with the least amount of change to the code. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate.
options.text_zh: 降低 Lambda 的并发速率。

options.text_en: Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.
options.text_zh: 在该 RDS 数据库实例上启用 RDS Proxy。

options.text_en: Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections.
options.text_zh: 调整该 RDS 数据库实例类型，使其能接受更多连接。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到采用按需伸缩的 Amazon DynamoDB。

explanation_en: RDS Proxy is a fully managed, highly available database proxy that can handle database connections for serverless and highly scalable applications. It helps manage database connections efficiently, reducing issues related to connection timeouts and errors.
explanation_zh: RDS Proxy 是一个全托管的高可用数据库代理，可为无服务器和高度可扩展的应用程序处理数据库连接。它有助于高效管理数据库连接，减少与连接超时和错误相关的问题。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上托管一个无服务器应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库。公司注意到，在流量高峰或流量不可预测时，因数据库连接超时导致的应用程序错误有所增加。公司需要一个能以最少代码改动减少应用程序失败的方案。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is migrating an old application to AWS. The application runs a batch job every hour and is CPU intensive. The batch job takes 15 minutes on average with an on-premises server. The server has 64 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 512 GiB of memory. Which solution will run the batch job within 15 minutes with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda with functional scaling.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 及其函数级伸缩。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 AWS Fargate。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Lightsail 搭配 AWS Auto Scaling。

options.text_en: Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon EC2 上使用 AWS Batch。

explanation_en: AWS Batch on Amazon EC2: AWS Batch is a fully managed service for batch computing that dynamically provisions the optimal quantity and type of compute resources (Amazon EC2 instances) based on the volume and specific resource requirements of the batch jobs. If the batch job is CPU-intensive and can be parallelized, AWS Batch can efficiently manage the compute resources needed for the job, and it provides a higher level of control over the environment compared to serverless options like AWS Lambda.
explanation_zh: 在 Amazon EC2 上使用 AWS Batch：AWS Batch 是一项面向批量计算的全托管服务，可根据批处理作业的数量和具体资源需求，动态预置最优数量和类型的计算资源（Amazon EC2 实例）。如果该批处理作业是 CPU 密集型且可并行化，AWS Batch 可以高效管理作业所需的计算资源，并且相比 AWS Lambda 等无服务器选项提供了更高程度的环境控制能力。
stem_zh:
某公司正在将一个旧应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序每小时运行一次批处理作业，属于 CPU 密集型。在本地服务器上该批处理作业平均耗时 15 分钟。该服务器有 64 个虚拟 CPU（vCPU）和 512 GiB 内存。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销在 15 分钟内运行完该批处理作业？

stem_en: A company stores its data objects in Amazon S3 Standard storage. A solutions architect has found that 75% of the data is rarely accessed after 30 days. The company needs all the data to remain immediately accessible with the same high availability and resiliency, but the company wants to minimize storage costs. Which storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Move the data objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把数据对象转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把数据对象转移到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

options.text_en: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 30 天后把数据对象转移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

options.text_en: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately.
options.text_zh: 立即把数据对象转移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

explanation_en: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA): This storage class is designed for infrequently accessed data but still provides low-latency and high-throughput performance. It maintains the same high availability and durability as S3 Standard, making it suitable for data that is accessed less frequently.
explanation_zh: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access（S3 Standard-IA）：该存储类专为不常访问的数据设计，但仍提供低延迟和高吞吐量的性能。它保持与 S3 Standard 相同的高可用性和持久性，因此适合访问频率较低的数据。
stem_zh:
某公司将其数据对象存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 存储中。一位解决方案架构师发现，其中 75% 的数据在 30 天后很少被访问。公司需要所有数据都保持可立即访问，并具有同样的高可用性和弹性，但公司希望最大限度降低存储成本。

哪个存储方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A gaming company is moving its public scoreboard from a data center to the AWS Cloud. The company uses Amazon EC2 Windows Server instances behind an Application Load Balancer to host its dynamic application. The company needs a highly available storage solution for the application. The application consists of static files and dynamic server-side code. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache objects at the edge.
options.text_zh: 把静态文件存放在 Amazon S3 上。用 Amazon CloudFront 在边缘节点缓存对象。

options.text_en: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache objects at the edge.
options.text_zh: 把静态文件存放在 Amazon S3 上。用 Amazon ElastiCache 在边缘节点缓存对象。

options.text_en: Store the server-side code on Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.text_zh: 把服务端代码存放在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 上。在每台 EC2 实例上挂载该 EFS 卷来共享文件。

options.text_en: Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.text_zh: 把服务端代码存放在 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 上。在每台 EC2 实例上挂载该 FSx for Windows File Server 卷来共享文件。

options.text_en: Store the server-side code on a General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.text_zh: 把服务端代码存放在一个通用型 SSD (gp2) 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。在每台 EC2 实例上挂载该 EBS 卷来共享文件。

explanation_en:
D. Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.

Amazon S3 is a highly scalable and durable object storage service, and it is well-suited for storing static files. Using CloudFront as a content delivery network (CDN) improves the delivery of static content by caching objects at edge locations, reducing latency for end users.

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides a fully managed Windows file system that is accessible from Windows-based EC2 instances. This is suitable for storing dynamic server-side code that requires file sharing across multiple instances. It offers high availability and supports Windows-native features.
explanation_zh:
D. 将服务器端代码存储在 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 上。在每台 EC2 实例上挂载该 FSx for Windows File Server 卷以共享文件。

Amazon S3 是一项高度可扩展且持久的对象存储服务，非常适合存储静态文件。使用 CloudFront 作为内容分发网络（CDN）可通过在边缘站点缓存对象来改善静态内容的交付，降低最终用户的延迟。

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 提供一个全托管的 Windows 文件系统，可从基于 Windows 的 EC2 实例访问。这适合存储需要在多台实例之间共享的动态服务器端代码。它提供高可用性并支持 Windows 原生功能。
stem_zh:
某游戏公司正在将其公开积分榜从数据中心迁移到 AWS 云。公司使用位于一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon EC2 Windows Server 实例来托管其动态应用程序。公司需要为该应用程序提供一个高可用的存储方案。该应用程序由静态文件和动态服务器端代码组成。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A social media company runs its application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB is the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The application has more than a billion images stored in an Amazon S3 bucket and processes thousands of images each second. The company wants to resize the images dynamically and serve appropriate formats to clients. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Install an external image management library on an EC2 instance. Use the image management library to process the images.
options.text_zh: 在一台 EC2 实例上安装外部图像处理库。用该图像处理库来处理图片。

options.text_en: Create a CloudFront origin request policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 CloudFront 源请求策略。用该策略自动调整图片尺寸，并根据请求中的 User-Agent HTTP 头返回合适的格式。

options.text_en: Use a Lambda@Edge function with an external image management library. Associate the Lambda@Edge function with the CloudFront behaviors that serve the images.
options.text_zh: 使用一个搭配外部图像处理库的 Lambda@Edge 函数。把该 Lambda@Edge 函数关联到分发图片的那些 CloudFront 行为上。

options.text_en: Create a CloudFront response headers policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 CloudFront 响应头策略。用该策略自动调整图片尺寸，并根据请求中的 User-Agent HTTP 头返回合适的格式。

explanation_en:
Lambda@Edge: Allows you to run code in response to CloudFront events without provisioning or managing servers. In this case, a Lambda@Edge function can be used to dynamically resize images based on the request.

External image management library: Since the company wants to minimize operational overhead, using an external image management library within a Lambda@Edge function is a good choice. This eliminates the need to manage EC2 instances or other infrastructure.
explanation_zh:
Lambda@Edge：允许你响应 CloudFront 事件运行代码，无需预置或管理服务器。在此场景中，可以使用 Lambda@Edge 函数根据请求动态调整图片尺寸。

外部图像管理库：由于公司希望最大限度降低运维开销，在 Lambda@Edge 函数中使用外部图像管理库是个不错的选择。这样就无需管理 EC2 实例或其他基础设施。
stem_zh:
某社交媒体公司在一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用程序。该 ALB 是一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。该应用程序在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中存储了超过十亿张图片，每秒处理数千张图片。公司希望动态调整图片尺寸并向客户端提供合适的格式。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A hospital needs to store patient records in an Amazon S3 bucket. The hospital’s compliance team must ensure that all protected health information (PHI) is encrypted in transit and at rest. The compliance team must administer the encryption key for data at rest. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a public SSL/TLS certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Associate the certificate with Amazon S3. Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中创建一张公有 SSL/TLS 证书。把该证书与 Amazon S3 关联。把每个 S3 存储桶的默认加密配置为使用采用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）。指派合规团队来管理这些 KMS 密钥。

options.text_en: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Assign the compliance team to manage the SSE-S3 keys.
options.text_zh: 在 S3 存储桶策略中使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，只允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。把每个 S3 存储桶的默认加密配置为使用采用 S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）。指派合规团队来管理这些 SSE-S3 密钥。

options.text_en: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.text_zh: 在 S3 存储桶策略中使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，只允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。把每个 S3 存储桶的默认加密配置为使用采用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）。指派合规团队来管理这些 KMS 密钥。

options.text_en: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Use Amazon Macie to protect the sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3. Assign the compliance team to manage Macie.
options.text_zh: 在 S3 存储桶策略中使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，只允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。用 Amazon Macie 保护存放在 Amazon S3 中的敏感数据。指派合规团队来管理 Macie。

explanation_en: it allows the compliance team to manage the KMS keys used for server-side encryption, thereby providing the necessary control over the encryption keys. Additionally, the use of the "aws:SecureTransport" condition on the bucket policy ensures that all connections to the S3 bucket are encrypted in transit.
explanation_zh: 该方案允许合规团队管理用于服务器端加密的 KMS 密钥，从而提供对加密密钥的必要控制。此外，在存储桶策略上使用 "aws:SecureTransport" 条件可确保到该 S3 存储桶的所有连接在传输过程中都是加密的。
stem_zh:
某医院需要将患者记录存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。医院的合规团队必须确保所有受保护健康信息（PHI）在传输过程中和静态时都被加密。合规团队必须管理静态数据的加密密钥。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon API Gateway to run a private gateway with two REST APIs in the same VPC. The BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service to ensure that enough funds are available before a stock can be purchased. The company has noticed in the VPC flow logs that the BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service over the internet instead of through the VPC. A solutions architect must implement a solution so that the APIs communicate through the VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.text_en: Add an X-API-Key header in the HTTP header for authorization.
options.text_zh: 在 HTTP 请求头中加入 X-API-Key 头来做授权。

options.text_en: Use an interface endpoint.
options.text_zh: 使用接口端点。

options.text_en: Use a gateway endpoint.
options.text_zh: 使用网关端点。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue between the two REST APIs.
options.text_zh: 在两个 REST API 之间加一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。

explanation_en: Interface Endpoint (VPC Endpoint for API Gateway): An interface endpoint allows private connectivity to API Gateway within your VPC. By creating a VPC endpoint for API Gateway, you can ensure that the communication between the BuyStock and CheckFunds RESTful web services stays within the VPC, eliminating the need for traffic to go over the internet.
explanation_zh: 接口终端节点（API Gateway 的 VPC 终端节点）：接口终端节点允许在你的 VPC 内部私密地连接到 API Gateway。通过为 API Gateway 创建 VPC 终端节点，你可以确保 BuyStock 与 CheckFunds RESTful Web 服务之间的通信保持在 VPC 内部，从而无需流量经由互联网。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 在同一个 VPC 中运行一个包含两个 REST API 的私有网关。BuyStock RESTful Web 服务会调用 CheckFunds RESTful Web 服务，以确保在购买股票之前有足够的资金。公司在 VPC 流日志中注意到，BuyStock RESTful Web 服务是通过互联网而非 VPC 内部调用 CheckFunds RESTful Web 服务的。解决方案架构师必须实施一个方案，使这些 API 通过 VPC 通信。

哪个方案能以最少的代码改动满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts a multiplayer gaming application on AWS. The company wants the application to read data with sub-millisecond latency and run one-time queries on historical data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS for data that is frequently accessed. Run a periodic custom script to export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 对经常访问的数据使用 Amazon RDS。定期运行自定义脚本把数据导出到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Store the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket. Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy to move older data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for long- term storage. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.text_zh: 把数据直接存放在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。实施 S3 生命周期策略，把较旧的数据转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 做长期存储。用 Amazon Athena 对 Amazon S3 中的数据运行一次性查询。

options.text_en: Use Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for data that is frequently accessed. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket by using DynamoDB table export. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.text_zh: 对经常访问的数据使用 Amazon DynamoDB 搭配 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。用 DynamoDB 表导出功能把数据导出到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。用 Amazon Athena 对 Amazon S3 中的数据运行一次性查询。

options.text_en: Use Amazon DynamoDB for data that is frequently accessed. Turn on streaming to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to read the data from Kinesis Data Streams. Store the records in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 对经常访问的数据使用 Amazon DynamoDB。开启到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 的流式传输。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 从 Kinesis Data Streams 读取数据。把记录存放到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

explanation_en:
Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX):

DynamoDB is a highly scalable and low-latency NoSQL database, suitable for frequently accessed data.
DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is a caching layer that provides sub-millisecond read latencies for DynamoDB.
Export Data to Amazon S3:

Use DynamoDB table export to periodically export historical data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
This allows you to store historical data in a cost-effective manner while still benefiting from DynamoDB for frequently accessed data.
Amazon Athena for One-time Queries:

Amazon Athena allows you to run SQL queries directly on data stored in Amazon S3.
By using Athena, you can perform one-time queries on the historical data without the need to manage a separate database.
explanation_zh:
Amazon DynamoDB 配合 DynamoDB Accelerator（DAX）：

DynamoDB 是一款高度可扩展、低延迟的 NoSQL 数据库，适合频繁访问的数据。
DynamoDB Accelerator（DAX）是一个缓存层，为 DynamoDB 提供亚毫秒级的读取延迟。
将数据导出到 Amazon S3：

使用 DynamoDB 表导出功能定期将历史数据导出到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。
这使你能够以具有成本效益的方式存储历史数据，同时仍然利用 DynamoDB 处理频繁访问的数据。
使用 Amazon Athena 进行一次性查询：

Amazon Athena 允许你直接对存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据运行 SQL 查询。
通过使用 Athena，你可以对历史数据执行一次性查询，而无需管理一个单独的数据库。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上托管一个多人游戏应用程序。公司希望该应用程序能以亚毫秒级延迟读取数据，并对历史数据运行一次性查询。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses a payment processing system that requires messages for a particular payment ID to be received in the same order that they were sent. Otherwise, the payments might be processed incorrectly. Which actions should a solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Write the messages to an Amazon DynamoDB table with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.text_zh: 把消息写入一张以支付 ID 为分区键的 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Write the messages to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.text_zh: 把消息写入一个以支付 ID 为分区键的 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。

options.text_en: Write the messages to an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster with the payment ID as the key.
options.text_zh: 把消息写入一个以支付 ID 为键的 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 集群。

options.text_en: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the message attribute to use the payment ID.
options.text_zh: 把消息写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。把消息属性设为使用支付 ID。

options.text_en: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID.
options.text_zh: 把消息写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列。把消息组设为使用支付 ID。

explanation_en:
E. Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID.

Amazon Kinesis data streams can be used with partition keys to ensure that messages with the same partition key are processed in order. In this case, using the payment ID as the partition key will help maintain the order of messages.

SQS FIFO queues ensure that messages are processed in the order they are received. By using message groups and setting the payment ID as the message group, you can guarantee that messages for the same payment ID will be processed sequentially.
explanation_zh:
E. 将消息写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）FIFO 队列。将消息组设置为使用支付 ID。

Amazon Kinesis 数据流可以配合分区键使用，以确保具有相同分区键的消息按顺序处理。在此场景中，使用支付 ID 作为分区键有助于保持消息顺序。

SQS FIFO 队列确保消息按接收顺序处理。通过使用消息组并将支付 ID 设置为消息组，你可以保证同一支付 ID 的消息会被顺序处理。
stem_zh:
某公司使用一个支付处理系统，要求特定支付 ID 的消息必须按照发送顺序被接收。否则，支付可能会被错误处理。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来满足此要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is building a game system that needs to send unique events to separate leaderboard, matchmaking, and authentication services concurrently. The company needs an AWS event-driven system that guarantees the order of the events. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon EventBridge event bus
options.text_zh: Amazon EventBridge 事件总线

options.text_en: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics
options.text_zh: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO 主题

options.text_en: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topics
options.text_zh: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 标准主题

options.text_en: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues
options.text_zh: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列

explanation_en: SNS FIFO also can send events or messages cocurrently to many subscribers while maintaining the order it receives. SNS fanout pattern is set in standard SNS which is commonly used to fan out events to large number of subscribers and usually for duplicated messages.
explanation_zh: SNS FIFO 也可以在保持接收顺序的同时并发地向众多订阅者发送事件或消息。SNS 扇出模式设置在标准 SNS 中，通常用于向大量订阅者扇出事件，且通常涉及重复消息。
stem_zh:
某公司正在构建一个游戏系统，需要同时向独立的排行榜服务、匹配服务和身份验证服务发送唯一事件。公司需要一个能保证事件顺序的 AWS 事件驱动系统。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A hospital is designing a new application that gathers symptoms from patients. The hospital has decided to use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) and Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) in the architecture. A solutions architect is reviewing the infrastructure design. Data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Only authorized personnel of the hospital should be able to access the data. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.text_zh: 在 SQS 组件上开启服务器端加密。更新默认密钥策略，把密钥使用权限限制给一组授权主体。

options.text_en: Turn on server-side encryption on the SNS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SNS 组件上开启服务器端加密。应用密钥策略，把密钥使用权限限制给一组授权主体。

options.text_en: Turn on encryption on the SNS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the topic policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.
options.text_zh: 在 SNS 组件上开启加密。更新默认密钥策略，把密钥使用权限限制给一组授权主体。在主题策略中设置条件，只允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。

options.text_en: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SQS 组件上开启服务器端加密。应用密钥策略，把密钥使用权限限制给一组授权主体。在队列策略中设置条件，只允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。

options.text_en: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply an IAM policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SQS 组件上开启服务器端加密。应用 IAM 策略，把密钥使用权限限制给一组授权主体。在队列策略中设置条件，只允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。

explanation_en:
D. Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

This option ensures that data at rest in the SNS components is encrypted using an AWS KMS customer managed key. The key policy restricts key usage to authorized personnel.

This option ensures that data at rest in the SQS components is encrypted using an AWS KMS customer managed key. The key policy restricts key usage to authorized personnel, and the queue policy ensures that only encrypted connections over TLS are allowed.
explanation_zh:
D. 使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户托管密钥为 SQS 组件开启服务器端加密。应用密钥策略，将密钥使用限制在一组授权主体范围内。在队列策略中设置条件，只允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。

该选项确保 SNS 组件中的静态数据使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥加密。密钥策略将密钥使用限制在授权人员范围内。

该选项确保 SQS 组件中的静态数据使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥加密。密钥策略将密钥使用限制在授权人员范围内，队列策略则确保只允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。
stem_zh:
某医院正在设计一个新应用程序，用于收集患者的症状信息。医院已决定在架构中使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）和 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）。

一位解决方案架构师正在评审该基础设施设计。数据在静态和传输过程中都必须加密。只有医院的授权人员才应能够访问这些数据。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs a web application that is backed by Amazon RDS. A new database administrator caused data loss by accidentally editing information in a database table. To help recover from this type of incident, the company wants the ability to restore the database to its state from 5 minutes before any change within the last 30 days. Which feature should the solutions architect include in the design to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Read replicas
options.text_zh: 只读副本

options.text_en: Manual snapshots
options.text_zh: 手动快照

options.text_en: Automated backups
options.text_zh: 自动备份

options.text_en: Multi-AZ deployments
options.text_zh: 多可用区部署

explanation_en:
Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) can automatically create backups of your database every day.
These backups are like snapshots of your entire database, capturing all the data.
They happen automatically, so you don't have to remember to do it.
You can decide how long you want to keep these backup snapshots. For example, you might choose to keep them for up to 35 days.
This is like saying, "I want to keep the pictures of my database for the last 35 days."
explanation_zh:
Amazon RDS（关系数据库服务）可以每天自动创建数据库备份。
这些备份就像整个数据库的快照，捕获所有数据。
它们会自动进行，因此你无需记着去做。
你可以决定保留这些备份快照多久。例如，你可以选择保留最多 35 天。
这就好比说："我想保留数据库最近 35 天的'照片'。"
stem_zh:
某公司运行一个由 Amazon RDS 支撑的 Web 应用程序。一位新的数据库管理员因意外编辑数据库表中的信息而造成数据丢失。为帮助从此类事件中恢复，公司希望能够将数据库恢复到过去 30 天内任何更改发生前 5 分钟的状态。

解决方案架构师应在设计中包含哪项功能以满足此要求？

stem_en: A company’s web application consists of an Amazon API Gateway API in front of an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB database. The Lambda function handles the business logic, and the DynamoDB table hosts the data. The application uses Amazon Cognito user pools to identify the individual users of the application. A solutions architect needs to update the application so that only users who have a subscription can access premium content. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Enable API caching and throttling on the API Gateway API.
options.text_zh: 在该 API Gateway API 上启用 API 缓存和限流。

options.text_en: Set up AWS WAF on the API Gateway API. Create a rule to filter users who have a subscription.
options.text_zh: 在该 API Gateway API 上配置 AWS WAF。创建一条规则来筛选出已订阅的用户。

options.text_en: Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to the premium content in the DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 对该 DynamoDB 表中的付费内容应用细粒度 IAM 权限。

options.text_en: Implement API usage plans and API keys to limit the access of users who do not have a subscription.
options.text_zh: 实施 API 使用计划和 API 密钥，限制未订阅用户的访问。

stem_zh: 某公司的 Web 应用由一个 Amazon API Gateway API、其后的一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库组成。该 Lambda 函数处理业务逻辑，DynamoDB 表承载数据。该应用使用 Amazon Cognito 用户池来识别应用的各个用户。解决方案架构师需要更新该应用，使只有已订阅的用户才能访问付费内容。哪个方案能以最小的运维开销满足这一需求？

stem_en: A company is using Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to its UDP-based application for users around the world. The application is hosted on redundant servers in the company's on-premises data centers in the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company’s compliance requirements state that the application must be hosted on premises. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the application. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the NLBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.text_zh: 在这三个 AWS 区域各配置一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 来对接本地端点。用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，把这些 NLB 注册为它的端点。通过一条指向该加速器 DNS 的 CNAME 提供应用访问。

options.text_en: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the ALBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.text_zh: 在这三个 AWS 区域各配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 来对接本地端点。用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，把这些 ALB 注册为它的端点。通过一条指向该加速器 DNS 的 CNAME 提供应用访问。

options.text_en: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three NLBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.
options.text_zh: 在这三个 AWS 区域各配置一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 来对接本地端点。在 Route 53 中创建一条指向这三个 NLB 的基于延迟的记录，并把它用作某个 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。通过一条指向 CloudFront DNS 的 CNAME 提供应用访问。

options.text_en: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three ALBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.
options.text_zh: 在这三个 AWS 区域各配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 来对接本地端点。在 Route 53 中创建一条指向这三个 ALB 的基于延迟的记录，并把它用作某个 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。通过一条指向 CloudFront DNS 的 CNAME 提供应用访问。

explanation_en: This option suggests configuring three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address on-premises endpoints. While AWS Global Accelerator is used, the NLBs are registered as its endpoints. This does not meet the requirement of hosting the application on premises.
explanation_zh: 该选项建议在三个 AWS 区域中配置三个 Network Load Balancer（NLB）以指向本地端点。虽然使用了 AWS Global Accelerator，但注册为其终端节点的是这些 NLB。这不满足将应用程序托管在本地的要求。
stem_zh:
某公司正在使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由，为全球用户将请求路由到其基于 UDP 的应用程序。该应用程序托管在公司位于美国、亚洲和欧洲的本地数据中心中的冗余服务器上。公司的合规要求规定该应用程序必须托管在本地。公司希望提升该应用程序的性能和可用性。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect wants all new users to have specific complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods for IAM user passwords. What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.text_en: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account.
options.text_zh: 为整个 AWS 账户设置一条统一的密码策略。

options.text_en: Set a password policy for each IAM user in the AWS account.
options.text_zh: 为该 AWS 账户中的每个 IAM 用户分别设置密码策略。

options.text_en: Use third-party vendor software to set password requirements.
options.text_zh: 使用第三方厂商软件来设定密码要求。

options.text_en: Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event to set the password with the appropriate requirements.
options.text_zh: 为 Create_newuser 事件挂一条 Amazon CloudWatch 规则，按相应要求设置密码。

explanation_en: Amazon Web Services (AWS) allows you to set an account-wide password policy using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). This policy defines the rules and requirements for all IAM users in the AWS account. It's a centralized approach to enforce security measures consistently across all users. In this case, the solutions architect can set the specific complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods by configuring the password policy at the AWS account level.
explanation_zh: Amazon Web Services（AWS）允许你使用 AWS Identity and Access Management（IAM）设置账户级的密码策略。该策略为 AWS 账户中的所有 IAM 用户定义规则和要求。这是一种在所有用户之间一致地实施安全措施的集中式方法。在此场景中，解决方案架构师可以通过在 AWS 账户级别配置密码策略来设定特定的复杂度要求和强制轮换周期。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师希望所有新用户的 IAM 用户密码都满足特定的复杂度要求并具有强制轮换周期。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来实现这一点？

stem_en: A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 Linux instances. One of these EC2 instances runs several 1-hour tasks on a schedule. These tasks were written by different teams and have no common programming language. The company is concerned about performance and scalability while these tasks run on a single instance. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to resolve these concerns. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Batch 把这些任务作为作业运行。用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 来调度这些作业。

options.text_en: Convert the EC2 instance to a container. Use AWS App Runner to create the container on demand to run the tasks as jobs.
options.text_zh: 把该 EC2 实例改造成容器。用 AWS App Runner 按需创建容器，把这些任务作为作业运行。

options.text_en: Copy the tasks into AWS Lambda functions. Schedule the Lambda functions by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.text_zh: 把这些任务改写进 AWS Lambda 函数。用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 来调度这些 Lambda 函数。
