explanation_en: using AWS DataSync, which is designed for efficiently transferring large amounts of data between on-premises storage and Amazon S3. It allows you to create data transfer tasks and initiate the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket.
explanation_zh: 使用 AWS DataSync，它专为在本地存储与 Amazon S3 之间高效传输大量数据而设计。它允许你创建数据传输任务并启动向 Amazon S3 存储桶的传输。
stem_zh:
某公司在其企业数据中心的一套大型网络附加存储（NAS）系统上存储了 700 TB 数据。公司有一个混合环境，配备一条 10 Gbps 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接。

在监管机构审计之后，公司有 90 天时间将数据迁移到云端。公司需要高效且不中断地迁移数据。在传输窗口期内，公司仍需要能够访问和更新这些数据。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores data in PDF format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must follow a legal requirement to retain all new and existing data in Amazon S3 for 7 years. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Turn on the S3 Versioning feature for the S3 bucket. Configure S3 Lifecycle to delete the data after 7 years. Configure multi-factor authentication (MFA) delete for all S3 objects.
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶开启 S3 版本控制功能。配置 S3 生命周期在 7 年后删除数据。为所有 S3 对象配置多重身份验证 (MFA) 删除。

options.text_en: Turn on S3 Object Lock with governance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶开启治理模式 (governance mode) 的 S3 对象锁定。把保留期设为 7 年后到期。重新复制所有现有对象，使既有数据也纳入合规。

options.text_en: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶开启合规模式 (compliance mode) 的 S3 对象锁定。把保留期设为 7 年后到期。重新复制所有现有对象，使既有数据也纳入合规。

options.text_en: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Use S3 Batch Operations to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶开启合规模式 (compliance mode) 的 S3 对象锁定。把保留期设为 7 年后到期。用 S3 批量操作让既有数据纳入合规。

stem_zh:
某公司以 PDF 格式将数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司必须遵守一项法律要求，将 Amazon S3 中所有新数据和现有数据保留 7 年。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a stateless web application that runs on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions to provide Regional failover capabilities. What should a solutions architect do to route traffic to multiple Regions?

options.text_en: Create Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region. Use an active-active failover configuration.
options.text_zh: 为每个区域创建 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查。采用主动-主动故障转移配置。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin for each Region. Use CloudFront health checks to route traffic.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，为每个区域各配一个源站。用 CloudFront 运行状况检查来路由流量。

options.text_en: Create a transit gateway. Attach the transit gateway to the API Gateway endpoint in each Region. Configure the transit gateway to route requests.
options.text_zh: 创建一个中转网关。把该中转网关挂接到每个区域的 API Gateway 端点上。配置该中转网关来路由请求。

options.text_en: Create an Application Load Balancer in the primary Region. Set the target group to point to the API Gateway endpoint hostnames in each Region.
options.text_zh: 在主区域创建一个 Application Load Balancer。把目标组设为指向各区域的 API Gateway 端点主机名。

explanation_en: By creating Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region and configuring an active-active failover configuration, Route 53 can monitor the health of the endpoints in each Region and route traffic to healthy endpoints. In the event of a failure in one Region, Route 53 automatically routes traffic to the healthy endpoints in other Regions.
explanation_zh: 通过为每个区域创建 Amazon Route 53 健康检查并配置双活故障转移，Route 53 可以监控每个区域中终端节点的健康状况，并将流量路由到健康的终端节点。当某个区域发生故障时，Route 53 会自动将流量路由到其他区域中健康的终端节点。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个无状态 Web 应用程序，运行在由 Amazon API Gateway 调用的 AWS Lambda 函数上。公司希望跨多个 AWS 区域部署该应用程序，以提供区域故障转移能力。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来将流量路由到多个区域？

stem_en: A company has two VPCs named Management and Production. The Management VPC uses VPNs through a customer gateway to connect to a single device in the data center. The Production VPC uses a virtual private gateway with two attached AWS Direct Connect connections. The Management and Production VPCs both use a single VPC peering connection to allow communication between the applications. What should a solutions architect do to mitigate any single point of failure in this architecture?

options.text_en: Add a set of VPNs between the Management and Production VPCs.
options.text_zh: 在 Management VPC 与 Production VPC 之间再加一组 VPN。

options.text_en: Add a second virtual private gateway and attach it to the Management VPC.
options.text_zh: 再加一个虚拟专用网关，挂接到 Management VPC 上。

options.text_en: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device.
options.text_zh: 从第二台客户网关设备再拉一组 VPN 到 Management VPC。

options.text_en: Add a second VPC peering connection between the Management VPC and the Production VPC.
options.text_zh: 在 Management VPC 与 Production VPC 之间再加一条 VPC 对等连接。

explanation_en: Adding a second set of VPN connections from the Management VPC to a second customer gateway device provides redundancy and eliminates this single point of failure.
explanation_zh: 从 Management VPC 向第二台客户网关设备添加第二组 VPN 连接可提供冗余并消除该单点故障。
stem_zh:
某公司有两个 VPC，分别名为 Management 和 Production。Management VPC 通过一个客户网关使用 VPN 连接到数据中心中的单台设备。Production VPC 使用一个虚拟专用网关，并挂载了两条 AWS Direct Connect 连接。Management 和 Production VPC 都使用单条 VPC 对等连接以允许应用程序之间通信。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来缓解该架构中的任何单点故障？

stem_en: A company runs its application on an Oracle database. The company plans to quickly migrate to AWS because of limited resources for the database, backup administration, and data center maintenance. The application uses third-party database features that require privileged access. Which solution will help the company migrate the database to AWS MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Replace third-party features with cloud services.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。用云服务替换那些第三方功能。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle。定制数据库设置以支持这些第三方功能。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Oracle 的 Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 上。定制数据库设置以支持这些第三方功能。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by rewriting the application code to remove dependency on Oracle APEX.
options.text_zh: 重写应用代码去掉对 Oracle APEX 的依赖，把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL。

stem_zh:
某公司在一个 Oracle 数据库上运行其应用程序。由于在数据库、备份管理和数据中心维护方面资源有限，公司计划尽快迁移到 AWS。该应用程序使用需要特权访问的第三方数据库功能。

哪个方案能帮助公司以最具成本效益的方式将该数据库迁移到 AWS？

stem_en: A company has a three-tier web application that is in a single server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. The company also wants the application to align with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and to be consistent with AWS recommended best practices for security, scalability, and resiliency. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones with the application's existing architecture. Host the application with existing architecture on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in each Availability Zone with EC2 Auto Scaling groups. Secure the EC2 instance with security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs).
options.text_zh: 创建一个跨两个可用区的 VPC，沿用该应用现有架构。在每个可用区的私有子网中用 EC2 Auto Scaling 组的 Amazon EC2 实例承载现有架构的应用。用安全组和网络访问控制列表（网络 ACL）保护这些 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Set up security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs) to control access to the database layer. Set up a single Amazon RDS database in a private subnet.
options.text_zh: 设置安全组和网络访问控制列表（网络 ACL）来控制对数据库层的访问。在私有子网中部署一个单节点 Amazon RDS 数据库。

options.text_en: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones. Refactor the application to host the web tier, application tier, and database tier. Host each tier on its own private subnet with Auto Scaling groups for the web tier and application tier.
options.text_zh: 创建一个跨两个可用区的 VPC。重构该应用，分出 Web 层、应用层和数据库层。每层各放在自己的私有子网中，Web 层和应用层配 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Use a single Amazon RDS database. Allow database access only from the application tier security group.
options.text_zh: 使用单个 Amazon RDS 数据库。只允许来自应用层安全组的数据库访问。

options.text_en: Use Elastic Load Balancers in front of the web tier. Control access by using security groups containing references to each layer's security groups.
options.text_zh: 在 Web 层前面使用弹性负载均衡器。通过引用各层安全组的安全组来控制访问。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon RDS database Multi-AZ cluster deployment in private subnets. Allow database access only from application tier security groups.
options.text_zh: 在私有子网中使用 Amazon RDS 多可用区数据库集群部署。只允许来自应用层安全组的数据库访问。

explanation_en:
This choice aligns with best practices by using separate subnets for each tier, allowing for better security and scalability. Auto Scaling groups provide elasticity and resiliency.

E. Use Elastic Load Balancers in front of the web tier. Control access by using security groups containing references to each layer's security groups.

This option introduces an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) for the web tier, which enhances scalability and resiliency. Using security groups to control access adds an additional layer of security.

F. Use an Amazon RDS database Multi-AZ cluster deployment in private subnets. Allow database access only from application tier security groups.

This option leverages Amazon RDS for the database tier, utilizing Multi-AZ for high availability. Placing the RDS database in private subnets and restricting access to the application tier security groups enhances security.
explanation_zh:
该选项通过为每一层使用独立子网符合最佳实践，从而带来更好的安全性和可扩展性。Auto Scaling 组则提供弹性和韧性。

E. 在 Web 层前面使用 Elastic Load Balancer。通过引用各层安全组的安全组来控制访问。

该选项为 Web 层引入了 Elastic Load Balancer（ELB），提升了可扩展性和韧性。使用安全组控制访问增加了一层额外的安全防护。

F. 在私有子网中使用 Amazon RDS 数据库多可用区集群部署。只允许来自应用层安全组的数据库访问。

该选项在数据库层利用 Amazon RDS，并使用多可用区实现高可用性。将 RDS 数据库置于私有子网中并将访问限制为应用层安全组，增强了安全性。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个位于单台服务器上的三层 Web 应用程序。公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 AWS 云。公司还希望该应用程序符合 AWS Well-Architected Framework，并与 AWS 在安全性、可扩展性和韧性方面推荐的最佳实践保持一致。

哪些方案组合能满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company is migrating its applications and databases to the AWS Cloud. The company will use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), AWS Direct Connect, and Amazon RDS. Which activities will be managed by the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Management of the Amazon RDS infrastructure layer, operating system, and platforms
options.text_zh: 管理 Amazon RDS 的基础设施层、操作系统和平台

options.text_en: Creation of an Amazon RDS DB instance and configuring the scheduled maintenance window
options.text_zh: 创建 Amazon RDS 数据库实例并配置计划维护窗口

options.text_en: Configuration of additional software components on Amazon ECS for monitoring, patch management, log management, and host intrusion detection
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon ECS 上配置用于监控、补丁管理、日志管理和主机入侵检测的附加软件组件

options.text_en: Installation of patches for all minor and major database versions for Amazon RDS
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon RDS 的所有小版本和大版本数据库安装补丁

options.text_en: Ensure the physical security of the Amazon RDS infrastructure in the data center
options.text_zh: 确保数据中心内 Amazon RDS 基础设施的物理安全

options.text_en: Encryption of the data that moves in transit through Direct Connect
options.text_zh: 对经由 Direct Connect 传输中的数据进行加密

explanation_en:
The company's operational team is responsible for configuring additional software components on Amazon ECS, such as monitoring tools, patch management tools, log management systems, and host intrusion detection systems. These components are often specific to the company's requirements and policies.

B. Creation of an Amazon RDS DB instance and configuring the scheduled maintenance window:

The operational team is responsible for creating Amazon RDS DB instances, configuring parameters, and setting up maintenance windows based on the company's operational needs. This includes decisions about the size and type of the RDS instance, storage configuration, and other relevant settings.

F. Encryption of the data that moves in transit through Direct Connect:

While AWS manages the physical infrastructure of Direct Connect, the company's operational team is responsible for configuring encryption for the data in transit over Direct Connect. This includes implementing encryption protocols and ensuring the security of data while it travels between the on-premises data center and AWS.
explanation_zh:
公司的运维团队负责在 Amazon ECS 上配置附加软件组件，例如监控工具、补丁管理工具、日志管理系统和主机入侵检测系统。这些组件通常取决于公司自身的需求和策略。

B. 创建 Amazon RDS 数据库实例并配置计划维护时段：

运维团队负责创建 Amazon RDS 数据库实例、配置参数，并根据公司运维需求设置维护时段。这包括对 RDS 实例规格与类型、存储配置及其他相关设置的决策。

F. 加密通过 Direct Connect 传输中的数据：

虽然 AWS 管理 Direct Connect 的物理基础设施，但公司的运维团队负责为通过 Direct Connect 传输中的数据配置加密。这包括实施加密协议，并确保数据在本地数据中心与 AWS 之间传输时的安全性。
stem_zh:
某公司正在将其应用程序和数据库迁移到 AWS 云。公司将使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）、AWS Direct Connect 和 Amazon RDS。

哪些活动将由公司的运维团队负责管理？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company runs a Java-based job on an Amazon EC2 instance. The job runs every hour and takes 10 seconds to run. The job runs on a scheduled interval and consumes 1 GB of memory. The CPU utilization of the instance is low except for short surges during which the job uses the maximum CPU available. The company wants to optimize the costs to run the job. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS App2Container (A2C) to containerize the job. Run the job as an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task on AWS Fargate with 0.5 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 1 GB of memory.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 把该作业容器化。以 0.5 个虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 和 1 GB 内存，在 AWS Fargate 上把该作业作为 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务运行。

options.text_en: Copy the code into an AWS Lambda function that has 1 GB of memory. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to run the code each hour.
options.text_zh: 把代码搬进一个 1 GB 内存的 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，每小时运行一次该代码。

options.text_en: Use AWS App2Container (A2C) to containerize the job. Install the container in the existing Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Ensure that the schedule stops the container when the task finishes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 把该作业容器化。把容器装进现有的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。确保计划任务在作业结束时停止该容器。

options.text_en: Configure the existing schedule to stop the EC2 instance at the completion of the job and restart the EC2 instance when the next job starts.
options.text_zh: 调整现有计划任务，在作业完成时停止该 EC2 实例，并在下一次作业开始时重新启动它。

explanation_en:
AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that allows you to run code without provisioning or managing servers. It automatically scales based on the number of requests, making it cost-effective for sporadic workloads.
Scheduled Rule with Amazon EventBridge:

Amazon EventBridge allows you to schedule events at specified intervals. By creating a scheduled rule, you can trigger the Lambda function to run the Java-based job every hour.
explanation_zh:
AWS Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，让你无需预置或管理服务器即可运行代码。它会根据请求数量自动伸缩，因此对零星工作负载具有成本效益。
使用 Amazon EventBridge 的定时规则：

Amazon EventBridge 允许你按指定间隔调度事件。通过创建定时规则，你可以每小时触发该 Lambda 函数运行这个基于 Java 的作业。
stem_zh:
某公司在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个基于 Java 的作业。该作业每小时运行一次，运行耗时 10 秒。该作业按计划间隔运行，占用 1 GB 内存。除了作业运行期间会短暂占满可用 CPU 的峰值外，该实例的 CPU 利用率很低。公司希望优化运行该作业的成本。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to implement a backup strategy for Amazon EC2 data and multiple Amazon S3 buckets. Because of regulatory requirements, the company must retain backup files for a specific time period. The company must not alter the files for the duration of the retention period. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in governance mode. Create the required backup plan.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个开启了治理模式 (governance mode) 保管库锁定的备份保管库。创建所需的备份计划。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create the required automated snapshot policy.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 创建所需的自动快照策略。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway to create the backup. Configure the appropriate S3 Lifecycle management.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 File Gateway 创建备份。配置相应的 S3 生命周期管理。

options.text_en: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode. Create the required backup plan.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个开启了合规模式 (compliance mode) 保管库锁定的备份保管库。创建所需的备份计划。

explanation_en: AWS Backup provides a centralized solution for managing backups across various AWS services, including Amazon EC2. By creating a backup vault with a vault lock in compliance mode, the company ensures that the backup files are retained and cannot be altered for the duration of the retention period. Compliance mode is designed to meet regulatory requirements for data retention.
explanation_zh: AWS Backup 提供跨多种 AWS 服务（包括 Amazon EC2）集中管理备份的方案。通过创建带合规模式保管库锁定的备份保管库，公司可确保备份文件在保留期内被保留且无法被更改。合规模式专为满足数据保留的监管要求而设计。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为 Amazon EC2 数据和多个 Amazon S3 存储桶实施备份策略。出于监管要求，公司必须将备份文件保留特定的时间段。在保留期内，公司不得更改这些文件。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A newly hired solutions architect discovers a previous employee did not provide details about the resources inventory. The solutions architect needs to build and map the relationship details of the various workloads across all accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from the detailed view report.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Systems Manager Inventory 从详细视图报告生成地图视图。

options.text_en: Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Build architecture diagrams of the workloads manually.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Step Functions 收集工作负载详情，再手工绘制这些工作负载的架构图。

options.text_en: Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
options.text_zh: 使用 Workload Discovery on AWS 生成这些工作负载的架构图。

options.text_en: Use AWS X-Ray to view the workload details. Build architecture diagrams with relationships.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS X-Ray 查看工作负载详情，据此绘制带依赖关系的架构图。

explanation_en: AWS has a service called AWS Well-Architected Tool, which includes Workload Discovery. Workload Discovery automatically discovers and visualizes the architecture of your workloads. It provides architecture diagrams, best practice recommendations, and insights into your workloads.
explanation_zh: AWS 有一项名为 AWS Well-Architected Tool 的服务，其中包含 Workload Discovery。Workload Discovery 会自动发现并可视化你的工作负载架构。它提供架构图、最佳实践建议以及对工作负载的洞察。
stem_zh:
某公司在多个 AWS 区域和账户中拥有资源。一位新入职的解决方案架构师发现前一位员工没有提供关于资源清单的详细信息。解决方案架构师需要梳理并绘制出所有账户中各种工作负载的关系细节。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses AWS Organizations. The company wants to operate some of its AWS accounts with different budgets. The company wants to receive alerts and automatically prevent provisioning of additional resources on AWS accounts when the allocated budget threshold is met during a specific period. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Cost and Usage Reports section of the required AWS accounts.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Budgets 创建预算。在所需 AWS 账户的「成本与使用情况报告」板块中设置预算金额。

options.text_en: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Billing dashboards of the required AWS accounts.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Budgets 创建预算。在所需 AWS 账户的账单控制面板中设置预算金额。

options.text_en: Create an IAM user for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.text_zh: 为 AWS Budgets 创建一个 IAM 用户，赋予其执行预算操作所需的权限。

options.text_en: Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.text_zh: 为 AWS Budgets 创建一个 IAM 角色，赋予其执行预算操作所需的权限。

options.text_en: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate config rule to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
options.text_zh: 添加告警，在各账户达到预算阈值时通知公司。添加预算操作，选用配了相应 config 规则的那个 IAM 身份，以阻止继续预置额外资源。

options.text_en: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
options.text_zh: 添加告警，在各账户达到预算阈值时通知公司。添加预算操作，选用配了相应服务控制策略 (SCP) 的那个 IAM 身份，以阻止继续预置额外资源。

explanation_en:
D. Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.

F. Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
explanation_zh:
D. 为 AWS Budgets 创建一个 IAM 角色，赋予其执行预算操作所需的权限。

F. 添加一条告警，在每个账户达到其预算阈值时通知公司。添加一个预算操作，选择带有相应服务控制策略（SCP）的已创建 IAM 身份，以阻止预置额外资源。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS Organizations。公司希望以不同的预算运营其部分 AWS 账户。公司希望在特定期间内达到分配的预算阈值时收到告警，并自动阻止在这些 AWS 账户上预置额外资源。

哪些方案组合能满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company runs applications on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region. The company wants to back up the EC2 instances to a second Region. The company also wants to provision EC2 resources in the second Region and manage the EC2 instances centrally from one AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Create a disaster recovery (DR) plan that has a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Configure data replication.
options.text_zh: 制定一个灾难恢复 (DR) 方案，在第二个区域部署数量相当的 EC2 实例，并配置数据复制。

options.text_en: Create point-in-time Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots of the EC2 instances. Copy the snapshots to the second Region periodically.
options.text_zh: 为这些 EC2 实例创建时间点 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照，并定期把快照复制到第二个区域。

options.text_en: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup. Configure cross-Region backup to the second Region for the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份计划。为这些 EC2 实例配置到第二个区域的跨区域备份。

options.text_en: Deploy a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data from the source Region to the second Region.
options.text_zh: 在第二个区域部署数量相当的 EC2 实例。用 AWS DataSync 把数据从源区域传输到第二个区域。

explanation_en: AWS Backup is a centralized backup service that allows you to create backup plans for various AWS resources, including EC2 instances. With AWS Backup, you can configure cross-Region backups, meaning you can replicate backups from one AWS Region to another. This provides a cost-effective and centralized solution for backup.
explanation_zh: AWS Backup 是一项集中式备份服务，允许你为包括 EC2 实例在内的各种 AWS 资源创建备份计划。使用 AWS Backup，你可以配置跨区域备份，即将备份从一个 AWS 区域复制到另一个区域。这为备份提供了一个具有成本效益的集中式方案。
stem_zh:
某公司在一个 AWS 区域的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行应用程序。公司希望将这些 EC2 实例备份到第二个区域。公司还希望在第二个区域预置 EC2 资源，并从一个 AWS 账户集中管理这些 EC2 实例。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company that uses AWS is building an application to transfer data to a product manufacturer. The company has its own identity provider (IdP). The company wants the IdP to authenticate application users while the users use the application to transfer data. The company must use Applicability Statement 2 (AS2) protocol. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 传输数据。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数做 IdP 身份验证。

options.text_en: Use Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task for IdP authentication.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon AppFlow 流来传输数据。创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务做 IdP 身份验证。

options.text_en: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Transfer Family 传输数据。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数做 IdP 身份验证。

options.text_en: Use AWS Storage Gateway to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool for IdP authentication.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Storage Gateway 传输数据。创建一个 Amazon Cognito 身份池做 IdP 身份验证。

explanation_en: AWS Transfer Family (Option C): AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service that allows you to transfer files over the internet using a range of protocols, including AS2. You can integrate AWS Transfer Family with your IdP for user authentication. By using a Lambda function, you can customize the authentication process and integrate it with your own IdP.
explanation_zh: AWS Transfer Family（选项 C）：AWS Transfer Family 是一项全托管服务，允许你使用包括 AS2 在内的多种协议通过互联网传输文件。你可以将 AWS Transfer Family 与你的 IdP 集成以进行用户身份验证。通过使用 Lambda 函数，你可以自定义身份验证流程并将其与自有 IdP 集成。
stem_zh:
某使用 AWS 的公司正在构建一个应用程序，将数据传输给一家产品制造商。该公司拥有自己的身份提供商（IdP）。公司希望在用户使用该应用程序传输数据时由该 IdP 对应用程序用户进行身份验证。公司必须使用适用性声明 2（AS2）协议。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a RESTAPI in Amazon API Gateway for a cash payback service. The application requires 1 GB of memory and 2 GB of storage for its computation resources. The application will require that the data is in a relational format. Which additional combination ofAWS services will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Amazon EC2
options.text_zh: Amazon EC2

options.text_en: AWS Lambda
options.text_zh: AWS Lambda

options.text_en: Amazon RDS
options.text_zh: Amazon RDS

options.text_en: Amazon DynamoDB
options.text_zh: Amazon DynamoDB

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS)
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)

explanation_en:
AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that automatically scales based on the number of requests and executes your code without requiring you to provision or manage servers. It's event-driven, and you pay only for the compute time consumed. For a REST API, Lambda can be a low-administration solution compared to managing infrastructure directly.

Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) is a fully managed relational database service that simplifies database administration tasks. It provides options for popular database engines like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server. You can easily provision, scale, and manage a relational database without dealing with the underlying infrastructure.
explanation_zh:
AWS Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，会根据请求数量自动伸缩并执行你的代码，无需你预置或管理服务器。它是事件驱动的，你只需为消耗的计算时间付费。对于 REST API 来说，相比直接管理基础设施，Lambda 是一种管理负担较低的方案。

Amazon RDS（关系数据库服务）是一项全托管的关系数据库服务，可简化数据库管理任务。它支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle 和 Microsoft SQL Server 等主流数据库引擎。你可以轻松预置、扩展和管理关系数据库，而无需处理底层基础设施。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在 Amazon API Gateway 中为一项现金返还服务设计 REST API。该应用程序的计算资源需要 1 GB 内存和 2 GB 存储。该应用程序将要求数据采用关系型格式。

哪些额外的 AWS 服务组合能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company uses AWS Organizations to run workloads within multiple AWS accounts. A tagging policy adds department tags to AWS resources when the company creates tags. An accounting team needs to determine spending on Amazon EC2 consumption. The accounting team must determine which departments are responsible for the costs regardless ofAWS account. The accounting team has access to AWS Cost Explorer for all AWS accounts within the organization and needs to access all reports from Cost Explorer. Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Organizations 管理账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为 department 的用户自定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一份按标签名分组、按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。

options.text_en: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Organizations 管理账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为 department 的 AWS 预定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一份按标签名分组、按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。

options.text_en: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by the tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Organizations 成员账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为 department 的用户自定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一份按标签名分组、按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。

options.text_en: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.text_zh: 在 Organizations 成员账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为 department 的 AWS 预定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一份按标签名分组、按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。

explanation_en: While AWS provides AWS-defined tags, the use of a user-defined tag provides flexibility in terms of naming and tagging conventions. Activating the tag at the Organizations management account level ensures that the tag is applied to resources across all member accounts.
explanation_zh: 虽然 AWS 提供了 AWS 定义的标签，但使用用户自定义标签在命名和打标签约定方面提供了灵活性。在 Organizations 管理账户级别激活该标签可确保该标签应用于所有成员账户中的资源。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS Organizations 在多个 AWS 账户中运行工作负载。一条标签策略会在公司创建标签时为 AWS 资源添加部门标签。

某会计团队需要确定 Amazon EC2 消费的支出。该会计团队必须确定哪些部门应对这些成本负责，而不论其所属 AWS 账户。该会计团队可以访问组织内所有 AWS 账户的 AWS Cost Explorer，并需要访问 Cost Explorer 中的所有报告。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to securely exchange data between its software as a service (SaaS) application Salesforce account and Amazon S3. The company must encrypt the data at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys (CMKs). The company must also encrypt the data in transit. The company has enabled API access for the Salesforce account.

options.text_en: Create AWS Lambda functions to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数，把数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Define the task to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Step Functions 工作流。定义任务把数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 创建 Amazon AppFlow 流，把数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Create a custom connector for Salesforce to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 为 Salesforce 开发一个自定义连接器，把数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。

explanation_en: Amazon AppFlow is a fully managed integration service that allows you to securely transfer data between AWS services and SaaS applications like Salesforce. It supports data encryption both in transit and at rest. With AppFlow, you can configure the integration flow, including source (Salesforce) and destination (Amazon S3), and set up encryption options. It simplifies the data transfer process and can handle the encryption requirements without the need for custom development.
explanation_zh: Amazon AppFlow 是一项全托管集成服务，允许你在 AWS 服务与 Salesforce 等 SaaS 应用程序之间安全地传输数据。它同时支持传输中和静态时的数据加密。使用 AppFlow，你可以配置集成流（包括源端 Salesforce 和目标端 Amazon S3）并设置加密选项。它简化了数据传输过程，并且无需自定义开发即可满足加密要求。
stem_zh: 某公司希望在其软件即服务 (SaaS) 应用 Salesforce 账户与 Amazon S3 之间安全地交换数据。该公司必须使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥 (CMK) 对静态数据加密，同时还必须对传输中的数据加密。该公司已为该 Salesforce 账户启用了 API 访问。

stem_en: A company is developing a mobile gaming app in a single AWS Region. The app runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The company stores the app data in Amazon DynamoDB. The app communicates by using TCP traffic and UDP traffic between the users and the servers. The application will be used globally. The company wants to ensure the lowest possible latency for all users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器。在使用 Global Accelerator 集成的加速器端点之后创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，侦听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新该 Auto Scaling 组，把实例注册到该 ALB。

options.text_en: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器。在使用 Global Accelerator 集成的加速器端点之后创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，侦听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新该 Auto Scaling 组，把实例注册到该 NLB。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB. Update CloudFront to use the NLB as the origin.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 内容分发网络 (CDN) 端点。在该端点之后创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，侦听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新该 Auto Scaling 组，把实例注册到该 NLB。更新 CloudFront，把该 NLB 用作源站。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB. Update CloudFront to use the ALB as the origin.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 内容分发网络 (CDN) 端点。在该端点之后创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，侦听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新该 Auto Scaling 组，把实例注册到该 ALB。更新 CloudFront，把该 ALB 用作源站。

stem_zh:
某公司正在单个 AWS 区域中开发一款移动游戏应用。该应用运行在一个 Auto Scaling 组中的多台 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司将应用数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。该应用在用户与服务器之间使用 TCP 流量和 UDP 流量通信。该应用将面向全球使用。公司希望确保所有用户的延迟尽可能低。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an application that processes customer orders. The company hosts the application on an Amazon EC2 instance that saves the orders to an Amazon Aurora database. Occasionally when traffic is high the workload does not process orders fast enough. What should a solutions architect do to write the orders reliably to the database as quickly as possible?

options.text_en: Increase the instance size of the EC2 instance when traffic is high. Write orders to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Subscribe the database endpoint to the SNS topic.
options.text_zh: 流量高时把该 EC2 实例规格调大。把订单写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)，让数据库端点订阅该 SNS 主题。

options.text_en: Write orders to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SQS queue and process orders into the database.
options.text_zh: 把订单写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。用 Application Load Balancer 之后 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例从该 SQS 队列读取消息，把订单处理入库。

options.text_en: Write orders to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Subscribe the database endpoint to the SNS topic. Use EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SNS topic.
options.text_zh: 把订单写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)，让数据库端点订阅该 SNS 主题。用 Application Load Balancer 之后 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例从该 SNS 主题读取消息。

options.text_en: Write orders to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when the EC2 instance reaches CPU threshold limits. Use scheduled scaling of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SQS queue and process orders into the database.
options.text_zh: 当该 EC2 实例达到 CPU 阈值时把订单写入一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。用 Application Load Balancer 之后 Auto Scaling 组中按计划伸缩的 EC2 实例从该 SQS 队列读取消息，把订单处理入库。

explanation_en:
Amazon SQS, which is a fully managed message queuing service. Writing orders to an SQS queue allows for decoupling the EC2 instances processing the orders from the application writing the orders. EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group can then read from the SQS queue, ensuring that the processing scales with demand.

Using an Auto Scaling group ensures that you can dynamically adjust the number of EC2 instances based on the workload. This can help handle high traffic efficiently.
explanation_zh:
Amazon SQS 是一项全托管的消息队列服务。将订单写入 SQS 队列可以将处理订单的 EC2 实例与写入订单的应用程序解耦。随后，Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例可以从 SQS 队列读取，从而确保处理能力随需求伸缩。

使用 Auto Scaling 组可确保你能够根据工作负载动态调整 EC2 实例数量，这有助于高效应对高流量。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个处理客户订单的应用程序。公司将该应用程序托管在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例将订单保存到一个 Amazon Aurora 数据库中。偶尔在流量较高时，该工作负载处理订单的速度不够快。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做，才能尽可能快速可靠地将订单写入数据库？

stem_en: An IoT company is releasing a mattress that has sensors to collect data about a user’s sleep. The sensors will send data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The sensors collect approximately 2 MB of data every night for each mattress. The company must process and summarize the data for each mattress. The results need to be available as soon as possible. Data processing will require 1 GB of memory and will finish within 30 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue with a Scala job
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Glue 搭配 Scala 作业。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EMR with an Apache Spark script
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon EMR 搭配 Apache Spark 脚本。

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda with a Python script
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 搭配 Python 脚本。

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue with a PySpark job
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Glue 搭配 PySpark 作业。

explanation_en:
AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that allows you to run code without provisioning or managing servers. It automatically scales with the number of requests, making it well-suited for event-driven workloads like processing data from IoT devices.

Python is a lightweight and efficient language for data processing tasks.

Lambda allows you to execute code in response to events, such as data arriving in the S3 bucket.
explanation_zh:
AWS Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，让你无需预置或管理服务器即可运行代码。它会随请求数量自动伸缩，因此非常适合像处理 IoT 设备数据这样的事件驱动工作负载。

Python 是一种适合数据处理任务的轻量高效语言。

Lambda 允许你响应事件（例如数据到达 S3 存储桶）执行代码。
stem_zh:
某物联网公司即将发布一款带传感器的床垫，用于收集用户的睡眠数据。这些传感器会将数据发送到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。传感器每晚为每张床垫收集约 2 MB 数据。公司必须处理并汇总每张床垫的数据。结果需要尽快可用。数据处理需要 1 GB 内存，并将在 30 秒内完成。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts an online shopping application that stores all orders in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instance. Management wants to eliminate single points of failure and has asked a solutions architect to recommend an approach to minimize database downtime without requiring any changes to the application code. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Convert the existing database instance to a Multi-AZ deployment by modifying the database instance and specifying the Multi-AZ option.
options.text_zh: 修改现有数据库实例并勾选多可用区选项，把它转换为多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Create a new RDS Multi-AZ deployment. Take a snapshot of the current RDS instance and restore the new Multi-AZ deployment with the snapshot.
options.text_zh: 新建一个 RDS 多可用区部署。对当前 RDS 实例做快照，用该快照恢复出新的多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Create a read-only replica of the PostgreSQL database in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted record sets to distribute requests across the databases.
options.text_zh: 在另一个可用区创建该 PostgreSQL 数据库的只读副本。用 Amazon Route 53 加权记录集把请求分发到各数据库。

options.text_en: Place the RDS for PostgreSQL database in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with a minimum group size of two. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted record sets to distribute requests across instances.
options.text_zh: 把该 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库放进一个最小组规模为 2 的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组。用 Amazon Route 53 加权记录集把请求分发到各实例。

explanation_en: By converting the existing RDS instance to a Multi-AZ deployment, you enable high availability with automatic failover. Amazon RDS will automatically replicate the database to a standby instance in a different Availability Zone (AZ). In the event of a failure, Amazon RDS will automatically promote the standby to the primary, minimizing downtime.
explanation_zh: 通过将现有 RDS 实例转换为多可用区部署，你可以实现带自动故障转移的高可用性。Amazon RDS 会自动将数据库复制到另一个可用区（AZ）中的备用实例。发生故障时，Amazon RDS 会自动将备用实例提升为主实例，从而最大限度减少停机时间。
stem_zh:
某公司托管一个在线购物应用程序，将所有订单存储在一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 单可用区数据库实例中。管理层希望消除单点故障，并请一位解决方案架构师推荐一种在无需更改任何应用程序代码的前提下最大限度减少数据库停机时间的方法。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is developing an application to support customer demands. The company wants to deploy the application on multiple Amazon EC2 Nitro-based instances within the same Availability Zone. The company also wants to give the application the ability to write to multiple block storage volumes in multiple EC2 Nitro-based instances simultaneously to achieve higher application availability. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach
options.text_zh: 使用通用型 SSD (gp3) EBS 卷，搭配 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 多重挂载。

options.text_en: Use Throughput Optimized HDD (st1) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach
options.text_zh: 使用吞吐量优化型 HDD (st1) EBS 卷，搭配 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 多重挂载。

options.text_en: Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach
options.text_zh: 使用预置 IOPS SSD (io2) EBS 卷，搭配 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 多重挂载。

options.text_en: Use General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach
options.text_zh: 使用通用型 SSD (gp2) EBS 卷，搭配 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 多重挂载。

explanation_en: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes do indeed support Multi-Attach, allowing you to attach a single volume to multiple Nitro-based instances in the same Availability Zone. This can be suitable for scenarios where multiple instances need simultaneous access to a shared volume with high performance.
explanation_zh: 预置 IOPS SSD（io2）卷确实支持 Multi-Attach，允许你将单个卷挂载到同一可用区内的多台基于 Nitro 的实例上。这适用于多台实例需要以高性能同时访问共享卷的场景。
stem_zh:
某公司正在开发一个应用程序以支撑客户需求。公司希望将该应用程序部署在同一可用区内的多台基于 Amazon EC2 Nitro 的实例上。公司还希望让该应用程序能够同时向多台基于 EC2 Nitro 的实例中的多个块存储卷写入数据，以获得更高的应用程序可用性。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company designed a stateless two-tier application that uses Amazon EC2 in a single Availability Zone and an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. New company management wants to ensure the application is highly available. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Configure the application to use Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling and create an Application Load Balancer
options.text_zh: 把该应用配置为使用跨可用区的 EC2 Auto Scaling，并创建一个 Application Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Configure the application to take snapshots of the EC2 instances and send them to a different AWS Region
options.text_zh: 把该应用配置为对 EC2 实例做快照，并把快照发送到另一个 AWS 区域。

options.text_en: Configure the application to use Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to feed requests to the application
options.text_zh: 把该应用配置为使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由来把请求送到应用。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Route 53 rules to handle incoming requests and create a Multi-AZ Application Load Balancer
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Route 53 规则来处理传入请求，并创建一个跨可用区的 Application Load Balancer。

stem_zh:
某公司设计了一个无状态两层应用程序，在单个可用区中使用 Amazon EC2，并使用一个 Amazon RDS 多可用区数据库实例。公司新任管理层希望确保该应用程序高可用。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足此要求？

stem_en: A company uses AWS Organizations. A member account has purchased a Compute Savings Plan. Because of changes in the workloads inside the member account, the account no longer receives the full benefit of the Compute Savings Plan commitment. The company uses less than 50% of its purchased compute power.

options.text_en: Turn on discount sharing from the Billing Preferences section of the account console in the member account that purchased the Compute Savings Plan.
options.text_zh: 在购买了该计算类节省计划的成员账户的账户控制台「账单首选项」板块中开启折扣共享。

options.text_en: Turn on discount sharing from the Billing Preferences section of the account console in the company's Organizations management account.
options.text_zh: 在该公司 Organizations 管理账户的账户控制台「账单首选项」板块中开启折扣共享。

options.text_en: Migrate additional compute workloads from another AWS account to the account that has the Compute Savings Plan.
options.text_zh: 把其他 AWS 账户中的更多计算负载迁移到持有该计算类节省计划的账户中。

options.text_en: Sell the excess Savings Plan commitment in the Reserved Instance Marketplace.
options.text_zh: 在预留实例市场上把用不完的节省计划承诺额卖掉。

stem_zh: 某公司使用 AWS Organizations。一个成员账户购买了计算类节省计划。由于该成员账户内工作负载发生变化，该账户已无法充分享受这份计算类节省计划承诺额带来的优惠。该公司使用的算力不到已购买量的 50%。

stem_en: A company is developing a microservices application that will provide a search catalog for customers. The company must use REST APIs to present the frontend of the application to users. The REST APIs must access the backend services that the company hosts in containers in private VPC subnets. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个 WebSocket API。把应用托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。创建一个私有 VPC 链接供 API Gateway 访问 Amazon ECS。

options.text_en: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个 REST API。把应用托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。创建一个私有 VPC 链接供 API Gateway 访问 Amazon ECS。

options.text_en: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个 WebSocket API。把应用托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。创建一个安全组供 API Gateway 访问 Amazon ECS。

options.text_en: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个 REST API。把应用托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。创建一个安全组供 API Gateway 访问 Amazon ECS。

stem_zh:
某公司正在开发一个微服务应用程序，将为客户提供搜索目录。公司必须使用 REST API 向用户呈现该应用程序的前端。这些 REST API 必须访问公司托管在私有 VPC 子网中容器内的后端服务。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores raw collected data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is used for several types of analytics on behalf of the company's customers. The type of analytics requested determines the access pattern on the S3 objects. The company cannot predict or control the access pattern. The company wants to reduce its S3 costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use S3 replication to transition infrequently accessed objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.text_zh: 用 S3 复制把不常访问的对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

options.text_en: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.text_zh: 用 S3 生命周期规则把对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

options.text_en: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.text_zh: 用 S3 生命周期规则把对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

options.text_en: Use S3 Inventory to identify and transition objects that have not been accessed from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.text_zh: 用 S3 清单找出未被访问过的对象，把它们从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

explanation_en:
S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize costs by automatically moving objects between two access tiers: frequent and infrequent access. It is well-suited for scenarios where access patterns are unpredictable.
Using S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects to S3 Intelligent-Tiering allows you to take advantage of automatic cost savings based on actual access patterns without the need for manual adjustments.
explanation_zh:
S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在通过在两个访问层（频繁访问和不频繁访问）之间自动移动对象来优化成本。它非常适合访问模式不可预测的场景。
使用 S3 生命周期规则将对象转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，可让你基于实际访问模式自动获得成本节约，而无需手动调整。
stem_zh:
某公司将采集到的原始数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。这些数据被用于代表公司客户执行多种类型的分析。所请求的分析类型决定了对 S3 对象的访问模式。

公司无法预测或控制访问模式。公司希望降低其 S3 成本。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has applications hosted on Amazon EC2 instances with IPv6 addresses. The applications must initiate communications with other external applications using the internet. However the company’s security policy states that any external service cannot initiate a connection to the EC2 instances. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.text_en: Create a NAT gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.text_zh: 创建一个 NAT 网关，并把它设为该子网路由表的目标。

options.text_en: Create an internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.text_zh: 创建一个互联网网关，并把它设为该子网路由表的目标。

options.text_en: Create a virtual private gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.text_zh: 创建一个虚拟专用网关，并把它设为该子网路由表的目标。

options.text_en: Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.text_zh: 创建一个仅出口互联网网关，并把它设为该子网路由表的目标。

explanation_en:
An egress-only internet gateway is used for IPv6 traffic leaving the VPC to reach the internet. It allows outbound communication initiated by resources inside the VPC but prevents incoming traffic initiated from the internet.
Configuring the subnet's route table to use the egress-only internet gateway as the destination ensures that IPv6 traffic initiated from EC2 instances can reach external services while blocking unsolicited incoming traffic.
explanation_zh:
仅出口互联网网关用于让离开 VPC 的 IPv6 流量到达互联网。它允许由 VPC 内部资源发起的出站通信，但阻止从互联网发起的传入流量。
将子网的路由表配置为以该仅出口互联网网关为目标，可确保由 EC2 实例发起的 IPv6 流量能够到达外部服务，同时阻止未经请求的传入流量。
stem_zh:
某公司在带有 IPv6 地址的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管应用程序。这些应用程序必须通过互联网向其他外部应用程序发起通信。但公司的安全策略规定，任何外部服务都不能向这些 EC2 实例发起连接。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么来解决此问题？

stem_en: A company is creating an application that runs on containers in a VPC. The application stores and accesses data in an Amazon S3 bucket. During the development phase, the application will store and access 1 TB of data in Amazon S3 each day. The company wants to minimize costs and wants to prevent traffic from traversing the internet whenever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering for the S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶启用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

options.text_en: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration for the S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。

options.text_en: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个网关 VPC 端点，并把该端点关联到该 VPC 的所有路由表。

options.text_en: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC
options.text_zh: 在该 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个接口端点，并把该端点关联到该 VPC 的所有路由表。

explanation_en: Gateway VPC Endpoint: A gateway VPC endpoint enables private connectivity between a VPC and Amazon S3. It allows direct access to Amazon S3 without the need for internet gateways, NAT devices, VPN connections, or AWS Direct Connect.
explanation_zh: 网关型 VPC 终端节点：网关型 VPC 终端节点可在 VPC 与 Amazon S3 之间实现私有连接。它允许直接访问 Amazon S3，无需互联网网关、NAT 设备、VPN 连接或 AWS Direct Connect。
stem_zh:
某公司正在创建一个运行在 VPC 内容器中的应用程序。该应用程序在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中存储和访问数据。在开发阶段，该应用程序每天将在 Amazon S3 中存储和访问 1 TB 数据。公司希望最大限度降低成本，并尽可能避免流量经由互联网传输。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a mobile chat application with a data store based in Amazon DynamoDB. Users would like new messages to be read with as little latency as possible. A solutions architect needs to design an optimal solution that requires minimal application changes. Which method should the solutions architect select?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for the new messages table. Update the code to use the DAX endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为新消息表配置 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。更新代码改用 DAX 端点。

options.text_en: Add DynamoDB read replicas to handle the increased read load. Update the application to point to the read endpoint for the read replicas.
options.text_zh: 添加 DynamoDB 只读副本来承担增加的读取负载。更新应用指向这些只读副本的读取端点。

options.text_en: Double the number of read capacity units for the new messages table in DynamoDB. Continue to use the existing DynamoDB endpoint.
options.text_zh: 把 DynamoDB 中新消息表的读取容量单位翻倍。继续使用现有的 DynamoDB 端点。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache to the application stack. Update the application to point to the Redis cache endpoint instead of DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 在应用技术栈中加入 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 缓存。更新应用，让它指向 Redis 缓存端点而不是 DynamoDB。

explanation_en: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is an in-memory caching service for DynamoDB that helps improve the read performance of DynamoDB tables.A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content. Website traffic is increasing, and the company is concerned about a potential increase in cost.
explanation_zh: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator（DAX）是面向 DynamoDB 的内存缓存服务，有助于提升 DynamoDB 表的读取性能。某公司在一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个网站。该网站提供静态内容。网站流量正在增长，公司担心成本可能上升。
stem_zh:
某公司有一款移动聊天应用，其数据存储基于 Amazon DynamoDB。用户希望以尽可能低的延迟读取新消息。解决方案架构师需要设计一个最优方案，且所需的应用程序改动最少。

解决方案架构师应选择哪种方法？

stem_en: A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content. Website traffic is increasing, and the company is concerned about a potential increase in cost.

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to cache state files at edge locations
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，在边缘站点缓存这些静态文件。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Connect the ALB to the ElastiCache cluster to serve cached files
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。把该 ALB 连到该 ElastiCache 集群来提供缓存文件。

options.text_en: Create an AWS WAF web ACL and associate it with the ALB. Add a rule to the web ACL to cache static files
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS WAF Web ACL 并关联到该 ALB。在该 Web ACL 中添加一条缓存静态文件的规则。

options.text_en: Create a second ALB in an alternative AWS Region. Route user traffic to the closest Region to minimize data transfer costs
options.text_zh: 在另一个 AWS 区域再建一个 ALB。把用户流量路由到最近的区域，以尽量降低数据传输成本。

explanation_en:
By creating a CloudFront distribution and configuring it to cache static files, you can offload the delivery of static content to the CDN, reducing the load on the ALB and potentially lowering data transfer costs.
CloudFront helps improve website performance and can be cost-effective due to its caching mechanism.
explanation_zh:
通过创建 CloudFront 分配并将其配置为缓存静态文件，你可以将静态内容的分发卸载给 CDN，减轻 ALB 的负载并有可能降低数据传输成本。
CloudFront 有助于提升网站性能，且由于其缓存机制而具有成本效益。
stem_zh: 某公司在一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个网站。该网站提供静态内容。网站流量正在增长，该公司担心成本随之上升。

stem_en: A company has multiple VPCs across AWS Regions to support and run workloads that are isolated from workloads in other Regions. Because of a recent application launch requirement, the company’s VPCs must communicate with all other VPCs across all Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?

options.text_en: Use VPC peering to manage VPC communication in a single Region. Use VPC peering across Regions to manage VPC communications.
options.text_zh: 在单个区域内用 VPC 对等连接来管理 VPC 间通信，跨区域也用 VPC 对等连接来管理 VPC 间通信。

options.text_en: Use AWS Direct Connect gateways across all Regions to connect VPCs across regions and manage VPC communications.
options.text_zh: 在所有区域使用 AWS Direct Connect 网关来连接跨区域的 VPC 并管理 VPC 间通信。

options.text_en: Use AWS Transit Gateway to manage VPC communication in a single Region and Transit Gateway peering across Regions to manage VPC communications.
options.text_zh: 在单个区域内用 AWS Transit Gateway 管理 VPC 间通信，跨区域用中转网关对等连接来管理 VPC 间通信。

options.text_en: Use AWS PrivateLink across all Regions to connect VPCs across Regions and manage VPC communications
options.text_zh: 在所有区域使用 AWS PrivateLink 来连接跨区域的 VPC 并管理 VPC 间通信。

explanation_en:
AWS Transit Gateway is designed for simplifying the connectivity between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks. It allows for hub-and-spoke connectivity patterns, making it easier to manage communication across multiple VPCs.
By using AWS Transit Gateway in a single Region to connect VPCs and enabling Transit Gateway peering across Regions, you can efficiently manage communication between VPCs in different Regions with centralized control and minimal administrative effort.
explanation_zh:
AWS Transit Gateway 旨在简化多个 VPC 与本地网络之间的连接。它支持中心辐射型（hub-and-spoke）连接模式，使跨多个 VPC 的通信管理更加容易。
通过在单个区域内使用 AWS Transit Gateway 连接各 VPC，并启用跨区域的 Transit Gateway 对等连接，你可以以集中的控制和极少的管理工作量高效管理不同区域中 VPC 之间的通信。
stem_zh:
某公司在多个 AWS 区域拥有多个 VPC，用于支持和运行与其他区域工作负载相隔离的工作负载。由于最近一次应用程序发布的要求，公司的各 VPC 必须能够与所有区域中的所有其他 VPC 通信。

哪个方案能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing a containerized application that will use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The application needs to access a shared file system that is highly durable and can recover data to another AWS Region with a recovery point objective (RPO) of 8 hours. The file system needs to provide a mount target m each Availability Zone within a Region. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Backup to manage the replication to another Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ deployment
options.text_zh: 采用多可用区部署的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

options.text_en: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with a Multi-AZ deployment
options.text_zh: 采用多可用区部署的 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with the Standard storage class
options.text_zh: 使用 Standard 存储类的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

options.text_en: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS
options.text_zh: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS

stem_zh:
某公司正在设计一个将使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）的容器化应用程序。该应用程序需要访问一个高度持久的共享文件系统，并且能够以 8 小时的恢复点目标（RPO）将数据恢复到另一个 AWS 区域。该文件系统需要在区域内的每个可用区提供一个挂载目标。

一位解决方案架构师希望使用 AWS Backup 来管理到另一个区域的复制。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is expecting rapid growth in the near future. A solutions architect needs to configure existing users and grant permissions to new users on AWS. The solutions architect has decided to create IAM groups. The solutions architect will add the new users to IAM groups based on department. Which additional action is the MOST secure way to grant permissions to the new users?

options.text_en: Apply service control policies (SCPs) to manage access permissions
options.text_zh: 用服务控制策略 (SCP) 来管理访问权限。

options.text_en: Create IAM roles that have least privilege permission. Attach the roles to the IAM groups
options.text_zh: 创建遵循最小权限原则的 IAM 角色，把这些角色附加到 IAM 组上。

options.text_en: Create an IAM policy that grants least privilege permission. Attach the policy to the IAM groups
options.text_zh: 创建一条遵循最小权限原则的 IAM 策略，把该策略附加到 IAM 组上。

options.text_en: Create IAM roles. Associate the roles with a permissions boundary that defines the maximum permissions
options.text_zh: 创建 IAM 角色，并给这些角色关联一个定义最大权限范围的权限边界。

explanation_en: Creating an IAM policy that grants the least privilege required for the users' tasks is a security best practice. By attaching this policy to IAM groups, you ensure that new users added to these groups inherit the specific permissions defined in the policy.
explanation_zh: 创建一条只授予用户任务所需最小权限的 IAM 策略是一项安全最佳实践。通过将该策略附加到 IAM 组，你可以确保加入这些组的新用户继承该策略中定义的特定权限。
stem_zh:
某公司预计近期会快速增长。解决方案架构师需要在 AWS 上配置现有用户并为新用户授予权限。解决方案架构师已决定创建 IAM 组，并将根据部门把新用户加入相应的 IAM 组。

哪项额外操作是为新用户授予权限的最安全方式？

stem_en: A group requires permissions to list an Amazon S3 bucket and delete objects from that bucket. An administrator has created the following IAM policy to provide access to the bucket and applied that policy to the group. The group is not able to delete objects in the bucket. The company follows least-privilege access rules. Which statement should a solutions architect add to the policy to correct bucket access?
stem_zh: 某个组需要有列出某个 Amazon S3 存储桶内容以及删除该存储桶中对象的权限。管理员创建了下面这条 IAM 策略来提供对该存储桶的访问，并把该策略应用到了这个组上。但该组无法删除存储桶中的对象。该公司遵循最小权限访问原则。解决方案架构师应该往这条策略中加入哪条语句来修正存储桶访问？
review_reason: 答案未确定；选项为图片，PDF 中无文字

stem_en: A law firm needs to share information with the public. The information includes hundreds of files that must be publicly readable. Modifications or deletions of the files by anyone before a designated future date are prohibited. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

options.text_en: Upload all files to an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for static website hosting. Grant read-only IAM permissions to any AWS principals that access the S3 bucket until the designated date.
options.text_zh: 把所有文件上传到一个配置为静态网站托管的 Amazon S3 存储桶。在指定日期之前，给所有访问该 S3 存储桶的 AWS 主体授予只读 IAM 权限。

options.text_en: Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Use S3 Object Lock with a retention period in accordance with the designated date. Configure the S3 bucket for static website hosting. Set an S3 bucket policy to allow read-only access to the objects.
options.text_zh: 新建一个启用了 S3 版本控制的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 S3 对象锁定，保留期设为指定日期。把该 S3 存储桶配置为静态网站托管。设置一条 S3 存储桶策略允许对这些对象的只读访问。

options.text_en: Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Configure an event trigger to run an AWS Lambda function in case of object modification or deletion. Configure the Lambda function to replace the objects with the original versions from a private S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 新建一个启用了 S3 版本控制的 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置一个事件触发器，在对象被修改或删除时运行一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数用某个私有 S3 存储桶中的原始版本把对象还原回去。

options.text_en: Upload all files to an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for static website hosting. Select the folder that contains the files. Use S3 Object Lock with a retention period in accordance with the designated date. Grant read-only IAM permissions to any AWS principals that access the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把所有文件上传到一个配置为静态网站托管的 Amazon S3 存储桶。选中包含这些文件的文件夹。使用 S3 对象锁定，保留期设为指定日期。给所有访问该 S3 存储桶的 AWS 主体授予只读 IAM 权限。

explanation_en: S3 Versioning helps maintain multiple versions of an object over time. With S3 Object Lock, you can enforce retention periods during which the objects cannot be modified or deleted. This aligns with the requirement to prohibit modifications or deletions before a designated future date.
explanation_zh: S3 版本控制有助于随时间维护对象的多个版本。使用 S3 Object Lock，你可以强制实施保留期，在此期间对象不能被修改或删除。这与在指定的未来日期之前禁止修改或删除的要求相符。
stem_zh:
某律师事务所需要向公众共享信息。这些信息包括数百个必须可公开读取的文件。在指定的未来日期之前，禁止任何人修改或删除这些文件。

哪个方案能以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is making a prototype of the infrastructure for its new website by manually provisioning the necessary infrastructure. This infrastructure includes an Auto Scaling group, an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon RDS database. After the configuration has been thoroughly validated, the company wants the capability to immediately deploy the infrastructure for development and production use in two Availability Zones in an automated fashion. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Systems Manager to replicate and provision the prototype infrastructure in two Availability Zones
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Systems Manager 把原型基础设施复制并预置到两个可用区。

options.text_en: Define the infrastructure as a template by using the prototype infrastructure as a guide. Deploy the infrastructure with AWS CloudFormation.
options.text_zh: 以原型基础设施为参照，把基础设施定义成模板。用 AWS CloudFormation 部署该基础设施。

options.text_en: Use AWS Config to record the inventory of resources that are used in the prototype infrastructure. Use AWS Config to deploy the prototype infrastructure into two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Config 记录原型基础设施中所用资源的清单。再用 AWS Config 把原型基础设施部署到两个可用区。

options.text_en: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk and configure it to use an automated reference to the prototype infrastructure to automatically deploy new environments in two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk，并把它配置为自动引用原型基础设施，从而在两个可用区自动部署新环境。

explanation_en: AWS CloudFormation is a service specifically designed for defining and deploying AWS infrastructure as code using templates. In this case, you can create a CloudFormation template based on the validated prototype infrastructure, and then use CloudFormation to deploy and manage the infrastructure in an automated and repeatable way.
explanation_zh: AWS CloudFormation 是一项专门用于使用模板以代码方式定义和部署 AWS 基础设施的服务。在此场景中，你可以基于已验证的原型基础设施创建 CloudFormation 模板，然后使用 CloudFormation 以自动化、可重复的方式部署和管理基础设施。
stem_zh:
某公司正在通过手动预置所需基础设施来为其新网站制作基础设施原型。该基础设施包括一个 Auto Scaling 组、一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Amazon RDS 数据库。在配置经过充分验证后，公司希望具备立即以自动化方式在两个可用区中为开发和生产用途部署该基础设施的能力。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A business application is hosted on Amazon EC2 and uses Amazon S3 for encrypted object storage. The chief information security officer has directed that no application traffic between the two services should traverse the public internet. Which capability should the solutions architect use to meet the compliance requirements?

options.text_en: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)
options.text_zh: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)

options.text_en: VPC endpoint
options.text_zh: VPC 端点

options.text_en: Private subnet
options.text_zh: 私有子网

options.text_en: Virtual private gateway
options.text_zh: 虚拟专用网关

explanation_en:
AWS provides VPC endpoints that allow you to privately connect your VPC to supported AWS services, including Amazon S3, without needing to use public IP addresses or traverse the public internet.
With an S3 VPC endpoint, the traffic between your Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon S3 remains within the AWS network, providing a secure and private connection.
explanation_zh:
AWS 提供 VPC 终端节点，允许你将 VPC 私密地连接到受支持的 AWS 服务（包括 Amazon S3），而无需使用公有 IP 地址或经由公共互联网。
使用 S3 VPC 终端节点时，你的 Amazon EC2 实例与 Amazon S3 之间的流量始终保持在 AWS 网络内部，从而提供安全私密的连接。
stem_zh:
某业务应用程序托管在 Amazon EC2 上，并使用 Amazon S3 进行加密对象存储。首席信息安全官已指示，这两项服务之间的任何应用程序流量都不得经由公共互联网传输。

解决方案架构师应使用哪项能力来满足这些合规要求？

stem_en: A company hosts a three-tier web application in the AWS Cloud. A Multi-AZAmazon RDS for MySQL server forms the database layer Amazon ElastiCache forms the cache layer. The company wants a caching strategy that adds or updates data in the cache when a customer adds an item to the database. The data in the cache must always match the data in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Implement the lazy loading caching strategy
options.text_zh: 采用惰性加载 (lazy loading) 缓存策略。

options.text_en: Implement the write-through caching strategy
options.text_zh: 采用直写 (write-through) 缓存策略。

options.text_en: Implement the adding TTL caching strategy
options.text_zh: 采用添加 TTL 的缓存策略。

options.text_en: Implement the AWS AppConfig caching strategy
options.text_zh: 采用 AWS AppConfig 缓存策略。

explanation_en:
In a write-through caching strategy, data is always written or updated in the cache when it is modified in the database. This ensures that the cache is consistently updated with the latest data from the database.
When a customer adds an item to the database, the write-through caching strategy ensures that the item is also added or updated in the cache.
explanation_zh:
在直写式缓存策略中，每当数据在数据库中被修改时，也会同时写入或更新到缓存中。这确保缓存始终与数据库中的最新数据保持一致。
当客户向数据库添加条目时，直写式缓存策略可确保该条目也被添加或更新到缓存中。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 云中托管一个三层 Web 应用程序。一个多可用区的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 服务器构成数据库层，Amazon ElastiCache 构成缓存层。公司希望采用一种缓存策略：当客户向数据库添加条目时，在缓存中添加或更新数据。缓存中的数据必须始终与数据库中的数据一致。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate 100 GB of historical data from an on-premises location to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has a 100 megabits per second (Mbps) internet connection on premises. The company needs to encrypt the data in transit to the S3 bucket. The company will store new data directly in Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use the s3 sync command in the AWS CLI to move the data directly to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CLI 的 s3 sync 命令把数据直接搬到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the on-premises location to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 把数据从本地位置迁移到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Use AWS Snowball to move the data to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Snowball 把数据搬到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Set up an IPsec VPN from the on-premises location to AWS. Use the s3 cp command in the AWS CLI to move the data directly to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 从本地位置到 AWS 建立一条 IPsec VPN。用 AWS CLI 的 s3 cp 命令把数据直接搬到一个 S3 存储桶。

explanation_en:
AWS DataSync is a service designed for efficiently transferring large amounts of data between on-premises storage systems and Amazon S3.
It supports encryption of data in transit, ensuring the security of the data during the migration process.
AWS DataSync is specifically built for data transfer scenarios and minimizes operational overhead, providing an efficient and straightforward solution.
explanation_zh:
AWS DataSync 是一项专为在本地存储系统与 Amazon S3 之间高效传输大量数据而设计的服务。
它支持传输中数据加密，确保迁移过程中数据的安全性。
AWS DataSync 专为数据传输场景而构建，可最大限度降低运维开销，提供高效直接的方案。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将 100 GB 历史数据从本地位置迁移到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司本地有一条 100 兆比特每秒（Mbps）的互联网连接。公司需要对传输到该 S3 存储桶过程中的数据进行加密。公司今后将把新数据直接存储在 Amazon S3 中。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company containerized a Windows job that runs on .NET 6 Framework under a Windows container. The company wants to run this job in the AWS Cloud. The job runs every 10 minutes. The job’s runtime varies between 1 minute and 3 minutes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function based on the container image of the job. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the function every 10 minutes.
options.text_zh: 基于该作业的容器镜像创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Amazon EventBridge 每 10 分钟调用该函数一次。

options.text_en: Use AWS Batch to create a job that uses AWS Fargate resources. Configure the job scheduling to run every 10 minutes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Batch 创建一个使用 AWS Fargate 资源的作业。把作业调度配置为每 10 分钟运行一次。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate to run the job. Create a scheduled task based on the container image of the job to run every 10 minutes.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Fargate 上用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 运行该作业。基于该作业的容器镜像创建一个每 10 分钟运行一次的计划任务。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate to run the job. Create a standalone task based on the container image of the job. Use Windows task scheduler to run the job every 10 minutes.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Fargate 上用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 运行该作业。基于该作业的容器镜像创建一个独立任务。用 Windows 任务计划程序每 10 分钟运行一次该作业。

explanation_en:
Amazon ECS is a fully managed container orchestration service, and AWS Fargate allows you to run containers without managing the underlying infrastructure.
ECS on Fargate is a serverless option, which means you only pay for the vCPU and memory that you use, and it scales automatically to meet the needs of the job.
explanation_zh:
Amazon ECS 是一项全托管的容器编排服务，而 AWS Fargate 让你无需管理底层基础设施即可运行容器。
Fargate 上的 ECS 是一种无服务器选项，这意味着你只需为使用的 vCPU 和内存付费，并且它会自动伸缩以满足作业需求。
stem_zh:
某公司将一个运行在 .NET 6 Framework 上的 Windows 作业容器化为 Windows 容器。公司希望在 AWS 云中运行该作业。该作业每 10 分钟运行一次。作业的运行时长在 1 分钟到 3 分钟之间变化。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to move from many standalone AWS accounts to a consolidated, multi-account architecture. The company plans to create many new AWS accounts for different business units. The company needs to authenticate access to these AWS accounts by using a centralized corporate directory service. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations with all features turned on. Create the new AWS accounts in the organization.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Organizations 中新建一个开启全部功能的组织。在该组织中创建这些新的 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon Cognito identity pool. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to accept Amazon Cognito authentication.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon Cognito 身份池。配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 接受 Amazon Cognito 身份验证。

options.text_en: Configure a service control policy (SCP) to manage the AWS accounts. Add AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to AWS Directory Service.
options.text_zh: 配置一条服务控制策略 (SCP) 来管理这些 AWS 账户。把 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 加入 AWS Directory Service。

options.text_en: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations. Configure the organization's authentication mechanism to use AWS Directory Service directly.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Organizations 中新建一个组织。把该组织的身份验证机制配置为直接使用 AWS Directory Service。

options.text_en: Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service.
options.text_zh: 在该组织中启用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。配置 IAM Identity Center，并把它与公司的企业目录服务集成。

explanation_en:
E. Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service.

Create a new organization in AWS Organizations with all features turned on. Create the new AWS accounts in the organization. This is a foundational step for managing multiple AWS accounts in a consolidated manner.
Option E: Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service. AWS Single Sign-On (SSO) is designed to simplify and centralize authentication across multiple AWS accounts.
explanation_zh:
E. 在该组织中设置 AWS IAM Identity Center（AWS Single Sign-On）。配置 IAM Identity Center，并将其与公司的企业目录服务集成。

在 AWS Organizations 中创建启用全部功能的新组织，并在该组织中创建新的 AWS 账户。这是以整合方式管理多个 AWS 账户的基础步骤。
选项 E：在该组织中设置 AWS IAM Identity Center（AWS Single Sign-On）。配置 IAM Identity Center，并将其与公司的企业目录服务集成。AWS Single Sign-On（SSO）旨在简化并集中管理跨多个 AWS 账户的身份验证。
stem_zh:
某公司希望从许多独立的 AWS 账户转向一个整合的多账户架构。公司计划为不同业务部门创建许多新的 AWS 账户。公司需要使用一个集中式企业目录服务来对这些 AWS 账户的访问进行身份验证。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is looking for a solution that can store video archives in AWS from old news footage. The company needs to minimize costs and will rarely need to restore these files. When the files are needed, they must be available in a maximum of five minutes. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.text_en: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Glacier and use Expedited retrievals.
options.text_zh: 把视频归档存放在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中，使用加急 (Expedited) 取回。

options.text_en: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Glacier and use Standard retrievals.
options.text_zh: 把视频归档存放在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中，使用标准 (Standard) 取回。

options.text_en: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.text_zh: 把视频归档存放在 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 中。

options.text_en: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA).
options.text_zh: 把视频归档存放在 Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 中。

stem_zh:
某公司正在寻找一个方案，将旧新闻影像的视频档案存储到 AWS 中。公司需要最大限度降低成本，并且很少需要恢复这些文件。当需要这些文件时，它们必须在最多五分钟内可用。

最具成本效益的方案是什么？

stem_en: A company is building a three-tier application on AWS. The presentation tier will serve a static website The logic tier is a containerized application. This application will store data in a relational database. The company wants to simplify deployment and to reduce operational costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 托管静态内容。用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 AWS Fargate 提供计算能力。数据库使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudFront to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon CloudFront 托管静态内容。用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 提供计算能力。数据库使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 托管静态内容。用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 AWS Fargate 提供计算能力。数据库使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EC2 预留实例托管静态内容。用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 提供计算能力。数据库使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群。

explanation_en:
Amazon S3 is a highly scalable and cost-effective storage service that can be used to host static content like a static website. It simplifies the storage and delivery of static assets.
AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers. It allows you to run containers without managing the underlying infrastructure. This simplifies deployment and reduces operational overhead.
explanation_zh:
Amazon S3 是一项高度可扩展且具有成本效益的存储服务，可用于托管静态网站等静态内容。它简化了静态资源的存储和交付。
AWS Fargate 是面向容器的无服务器计算引擎。它让你无需管理底层基础设施即可运行容器，从而简化部署并降低运维开销。
stem_zh:
某公司正在 AWS 上构建一个三层应用程序。表示层将提供一个静态网站。逻辑层是一个容器化应用程序。该应用程序将把数据存储在一个关系数据库中。公司希望简化部署并降低运维成本。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company seeks a storage solution for its application. The solution must be highly available and scalable. The solution also must function as a file system be mountable by multiple Linux instances in AWS and on premises through native protocols, and have no minimum size requirements. The company has set up a Site-to-Site VPN for access from its on-premises network to its VPC. Which storage solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Amazon FSx Multi-AZ deployments
options.text_zh: Amazon FSx 多可用区部署

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach volumes
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 多重挂载卷

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with multiple mount targets
options.text_zh: 带多个挂载目标的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a single mount target and multiple access points
options.text_zh: 带单个挂载目标和多个接入点的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

explanation_en:
Amazon EFS is a scalable file storage service that can be mounted by multiple Amazon EC2 instances and on-premises servers.
It provides a shared file system with multiple mount targets in different Availability Zones (AZs) for high availability.
Multiple mount targets allow you to mount the file system from different subnets, ensuring that instances in different network segments can access the file system.
explanation_zh:
Amazon EFS 是一项可扩展的文件存储服务，可被多台 Amazon EC2 实例和本地服务器挂载。
