它提供一个共享文件系统，并在不同可用区（AZ）中设有多个挂载目标以实现高可用性。
多个挂载目标允许你从不同子网挂载该文件系统，确保位于不同网段中的实例都能访问该文件系统。
stem_zh:
某公司为其应用程序寻求一个存储方案。该方案必须高可用且可扩展。该方案还必须能作为文件系统使用，可通过原生协议被 AWS 中和本地的多台 Linux 实例挂载，并且没有最小容量要求。公司已设置一条 Site-to-Site VPN，用于从其本地网络访问 VPC。

哪个存储方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A 4-year-old media company is using the AWS Organizations all features feature set to organize its AWS accounts. According to the company's finance team, the billing information on the member accounts must not be accessible to anyone, including the root user of the member accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Add all finance team users to an IAM group. Attach an AWS managed policy named Billing to the group.
options.text_zh: 把所有财务团队用户加入一个 IAM 组。给该组附加名为 Billing 的 AWS 托管策略。

options.text_en: Attach an identity-based policy to deny access to the billing information to all users, including the root user.
options.text_zh: 附加一条基于身份的策略，对包括根用户在内的所有用户拒绝访问账单信息。

options.text_en: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny access to the billing information. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU).
options.text_zh: 创建一条拒绝访问账单信息的服务控制策略 (SCP)。把该 SCP 附加到根组织单位 (OU) 上。

options.text_en: Convert from the Organizations all features feature set to the Organizations consolidated billing feature set.
options.text_zh: 把 Organizations 从「全部功能」功能集切换为「合并账单」功能集。

explanation_en:
SCPs in AWS Organizations allow you to set fine-grained permissions and controls over what actions can be performed in member accounts.
By creating an SCP, you can explicitly deny access to billing information for all users, including the root user, under the specified organizational unit (OU).
explanation_zh:
AWS Organizations 中的 SCP 允许你对成员账户中可执行的操作设置细粒度的权限和控制。
通过创建 SCP，你可以为指定组织单元（OU）下的所有用户（包括 root 用户）显式拒绝对计费信息的访问。
stem_zh:
一家成立 4 年的媒体公司使用 AWS Organizations 的全功能特性集来组织其 AWS 账户。据公司财务团队要求，成员账户上的计费信息不得被任何人访问，包括成员账户的 root 用户。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An ecommerce company runs an application in the AWS Cloud that is integrated with an on-premises warehouse solution. The company uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send order messages to an on-premises HTTPS endpoint so the warehouse application can process the orders. The local data center team has detected that some of the order messages were not received. A solutions architect needs to retain messages that are not delivered and analyze the messages for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，其目标为保留期 14 天的 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。

options.text_en: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a retention period of 14 days between the application and Amazon SNS.
options.text_zh: 在应用与 Amazon SNS 之间加一个保留期 14 天的 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，其目标为保留期 14 天的 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon DynamoDB target with a TTL attribute set for a retention period of 14 days.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，其目标为一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表，并设置 TTL 属性使保留期为 14 天。

explanation_en:
Amazon SNS allows you to set up a dead letter queue to capture and retain messages that cannot be delivered to the intended endpoint.
When configuring a DLQ, you can specify an Amazon SQS queue as the target for messages that fail to be delivered.
Amazon SQS provides message retention settings, and in this case, you can set the retention period to 14 days.
explanation_zh:
Amazon SNS 允许你设置死信队列，以捕获并保留无法投递到目标端点的消息。
配置 DLQ 时，你可以指定一个 Amazon SQS 队列作为投递失败消息的目标。
Amazon SQS 提供消息保留设置，在此场景中你可以将保留期设为 14 天。
stem_zh:
某电商公司在 AWS 云中运行一个与本地仓库系统集成的应用程序。公司使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）向一个本地 HTTPS 端点发送订单消息，以便仓库应用程序处理订单。本地数据中心团队发现有些订单消息未被收到。

解决方案架构师需要保留未成功投递的消息，并对这些消息进行最长 14 天的分析。

哪个方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A gaming company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store user information such as geographic location, player data, and leaderboards. The company needs to configure continuous backups to an Amazon S3 bucket with a minimal amount of coding. The backups must not affect availability of the application and must not affect the read capacity units (RCUs) that are defined for the table. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Use an Amazon EMR cluster. Create an Apache Hive job to back up the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 使用一个 Amazon EMR 集群。创建一个 Apache Hive 作业把数据备份到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Export the data directly from DynamoDB to Amazon S3 with continuous backups. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.
options.text_zh: 用持续备份把数据从 DynamoDB 直接导出到 Amazon S3。为该表开启时间点恢复。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the stream and export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon DynamoDB Streams。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数消费该流，并把数据导出到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to export the data from the database tables to Amazon S3 on a regular basis. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期把数据库表中的数据导出到 Amazon S3。为该表开启时间点恢复。

stem_zh:
某游戏公司使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储用户信息，例如地理位置、玩家数据和排行榜。公司需要以极少的编码配置到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶的持续备份。这些备份不得影响应用程序的可用性，也不得影响为该表定义的读取容量单位（RCU）。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing an asynchronous application to process credit card data validation requests for a bank. The application must be secure and be able to process each request at least once. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queues as the event source. Use AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS) for encryption. Add the kms:Decrypt permission for the Lambda execution role.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。把 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列设为事件源。使用 AWS Key Management Service 加密 (SSE-KMS)。为 Lambda 执行角色添加 kms:Decrypt 权限。

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda event source mapping. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the event source. Use SQS managed encryption keys (SSE-SQS) for encryption. Add the encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。把 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列用作事件源。使用 SQS 托管加密密钥 (SSE-SQS) 加密。为该 Lambda 函数添加加密密钥调用权限。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the event source. Use AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Add the kms:Decrypt permission for the Lambda execution role.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。把 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列设为事件源。使用 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS)。为 Lambda 执行角色添加 kms:Decrypt 权限。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queues as the event source. Use AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for encryption. Add the encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。把 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列设为事件源。使用 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS) 加密。为该 Lambda 函数添加加密密钥调用权限。

stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为某银行设计一个异步应用程序，用于处理信用卡数据验证请求。该应用程序必须安全，并且能够对每个请求至少处理一次。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has multiple AWS accounts for development work. Some staff consistently use oversized Amazon EC2 instances, which causes the company to exceed the yearly budget for the development accounts. The company wants to centrally restrict the creation of AWS resources in these accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.text_en: Develop AWS Systems Manager templates that use an approved EC2 creation process. Use the approved Systems Manager templates to provision EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 开发使用已审批 EC2 创建流程的 AWS Systems Manager 模板。用这些已审批的 Systems Manager 模板来预置 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Use AWS Organizations to organize the accounts into organizational units (OUs). Define and attach a service control policy (SCP) to control the usage of EC2 instance types.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Organizations 把这些账户组织成组织单位 (OU)。定义一条服务控制策略 (SCP) 并附加上去，控制可使用的 EC2 实例类型。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function when an EC2 instance is created. Stop disallowed EC2 instance types.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在有 EC2 实例被创建时调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，停止不被允许的 EC2 实例类型。

options.text_en: Set up AWS Service Catalog products for the staff to create the allowed EC2 instance types. Ensure that staff can deploy EC2 instances only by using the Service Catalog products.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Service Catalog 产品，供员工创建被允许的 EC2 实例类型。确保员工只能通过这些 Service Catalog 产品来部署 EC2 实例。

explanation_en:
AWS Organizations allows you to consolidate multiple AWS accounts into an organization that you create and centrally manage.
Organizational Units (OUs) can be used to group accounts based on different criteria, such as development, production, etc.
Service Control Policies (SCPs) are used to set fine-grained permissions on AWS accounts within an organization.
By defining an SCP and attaching it to the OUs containing the development accounts, you can restrict the EC2 instance types that can be launched.
explanation_zh:
AWS Organizations 允许你将多个 AWS 账户整合到一个由你创建并集中管理的组织中。
组织单元（OU）可用于按不同标准（例如开发、生产等）对账户进行分组。
服务控制策略（SCP）用于对组织内的 AWS 账户设置细粒度权限。
通过定义 SCP 并将其附加到包含开发账户的 OU，你可以限制可以启动的 EC2 实例类型。
stem_zh:
某公司有多个用于开发工作的 AWS 账户。部分员工一直使用超规格的 Amazon EC2 实例，导致公司超出开发账户的年度预算。公司希望集中限制在这些账户中创建 AWS 资源。

哪个方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to use artificial intelligence (AI) to determine the quality of its customer service calls. The company currently manages calls in four different languages, including English. The company will offer new languages in the future. The company does not have the resources to regularly maintain machine learning (ML) models. The company needs to create written sentiment analysis reports from the customer service call recordings. The customer service call recording text must be translated into English. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Use Amazon Comprehend to translate the audio recordings into English.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Comprehend 把音频录音翻译成英语。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Lex to create the written sentiment analysis reports.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Lex 生成书面的情感分析报告。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Polly to convert the audio recordings into text.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Polly 把音频录音转成文本。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Transcribe to convert the audio recordings in any language into text.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Transcribe 把任意语言的音频录音转成文本。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Translate to translate text in any language to English.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Translate 把任意语言的文本翻译成英语。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Comprehend to create the sentiment analysis reports.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Comprehend 生成情感分析报告。

explanation_en:
Use Amazon Transcribe to Convert Audio Recordings into Text:

Amazon Transcribe is a service that converts speech into text. Use it to transcribe the customer service call recordings into text.
Use Amazon Translate to Translate Text into English:

Amazon Translate is a service that provides language translation. After transcribing the call recordings into text, use Amazon Translate to translate the text into English.
Use Amazon Comprehend to Create Sentiment Analysis Reports:

Amazon Comprehend can be used for sentiment analysis, which involves determining the sentiment or emotion expressed in the text. After translating the text into English, use Amazon Comprehend to analyze the sentiment and create sentiment analysis reports.
explanation_zh:
使用 Amazon Transcribe 将音频录音转换为文本：

Amazon Transcribe 是一项将语音转换为文本的服务。用它将客服通话录音转录为文本。
使用 Amazon Translate 将文本翻译成英语：

Amazon Translate 是一项提供语言翻译的服务。在将通话录音转录为文本后，使用 Amazon Translate 将文本翻译成英语。
使用 Amazon Comprehend 生成情感分析报告：

Amazon Comprehend 可用于情感分析，即判定文本中所表达的情绪或情感。在将文本翻译成英语后，使用 Amazon Comprehend 分析情感并生成情感分析报告。
stem_zh:
某公司希望使用人工智能（AI）来判定其客服通话的质量。公司目前用四种不同语言（包括英语）处理通话，未来还将提供新的语言。公司没有资源来定期维护机器学习（ML）模型。

公司需要从客服通话录音生成书面的情感分析报告。客服通话录音文本必须被翻译成英语。

哪些步骤组合能满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances to host its internal systems. As part of a deployment operation, an administrator tries to use the AWS CLI to terminate an EC2 instance. However, the administrator receives a 403 (Access Denied) error message. The administrator is using an IAM role that has the following IAM policy attached: What is the cause of the unsuccessful request?

options.text_en: The EC2 instance has a resource-based policy with a Deny statement.
options.text_zh: 该 EC2 实例上有一条含 Deny 语句的基于资源的策略。

options.text_en: The principal has not been specified in the policy statement.
options.text_zh: 策略语句中没有指定 Principal（主体）。

options.text_en: The "Action" field does not grant the actions that are required to terminate the EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: "Action" 字段没有授予终止该 EC2 实例所需的操作权限。

options.text_en: The request to terminate the EC2 instance does not originate from the CIDR blocks 192.0.2.0/24 or 203.0.113.0/24.
options.text_zh: 终止该 EC2 实例的请求并非来自 192.0.2.0/24 或 203.0.113.0/24 这两个 CIDR 块。

stem_zh: 某公司用 Amazon EC2 实例承载其内部系统。作为部署操作的一部分，一名管理员尝试用 AWS CLI 终止一台 EC2 实例，但收到了 403（拒绝访问）错误消息。该管理员使用的 IAM 角色附加了下面这条 IAM 策略：这次请求失败的原因是什么？

stem_en: A company is conducting an internal audit. The company wants to ensure that the data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is associated with the company’s AWS Lake Formation data lake does not contain sensitive customer or employee data. The company wants to discover personally identifiable information (PII) or financial information, including passport numbers and credit card numbers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure AWS Audit Manager on the account. Select the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS) for auditing.
options.text_zh: 在该账户上配置 AWS Audit Manager。选择支付卡行业数据安全标准 (PCI DSS) 进行审计。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon S3 Inventory on the S3 bucket Configure Amazon Athena to query the inventory.
options.text_zh: 在该 S3 存储桶上配置 Amazon S3 清单。配置 Amazon Athena 查询该清单。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Macie to run a data discovery job that uses managed identifiers for the required data types.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Macie，运行一个针对所需数据类型使用托管标识符的数据发现作业。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 Select to run a report across the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 Select 对该 S3 存储桶跑一份报告。

explanation_en:
Amazon Macie is a security service that uses machine learning to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data like PII or financial information.
By configuring Amazon Macie to run a data discovery job, you can use managed identifiers to search for specific types of sensitive data within the S3 bucket.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Macie 是一项使用机器学习自动发现、分类和保护 PII 或财务信息等敏感数据的安全服务。
通过配置 Amazon Macie 运行数据发现作业，你可以使用托管标识符在该 S3 存储桶中搜索特定类型的敏感数据。
stem_zh:
某公司正在进行内部审计。公司希望确保与其 AWS Lake Formation 数据湖关联的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中的数据不包含敏感的客户或员工数据。公司希望发现个人可识别信息（PII）或财务信息，包括护照号码和信用卡号码。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses on-premises servers to host its applications. The company is running out of storage capacity. The applications use both block storage and NFS storage. The company needs a high-performing solution that supports local caching without re-architecting its existing applications. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Mount Amazon S3 as a file system to the on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 把 Amazon S3 作为文件系统挂载到本地服务器上。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to replace NFS storage.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关来替代 NFS 存储。

options.text_en: Deploy AWS Snowball Edge to provision NFS mounts to on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 部署 AWS Snowball Edge 为本地服务器提供 NFS 挂载。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway to replace the block storage.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关来替代块存储。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volumes and mount them to on-premises servers.
options.text_zh: 部署 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷并挂载到本地服务器上。

stem_zh:
某公司使用本地服务器托管其应用程序。公司的存储容量即将耗尽。这些应用程序同时使用块存储和 NFS 存储。公司需要一个高性能方案，在不重构现有应用程序的前提下支持本地缓存。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company has a service that reads and writes large amounts of data from an Amazon S3 bucket in the same AWS Region. The service is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances within the private subnet of a VPC. The service communicates with Amazon S3 over a NAT gateway in the public subnet. However, the company wants a solution that will reduce the data output costs. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Provision a dedicated EC2 NAT instance in the public subnet. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use the elastic network interface of this instance as the destination for all S3 traffic.
options.text_zh: 在公有子网中预置一台专用的 EC2 NAT 实例。配置私有子网的路由表，把该实例的弹性网络接口设为所有 S3 流量的目标。

options.text_en: Provision a dedicated EC2 NAT instance in the private subnet. Configure the route table for the public subnet to use the elastic network interface of this instance as the destination for all S3 traffic.
options.text_zh: 在私有子网中预置一台专用的 EC2 NAT 实例。配置公有子网的路由表，把该实例的弹性网络接口设为所有 S3 流量的目标。

options.text_en: Provision a VPC gateway endpoint. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use the gateway endpoint as the route for all S3 traffic.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 VPC 网关端点。配置私有子网的路由表，把该网关端点作为所有 S3 流量的路由。

options.text_en: Provision a second NAT gateway. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use this NAT gateway as the destination for all S3 traffic.
options.text_zh: 再预置一个 NAT 网关。配置私有子网的路由表，把这个 NAT 网关设为所有 S3 流量的目标。

stem_zh:
某公司有一项服务，从同一 AWS 区域中的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶读取和写入大量数据。该服务部署在某 VPC 私有子网内的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该服务通过公有子网中的一个 NAT 网关与 Amazon S3 通信。但公司希望有一个能降低数据输出成本的方案。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon S3 to store high-resolution pictures in an S3 bucket. To minimize application changes, the company stores the pictures as the latest version of an S3 object. The company needs to retain only the two most recent versions of the pictures. The company wants to reduce costs. The company has identified the S3 bucket as a large expense. Which solution will reduce the S3 costs with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use S3 Lifecycle to delete expired object versions and retain the two most recent versions.
options.text_zh: 用 S3 生命周期删除过期的对象版本，只保留最近的两个版本。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to check for older versions and delete all but the two most recent versions.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Lambda 函数检查旧版本，删除除最近两个版本以外的所有版本。

options.text_en: Use S3 Batch Operations to delete noncurrent object versions and retain only the two most recent versions.
options.text_zh: 用 S3 批量操作删除非当前的对象版本，只保留最近的两个版本。

options.text_en: Deactivate versioning on the S3 bucket and retain the two most recent versions.
options.text_zh: 关闭该 S3 存储桶的版本控制，只保留最近的两个版本。

explanation_en: This approach allows you to automate the deletion of object versions based on lifecycle policies, reducing manual intervention and operational overhead.
explanation_zh: 这种做法让你能够基于生命周期策略自动删除对象版本，减少人工干预和运维开销。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon S3 在一个 S3 存储桶中存储高分辨率图片。为尽量减少应用程序改动，公司将图片存储为 S3 对象的最新版本。公司只需保留图片最近的两个版本。

公司希望降低成本。公司已确定该 S3 存储桶是一笔较大的开支。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销降低 S3 成本？

stem_en: A company needs to minimize the cost of its 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. The company's average connection utilization is less than 10%. A solutions architect must recommend a solution that will reduce the cost without compromising security. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set up a new 1 Gbps Direct Connect connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.text_zh: 新建一条 1 Gbps 的 Direct Connect 连接，并把该连接共享给另一个 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Set up a new 200 Mbps Direct Connect connection in the AWS Management Console.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS 管理控制台中新建一条 200 Mbps 的 Direct Connect 连接。

options.text_en: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 1 Gbps connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.text_zh: 联系 AWS Direct Connect 合作伙伴订购一条 1 Gbps 连接，并把该连接共享给另一个 AWS 账户。

options.text_en: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 200 Mbps hosted connection for an existing AWS account.
options.text_zh: 联系 AWS Direct Connect 合作伙伴，为现有 AWS 账户订购一条 200 Mbps 的托管连接。

stem_zh:
某公司需要最大限度降低其 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接的成本。公司的平均连接利用率低于 10%。解决方案架构师必须推荐一个在不牺牲安全性的前提下降低成本的方案。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has multiple Windows file servers on premises. The company wants to migrate and consolidate its files into an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. File permissions must be preserved to ensure that access rights do not change. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Deploy AWS DataSync agents on premises. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.text_zh: 在本地部署 AWS DataSync 代理。安排 DataSync 任务把数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

options.text_en: Copy the shares on each file server into Amazon S3 buckets by using the AWS CLI. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CLI 把每台文件服务器上的共享复制到 Amazon S3 存储桶。安排 AWS DataSync 任务把数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

options.text_en: Remove the drives from each file server. Ship the drives to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.text_zh: 把每台文件服务器的硬盘拆下来寄给 AWS 导入 Amazon S3。安排 AWS DataSync 任务把数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowcone device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Launch AWS DataSync agents on the device. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.text_zh: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备。把设备接入本地网络。在设备上启动 AWS DataSync 代理。安排 DataSync 任务把数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Copy data to the device by using the AWS CLI. Ship the device back to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.text_zh: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。把设备接入本地网络。用 AWS CLI 把数据复制到该设备上。把设备寄回 AWS 导入 Amazon S3。安排 AWS DataSync 任务把数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

explanation_en: D. Order an AWS Snowcone device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Launch AWS DataSync agents on the device. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
explanation_zh: D. 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备。将该设备连接到本地网络。在该设备上启动 AWS DataSync 代理。安排 DataSync 任务将数据传输到该 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
stem_zh:
某公司在本地有多台 Windows 文件服务器。公司希望将其文件迁移并整合到一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统中。必须保留文件权限，以确保访问权限不发生变化。

哪些方案能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company wants to ingest customer payment data into the company's data lake in Amazon S3. The company receives payment data every minute on average. The company wants to analyze the payment data in real time. Then the company wants to ingest the data into the data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 接入数据。用 AWS Lambda 实时分析数据。

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Glue 接入数据。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 实时分析数据。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 接入数据。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 实时分析数据。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 接入数据。用 AWS Lambda 实时分析数据。

explanation_en:
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose:

It is a fully managed service that can reliably load streaming data into data lakes, data stores, and analytics tools.
It can automatically scale to handle varying data throughput.
It simplifies the data delivery process, making it easy to ingest data into Amazon S3.

Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics:

It enables you to analyze streaming data in real-time with SQL queries.
It integrates seamlessly with other AWS services, including Kinesis Data Firehose.
It provides the capability to perform real-time analytics on the streaming data before storing it in Amazon S3.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose：

这是一项全托管服务，可可靠地将流数据加载到数据湖、数据存储和分析工具中。
它可以自动伸缩以应对不同的数据吞吐量。
它简化了数据传输过程，让数据能够轻松摄取到 Amazon S3。

Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics：

它使你能够通过 SQL 查询实时分析流数据。
它可与包括 Kinesis Data Firehose 在内的其他 AWS 服务无缝集成。
它提供在将流数据存入 Amazon S3 之前对其执行实时分析的能力。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将客户支付数据摄取到公司位于 Amazon S3 的数据湖中。公司平均每分钟收到一次支付数据。公司希望实时分析这些支付数据，然后将数据摄取到数据湖中。

哪个方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a website that uses a content management system (CMS) on Amazon EC2. The CMS runs on a single EC2 instance and uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance for the data tier. Website images are stored on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is mounted inside the EC2 instance. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve the performance and resilience of the website? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Move the website images into an Amazon S3 bucket that is mounted on every EC2 instance
options.text_zh: 把网站图片移到一个挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

options.text_en: Share the website images by using an NFS share from the primary EC2 instance. Mount this share on the other EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 从主 EC2 实例通过 NFS 共享把网站图片共享出来，在其他 EC2 实例上挂载该共享。

options.text_en: Move the website images onto an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on every EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 把网站图片移到一个挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator for the website
options.text_zh: 从现有 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。用该 AMI 在一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Auto Scaling 组中预置新实例。把该 Auto Scaling 组配置为至少保持两台实例。为该网站在 AWS Global Accelerator 中配置一个加速器。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website.
options.text_zh: 从现有 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。用该 AMI 在一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Auto Scaling 组中预置新实例。把该 Auto Scaling 组配置为至少保持两台实例。为该网站配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

explanation_en:
E. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website.

Option C provides moving the website images onto an Amazon EFS file system that is mounted on every EC2 instance. Amazon EFS provides a scalable and fully managed file storage solution that can be accessed concurrently from multiple EC2 instances. This ensures that the website images can be accessed efficiently and consistently by all instances, improving performance.

In Option E The Auto Scaling group maintains a minimum of two instances, ensuring resilience by automatically replacing any unhealthy instances. Additionally, configuring an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website further improves performance by caching content at edge locations closer to the end-users, reducing latency and improving content delivery.
Hence combining these actions, the website's performance is improved through efficient image storage and content delivery
explanation_zh:
E. 从现有 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image（AMI）。使用该 AMI 在一个 Application Load Balancer 之后、作为 Auto Scaling 组的一部分预置新实例。配置该 Auto Scaling 组至少维持两台实例。为该网站配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

选项 C 提出将网站图片迁移到挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 Amazon EFS 文件系统上。Amazon EFS 提供一个可扩展的全托管文件存储方案，可被多台 EC2 实例并发访问。这确保所有实例都能高效且一致地访问网站图片，从而提升性能。

在选项 E 中，Auto Scaling 组至少维持两台实例，并通过自动替换任何不健康实例来确保韧性。此外，为网站配置 Amazon CloudFront 分配可通过在更靠近最终用户的边缘站点缓存内容进一步提升性能，降低延迟并改善内容交付。
因此，将这些操作结合起来，网站性能可通过高效的图片存储和内容交付得到提升。
stem_zh:
某公司运营一个在 Amazon EC2 上使用内容管理系统（CMS）的网站。该 CMS 运行在单台 EC2 实例上，数据层使用一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL 多可用区数据库实例。网站图片存储在挂载到该 EC2 实例内部的一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷上。

解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合来提升该网站的性能和韧性？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs an infrastructure monitoring service. The company is building a new feature that will enable the service to monitor data in customer AWS accounts. The new feature will call AWS APIs in customer accounts to describe Amazon EC2 instances and read Amazon CloudWatch metrics. What should the company do to obtain access to customer accounts in the MOST secure way?

options.text_en: Ensure that the customers create an IAM role in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions and a trust policy to the company’s account.
options.text_zh: 让客户在自己账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，赋予其 EC2 和 CloudWatch 只读权限，并在信任策略中信任该公司的账户。

options.text_en: Create a serverless API that implements a token vending machine to provide temporary AWS credentials for a role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions.
options.text_zh: 创建一个无服务器 API，实现一个令牌分发机制，为一个具备 EC2 和 CloudWatch 只读权限的角色提供临时 AWS 凭证。

options.text_en: Ensure that the customers create an IAM user in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store customer access and secret keys in a secrets management system.
options.text_zh: 让客户在自己账户中创建一个具备 EC2 和 CloudWatch 只读权限的 IAM 用户。把客户的访问密钥和私有密钥加密后存放在密钥管理系统中。

options.text_en: Ensure that the customers create an Amazon Cognito user in their account to use an IAM role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store the Amazon Cognito user and password in a secrets management system.
options.text_zh: 让客户在自己账户中创建一个 Amazon Cognito 用户，用它来使用一个具备 EC2 和 CloudWatch 只读权限的 IAM 角色。把该 Amazon Cognito 用户名和密码加密后存放在密钥管理系统中。

stem_zh:
某公司运营一项基础设施监控服务。公司正在构建一项新功能，使该服务能够监控客户 AWS 账户中的数据。该新功能将在客户账户中调用 AWS API，以描述 Amazon EC2 实例并读取 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。

公司应该怎么做才能以最安全的方式获得对客户账户的访问权限？

stem_en: A company needs to connect several VPCs in the us-east-1 Region that span hundreds of AWS accounts. The company's networking team has its own AWS account to manage the cloud network. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution to connect the VPCs?

options.text_en: Set up VPC peering connections between each VPC. Update each associated subnet’s route table
options.text_zh: 在各个 VPC 之间建立 VPC 对等连接。更新各关联子网的路由表。

options.text_en: Configure a NAT gateway and an internet gateway in each VPC to connect each VPC through the internet
options.text_zh: 在每个 VPC 中配置一个 NAT 网关和一个互联网网关，让各 VPC 经由互联网互联。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Transit Gateway in the networking team’s AWS account. Configure static routes from each VPC.
options.text_zh: 在网络团队的 AWS 账户中创建一个 AWS Transit Gateway。为每个 VPC 配置静态路由。

options.text_en: Deploy VPN gateways in each VPC. Create a transit VPC in the networking team’s AWS account to connect to each VPC.
options.text_zh: 在每个 VPC 中部署 VPN 网关。在网络团队的 AWS 账户中创建一个中转 VPC 来连接各个 VPC。

explanation_en: AWS Transit Gateway: It is designed to simplify the connectivity between multiple VPCs. It acts as a central hub that allows you to connect multiple VPCs and on-premises networks. This approach reduces the complexity of managing peering connections individually.
explanation_zh: AWS Transit Gateway：它旨在简化多个 VPC 之间的连接。它充当中心枢纽，让你能够连接多个 VPC 和本地网络。这种做法降低了单独管理对等连接的复杂度。
stem_zh:
某公司需要连接 us-east-1 区域中跨数百个 AWS 账户的若干 VPC。公司的网络团队有自己的 AWS 账户来管理云网络。

连接这些 VPC 在运维上最高效的方案是什么？

stem_en: A company has Amazon EC2 instances that run nightly batch jobs to process data. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group that uses On- Demand billing. If a job fails on one instance, another instance will reprocess the job. The batch jobs run between 12:00 AM and 06:00 AM local time every day. Which solution will provide EC2 instances to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Purchase a 1-year Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 that covers the instance family of the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.text_zh: 为该批处理作业所用 Auto Scaling 组的实例系列购买 1 年期的 Amazon EC2 节省计划。

options.text_en: Purchase a 1-year Reserved Instance for the specific instance type and operating system of the instances in the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.text_zh: 为该批处理作业所用 Auto Scaling 组中实例的具体实例类型和操作系统购买 1 年期预留实例。

options.text_en: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组创建一个新的启动模板，把实例设为 Spot 实例。设置一条按 CPU 使用率扩容的策略。

options.text_en: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Increase the instance size. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组创建一个新的启动模板，把实例规格调大。设置一条按 CPU 使用率扩容的策略。

explanation_en:
Spot Instances: Spot Instances allow you to bid for unused EC2 capacity at a potentially lower cost than On-Demand pricing. This can result in significant cost savings for batch jobs that are fault-tolerant and can be interrupted or retried.

Scaling Policy: Setting a policy to scale out based on CPU usage ensures that additional Spot Instances are launched when the demand for processing power increases during batch job execution. This helps in handling varying workloads efficiently.
explanation_zh:
Spot 实例：Spot 实例让你能够以可能低于按需定价的成本竞价获取未使用的 EC2 容量。对于具备容错能力、可被中断或重试的批处理作业来说，这可以带来显著的成本节约。

伸缩策略：设置基于 CPU 使用率的扩容策略，可确保在批处理作业执行期间算力需求增加时启动额外的 Spot 实例。这有助于高效应对波动的工作负载。
stem_zh:
某公司有一些 Amazon EC2 实例，运行夜间批处理作业来处理数据。这些 EC2 实例运行在一个使用按需计费的 Auto Scaling 组中。如果某个作业在一台实例上失败，另一台实例会重新处理该作业。这些批处理作业每天在当地时间 00:00 到 06:00 之间运行。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式提供满足这些要求的 EC2 实例？

stem_en: A social media company is building a feature for its website. The feature will give users the ability to upload photos. The company expects significant increases in demand during large events and must ensure that the website can handle the upload traffic from users. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST scalability?

options.text_en: Upload files from the user's browser to the application servers. Transfer the files to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 让用户从浏览器把文件上传到应用服务器，再由应用服务器把文件转存到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file gateway.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关。让用户从浏览器直接把文件上传到该文件网关。

options.text_en: Generate Amazon S3 presigned URLs in the application. Upload files directly from the user's browser into an S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在应用中生成 Amazon S3 预签名 URL。让用户从浏览器直接把文件上传到 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file system.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。让用户从浏览器直接把文件上传到该文件系统。

explanation_en: Amazon S3 Presigned URLs: This approach allows the client (user's browser) to directly upload files to Amazon S3 using a presigned URL generated by the server. This offloads the file transfer process from the application servers and enables a direct upload to S3 from the client side.
explanation_zh: Amazon S3 预签名 URL：这种做法允许客户端（用户浏览器）使用服务器生成的预签名 URL 直接将文件上传到 Amazon S3。这将文件传输过程从应用服务器卸载出去，实现了从客户端直接上传到 S3。
stem_zh:
某社交媒体公司正在为其网站构建一项功能。该功能将使用户能够上传照片。公司预计在大型活动期间需求会显著增加，必须确保网站能够处理来自用户的上传流量。

哪个方案能以最高的可扩展性满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a web application for travel ticketing. The application is based on a database that runs in a single data center in North America. The company wants to expand the application to serve a global user base. The company needs to deploy the application to multiple AWS Regions. Average latency must be less than 1 second on updates to the reservation database. The company wants to have separate deployments of its web platform across multiple Regions. However, the company must maintain a single primary reservation database that is globally consistent. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment.
options.text_zh: 把该应用改造为使用 Amazon DynamoDB。中心预约表使用全局表。每个区域的部署各自使用对应区域的端点。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库。在每个区域部署 Aurora 只读副本。每个区域的部署各自使用对应区域的端点访问数据库。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库。在每个区域部署 MySQL 只读副本。每个区域的部署各自使用对应区域的端点访问数据库。

options.text_en: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases.
options.text_zh: 把该应用迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库。在每个区域各部署一个数据库实例。每个区域的部署各自使用对应区域的端点访问数据库。用 AWS Lambda 函数在各区域处理事件流来同步这些数据库。

explanation_en: Using DynamoDB's global tables feature, you can achieve a globally consistent reservation database with low latency on updates, making it suitable for serving a global user base. The automatic replication provided by DynamoDB eliminates the need for manual synchronization between Regions.
explanation_zh: 使用 DynamoDB 的全球表功能，你可以实现一个全球一致、更新延迟低的预订数据库，因此适合服务全球用户群。DynamoDB 提供的自动复制免去了在区域之间手动同步的需要。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个用于旅行票务的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序基于一个运行在北美单个数据中心中的数据库。公司希望扩展该应用程序以服务全球用户群。公司需要将该应用程序部署到多个 AWS 区域。对预订数据库的更新平均延迟必须小于 1 秒。

公司希望在多个区域分别独立部署其 Web 平台。但公司必须维护一个全球一致的、单一的主预订数据库。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪个方案来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has migrated multiple Microsoft Windows Server workloads to Amazon EC2 instances that run in the us-west-1 Region. The company manually backs up the workloads to create an image as needed. In the event of a natural disaster in the us-west-1 Region, the company wants to recover workloads quickly in the us-west-2 Region. The company wants no more than 24 hours of data loss on the EC2 instances. The company also wants to automate any backups of the EC2 instances. Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Copy the image on demand.
options.text_zh: 创建一条基于标签的 Amazon EC2 支持的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 生命周期策略来创建备份。把备份安排为每天运行两次。按需复制镜像。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Configure the copy to the us-west-2 Region.
options.text_zh: 创建一条基于标签的 Amazon EC2 支持的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 生命周期策略来创建备份。把备份安排为每天运行两次。配置复制到 us-west-2 区域。

options.text_en: Create backup vaults in us-west-1 and in us-west-2 by using AWS Backup. Create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Create an AWS Lambda function to run as a scheduled job to copy the backup data to us-west-2.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 在 us-west-1 和 us-west-2 各创建一个备份保管库。基于标签值为这些 EC2 实例创建备份计划。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数作为计划任务运行，把备份数据复制到 us-west-2。

options.text_en: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Define the destination for the copy as us-west-2. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份保管库。用 AWS Backup 基于标签值为这些 EC2 实例创建备份计划。把复制目标定为 us-west-2。把备份计划设为每天运行两次。

options.text_en: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily. Copy on demand to us-west-2.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份保管库。用 AWS Backup 基于标签值为这些 EC2 实例创建备份计划。把备份计划设为每天运行两次。按需复制到 us-west-2。

explanation_en: D. Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Define the destination for the copy as us-west-2. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily.
explanation_zh: D. 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份保管库。使用 AWS Backup 基于标签值为这些 EC2 实例创建备份计划。将复制目标定义为 us-west-2。将备份计划指定为每日运行两次。
stem_zh:
主题 1
某公司已将多个 Microsoft Windows Server 工作负载迁移到运行在 us-west-1 区域的 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司按需手动备份这些工作负载以创建镜像。

如果 us-west-1 区域发生自然灾害，公司希望在 us-west-2 区域快速恢复工作负载。公司希望 EC2 实例上的数据丢失不超过 24 小时。公司还希望自动化 EC2 实例的所有备份。

哪些方案能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company operates a two-tier application for image processing. The application uses two Availability Zones, each with one public subnet and one private subnet. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) for the web tier uses the public subnets. Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier use the private subnets. Users report that the application is running more slowly than expected. A security audit of the web server log files shows that the application is receiving millions of illegitimate requests from a small number of IP addresses. A solutions architect needs to resolve the immediate performance problem while the company investigates a more permanent solution. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Modify the inbound security group for the web tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.text_zh: 修改 Web 层的入站安全组，为消耗资源的那些 IP 地址添加拒绝规则。

options.text_en: Modify the network ACL for the web tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.text_zh: 修改 Web 层子网的网络 ACL，为消耗资源的那些 IP 地址添加入站拒绝规则。

options.text_en: Modify the inbound security group for the application tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.text_zh: 修改应用层的入站安全组，为消耗资源的那些 IP 地址添加拒绝规则。

options.text_en: Modify the network ACL for the application tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.text_zh: 修改应用层子网的网络 ACL，为消耗资源的那些 IP 地址添加入站拒绝规则。

stem_zh:
某公司运营一个用于图像处理的两层应用程序。该应用程序使用两个可用区，每个可用区中有一个公有子网和一个私有子网。Web 层的 Application Load Balancer（ALB）使用公有子网。应用层的 Amazon EC2 实例使用私有子网。

用户报告该应用程序运行速度低于预期。对 Web 服务器日志文件的安全审计显示，该应用程序正在接收来自少数几个 IP 地址的数百万个非法请求。解决方案架构师需要在公司调查更长期的方案期间，先解决当下的性能问题。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么来满足此要求？

stem_en: A global marketing company has applications that run in the ap-southeast-2 Region and the eu-west-1 Region. Applications that run in a VPC in eu- west-1 need to communicate securely with databases that run in a VPC in ap-southeast-2. Which network design will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a VPC peering connection between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. Create an inbound rule in the eu-west-1 application security group that allows traffic from the database server IP addresses in the ap-southeast-2 security group.
options.text_zh: 在 eu-west-1 的 VPC 与 ap-southeast-2 的 VPC 之间创建一条 VPC 对等连接。在 eu-west-1 的应用安全组中创建一条入站规则，允许来自 ap-southeast-2 安全组中数据库服务器 IP 地址的流量。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPC. Update the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.
options.text_zh: 在 ap-southeast-2 的 VPC 与 eu-west-1 的 VPC 之间配置一条 VPC 对等连接。更新子网路由表。在 ap-southeast-2 的数据库安全组中创建一条入站规则，引用 eu-west-1 中应用服务器的安全组 ID。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPUpdate the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that allows traffic from the eu-west-1 application server IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 在 ap-southeast-2 的 VPC 与 eu-west-1 的 VPC 之间配置一条 VPC 对等连接。更新子网路由表。在 ap-southeast-2 的数据库安全组中创建一条入站规则，允许来自 eu-west-1 应用服务器 IP 地址的流量。

options.text_en: Create a transit gateway with a peering attachment between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. After the transit gateways are properly peered and routing is configured, create an inbound rule in the database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.
options.text_zh: 创建一个中转网关，并在 eu-west-1 的 VPC 与 ap-southeast-2 的 VPC 之间建立对等连接附件。等中转网关正确对等且路由配置好之后，在数据库安全组中创建一条入站规则，引用 eu-west-1 中应用服务器的安全组 ID。

explanation_en:
VPC peering connections can be established between VPCs in different AWS Regions.
In this case, a VPC peering connection is set up between the VPC in ap-southeast-2 and the VPC in eu-west-1.
explanation_zh:
VPC 对等连接可以在不同 AWS 区域的 VPC 之间建立。
在此场景中，需要在 ap-southeast-2 的 VPC 与 eu-west-1 的 VPC 之间建立 VPC 对等连接。
stem_zh:
某全球营销公司有运行在 ap-southeast-2 区域和 eu-west-1 区域的应用程序。运行在 eu-west-1 某 VPC 中的应用程序需要与运行在 ap-southeast-2 某 VPC 中的数据库安全通信。

哪种网络设计能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is developing software that uses a PostgreSQL database schema. The company needs to configure multiple development environments and databases for the company's developers. On average, each development environment is used for half of the 8-hour workday. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database
options.text_zh: 为每个开发环境各配置一个自己的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库。

options.text_en: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances
options.text_zh: 为每个开发环境各配置一个自己的单可用区 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。

options.text_en: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL-Compatible database
options.text_zh: 为每个开发环境各配置一个自己的按需 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 兼容版数据库。

options.text_en: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon S3 bucket by using Amazon S3 Object Select
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 Object Select，为每个开发环境各配置一个自己的 Amazon S3 存储桶。

explanation_en: Explanation: Since each environment is only used for half of the workday, a standard RDS for PostgreSQL instance that gets stopped when not in use is cheaper than running Aurora continuously — Aurora costs more than standard RDS and this workload doesn't need Aurora's extra performance/availability features.
explanation_zh: 解析：由于每个环境只在工作日的一半时间内使用，一个在不使用时停止的标准 RDS for PostgreSQL 实例比持续运行 Aurora 更便宜——Aurora 的成本高于标准 RDS，而这个工作负载并不需要 Aurora 额外的性能/可用性特性。
stem_zh:
某公司正在开发使用 PostgreSQL 数据库架构的软件。公司需要为其开发人员配置多个开发环境和数据库。平均而言，每个开发环境在 8 小时工作日中只使用一半时间。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses AWS Organizations with resources tagged by account. The company also uses AWS Backup to back up its AWS infrastructure resources. The company needs to back up all AWS resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS Config to identify all untagged resources. Tag the identified resources programmatically. Use tags in the backup plan.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Config 找出所有未打标签的资源。以编程方式给这些资源打上标签。在备份计划中按标签选取资源。

options.text_en: Use AWS Config to identify all resources that are not running. Add those resources to the backup vault.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Config 找出所有未在运行的资源。把这些资源加入备份保管库。

options.text_en: Require all AWS account owners to review their resources to identify the resources that need to be backed up.
options.text_zh: 要求所有 AWS 账户负责人自行检查各自的资源，识别出需要备份的资源。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Inspector to identify all noncompliant resources.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Inspector 找出所有不合规的资源。

explanation_en:
AWS Config can be used to identify untagged resources, and it can provide a comprehensive view of the resource inventory across your AWS Organization. 
AWS Backup supports the use of tags in backup plans. By utilizing tags, you can create a backup plan that automatically includes resources based on their tags.
explanation_zh:
AWS Config 可用于识别未打标签的资源，并能提供整个 AWS 组织内资源清单的全面视图。
AWS Backup 支持在备份计划中使用标签。通过利用标签，你可以创建一个基于标签自动包含相应资源的备份计划。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS Organizations，资源按账户打标签。公司还使用 AWS Backup 备份其 AWS 基础设施资源。公司需要备份所有 AWS 资源。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A social media company wants to allow its users to upload images in an application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a solution that automatically resizes the images so that the images can be displayed on multiple device types. The application experiences unpredictable traffic patterns throughout the day. The company is seeking a highly available solution that maximizes scalability. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a static website hosted in Amazon S3 that invokes AWS Lambda functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一个托管在 Amazon S3 上的静态网站，由它调用 AWS Lambda 函数来缩放图片，并把图片存入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create a static website hosted in Amazon CloudFront that invokes AWS Step Functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon RDS database.
options.text_zh: 创建一个托管在 Amazon CloudFront 上的静态网站，由它调用 AWS Step Functions 来缩放图片，并把图片存入一个 Amazon RDS 数据库。

options.text_en: Create a dynamic website hosted on a web server that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure a process that runs on the EC2 instance to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一个动态网站，托管在运行于 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 服务器。在该 EC2 实例上配置一个进程来缩放图片，并把图片存入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create a dynamic website hosted on an automatically scaling Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that creates a resize job in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Set up an image-resizing program that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance to process the resize jobs.
options.text_zh: 创建一个动态网站，托管在自动伸缩的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群上，由它在 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 中创建缩放作业。再配置一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的图片缩放程序来处理这些作业。

explanation_en:
Hosting a static website in Amazon S3 is a cost-effective and highly available solution. Amazon S3 provides scalable and durable object storage.
A static website in S3 can serve as the front end for user interactions.
In this option, Lambda functions can be triggered by events (e.g., new image uploads to an S3 bucket) to perform image resizing. Lambda can efficiently handle sporadic and unpredictable workloads.
explanation_zh:
在 Amazon S3 中托管静态网站是一种具有成本效益且高可用的方案。Amazon S3 提供可扩展且持久的对象存储。
S3 中的静态网站可以作为用户交互的前端。
在此选项中，Lambda 函数可由事件（例如向 S3 存储桶上传新图片）触发以执行图片尺寸调整。Lambda 能够高效应对零星且不可预测的工作负载。
stem_zh:
某社交媒体公司希望允许其用户在一个托管于 AWS 云中的应用程序中上传图片。公司需要一个能自动调整图片尺寸的方案，以便图片能在多种设备类型上显示。该应用程序全天的流量模式不可预测。公司正在寻求一个高可用且可扩展性最大化的方案。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is running a microservices application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to migrate the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster for scalability. The company must configure the Amazon EKS control plane with endpoint private access set to true and endpoint public access set to false to maintain security compliance. The company must also put the data plane in private subnets. However, the company has received error notifications because the node cannot join the cluster. Which solution will allow the node to join the cluster?

options.text_en: Grant the required permission in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to the AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM role.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中给 AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM 角色授予所需权限。

options.text_en: Create interface VPC endpoints to allow nodes to access the control plane.
options.text_zh: 创建接口 VPC 端点，让节点能访问控制平面。

options.text_en: Recreate nodes in the public subnet. Restrict security groups for EC2 nodes.
options.text_zh: 在公有子网中重建这些节点，并收紧 EC2 节点的安全组。

options.text_en: Allow outbound traffic in the security group of the nodes.
options.text_zh: 在这些节点的安全组中放通出站流量。

explanation_en:
When the Amazon EKS control plane has private access, nodes need to communicate with the control plane through interface VPC endpoints.
Creating interface VPC endpoints ensures that the nodes in private subnets can securely communicate with the EKS control plane without the need for public IP addresses.
explanation_zh:
当 Amazon EKS 控制平面为私有访问时，节点需要通过接口型 VPC 终端节点与控制平面通信。
创建接口型 VPC 终端节点可确保私有子网中的节点无需公有 IP 地址即可安全地与 EKS 控制平面通信。
stem_zh:
某公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个微服务应用程序。公司希望将该应用程序迁移到一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）集群以获得可扩展性。为保持安全合规，公司必须将 Amazon EKS 控制平面配置为终端节点私有访问设为 true、终端节点公有访问设为 false。公司还必须将数据平面置于私有子网中。然而，公司收到了错误通知，因为节点无法加入集群。

哪个方案能让节点加入集群？

stem_en: A company is migrating an on-premises application to AWS. The company wants to use Amazon Redshift as a solution. Which use cases are suitable for Amazon Redshift in this scenario? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications
options.text_zh: 提供数据 API，供传统应用、容器化应用和事件驱动应用访问数据

options.text_en: Supporting client-side and server-side encryption
options.text_zh: 支持客户端加密和服务器端加密

options.text_en: Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active
options.text_zh: 在指定时段以及应用不活跃时构建分析工作负载

options.text_en: Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database
options.text_zh: 缓存数据以减轻后端数据库的压力

options.text_en: Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute
options.text_zh: 全球伸缩，支撑 PB 级数据和每分钟数千万次请求

options.text_en: Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console
options.text_zh: 通过 AWS 管理控制台创建该集群的辅助副本

explanation_en:
C. Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active

E. Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute
Amazon Redshift supports encryption for data at rest and in transit, providing security features for sensitive data. This makes it suitable for scenarios where encryption is a requirement.
Amazon Redshift is a fully managed data warehouse service optimized for analytical queries. Running analytics workloads during specified hours aligns with Redshift's strengths, allowing for efficient query processing and analysis.
explanation_zh:
C. 在指定时段以及应用程序不活跃时构建分析工作负载

E. 全球扩展以支持 PB 级数据和每分钟数千万次请求
Amazon Redshift 支持静态数据和传输中数据的加密，为敏感数据提供安全特性。这使其适合需要加密的场景。
Amazon Redshift 是一项针对分析查询优化的全托管数据仓库服务。在指定时段运行分析工作负载与 Redshift 的优势相契合，可实现高效的查询处理和分析。
stem_zh:
某公司正在将一个本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。公司希望使用 Amazon Redshift 作为方案。

在此场景中，哪些用例适合使用 Amazon Redshift？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company provides an API interface to customers so the customers can retrieve their financial information. Е he company expects a larger number of requests during peak usage times of the year. The company requires the API to respond consistently with low latency to ensure customer satisfaction. The company needs to provide a compute host for the API. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use an Application Load Balancer and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).
options.text_zh: 使用 Application Load Balancer 搭配 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 搭配配置了预置并发的 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Use an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
options.text_zh: 使用 Application Load Balancer 搭配 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 搭配配置了预留并发的 AWS Lambda 函数。

explanation_en:
Amazon API Gateway is a fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale.
AWS Lambda is a serverless computing service that automatically scales based on demand.
Provisioned concurrency in AWS Lambda allows you to set a specific number of concurrent executions to ensure that the function is ready to respond quickly to incoming requests.
explanation_zh:
Amazon API Gateway 是一项全托管服务，让开发人员能够轻松地以任意规模创建、发布、维护、监控和保护 API。
AWS Lambda 是一项根据需求自动伸缩的无服务器计算服务。
AWS Lambda 中的预置并发允许你设定特定数量的并发执行，确保函数随时准备好快速响应传入请求。
stem_zh:
某公司向客户提供一个 API 接口，以便客户能够检索其财务信息。公司预计在一年中的使用高峰期会有大量请求。

公司要求该 API 以低延迟稳定响应，以确保客户满意度。公司需要为该 API 提供一个计算主机。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to send all AWS Systems Manager Session Manager logs to an Amazon S3 bucket for archival purposes. Which solution will meet this requirement with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.text_en: Enable S3 logging in the Systems Manager console. Choose an S3 bucket to send the session data to.
options.text_zh: 在 Systems Manager 控制台中启用 S3 日志记录。选择一个 S3 存储桶来接收会话数据。

options.text_en: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Export the logs to an S3 bucket from the group for archival purposes.
options.text_zh: 安装 Amazon CloudWatch 代理。把所有日志推送到一个 CloudWatch 日志组。再从该日志组把日志导出到一个 S3 存储桶用于归档。

options.text_en: Create a Systems Manager document to upload all server logs to a central S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the Systems Manager document against all servers that are in the account daily.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Systems Manager 文档，把所有服务器日志上传到一个中心 S3 存储桶。用 Amazon EventBridge 每天对账户中的所有服务器运行该 Systems Manager 文档。

options.text_en: Install an Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Create a CloudWatch logs subscription that pushes any incoming log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Set Amazon S3 as the destination.
options.text_zh: 安装 Amazon CloudWatch 代理。把所有日志推送到一个 CloudWatch 日志组。创建一个 CloudWatch Logs 订阅，把所有到达的日志事件推送到一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 投递流。把 Amazon S3 设为目标。

explanation_en:
While AWS Systems Manager supports logging command output to an S3 bucket, this is primarily for storing the output of commands executed through Systems Manager, not specifically for Session Manager logs.
It may not capture all the detailed session logs, including interactive session input/output and other session-specific details.
explanation_zh:
虽然 AWS Systems Manager 支持将命令输出记录到 S3 存储桶，但这主要用于存储通过 Systems Manager 执行的命令的输出，而非专门针对 Session Manager 日志。
它可能无法捕获所有详细的会话日志，包括交互式会话的输入/输出以及其他会话特有的细节。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将所有 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 日志发送到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶以便归档。

哪个方案能以最高的运维效率满足此要求？

stem_en: An application uses an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. The RDS database is becoming low on disk space. A solutions architect wants to increase the disk space without downtime. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.text_en: Enable storage autoscaling in RDS
options.text_zh: 在 RDS 中启用存储自动伸缩。

options.text_en: Increase the RDS database instance size
options.text_zh: 把该 RDS 数据库实例规格调大。

options.text_en: Change the RDS database instance storage type to Provisioned IOPS
options.text_zh: 把该 RDS 数据库实例的存储类型改为预置 IOPS。

options.text_en: Back up the RDS database, increase the storage capacity, restore the database, and stop the previous instance
options.text_zh: 备份该 RDS 数据库，扩大存储容量，恢复数据库，然后停掉原来的实例。

explanation_en:
Enabling storage autoscaling allows Amazon RDS to automatically adjust the storage capacity of the database without requiring manual intervention.
With autoscaling, the storage capacity can increase dynamically based on the actual usage, preventing the need for manual adjustments.
explanation_zh:
启用存储自动伸缩可让 Amazon RDS 自动调整数据库的存储容量，无需人工干预。
借助自动伸缩，存储容量可根据实际使用情况动态增加，从而避免手动调整的需要。
stem_zh:
某应用程序使用一个 Amazon RDS MySQL 数据库实例。该 RDS 数据库的磁盘空间即将不足。一位解决方案架构师希望在不停机的情况下增加磁盘空间。

哪个方案能以最少的工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A consulting company provides professional services to customers worldwide. The company provides solutions and tools for customers to expedite gathering and analyzing data on AWS. The company needs to centrally manage and deploy a common set of solutions and tools for customers to use for self-service purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create AWS CloudFormation templates for the customers.
options.text_zh: 为客户创建 AWS CloudFormation 模板。

options.text_en: Create AWS Service Catalog products for the customers.
options.text_zh: 为客户创建 AWS Service Catalog 产品。

options.text_en: Create AWS Systems Manager templates for the customers.
options.text_zh: 为客户创建 AWS Systems Manager 模板。

options.text_en: Create AWS Config items for the customers.
options.text_zh: 为客户创建 AWS Config 项。

explanation_en: AWS Service Catalog allows you to create and manage catalogs of IT services that are approved for use on AWS. It enables you to centrally manage and distribute standardized product portfolios.
explanation_zh: AWS Service Catalog 允许你创建和管理已批准在 AWS 上使用的 IT 服务目录。它使你能够集中管理和分发标准化的产品组合。
stem_zh:
某咨询公司为全球客户提供专业服务。公司提供解决方案和工具，帮助客户加快在 AWS 上收集和分析数据。公司需要集中管理和部署一套通用的解决方案与工具，供客户自助使用。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing a new web application that will run on Amazon EC2 Instances. The application will use Amazon DynamoDB for backend data storage. The application traffic will be unpredictable. The company expects that the application read and write throughput to the database will be moderate to high. The company needs to scale in response to application traffic. Which DynamoDB table configuration will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity.
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB Standard 表类，配置预置读写容量。把 DynamoDB 自动伸缩设置一个容量上限。

options.text_en: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard table class.
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB Standard 表类，把 DynamoDB 配置为按需模式。

options.text_en: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity.
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) 表类，配置预置读写容量。把 DynamoDB 自动伸缩设置一个容量上限。

options.text_en: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) table class.
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) 表类，把 DynamoDB 配置为按需模式。

explanation_en:
On-demand capacity mode allows DynamoDB to automatically scale read and write capacity based on actual application traffic.
It eliminates the need for manual provisioning of read and write capacity, making it well-suited for unpredictable workloads.
DynamoDB Standard Table Class:

The DynamoDB Standard table class provides general-purpose storage with consistent, single-digit millisecond latency. It's suitable for a wide range of applications, including those with unpredictable traffic
explanation_zh:
按需容量模式允许 DynamoDB 根据实际应用流量自动伸缩读写容量。
它免去了手动预置读写容量的需要，因此非常适合不可预测的工作负载。
DynamoDB Standard 表类：

DynamoDB Standard 表类提供通用型存储，具有稳定的个位数毫秒级延迟。它适合各种应用程序，包括流量不可预测的应用。
stem_zh:
某公司正在设计一个将运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的新 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将使用 Amazon DynamoDB 进行后端数据存储。应用程序流量将不可预测。公司预计该应用程序对数据库的读写吞吐量将处于中到高水平。公司需要根据应用程序流量进行伸缩。

哪种 DynamoDB 表配置能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A retail company has several businesses. The IT team for each business manages its own AWS account. Each team account is part of an organization in AWS Organizations. Each team monitors its product inventory levels in an Amazon DynamoDB table in the team's own AWS account. The company is deploying a central inventory reporting application into a shared AWS account. The application must be able to read items from all the teams' DynamoDB tables. Which authentication option will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.text_en: Integrate DynamoDB with AWS Secrets Manager in the inventory application account. Configure the application to use the correct secret from Secrets Manager to authenticate and read the DynamoDB table. Schedule secret rotation for every 30 days.
options.text_zh: 在库存应用账户中把 DynamoDB 与 AWS Secrets Manager 集成。配置应用使用 Secrets Manager 中正确的密钥项来认证并读取该 DynamoDB 表。把密钥轮换安排为每 30 天一次。

options.text_en: In every business account, create an IAM user that has programmatic access. Configure the application to use the correct IAM user access key ID and secret access key to authenticate and read the DynamoDB table. Manually rotate IAM access keys every 30 days.
options.text_zh: 在每个业务账户中创建一个具备编程访问权限的 IAM 用户。配置应用使用对应的 IAM 用户访问密钥 ID 和私有访问密钥来认证并读取该 DynamoDB 表。每 30 天手动轮换一次 IAM 访问密钥。

options.text_en: In every business account, create an IAM role named BU_ROLE with a policy that gives the role access to the DynamoDB table and a trust policy to trust a specific role in the inventory application account. In the inventory account, create a role named APP_ROLE that allows access to the STS AssumeRole API operation. Configure the application to use APP_ROLE and assume the crossaccount role BU_ROLE to read the DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 在每个业务账户中创建一个名为 BU_ROLE 的 IAM 角色，其策略授予该角色访问 DynamoDB 表的权限，并在信任策略中信任库存应用账户中的某个特定角色。在库存账户中创建一个名为 APP_ROLE 的角色，允许其调用 STS AssumeRole API 操作。配置应用使用 APP_ROLE 并代入跨账户角色 BU_ROLE 来读取该 DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Integrate DynamoDB with AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Generate identity certificates to authenticate DynamoDB. Configure the application to use the correct certificate to authenticate and read the DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 把 DynamoDB 与 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 集成。生成身份证书用于 DynamoDB 认证。配置应用使用正确的证书来认证并读取该 DynamoDB 表。

stem_zh:
某零售公司有多项业务。每项业务的 IT 团队管理自己的 AWS 账户。每个团队账户都是 AWS Organizations 中某个组织的一部分。每个团队在其自有 AWS 账户中的一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表里监控自己的产品库存水平。

公司正在向一个共享 AWS 账户中部署一个中央库存报表应用程序。该应用程序必须能够读取所有团队的 DynamoDB 表中的条目。

哪个身份验证选项能最安全地满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs container applications by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The company's workload is not consistent throughout the day. The company wants Amazon EKS to scale in and out according to the workload. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to resize the EKS cluster.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调整该 EKS 集群的规模。

options.text_en: Use the Kubernetes Metrics Server to activate horizontal pod autoscaling.
options.text_zh: 用 Kubernetes Metrics Server 启用 Pod 水平自动伸缩。

options.text_en: Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
options.text_zh: 用 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 来管理集群中的节点数量。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway and connect it to Amazon EKS.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 并把它接到 Amazon EKS。

options.text_en: Use AWS App Mesh to observe network activity.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS App Mesh 来观测网络活动。

explanation_en:
Kubernetes supports Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) based on custom metrics or resource metrics.
By using the Kubernetes Metrics Server, you can enable HPA to automatically adjust the number of pods in a deployment based on observed custom metrics (such as application-specific metrics) or resource metrics (such as CPU or memory usage).

C. Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler:

The Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler automatically adjusts the size of the cluster by adding or removing nodes based on the resource utilization and pod scheduling requirements.
This helps in scaling the cluster itself based on the overall demand.
explanation_zh:
Kubernetes 支持基于自定义指标或资源指标的 Pod 水平自动伸缩（HPA）。
通过使用 Kubernetes Metrics Server，你可以启用 HPA，根据观测到的自定义指标（例如应用程序特有指标）或资源指标（例如 CPU 或内存使用率）自动调整某个部署中的 Pod 数量。

C. 使用 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler：

Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 会根据资源利用率和 Pod 调度需求，通过增删节点自动调整集群规模。
这有助于根据总体需求对集群本身进行伸缩。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）运行容器应用程序。公司的工作负载在一天中并不稳定。公司希望 Amazon EKS 能够根据工作负载扩容和缩容。

哪些步骤组合能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs a microservice-based serverless web application. The application must be able to retrieve data from multiple Amazon DynamoDB tables A solutions architect needs to give the application the ability to retrieve the data with no impact on the baseline performance of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: AWS AppSync pipeline resolvers
options.text_zh: AWS AppSync 管道解析器

options.text_en: Amazon CloudFront with Lambda@Edge functions
options.text_zh: Amazon CloudFront 搭配 Lambda@Edge 函数

options.text_en: Edge-optimized Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions
options.text_zh: 边缘优化的 Amazon API Gateway 搭配 AWS Lambda 函数

options.text_en: Amazon Athena Federated Query with a DynamoDB connector
options.text_zh: Amazon Athena 联合查询搭配 DynamoDB 连接器

explanation_en:
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that can distribute content globally with low latency.
Lambda@Edge allows you to run custom code in response to CloudFront events, such as viewer requests, origin requests, and more.
By using Lambda@Edge functions, you can customize and augment the behavior of CloudFront.
explanation_zh:
Amazon CloudFront 是一项内容分发网络（CDN）服务，能以低延迟在全球分发内容。
Lambda@Edge 允许你运行自定义代码来响应 CloudFront 事件，例如访问者请求、源站请求等。
通过使用 Lambda@Edge 函数，你可以自定义和增强 CloudFront 的行为。
stem_zh:
某公司运行一个基于微服务的无服务器 Web 应用程序。该应用程序必须能够从多张 Amazon DynamoDB 表中检索数据。解决方案架构师需要让该应用程序具备检索这些数据的能力，同时不影响应用程序的基准性能。

哪个方案能以运维上最高效的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to analyze and troubleshoot Access Denied errors and Unauthorized errors that are related to IAM permissions. The company has AWS CloudTrail turned on. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue and write custom scripts to query CloudTrail logs for the errors.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Glue 编写自定义脚本来查询 CloudTrail 日志中的这些错误。

options.text_en: Use AWS Batch and write custom scripts to query CloudTrail logs for the errors.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Batch 编写自定义脚本来查询 CloudTrail 日志中的这些错误。

options.text_en: Search CloudTrail logs with Amazon Athena queries to identify the errors.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Athena 查询检索 CloudTrail 日志来定位这些错误。

options.text_en: Search CloudTrail logs with Amazon QuickSight. Create a dashboard to identify the errors.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon QuickSight 检索 CloudTrail 日志，创建一个仪表板来定位这些错误。

explanation_en:
Amazon Athena allows you to query data directly from S3 using standard SQL queries.
CloudTrail logs can be stored in Amazon S3, and Athena makes it easy to analyze the logs using SQL queries.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Athena 允许你使用标准 SQL 查询直接从 S3 查询数据。
Amazon Athena 允许你使用标准 SQL 查询直接从 S3 查询数据。
CloudTrail 日志可以存储在 Amazon S3 中，Athena 让你能够轻松地使用 SQL 查询分析这些日志。
stem_zh:
某公司希望分析和排查与 IAM 权限相关的 Access Denied 错误和 Unauthorized 错误。公司已开启 AWS CloudTrail。

哪个方案能以最少的工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to add its existing AWS usage cost to its operation cost dashboard. A solutions architect needs to recommend a solution that will give the company access to its usage cost programmatically. The company must be able to access cost data for the current year and forecast costs for the next 12 months. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Access usage cost-related data by using the AWS Cost Explorer API with pagination.
options.text_zh: 使用带分页的 AWS Cost Explorer API 来获取用量成本相关数据。

options.text_en: Access usage cost-related data by using downloadable AWS Cost Explorer report .csv files.
options.text_zh: 使用可下载的 AWS Cost Explorer 报告 .csv 文件来获取用量成本相关数据。

options.text_en: Configure AWS Budgets actions to send usage cost data to the company through FTP.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Budgets 操作，通过 FTP 把用量成本数据发送给公司。

options.text_en: Create AWS Budgets reports for usage cost data. Send the data to the company through SMTP.
options.text_zh: 为用量成本数据创建 AWS Budgets 报告，通过 SMTP 把数据发送给公司。

explanation_en: AWS Cost Explorer is a tool provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS) that allows users to visualize, understand, and manage their AWS costs and usage.
explanation_zh: AWS Cost Explorer 是 Amazon Web Services（AWS）提供的一款工具，允许用户可视化、理解和管理其 AWS 成本与使用情况。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将其现有的 AWS 使用成本添加到运营成本仪表板中。解决方案架构师需要推荐一个方案，让公司能够以编程方式访问其使用成本。公司必须能够访问当年的成本数据，并预测未来 12 个月的成本。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is reviewing the resilience of an application. The solutions architect notices that a database administrator recently failed over the application's Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database writer instance as part of a scaling exercise. The failover resulted in 3 minutes of downtime for the application. Which solution will reduce the downtime for scaling exercises with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create more Aurora PostgreSQL read replicas in the cluster to handle the load during failover.
options.text_zh: 在该集群中增加更多 Aurora PostgreSQL 只读副本，以在故障转移期间承担负载。

options.text_en: Set up a secondary Aurora PostgreSQL cluster in the same AWS Region. During failover, update the application to use the secondary cluster's writer endpoint.
options.text_zh: 在同一个 AWS 区域再建一个辅助 Aurora PostgreSQL 集群。故障转移时更新应用改用辅助集群的写入端点。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster to handle the load during failover.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 集群，以在故障转移期间承担负载。

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon RDS proxy for the database. Update the application to use the proxy endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库配置一个 Amazon RDS 代理。更新应用改用该代理端点。

explanation_en: Amazon RDS Proxy is a fully managed, highly available database proxy for Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service). It provides connection pooling, read/write splitting, and automatic failover, helping to improve the availability and scalability of database workloads.
explanation_zh: Amazon RDS Proxy 是面向 Amazon RDS（关系数据库服务）的全托管、高可用数据库代理。它提供连接池、读写分离和自动故障转移，有助于提升数据库工作负载的可用性和可扩展性。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在评审某应用程序的韧性。解决方案架构师注意到，一位数据库管理员最近在一次扩容操作中对该应用程序的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库写入实例执行了故障转移。该故障转移导致应用程序停机 3 分钟。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销减少扩容操作时的停机时间？

stem_en: A company has a regional subscription-based streaming service that runs in a single AWS Region. The architecture consists of web servers and application servers on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in Auto Scaling groups behind Elastic Load Balancers. The architecture includes an Amazon Aurora global database cluster that extends across multiple Availability Zones. The company wants to expand globally and to ensure that its application has minimal downtime. Which solution will provide the MOST fault tolerance?

options.text_en: Extend the Auto Scaling groups for the web tier and the application tier to deploy instances in Availability Zones in a second Region. Use an Aurora global database to deploy the database in the primary Region and the second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks with a failover routing policy to the second Region.
options.text_zh: 扩展 Web 层和应用层的 Auto Scaling 组，在第二个区域的可用区中也部署实例。用 Aurora 全局数据库在主区域和第二区域部署数据库。用带故障转移路由策略的 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查切换到第二区域。

options.text_en: Deploy the web tier and the application tier to a second Region. Add an Aurora PostgreSQL cross-Region Aurora Replica in the second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks with a failover routing policy to the second Region. Promote the secondary to primary as needed.
options.text_zh: 把 Web 层和应用层部署到第二个区域。在第二个区域添加一个 Aurora PostgreSQL 跨区域 Aurora 副本。用带故障转移路由策略的 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查切换到第二个区域。必要时把辅助库提升为主库。

options.text_en: Deploy the web tier and the application tier to a second Region. Create an Aurora PostgreSQL database in the second Region. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the primary database to the second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks with a failover routing policy to the second Region.
options.text_zh: 把 Web 层和应用层部署到第二个区域。在第二个区域创建一个 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库。用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 把主数据库复制到第二个区域。用带故障转移路由策略的 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查切换到第二个区域。

options.text_en: Deploy the web tier and the application tier to a second Region. Use an Amazon Aurora global database to deploy the database in the primary Region and the second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks with a failover routing policy to the second Region. Promote the secondary to primary as needed.
options.text_zh: 把 Web 层和应用层部署到第二个区域。用 Amazon Aurora 全局数据库在主区域和第二区域部署数据库。用带故障转移路由策略的 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查切换到第二个区域。必要时把辅助库提升为主库。

explanation_en:
An Aurora global database allows you to replicate your database across multiple AWS Regions. This ensures that you have a read-capable secondary database in the second Region, providing low-latency access to the database.
Amazon Route 53 can be configured with health checks to monitor the health of the web and application tiers in both Regions. In the event of a failure in the primary Region, Route 53 can automatically route traffic to the healthy resources in the second Region.
explanation_zh:
Aurora 全球数据库允许你跨多个 AWS 区域复制数据库。这确保你在第二个区域拥有一个可读的辅助数据库，提供对数据库的低延迟访问。
Amazon Route 53 可配置健康检查来监控两个区域中 Web 层和应用层的健康状况。当主区域发生故障时，Route 53 可自动将流量路由到第二个区域中健康的资源。
stem_zh:
某公司有一项运行在单个 AWS 区域中的区域性订阅制流媒体服务。该架构由 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 服务器和应用服务器组成。这些 EC2 实例位于 Elastic Load Balancer 之后的 Auto Scaling 组中。该架构包含一个跨多个可用区的 Amazon Aurora 全球数据库集群。

公司希望向全球扩张，并确保其应用程序的停机时间最短。

哪个方案能提供最强的容错能力？

stem_en: A data analytics company wants to migrate its batch processing system to AWS. The company receives thousands of small data files periodically during the day through FTP. An on-premises batch job processes the data files overnight. However, the batch job takes hours to finish running. The company wants the AWS solution to process incoming data files as soon as possible with minimal changes to the FTP clients that send the files. The solution must delete the incoming data files after the files have been processed successfully. Processing for each file needs to take 3-8 minutes. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.text_en: Use an Amazon EC2 instance that runs an FTP server to store incoming files as objects in Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Configure a job queue in AWS Batch. Use Amazon EventBridge rules to invoke the job to process the objects nightly from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Delete the objects after the job has processed the objects.
