The sensors will feed a database through HTTP requests that will add up usage for each tenant. The solutions architect must use managed services when possible. The workload will receive more features in the future as the solutions architect adds independent components. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 配合 AWS Lambda 函数接收传感器数据、处理数据，并把数据存入一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

options.text_en: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the processed data.
options.text_zh: 用一个由 Amazon EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组支撑的弹性负载均衡器来接收和处理传感器数据。用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶存放处理后的数据。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in a Microsoft SQL Server Express database on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 配合 AWS Lambda 函数接收传感器数据、处理数据，并把数据存入一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Microsoft SQL Server Express 数据库。

options.text_en: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) shared file system to store the processed data.
options.text_zh: 用一个由 Amazon EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组支撑的弹性负载均衡器来接收和处理传感器数据。用一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 共享文件系统存放处理后的数据。

explanation_en:
Amazon API Gateway is a fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale. It acts as an entry point for HTTP requests and can handle the communication with the sensors.
In this scenario, you can use Lambda functions to process the data received from the sensors. 
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database that can handle the storage of the hourly energy consumption data.
explanation_zh:
Amazon API Gateway 是一项全托管服务，让开发人员能够轻松地以任意规模创建、发布、维护、监控和保护 API。它充当 HTTP 请求的入口，可以处理与传感器的通信。
在此场景中，你可以使用 Lambda 函数处理从传感器接收到的数据。
Amazon DynamoDB 是一款全托管的 NoSQL 数据库，可以处理每小时能耗数据的存储。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个工作负载，用于存储某栋建筑内商业租户的每小时能耗数据。传感器将通过 HTTP 请求向数据库输送数据，并累计每位租户的用量。解决方案架构师必须尽可能使用托管服务。随着解决方案架构师添加独立组件，该工作负载今后还会增加更多功能。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing the storage architecture for a new web application used for storing and viewing engineering drawings. All application components will be deployed on the AWS infrastructure. The application design must support caching to minimize the amount of time that users wait for the engineering drawings to load. The application must be able to store petabytes of data. Which combination of storage and caching should the solutions architect use?

options.text_en: Amazon S3 with Amazon CloudFront
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 搭配 Amazon CloudFront

options.text_en: Amazon S3 Glacier with Amazon ElastiCache
options.text_zh: Amazon S3 Glacier 搭配 Amazon ElastiCache

options.text_en: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes with Amazon CloudFront
options.text_zh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷搭配 Amazon CloudFront

options.text_en: AWS Storage Gateway with Amazon ElastiCache
options.text_zh: AWS Storage Gateway 搭配 Amazon ElastiCache

explanation_en:
It is suitable for storing petabytes of data and is designed to provide low-latency access.
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to customers globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. By integrating CloudFront with S3, you can distribute the engineering drawings to edge locations worldwide, reducing the latency for users and improving load times.
explanation_zh:
它适合存储 PB 级数据，并被设计为提供低延迟访问。
Amazon CloudFront 是一项内容分发网络（CDN）服务，能以低延迟和高传输速度向全球客户安全地交付数据、视频、应用程序和 API。通过将 CloudFront 与 S3 集成，你可以将工程图纸分发到全球各地的边缘站点，从而降低用户延迟并改善加载时间。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为一个新的 Web 应用程序设计存储架构，该应用程序用于存储和查看工程图纸。所有应用程序组件都将部署在 AWS 基础设施上。

该应用程序设计必须支持缓存，以尽量缩短用户等待工程图纸加载的时间。该应用程序必须能够存储 PB 级数据。

解决方案架构师应使用哪种存储与缓存组合？

stem_en: An Amazon EventBridge rule targets a third-party API. The third-party API has not received any incoming traffic. A solutions architect needs to determine whether the rule conditions are being met and if the rule's target is being invoked. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Check for metrics in Amazon CloudWatch in the namespace for AWS/Events.
options.text_zh: 查看 Amazon CloudWatch 中 AWS/Events 命名空间下的指标。

options.text_en: Review events in the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue.
options.text_zh: 查看 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 死信队列中的事件。

options.text_en: Check for the events in Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中查看这些事件。

options.text_en: Check the trails in AWS CloudTrail for the EventBridge events.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS CloudTrail 的跟踪记录中查看这些 EventBridge 事件。

stem_zh:
一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则以一个第三方 API 为目标。该第三方 API 未收到任何传入流量。解决方案架构师需要判断该规则的条件是否被满足，以及该规则的目标是否被调用。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a large workload that runs every Friday evening. The workload runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in two Availability Zones in the us-east-1 Region. Normally, the company must run no more than two instances at all times. However, the company wants to scale up to six instances each Friday to handle a regularly repeating increased workload. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a reminder in Amazon EventBridge to scale the instances.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中创建一个提醒，用于伸缩实例。

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a scheduled action.
options.text_zh: 创建一个带计划操作的 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses manual scaling.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用手动伸缩的 Auto Scaling 组。

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses automatic scaling.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用自动伸缩的 Auto Scaling 组。

explanation_en: By creating an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled action, you can configure the group to automatically adjust the desired capacity based on a specified schedule. In this case, you can set up a scheduled action to increase the desired capacity to six instances every Friday evening.
explanation_zh: 通过创建带计划操作的 Auto Scaling 组，你可以配置该组按照指定的时间表自动调整期望容量。在此场景中，你可以设置一个计划操作，在每周五晚上将期望容量提高到六台实例。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个每周五晚上运行的大型工作负载。该工作负载运行在 us-east-1 区域两个可用区中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。通常情况下，公司必须始终运行不超过两台实例。但公司希望每周五扩容到六台实例，以应对这个有规律重复出现的负载增长。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is creating a REST API. The company has strict requirements for the use of TLS. The company requires TLSv1.3 on the API endpoints. The company also requires a specific public third-party certificate authority (CA) to sign the TLS certificate. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use a local machine to create a certificate that is signed by the third-party CImport the certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an HTTP API in Amazon API Gateway with a custom domain. Configure the custom domain to use the certificate.
options.text_zh: 在本地机器上创建一张由该第三方 CA 签发的证书。把证书导入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。在 Amazon API Gateway 中创建一个带自定义域名的 HTTP API。把该自定义域名配置为使用这张证书。

options.text_en: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) that is signed by the third-party CA. Create an HTTP API in Amazon API Gateway with a custom domain. Configure the custom domain to use the certificate.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中创建一张由该第三方 CA 签发的证书。在 Amazon API Gateway 中创建一个带自定义域名的 HTTP API。把该自定义域名配置为使用这张证书。

options.text_en: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate that is signed by the third-party CA. Import the certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an AWS Lambda function with a Lambda function URL. Configure the Lambda function URL to use the certificate.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建一张由该第三方 CA 签发的证书。把证书导入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。创建一个带函数 URL 的 AWS Lambda 函数。把该 Lambda 函数 URL 配置为使用这张证书。

options.text_en: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) that is signed by the third-party CA. Create an AWS Lambda function with a Lambda function URL. Configure the Lambda function URL to use the certificate.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中创建一张由该第三方 CA 签发的证书。创建一个带函数 URL 的 AWS Lambda 函数。把该 Lambda 函数 URL 配置为使用这张证书。

stem_zh:
某公司正在创建一个 REST API。公司对 TLS 的使用有严格要求，要求 API 终端节点使用 TLSv1.3。公司还要求由某个特定的公共第三方证书颁发机构（CA）签发该 TLS 证书。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs an application on AWS. The application receives inconsistent amounts of usage. The application uses AWS Direct Connect to connect to an on-premises MySQL-compatible database. The on-premises database consistently uses a minimum of 2 GiB of memory. The company wants to migrate the on-premises database to a managed AWS service. The company wants to use auto scaling capabilities to manage unexpected workload increases. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon DynamoDB database with default read and write capacity settings.
options.text_zh: 预置一个采用默认读写容量设置的 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库。

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon Aurora database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU).
options.text_zh: 预置一个最小容量为 1 个 Aurora 容量单位 (ACU) 的 Amazon Aurora 数据库。

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU).
options.text_zh: 预置一个最小容量为 1 个 Aurora 容量单位 (ACU) 的 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 数据库。

options.text_en: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL database with 2 GiB of memory.
options.text_zh: 预置一个 2 GiB 内存的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库。

explanation_en: Aurora Serverless is designed for applications with variable or unpredictable workloads. With Aurora Serverless v2, you can set the minimum capacity to 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU), and it will automatically scale based on the actual workload.
explanation_zh: Aurora Serverless 专为工作负载多变或不可预测的应用程序而设计。使用 Aurora Serverless v2，你可以将最小容量设为 1 个 Aurora 容量单位（ACU），它会根据实际工作负载自动伸缩。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序的使用量并不稳定。该应用程序使用 AWS Direct Connect 连接到一个本地的兼容 MySQL 的数据库。该本地数据库始终至少占用 2 GiB 内存。

公司希望将该本地数据库迁移到一项托管的 AWS 服务。公司希望使用自动伸缩能力来应对意外的工作负载增长。

哪个方案能以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to use an event-driven programming model with AWS Lambda. The company wants to reduce startup latency for Lambda functions that run on Java 11. The company does not have strict latency requirements for the applications. The company wants to reduce cold starts and outlier latencies when a function scales up. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure Lambda provisioned concurrency.
options.text_zh: 配置 Lambda 预置并发。

options.text_en: Increase the timeout of the Lambda functions.
options.text_zh: 延长这些 Lambda 函数的超时时间。

options.text_en: Increase the memory of the Lambda functions.
options.text_zh: 增加这些 Lambda 函数的内存。

options.text_en: Configure Lambda SnapStart.
options.text_zh: 配置 Lambda SnapStart。

explanation_en:
Lambda Cold Start:
When a Lambda function is invoked, it may take a bit of time for the system to set up everything needed to run the function. This initial setup time is called a "cold start." Cold starts can add some delay, especially if the function hasn't been used recently.
Lambda SnapStart:
SnapStart is a feature in AWS Lambda designed to make these cold starts faster, specifically for functions written in Java. Instead of starting from scratch every time a function is called, SnapStart pre-warms the environment. It's like getting things ready in advance so that when your function is called, it can start quickly without much delay.
explanation_zh:
Lambda 冷启动：
当一个 Lambda 函数被调用时，系统可能需要一些时间来准备运行该函数所需的一切。这段初始准备时间被称为"冷启动"。冷启动会带来一定延迟，尤其是在该函数近期未被使用时。
Lambda SnapStart：
SnapStart 是 AWS Lambda 中的一项功能，专为加快这些冷启动而设计，特别是针对用 Java 编写的函数。SnapStart 会预热运行环境，而不是每次调用函数时都从头开始。这就像提前把东西准备好，这样当你的函数被调用时，它就能迅速启动而不会有太多延迟。
stem_zh:
某公司希望在 AWS Lambda 上使用事件驱动编程模型。公司希望降低运行在 Java 11 上的 Lambda 函数的启动延迟。公司对这些应用程序没有严格的延迟要求。公司希望在函数扩容时减少冷启动和异常的高延迟。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A financial services company launched a new application that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The company uses the application to track stock market trends. The company needs to operate the application for only 2 hours at the end of each week. The company needs to optimize the cost of running the database. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora Serverless v2 MySQL database cluster.
options.text_zh: 把现有的 RDS for MySQL 数据库迁移到 Aurora Serverless v2 MySQL 数据库集群。

options.text_en: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora MySQL database cluster.
options.text_zh: 把现有的 RDS for MySQL 数据库迁移到 Aurora MySQL 数据库集群。

options.text_en: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs MySQL. Purchase an instance reservation for the EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 把现有的 RDS for MySQL 数据库迁移到一台运行 MySQL 的 Amazon EC2 实例，并为该 EC2 实例购买实例预留。

options.text_en: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses MySQL container images to run tasks.
options.text_zh: 把现有的 RDS for MySQL 数据库迁移到一个用 MySQL 容器镜像运行任务的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。

explanation_en: Aurora Serverless allows the database to automatically start up, shut down, and scale capacity based on actual usage. With Aurora Serverless v2, you can set a minimum and maximum capacity for the cluster. This is suitable for intermittent workloads, such as the application that is only operated for 2 hours at the end of each week.
explanation_zh: Aurora Serverless 允许数据库根据实际使用情况自动启动、关闭和伸缩容量。使用 Aurora Serverless v2，你可以为集群设置最小和最大容量。这适合像每周末只运行 2 小时的应用程序这样的间歇性工作负载。
stem_zh:
某金融服务公司推出了一个使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库的新应用程序。公司使用该应用程序追踪股票市场趋势。公司只需在每周末运行该应用程序 2 小时。公司需要优化运行该数据库的成本。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company deploys its applications on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) behind an Application Load Balancer in an AWS Region. The application needs to store data in a PostgreSQL database engine. The company wants the data in the database to be highly available. The company also needs increased capacity for read workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.text_en: Create an Amazon DynamoDB database table configured with global tables.
options.text_zh: 创建一张配置了全局表的 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库表。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ deployments.
options.text_zh: 创建一个采用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS 数据库。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment.
options.text_zh: 创建一个采用多可用区数据库集群部署的 Amazon RDS 数据库。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon RDS database configured with cross-Region read replicas.
options.text_zh: 创建一个配置了跨区域只读副本的 Amazon RDS 数据库。

explanation_en: Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ (Availability Zone) DB cluster deployment provides high availability by automatically replicating the primary database to a standby instance in a different Availability Zone. This helps ensure database availability in the event of a failure in the primary Availability Zone.
explanation_zh: 采用多可用区（AZ）数据库集群部署的 Amazon RDS 通过自动将主数据库复制到另一个可用区中的备用实例来提供高可用性。这有助于在主可用区发生故障时确保数据库可用。
stem_zh:
某公司在某 AWS 区域中一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）上部署其应用程序。该应用程序需要将数据存储在一个 PostgreSQL 数据库引擎中。公司希望数据库中的数据高可用。公司还需要为读工作负载增加容量。

哪个方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is building a RESTful serverless web application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The users of this web application will be geographically distributed, and the company wants to reduce the latency of API requests to these users. Which type of endpoint should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Private endpoint
options.text_zh: 私有端点

options.text_en: Regional endpoint
options.text_zh: 区域端点

options.text_en: Interface VPC endpoint
options.text_zh: 接口 VPC 端点

options.text_en: Edge-optimized endpoint
options.text_zh: 边缘优化端点

explanation_en: Edge-optimized endpoints use the global CloudFront network to distribute API traffic across multiple edge locations. This reduces latency for users by serving API requests from the edge locations closest to the users. It leverages the AWS Global Accelerator and CloudFront to automatically route requests to the nearest AWS endpoint.
explanation_zh: 边缘优化终端节点使用全球 CloudFront 网络将 API 流量分发到多个边缘站点。这通过从距离用户最近的边缘站点响应 API 请求来降低用户延迟。它利用 AWS Global Accelerator 和 CloudFront 自动将请求路由到最近的 AWS 终端节点。
stem_zh:
某公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 在 AWS 上构建一个 RESTful 无服务器 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序的用户将分布在不同地理位置，公司希望降低这些用户 API 请求的延迟。

解决方案架构师应使用哪种类型的终端节点来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve content pages for its website. The company needs to ensure that clients use a TLS certificate when accessing the company's website. The company wants to automate the creation and renewal of the TLS certificates. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.text_en: Use a CloudFront security policy to create a certificate.
options.text_zh: 用 CloudFront 安全策略来创建证书。

options.text_en: Use a CloudFront origin access control (OAC) to create a certificate.
options.text_zh: 用 CloudFront 源访问控制 (OAC) 来创建证书。

options.text_en: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use DNS validation for the domain.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建证书。对该域名使用 DNS 验证。

options.text_en: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use email validation for the domain.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建证书。对该域名使用邮件验证。

explanation_en:
AWS Certificate Manager (ACM): ACM is a fully managed service that allows you to easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS) certificates for use with AWS services and your internal connected resources. It is designed for automation and ease of use.

DNS Validation: DNS validation involves adding a DNS record to your domain's DNS configuration. This method is more suitable for automation as it does not require manual intervention, and it can be easily integrated into automated certificate issuance and renewal processes.
explanation_zh:
AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）：ACM 是一项全托管服务，让你能够轻松预置、管理和部署公有和私有的安全套接字层/传输层安全（SSL/TLS）证书，以配合 AWS 服务和你的内部互联资源使用。它专为自动化和易用性而设计。

DNS 验证：DNS 验证需要在你域名的 DNS 配置中添加一条 DNS 记录。这种方法更适合自动化，因为它不需要人工干预，并且可以轻松集成到自动化的证书签发和续订流程中。
stem_zh:
某公司使用一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配为其网站提供内容页面。公司需要确保客户端在访问公司网站时使用 TLS 证书。公司希望自动化 TLS 证书的创建和续订。

哪个方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company deployed a serverless application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as a database layer. The application has experienced a large increase in users. The company wants to improve database response time from milliseconds to microseconds and to cache requests to the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
options.text_zh: 使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。

options.text_en: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。

explanation_en: DAX is a fully managed, highly available, in-memory cache for DynamoDB that delivers fast response times for DynamoDB queries. It can be seamlessly integrated with existing DynamoDB applications, requiring minimal code changes. DAX allows you to cache frequently accessed data, reducing the need to read from the DynamoDB table and improving response times.
explanation_zh: DAX 是面向 DynamoDB 的全托管、高可用内存缓存，可为 DynamoDB 查询提供快速的响应时间。它可以与现有 DynamoDB 应用程序无缝集成，只需极少的代码改动。DAX 让你能够缓存频繁访问的数据，减少从 DynamoDB 表读取的需要并改善响应时间。
stem_zh:
某公司部署了一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库层的无服务器应用程序。该应用程序的用户量大幅增长。公司希望将数据库响应时间从毫秒级提升到微秒级，并对数据库请求进行缓存。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs an application that uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The application receives traffic only on weekdays during business hours. The company wants to optimize costs and reduce operational overhead based on this usage. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use the Instance Scheduler on AWS to configure start and stop schedules.
options.text_zh: 使用 Instance Scheduler on AWS 来配置启停计划。

options.text_en: Turn off automatic backups. Create weekly manual snapshots of the database.
options.text_zh: 关闭自动备份，改为每周手动创建数据库快照。

options.text_en: Create a custom AWS Lambda function to start and stop the database based on minimum CPU utilization.
options.text_zh: 编写一个自定义 AWS Lambda 函数，根据最低 CPU 利用率来启停该数据库。

options.text_en: Purchase All Upfront reserved DB instances.
options.text_zh: 购买全预付的预留数据库实例。

explanation_en: Instance Scheduler: The AWS Instance Scheduler is a solution that allows you to schedule the start and stop times of your Amazon EC2 and RDS instances. By configuring start and stop schedules, you can ensure that resources are only running during the required business hours, thereby optimizing costs.
explanation_zh: Instance Scheduler：AWS Instance Scheduler 是一套方案，允许你安排 Amazon EC2 和 RDS 实例的启动和停止时间。通过配置启动和停止计划，你可以确保资源只在所需的工作时间内运行，从而优化成本。
stem_zh:
某公司运行一个使用 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的应用程序。该应用程序仅在工作日的工作时间内接收流量。公司希望基于这种使用情况优化成本并降低运维开销。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses locally attached storage to run a latency-sensitive application on premises. The company is using a lift and shift method to move the application to the AWS Cloud. The company does not want to change the application architecture. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system to run the application.
options.text_zh: 配置一个含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组。用一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统来运行该应用。

options.text_en: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) GP2 volume to run the application.
options.text_zh: 把该应用部署在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上。用一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) gp2 卷来运行该应用。

options.text_en: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system to run the application.
options.text_zh: 配置一个含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组。用一个 Amazon FSx for OpenZFS 文件系统来运行该应用。

options.text_en: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) GP3 volume to run the application.
options.text_zh: 把该应用部署在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上。用一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) gp3 卷来运行该应用。

explanation_en: Amazon EC2 Instance with GP3 Volume (Option D): Amazon EBS GP3 volumes are designed to provide cost savings compared to GP2 volumes while still offering good performance for a broad range of workloads. GP3 volumes allow you to provision the IOPS (input/output operations per second) and throughput that your application needs, giving you flexibility and cost-effectiveness.
explanation_zh: 带 GP3 卷的 Amazon EC2 实例（选项 D）：与 GP2 卷相比，Amazon EBS GP3 卷旨在节省成本，同时仍为各类工作负载提供良好性能。GP3 卷允许你按应用程序所需预置 IOPS（每秒输入/输出操作数）和吞吐量，兼具灵活性和成本效益。
stem_zh:
某公司使用本地挂载的存储在本地运行一个延迟敏感型应用程序。公司正使用"直接迁移（lift and shift）"方式将该应用程序迁移到 AWS 云。公司不想改变应用程序架构。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a stateful production application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application requires at least two EC2 instances to always be running. A solutions architect needs to design a highly available and fault-tolerant architecture for the application. The solutions architect creates an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances. Which set of additional steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy one On-Demand Instance in one Availability Zone and one On-Demand Instance in a second Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量设为 2。在一个可用区部署一台按需实例，在第二个可用区部署一台按需实例。

options.text_en: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two On-Demand Instances in a second Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量设为 4。在一个可用区部署两台按需实例，在第二个可用区部署两台按需实例。

options.text_en: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy four Spot Instances in one Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量设为 2。在一个可用区部署四台 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two Spot Instances in a second Availability Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量设为 4。在一个可用区部署两台按需实例，在第二个可用区部署两台 Spot 实例。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个有状态的生产应用程序。该应用程序要求始终至少有两台 EC2 实例在运行。

解决方案架构师需要为该应用程序设计一个高可用且容错的架构。解决方案架构师创建了一个 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组。

解决方案架构师应采取哪一组额外步骤来满足这些要求？

stem_en: An ecommerce company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS provider. The company hosts its website on premises and in the AWS Cloud. The company's on-premises data center is near the us-west-1 Region. The company uses the eu-central-1 Region to host the website. The company wants to minimize load time for the website as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Set up a geolocation routing policy. Send the traffic that is near us-west-1 to the on-premises data center. Send the traffic that is near eu- central-1 to eu-central-1.
options.text_zh: 配置地理位置路由策略。把靠近 us-west-1 的流量发往本地数据中心，把靠近 eu-central-1 的流量发往 eu-central-1。

options.text_en: Set up a simple routing policy that routes all traffic that is near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1 and routes all traffic that is near the on-premises datacenter to the on-premises data center.
options.text_zh: 配置简单路由策略，把靠近 eu-central-1 的所有流量路由到 eu-central-1，把靠近本地数据中心的所有流量路由到本地数据中心。

options.text_en: Set up a latency routing policy. Associate the policy with us-west-1.
options.text_zh: 配置基于延迟的路由策略，并把该策略关联到 us-west-1。

options.text_en: Set up a weighted routing policy. Split the traffic evenly between eu-central-1 and the on-premises data center.
options.text_zh: 配置加权路由策略，把流量在 eu-central-1 和本地数据中心之间平均分配。

explanation_en: Geolocation routing directs traffic based on the geographic location of the user. This option would send users near us-west-1 to the on-premises data center and users near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1. While this approach considers geographic location, it might not always result in the lowest latency.
explanation_zh: 地理位置路由根据用户的地理位置导向流量。此选项会将靠近 us-west-1 的用户导向本地数据中心，将靠近 eu-central-1 的用户导向 eu-central-1。虽然这种做法考虑了地理位置，但未必总能带来最低的延迟。
stem_zh:
某电商公司使用 Amazon Route 53 作为其 DNS 提供商。公司在本地和 AWS 云中都托管其网站。公司的本地数据中心靠近 us-west-1 区域。公司使用 eu-central-1 区域托管网站。公司希望尽可能缩短网站的加载时间。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has 5 PB of archived data on physical tapes. The company needs to preserve the data on the tapes for another 10 years for compliance purposes. The company wants to migrate to AWS in the next 6 months. The data center that stores the tapes has a 1 Gbps uplink internet connectivity. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Read the data from the tapes on premises. Stage the data in a local NFS storage. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
options.text_zh: 在本地读取磁带上的数据，先暂存到本地 NFS 存储。再用 AWS DataSync 把数据迁移到 Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

options.text_en: Use an on-premises backup application to read the data from the tapes and to write directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 用本地备份软件读取磁带上的数据，直接写入 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices that have Tape Gateway. Copy the physical tapes to virtual tapes in Snowball. Ship the Snowball devices to AWS. Create a lifecycle policy to move the tapes to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.text_zh: 订购多台带 Tape Gateway 的 AWS Snowball 设备。把物理磁带复制成 Snowball 中的虚拟磁带。把 Snowball 设备寄给 AWS。创建生命周期策略把这些磁带转移到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Configure an on-premises Tape Gateway. Create virtual tapes in the AWS Cloud. Use backup software to copy the physical tape to the virtual tape.
options.text_zh: 在本地配置一个 Tape Gateway。在 AWS 云中创建虚拟磁带。用备份软件把物理磁带复制到虚拟磁带上。

explanation_en:
AWS Snowball devices can be more cost-effective than transferring large amounts of data over a 1 Gbps internet connection, especially when dealing with petabytes of data. 
AWS, a lifecycle policy can be configured to move the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive, which is a cost-effective storage class designed for long-term archival.
explanation_zh:
对于 PB 级数据而言，AWS Snowball 设备可能比通过 1 Gbps 互联网连接传输大量数据更具成本效益。
在 AWS 中，可以配置生命周期策略将数据移动到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive，这是一种专为长期归档设计的具有成本效益的存储类。
stem_zh:
某公司在物理磁带上存有 5 PB 的归档数据。出于合规目的，公司需要将磁带上的数据再保存 10 年。公司希望在未来 6 个月内迁移到 AWS。存放这些磁带的数据中心具有 1 Gbps 的上行互联网连接。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is deploying an application that processes large quantities of data in parallel. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to prevent groups of nodes from sharing the same underlying hardware. Which networking solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Run the EC2 instances in a spread placement group.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例运行在一个分散型 (spread) 置放群组中。

options.text_en: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例分组放在不同的账户中。

options.text_en: Configure the EC2 instances with dedicated tenancy.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例配置为专用租户 (dedicated tenancy)。

options.text_en: Configure the EC2 instances with shared tenancy.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例配置为共享租户 (shared tenancy)。

explanation_en: A spread placement group is a logical grouping of instances that are placed on distinct underlying hardware. This ensures that instances within the group are physically separated, reducing the risk of correlated failures. This option is suitable for applications that need to maximize the level of isolation.
explanation_zh: 分散置放群组是一种逻辑分组，其中的实例被放置在彼此不同的底层硬件上。这确保组内实例在物理上相互隔离，从而降低相关联故障的风险。此选项适合需要最大化隔离级别的应用程序。
stem_zh:
某公司正在部署一个并行处理大量数据的应用程序。公司计划为该工作负载使用 Amazon EC2 实例。网络架构必须可配置，以防止多组节点共享同一底层硬件。

哪种网络方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a disaster recovery (DR) strategy to provide Amazon EC2 capacity in a failover AWS Region. Business requirements state that the DR strategy must meet capacity in the failover Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Purchase On-Demand Instances in the failover Region.
options.text_zh: 在故障转移区域购买按需实例。

options.text_en: Purchase an EC2 Savings Plan in the failover Region.
options.text_zh: 在故障转移区域购买 EC2 节省计划。

options.text_en: Purchase regional Reserved Instances in the failover Region.
options.text_zh: 在故障转移区域购买区域级预留实例。

options.text_en: Purchase a Capacity Reservation in the failover Region.
options.text_zh: 在故障转移区域购买容量预留 (Capacity Reservation)。

explanation_en: A Capacity Reservation allows you to reserve a specific amount of EC2 instance capacity in a given region without purchasing specific instances. This reserved capacity is dedicated to your account and can be utilized for launching instances when needed. Capacity Reservations offer flexibility, allowing you to launch different instance types and sizes within the reserved capacity.
explanation_zh: 容量预留允许你在指定区域中预留特定数量的 EC2 实例容量，而无需购买具体的实例。这部分预留容量专供你的账户使用，可在需要时用于启动实例。容量预留提供了灵活性，允许你在预留容量范围内启动不同类型和规格的实例。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个灾难恢复（DR）策略，以在故障转移的 AWS 区域中提供 Amazon EC2 容量。业务要求规定该 DR 策略必须在故障转移区域中满足容量需求。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has five organizational units (OUs) as part of its organization in AWS Organizations. Each OU correlates to the five businesses that the company owns. The company's research and development (R&D) business is separating from the company and will need its own organization. A solutions architect creates a separate new management account for this purpose. What should the solutions architect do next in the new management account?

options.text_en: Have the R&D AWS account be part of both organizations during the transition.
options.text_zh: 让研发 AWS 账户在过渡期间同时属于两个组织。

options.text_en: Invite the R&D AWS account to be part of the new organization after the R&D AWS account has left the prior organization.
options.text_zh: 等研发 AWS 账户先退出原组织之后，再邀请它加入新组织。

options.text_en: Create a new R&D AWS account in the new organization. Migrate resources from the prior R&D AWS account to the new R&D AWS account.
options.text_zh: 在新组织中新建一个研发 AWS 账户，把资源从原研发账户迁移到新研发账户。

options.text_en: Have the R&D AWS account join the new organization. Make the new management account a member of the prior organization.
options.text_zh: 让研发 AWS 账户加入新组织，同时把新的管理账户变成原组织的成员账户。

stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS Organizations 的组织中有五个组织单元（OU）。每个 OU 对应公司旗下的五项业务之一。公司的研发（R&D）业务即将从公司分拆出去，需要拥有自己的组织。一位解决方案架构师为此创建了一个独立的新管理账户。

解决方案架构师接下来应在这个新管理账户中做什么？

stem_en: A company is designing a solution to capture customer activity in different web applications to process analytics and make predictions. Customer activity in the web applications is unpredictable and can increase suddenly. The company requires a solution that integrates with other web applications. The solution must include an authorization step for security purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Authorization is resolved at the GWLB.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 容器实例前面配置一个 Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)，由该容器实例把收到的信息存入一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。授权在该 GWLB 上完成。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis data stream that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流前面配置一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点，由该数据流把收到的信息存入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来完成授权。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to resolve authorization.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 前面配置一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点，由它把收到的信息存入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。用 API Gateway Lambda 授权方来完成授权。

options.text_en: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.
options.text_zh: 在一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 容器实例前面配置一个 Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)，由该容器实例把收到的信息存到一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统上。用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来完成授权。

explanation_en:
Amazon API Gateway: It provides a fully managed service for creating, publishing, maintaining, monitoring, and securing APIs at any scale. It allows you to expose the capabilities of your backend services as APIs.
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose: It can capture and load streaming data into storage services such as Amazon S3. It is well-suited for scenarios where you need to ingest and store large volumes of streaming data.
API Gateway Lambda Authorizer: It allows you to control access to your APIs using Lambda functions. It's used to resolve authorization before allowing access to the API.
explanation_zh:
Amazon API Gateway：它提供一项全托管服务，用于以任意规模创建、发布、维护、监控和保护 API。它让你能够将后端服务的能力以 API 形式暴露出来。
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose：它可以捕获流数据并将其加载到 Amazon S3 等存储服务中。它非常适合需要摄取和存储大量流数据的场景。
API Gateway Lambda 授权方：它允许你使用 Lambda 函数控制对 API 的访问，在允许访问 API 之前先完成授权判断。
stem_zh:
某公司正在设计一个方案，用于捕获不同 Web 应用程序中的客户活动，以便进行分析处理和预测。Web 应用程序中的客户活动不可预测，并且可能突然增加。公司要求该方案能与其他 Web 应用程序集成。出于安全考虑，该方案必须包含一个授权环节。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An ecommerce company wants a disaster recovery solution for its Amazon RDS DB instances that run Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise Edition. The company's current recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) are 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Create a cross-Region read replica and promote the read replica to the primary instance.
options.text_zh: 创建一个跨区域只读副本，并把该只读副本提升为主实例。

options.text_en: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create RDS cross-Region replication.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 建立 RDS 跨区域复制。

options.text_en: Use cross-Region replication every 24 hours to copy native backups to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 每 24 小时用跨区域复制把原生备份复制到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Copy automatic snapshots to another Region every 24 hours.
options.text_zh: 每 24 小时把自动快照复制到另一个区域。

explanation_en: RDS automatically takes snapshots of your database instances. These snapshots capture the entire DB instance, including the data and the DB instance's metadata.
explanation_zh: RDS 会自动为你的数据库实例创建快照。这些快照会捕获整个数据库实例，包括数据和该数据库实例的元数据。
stem_zh:
某电商公司希望为其运行 Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise Edition 的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例制定灾难恢复方案。公司当前的恢复点目标（RPO）和恢复时间目标（RTO）均为 24 小时。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer that has sticky sessions enabled. The web server currently hosts the user session state. The company wants to ensure high availability and avoid user session state loss in the event of a web server outage. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance to store the session data. Update the application to use ElastiCache for Memcached to store the session state.
options.text_zh: 用一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 实例存储会话数据。改造应用改用 ElastiCache for Memcached 存储会话状态。

options.text_en: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to store the session state. Update the application to use ElastiCache for Redis to store the session state.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 存储会话状态。改造应用改用 ElastiCache for Redis 存储会话状态。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Storage Gateway cached volume to store session data. Update the application to use AWS Storage Gateway cached volume to store the session state.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Storage Gateway 缓存卷存储会话数据。改造应用改用 AWS Storage Gateway 缓存卷存储会话状态。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS to store the session state. Update the application to use Amazon RDS to store the session state.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon RDS 存储会话状态。改造应用改用 Amazon RDS 存储会话状态。

explanation_en: ElastiCache for Redis is an in-memory data store service that is well-suited for storing session data. It provides high availability and durability. Using Redis allows the application to offload the session state from individual EC2 instances to a centralized and highly available Redis cluster.
explanation_zh: ElastiCache for Redis 是一项内存数据存储服务，非常适合存储会话数据。它提供高可用性和持久性。使用 Redis 可以让应用程序把会话状态从单台 EC2 实例卸载到一个集中且高可用的 Redis 集群中。
stem_zh:
某公司在一个启用了粘性会话的 Application Load Balancer 之后、位于 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用程序。Web 服务器目前承载用户会话状态。公司希望确保高可用性，并在 Web 服务器故障时避免用户会话状态丢失。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company migrated a MySQL database from the company's on-premises data center to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company sized the RDS DB instance to meet the company's average daily workload. Once a month, the database performs slowly when the company runs queries for a report. The company wants to have the ability to run reports and maintain the performance of the daily workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a read replica of the database. Direct the queries to the read replica.
options.text_zh: 创建该数据库的只读副本，把这些查询导向该只读副本。

options.text_en: Create a backup of the database. Restore the backup to another DB instance. Direct the queries to the new database.
options.text_zh: 备份该数据库，把备份恢复到另一个数据库实例，把这些查询导向新数据库。

options.text_en: Export the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把数据导出到 Amazon S3，用 Amazon Athena 查询该 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Resize the DB instance to accommodate the additional workload.
options.text_zh: 调大该数据库实例规格以容纳额外的负载。

explanation_en:
Read Replica: Creating a read replica of the database allows you to offload read queries to a replica instance. This helps in distributing the workload and prevents the additional load from impacting the performance of the primary database.

Direct Queries to the Read Replica: By directing the queries for the monthly reports to the read replica, you ensure that the heavy reporting workload doesn't affect the performance of the primary database handling daily workloads. Read replicas are designed to handle read-intensive workloads, providing a scalable solution.
explanation_zh:
只读副本：创建数据库的只读副本可让你把读查询卸载到副本实例上。这有助于分摊工作负载，防止额外负载影响主数据库的性能。

将查询导向只读副本：通过将月度报表的查询导向只读副本，你可以确保繁重的报表工作负载不会影响处理日常工作负载的主数据库性能。只读副本专为处理读密集型工作负载而设计，提供了可扩展的方案。
stem_zh:
某公司将一个 MySQL 数据库从公司本地数据中心迁移到了一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。公司按照自身日均工作负载确定了该 RDS 数据库实例的规格。每月一次，当公司运行报表查询时，数据库会变慢。公司希望既能运行报表，又能保持日常工作负载的性能。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a container application by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application includes microservices that manage customers and place orders. The company needs to route incoming requests to the appropriate microservices. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision a Network Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Load Balancer Controller 预置一个 Network Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision an Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Load Balancer Controller 预置一个 Application Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to connect the requests to Amazon EKS.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Lambda 函数把请求接到 Amazon EKS。

options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway to connect the requests to Amazon EKS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon API Gateway 把请求接到 Amazon EKS。

explanation_en:
This is a Kubernetes-native controller that allows you to define and manage Application Load Balancers and Network Load Balancers to route traffic to services in your Amazon EKS cluster.
ALBs are designed for routing HTTP/HTTPS traffic and provide more advanced routing features compared to Network Load Balancers.
explanation_zh:
这是一个 Kubernetes 原生的控制器，允许你定义和管理 Application Load Balancer 和 Network Load Balancer，将流量路由到 Amazon EKS 集群中的服务。
ALB 专为路由 HTTP/HTTPS 流量而设计，相比 Network Load Balancer 提供更高级的路由功能。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）运行一个容器应用程序。该应用程序包含管理客户和下订单的微服务。公司需要将传入请求路由到相应的微服务。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足此要求？

stem_en: A company uses AWS and sells access to copyrighted images. The company’s global customer base needs to be able to access these images quickly. The company must deny access to users from specific countries. The company wants to minimize costs as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA) and public bucket access. Provide customers with a link to the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 存放这些图片。开启多重身份验证 (MFA) 和存储桶公有访问。把该 S3 存储桶的链接提供给客户。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Create an IAM user for each customer. Add the users to a group that has permission to access the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 存放这些图片。为每个客户创建一个 IAM 用户，把这些用户加入一个有权访问该 S3 存储桶的组。

options.text_en: Use Amazon EC2 instances that are behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) to store the images. Deploy the instances only in the countries the company services. Provide customers with links to the ALBs for their specific country's instances.
options.text_zh: 用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 之后的 Amazon EC2 实例存放这些图片。只在该公司提供服务的国家/地区部署实例。把各自国家/地区实例对应的 ALB 链接提供给客户。

options.text_en: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute the images with geographic restrictions. Provide a signed URL for each customer to access the data in CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon S3 存放这些图片。用 Amazon CloudFront 分发图片并施加地理限制。为每个客户提供一个签名 URL 来访问 CloudFront 中的数据。

explanation_en:
By using CloudFront, you can cache and serve the images from edge locations around the world, improving access speed for global customers.
Geographic Restrictions in CloudFront: CloudFront allows you to set up geographic restrictions to deny access to users from specific countries.
explanation_zh:
通过使用 CloudFront，你可以从世界各地的边缘站点缓存并提供这些图片，提升全球客户的访问速度。
CloudFront 中的地理限制：CloudFront 允许你设置地理限制，以拒绝特定国家/地区用户的访问。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS 并销售受版权保护图片的访问权限。公司的全球客户群需要能够快速访问这些图片。公司必须拒绝特定国家/地区用户的访问。公司希望尽可能降低成本。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a highly available Amazon ElastiCache for Redis based solution. The solutions architect needs to ensure that failures do not result in performance degradation or loss of data locally and within an AWS Region. The solution needs to provide high availability at the node level and at the Region level. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Multi-AZ Redis replication groups with shards that contain multiple nodes.
options.text_zh: 使用多可用区 Redis 复制组，其分片包含多个节点。

options.text_en: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Redis append only files (AOF) turned on.
options.text_zh: 使用包含多个节点的 Redis 分片，并开启 Redis 只追加文件 (AOF)。

options.text_en: Use a Multi-AZ Redis cluster with more than one read replica in the replication group.
options.text_zh: 使用多可用区 Redis 集群，并在复制组中配置一个以上的只读副本。

options.text_en: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Auto Scaling turned on.
options.text_zh: 使用包含多个节点的 Redis 分片，并开启 Auto Scaling。

explanation_en:
Multi-AZ (Availability Zone) replication groups provide high availability at the node level. In a Multi-AZ setup, your data is replicated asynchronously to a standby replica in a different Availability Zone.
Using shards with multiple nodes within each Availability Zone further enhances availability and provides scalability.
explanation_zh:
多可用区（AZ）复制组在节点级别提供高可用性。在多可用区配置中，你的数据会被异步复制到另一个可用区中的备用副本。
在每个可用区内使用包含多个节点的分片可进一步增强可用性并提供可扩展性。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个基于 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 的高可用方案。解决方案架构师需要确保故障不会导致性能下降或本地及 AWS 区域内的数据丢失。该方案需要在节点级别和区域级别都提供高可用性。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company plans to migrate to AWS and use Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances for its application. During the migration testing phase, a technical team observes that the application takes a long time to launch and load memory to become fully productive. Which solution will reduce the launch time of the application during the next testing phase?

options.text_en: Launch two or more EC2 On-Demand Instances. Turn on auto scaling features and make the EC2 On-Demand Instances available during the next testing phase.
options.text_zh: 启动两台或更多 EC2 按需实例。开启自动伸缩功能，使这些 EC2 按需实例在下一轮测试期间可用。

options.text_en: Launch EC2 Spot Instances to support the application and to scale the application so it is available during the next testing phase.
options.text_zh: 启动 EC2 Spot 实例来支撑该应用并进行伸缩，使其在下一轮测试期间可用。

options.text_en: Launch the EC2 On-Demand Instances with hibernation turned on. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling warm pools during the next testing phase.
options.text_zh: 启动开启了休眠功能的 EC2 按需实例。在下一轮测试期间配置 EC2 Auto Scaling 预热池 (warm pool)。

options.text_en: Launch EC2 On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Start additional EC2 instances during the next testing phase.
options.text_zh: 启动带容量预留的 EC2 按需实例。在下一轮测试期间再启动额外的 EC2 实例。

explanation_en: When you launch EC2 On-Demand Instances with hibernation turned on, the instances can be hibernated and resumed rather than terminated and launched.
explanation_zh: 当你在开启休眠的情况下启动 EC2 按需实例时，这些实例可以被休眠并恢复，而不是被终止后重新启动。
stem_zh:
某公司计划迁移到 AWS，并为其应用程序使用 Amazon EC2 按需实例。在迁移测试阶段，技术团队观察到该应用程序启动并将内存加载至完全可用状态需要很长时间。

哪个方案能在下一个测试阶段缩短该应用程序的启动时间？

stem_en: A company's applications run on Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. The company notices that its applications experience sudden traffic increases on random days of the week. The company wants to maintain application performance during sudden traffic increases. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Use manual scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 用手动伸缩来调整该 Auto Scaling 组的规模。

options.text_en: Use predictive scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 用预测性伸缩来调整该 Auto Scaling 组的规模。

options.text_en: Use dynamic scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 用动态伸缩来调整该 Auto Scaling 组的规模。

options.text_en: Use schedule scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 用计划伸缩来调整该 Auto Scaling 组的规模。

explanation_en: Dynamic Scaling: With dynamic scaling, the Auto Scaling group automatically adjusts its capacity based on real-time demand. It scales out during traffic spikes and scales in during periods of lower demand. This ensures that your application can handle sudden increases in traffic without manual intervention.
explanation_zh: 动态伸缩：借助动态伸缩，Auto Scaling 组会根据实时需求自动调整其容量。它在流量高峰时扩容，在需求较低时缩容。这确保你的应用程序无需人工干预即可应对流量的突然增长。
stem_zh:
某公司的应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司注意到其应用程序在一周中随机的某些日子会遇到流量的突然增长。公司希望在流量突增期间保持应用程序性能。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: An ecommerce application uses a PostgreSQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. During a monthly sales event, database usage increases and causes database connection issues for the application. The traffic is unpredictable for subsequent monthly sales events, which impacts the sales forecast. The company needs to maintain performance when there is an unpredictable increase in traffic. Which solution resolves this issue in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora Serverless v2.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2。

options.text_en: Enable auto scaling for the PostgreSQL database on the EC2 instance to accommodate increased usage.
options.text_zh: 为该 EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库启用自动伸缩以应对用量增长。

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL with a larger instance type.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到更大实例类型的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL。

options.text_en: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Redshift to accommodate increased usage.
options.text_zh: 把该 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift 以应对用量增长。

explanation_en: Aurora Serverless is a serverless relational database engine provided by Amazon. It automatically adjusts its capacity based on actual usage, allowing it to scale up or down as needed. Aurora Serverless v2 builds upon the original Aurora Serverless model with additional features for even more efficient scaling.
explanation_zh: Aurora Serverless 是 Amazon 提供的一款无服务器关系数据库引擎。它会根据实际使用情况自动调整容量，可按需扩容或缩容。Aurora Serverless v2 在最初的 Aurora Serverless 模型基础上增加了更多功能，实现更高效的伸缩。
stem_zh:
某电子商务应用程序使用运行在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库。在每月一次的促销活动期间，数据库使用量增加，导致该应用程序出现数据库连接问题。后续每月促销活动的流量不可预测，这影响了销售预测。公司需要在流量不可预测地增长时保持性能。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式解决此问题？

stem_en: A company hosts an internal serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company’s employees report issues with high latency when they begin using the application each day. The company wants to reduce latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Increase the API Gateway throttling limit.
options.text_zh: 提高 API Gateway 的限流上限。

options.text_en: Set up a scheduled scaling to increase Lambda provisioned concurrency before employees begin to use the application each day.
options.text_zh: 配置计划伸缩，在员工每天开始使用该应用之前提高 Lambda 预置并发。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to initiate a Lambda function as a target for the alarm at the beginning of each day.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，每天开始时以一个 Lambda 函数作为告警目标来触发它。

options.text_en: Increase the Lambda function memory.
options.text_zh: 增加该 Lambda 函数的内存。

explanation_en: Lambda Provisioned Concurrency: Provisioned concurrency is the number of simultaneous executions that your function can handle. By setting up a scheduled scaling to increase Lambda provisioned concurrency before employees begin using the application, you are proactively ensuring that there are enough resources available to handle the expected load.
explanation_zh: Lambda 预置并发：预置并发是指你的函数可以处理的同时执行数量。通过设置计划伸缩，在员工开始使用应用程序之前提高 Lambda 预置并发，你可以主动确保有足够的资源来应对预期负载。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 在 AWS 上托管一个内部无服务器应用程序。公司员工反映每天开始使用该应用程序时会遇到高延迟问题。公司希望降低延迟。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A research company uses on-premises devices to generate data for analysis. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to analyze the data. The devices generate .csv files and support writing the data to an SMB file share. Company analysts must be able to use SQL commands to query the data. The analysts will run queries periodically throughout the day. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon S3 File Gateway mode.
options.text_zh: 在本地以 Amazon S3 File Gateway 模式部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon FSx File Gateway made.
options.text_zh: 在本地以 Amazon FSx File Gateway 模式部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway。

options.text_en: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序，基于 Amazon S3 中的数据创建表。

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon EMR cluster with EMR File System (EMRFS) to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.text_zh: 搭建一个带 EMR File System (EMRFS) 的 Amazon EMR 集群来查询 Amazon S3 中的数据，并开放给分析师访问。

options.text_en: Set up an Amazon Redshift cluster to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.text_zh: 搭建一个 Amazon Redshift 集群来查询 Amazon S3 中的数据，并开放给分析师访问。

options.text_en: Setup Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Athena 来查询 Amazon S3 中的数据，并开放给分析师访问。

explanation_en:
C. Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3.

F. Setup Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.

This step allows you to seamlessly integrate on-premises devices with AWS S3, providing a scalable and cost-effective storage solution. The AWS Storage Gateway in S3 File Gateway mode enables you to write data from on-premises devices to S3.

AWS Glue can discover, catalog, and transform data from S3. By setting up a Glue crawler, you create a table schema based on the .csv files in S3. This step prepares the data for analysis.

Amazon Athena allows you to run SQL queries directly on the data stored in S3 without the need for a dedicated database. You can create databases and tables in Athena based on the cataloged data using Glue.
explanation_zh:
C. 设置一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序，基于 Amazon S3 中的数据创建表。

F. 设置 Amazon Athena 查询 Amazon S3 中的数据。为分析师提供访问权限。

该步骤让你能够将本地设备与 AWS S3 无缝集成，提供可扩展且具有成本效益的存储方案。以 S3 File Gateway 模式运行的 AWS Storage Gateway 使你能够将数据从本地设备写入 S3。

AWS Glue 可以发现、编目和转换来自 S3 的数据。通过设置 Glue 爬网程序，你可以基于 S3 中的 .csv 文件创建表结构。这一步为数据分析做好准备。

Amazon Athena 允许你直接对存储在 S3 中的数据运行 SQL 查询，而无需专用数据库。你可以基于 Glue 编目的数据在 Athena 中创建数据库和表。
stem_zh:
某研究公司使用本地设备生成用于分析的数据。公司希望使用 AWS 云来分析这些数据。这些设备生成 .csv 文件，并支持将数据写入 SMB 文件共享。公司分析师必须能够使用 SQL 命令查询这些数据。分析师将在一天中定期运行查询。

哪些步骤组合能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) clusters and Amazon RDS DB instances to build and run a payment processing application. The company will run the application in its on-premises data center for compliance purposes. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Outposts as part of the solution. The solutions architect is working with the company's operational team to build the application. Which activities are the responsibility of the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks
options.text_zh: 为 Outposts 机架提供可靠的供电和网络连接

options.text_en: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts
options.text_zh: 管理虚拟化管理程序、存储系统以及运行在 Outposts 上的 AWS 服务

options.text_en: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment
options.text_zh: 数据中心环境的物理安全与门禁管控

options.text_en: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks
options.text_zh: 保障 Outposts 基础设施的可用性，包括 Outposts 机架内的供电设备、服务器和网络设备

options.text_en: Physical maintenance of Outposts components
options.text_zh: Outposts 组件的物理维护

options.text_en: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon ECS 集群提供额外容量，以缓解服务器故障和维护事件的影响

stem_zh:
某公司希望使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群和 Amazon RDS 数据库实例来构建和运行一个支付处理应用程序。出于合规目的，公司将在其本地数据中心运行该应用程序。

一位解决方案架构师希望将 AWS Outposts 作为方案的一部分。该解决方案架构师正与公司的运维团队一起构建该应用程序。

哪些活动由公司的运维团队负责？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A company is planning to migrate a TCP-based application into the company's VPC. The application is publicly accessible on a nonstandard TCP port through a hardware appliance in the company's data center. This public endpoint can process up to 3 million requests per second with low latency. The company requires the same level of performance for the new public endpoint in AWS. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text_en: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。把该 NLB 配置为在该应用所需的 TCP 端口上可公开访问。

options.text_en: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。把该 ALB 配置为在该应用所需的 TCP 端口上可公开访问。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin.
options.text_zh: 部署一个在该应用所需 TCP 端口上侦听的 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以一个 Application Load Balancer 作为源站。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway API that is configured with the TCP port that the application requires. Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests.
options.text_zh: 部署一个配置了该应用所需 TCP 端口的 Amazon API Gateway API。配置带预置并发的 AWS Lambda 函数来处理这些请求。

explanation_en:
Network Load Balancer (NLB): It operates at the connection level (Layer 4) and is well-suited for TCP traffic. It can handle millions of requests per second with minimal latency.
NLB allows you to configure the listener for the specific TCP port that the application requires, ensuring compatibility with the nonstandard TCP port used by the application.
explanation_zh:
Network Load Balancer（NLB）：它工作在连接层（第 4 层），非常适合 TCP 流量。它能以极低的延迟处理每秒数百万次请求。
NLB 允许你为应用程序所需的特定 TCP 端口配置侦听器，从而兼容该应用程序使用的非标准 TCP 端口。
stem_zh:
某公司计划将一个基于 TCP 的应用程序迁移到公司的 VPC 中。该应用程序通过公司数据中心中的一台硬件设备，在一个非标准 TCP 端口上可公开访问。这个公共端点能以低延迟处理每秒高达 300 万次请求。公司要求在 AWS 中的新公共端点具备同等水平的性能。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足此要求？

stem_en: A company runs its critical database on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company wants to migrate to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal downtime and data loss. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a DB snapshot of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance to populate a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 为该 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例创建一个数据库快照，用它来生成一个新的 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群。

options.text_en: Create an Aurora read replica of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Promote the Aurora read replicate to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 为该 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例创建一个 Aurora 只读副本，再把该 Aurora 只读副本提升为一个新的 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群。

options.text_en: Use data import from Amazon S3 to migrate the database to an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 通过从 Amazon S3 导入数据的方式，把该数据库迁移到一个 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群。

options.text_en: Use the pg_dump utility to back up the RDS for PostgreSQL database. Restore the backup to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.text_zh: 用 pg_dump 工具备份该 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库，再把备份恢复到一个新的 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群。

explanation_en:
Aurora Read Replica: Creating an Aurora read replica from the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance is a low-impact operation that allows you to replicate the data to Aurora with minimal downtime.
Promote to Aurora PostgreSQL DB Cluster: Once the read replica is in sync with the primary RDS instance, you can promote the Aurora read replica to become the new primary cluster.
explanation_zh:
Aurora 只读副本：从 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例创建 Aurora 只读副本是一项影响很小的操作，可让你以最少的停机时间将数据复制到 Aurora。
提升为 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群：当只读副本与主 RDS 实例同步后，你可以将该 Aurora 只读副本提升为新的主集群。
stem_zh:
某公司在一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例上运行其关键数据库。公司希望以最少的停机时间和数据丢失迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company's infrastructure consists of hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. A solutions architect must ensure that every EC2 instance can be recovered after a disaster. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.text_en: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Create an AWS CloudFormation template to launch new EC2 instances from the EBS storage.
options.text_zh: 对挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 EBS 存储做快照。创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，从这些 EBS 存储启动新的 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to set the environment based on the EC2 template and attach the EBS storage.
options.text_zh: 对挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 EBS 存储做快照。用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 基于该 EC2 模板搭建环境并挂上这些 EBS 存储。

options.text_en: Use AWS Backup to set up a backup plan for the entire group of EC2 instances. Use the AWS Backup API or the AWS CLI to speed up the restore process for multiple EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 为整组 EC2 实例配置一个备份计划。用 AWS Backup API 或 AWS CLI 来加快多台 EC2 实例的恢复过程。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance and copy the Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). Create another Lambda function to perform the restores with the copied AMIs and attach the EBS storage.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，对挂载在每台 EC2 实例上的 EBS 存储做快照并复制相应的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。再创建另一个 Lambda 函数，用这些复制的 AMI 执行恢复并挂上 EBS 存储。

explanation_en:
AWS Backup: AWS Backup is a fully managed backup service that centralizes and automates the backup of data across AWS services. 
Backup Plan: You can set up a backup plan in AWS Backup to create and manage backups of the entire group of EC2 instances. 
AWS Backup provides a streamlined process for restoring data. You can use the AWS Backup console, API, or AWS CLI to initiate the restore process for multiple EC2 instances.
explanation_zh:
AWS Backup：AWS Backup 是一项全托管备份服务，可集中并自动化跨 AWS 服务的数据备份。
备份计划：你可以在 AWS Backup 中设置备份计划，为整组 EC2 实例创建和管理备份。
AWS Backup 提供简化的数据恢复流程。你可以使用 AWS Backup 控制台、API 或 AWS CLI 为多台 EC2 实例发起恢复过程。
stem_zh:
某公司的基础设施由数百台使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）存储的 Amazon EC2 实例组成。解决方案架构师必须确保每台 EC2 实例在灾难后都能恢复。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能以最少的工作量满足此要求？

stem_en: A company recently migrated to the AWS Cloud. The company wants a serverless solution for large-scale parallel on-demand processing of a semistructured dataset. The data consists of logs, media files, sales transactions, and IoT sensor data that is stored in Amazon S3. The company wants the solution to process thousands of items in the dataset in parallel. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.text_en: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Inline mode to process the data in parallel.
options.text_zh: 使用 Inline 模式的 AWS Step Functions Map 状态来并行处理数据。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Distributed mode to process the data in parallel.
options.text_zh: 使用 Distributed 模式的 AWS Step Functions Map 状态来并行处理数据。

options.text_en: Use AWS Glue to process the data in parallel.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Glue 来并行处理数据。

options.text_en: Use several AWS Lambda functions to process the data in parallel.
options.text_zh: 用多个 AWS Lambda 函数来并行处理数据。

explanation_en: The Map state in AWS Step Functions is designed for parallel processing. In Distributed mode, it efficiently processes items in parallel, providing a scalable solution. This allows you to process thousands of items concurrently, achieving high throughput.
explanation_zh: AWS Step Functions 中的 Map 状态专为并行处理而设计。在分布式模式下，它可高效地并行处理条目，提供可扩展的方案。这使你能够并发处理数千个条目，实现高吞吐量。
stem_zh:
某公司最近迁移到了 AWS 云。公司希望有一个无服务器方案，对一个半结构化数据集进行大规模并行的按需处理。该数据集包含存储在 Amazon S3 中的日志、媒体文件、销售交易和 IoT 传感器数据。公司希望该方案能并行处理数据集中的数千个条目。

哪个方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company will migrate 10 PB of data to Amazon S3 in 6 weeks. The current data center has a 500 Mbps uplink to the internet. Other on-premises applications share the uplink. The company can use 80% of the internet bandwidth for this one-time migration task. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 and to automatically verify the data.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS DataSync 把数据迁移到 Amazon S3，并自动校验数据。

options.text_en: Use rsync to transfer the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 用 rsync 把数据直接传输到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Use the AWS CLI and multiple copy processes to send the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CLI 起多个复制进程把数据直接发送到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices. Copy the data to the devices. Send the devices to AWS to copy the data to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 订购多台 AWS Snowball 设备。把数据复制到设备上，再把设备寄给 AWS 以便把数据导入 Amazon S3。

explanation_en: With only a 500 Mbps uplink bandwidth shared among other on-premises applications, transferring 10 PB of data over the internet would be impractical and time-consuming. AWS Snowball provides a physical device that can be shipped to the company to facilitate faster initial data transfer.
explanation_zh: 在仅有 500 Mbps 上行带宽且还要与其他本地应用程序共享的情况下，通过互联网传输 10 PB 数据既不现实也非常耗时。AWS Snowball 提供可寄送给公司的物理设备，从而加快初始数据传输。
stem_zh:
某公司将在 6 周内向 Amazon S3 迁移 10 PB 数据。当前数据中心有一条 500 Mbps 的互联网上行链路。其他本地应用程序共享该上行链路。公司可将 80% 的互联网带宽用于这次一次性迁移任务。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has several on-premises Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (ISCSI) network storage servers. The company wants to reduce the number of these servers by moving to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect must provide low-latency access to frequently used data and reduce the dependency on on-premises servers with a minimal number of infrastructure changes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage with backups to Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 部署 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储并备份到 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with stored volumes.
options.text_zh: 部署一个配置为存储卷 (stored volumes) 的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with cached volumes.
options.text_zh: 部署一个配置为缓存卷 (cached volumes) 的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。

explanation_en: A volume gateway with cached volumes is a good fit when you want to keep frequently accessed data on-premises for low-latency access while still having a copy in the AWS Cloud. Cached volumes store the entire dataset in Amazon S3 while retaining the most frequently accessed data locally.
explanation_zh: 当你希望将频繁访问的数据保留在本地以实现低延迟访问，同时又在 AWS 云中保有一份副本时，采用缓存卷的卷网关是个很合适的选择。缓存卷将整个数据集存储在 Amazon S3 中，同时将访问最频繁的数据保留在本地。
stem_zh:
某公司有多台本地的 Internet 小型计算机系统接口（iSCSI）网络存储服务器。公司希望通过迁移到 AWS 云来减少这些服务器的数量。解决方案架构师必须以最少的基础设施改动，为频繁使用的数据提供低延迟访问，并减少对本地服务器的依赖。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing an application that will allow business users to upload objects to Amazon S3. The solution needs to maximize object durability. Objects also must be readily available at any time and for any length of time. Users will access objects frequently within the first 30 days after the objects are uploaded, but users are much less likely to access objects that are older than 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 所有对象都存放在 S3 Standard 中，并用一条 S3 生命周期规则在 30 天后把对象转换到 S3 Glacier。

options.text_en: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 所有对象都存放在 S3 Standard 中，并用一条 S3 生命周期规则在 30 天后把对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

options.text_en: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 所有对象都存放在 S3 Standard 中，并用一条 S3 生命周期规则在 30 天后把对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

options.text_en: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 所有对象都存放在 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中，并用一条 S3 生命周期规则在 30 天后把对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

explanation_en: Storing objects in S3 Standard ensures low-latency access and high durability. After 30 days, transitioning objects to S3 Standard-IA allows you to take advantage of a lower storage cost for objects that are less frequently accessed.
explanation_zh: 将对象存储在 S3 Standard 中可确保低延迟访问和高持久性。30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-IA，可让你对访问频率较低的对象享受更低的存储成本。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个允许业务用户向 Amazon S3 上传对象的应用程序。该方案需要最大化对象持久性。对象还必须随时且在任何时长内都可立即获取。用户会在对象上传后的前 30 天内频繁访问，但访问超过 30 天的对象的可能性要低得多。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has migrated a two-tier application from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The data tier is a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for Oracle with 12 TB of General Purpose SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. The application is designed to process and store documents in the database as binary large objects (blobs) with an average document size of 6 MB. The database size has grown over time, reducing the performance and increasing the cost of storage. The company must improve the database performance and needs a solution that is highly available and resilient. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Reduce the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiB. Change the storage type to Magnetic.
options.text_zh: 缩小该 RDS 数据库实例规格。把存储容量扩到 24 TiB。把存储类型改为磁介质。

options.text_en: Increase the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiChange the storage type to Provisioned IOPS.
options.text_zh: 扩大该 RDS 数据库实例规格。把存储容量扩到 24 TiB。把存储类型改为预置 IOPS。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the application to store documents in the S3 bucket. Store the object metadata in the existing database.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。改造应用把文档存到该 S3 存储桶中。对象元数据仍存放在现有数据库里。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the application to use DynamoDB. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data from the Oracle database to DynamoDB.
options.text_zh: 创建一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。改造应用改用 DynamoDB。用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 把数据从 Oracle 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB。

explanation_en: Amazon S3 is highly scalable, durable, and cost-effective for storing objects, making it well-suited for binary large objects (blobs) such as documents. It provides low-latency access and is designed to handle large volumes of data.
explanation_zh: Amazon S3 在存储对象方面具有高度可扩展性、持久性和成本效益，因此非常适合文档等二进制大对象（blob）。它提供低延迟访问，并被设计为可处理大容量数据。
stem_zh:
某公司已将一个两层应用程序从其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS 云。数据层是一个多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for Oracle，使用 12 TB 的通用型 SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）存储。该应用程序被设计为将文档以二进制大对象（blob）形式处理并存储在数据库中，文档平均大小为 6 MB。

数据库规模随时间不断增长，导致性能下降且存储成本上升。公司必须提升数据库性能，并需要一个高可用且有韧性的方案。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an application that serves clients that are deployed in more than 20.000 retail storefront locations around the world. The application consists of backend web services that are exposed over HTTPS on port 443. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The retail locations communicate with the web application over the public internet. The company allows each retail location to register the IP address that the retail location has been allocated by its local ISP. The company's security team recommends to increase the security of the application endpoint by restricting access to only the IP addresses registered by the retail locations. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 把一个 AWS WAF Web ACL 关联到该 ALB。在该 ALB 上用 IP 规则集筛选流量。更新规则中的 IP 地址，把已登记的 IP 地址纳入其中。

options.text_en: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALConfigure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALModify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 部署 AWS Firewall Manager 来管理该 ALB。配置防火墙规则限制到该 ALB 的流量。修改防火墙规则把已登记的 IP 地址纳入其中。

options.text_en: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 把这些 IP 地址存放在一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。在该 ALB 上配置一个 AWS Lambda 授权函数，校验传入请求是否来自已登记的 IP 地址。

options.text_en: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses.
options.text_zh: 在承载该 ALB 公有接口的子网上配置网络 ACL。在该网络 ACL 的入站规则中为每个已登记的 IP 地址添加条目。

stem_zh:
某公司有一个应用程序，为部署在全球 20,000 多个零售门店的客户端提供服务。该应用程序由通过 HTTPS 在 443 端口对外暴露的后端 Web 服务组成。该应用程序托管在一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后的 Amazon EC2 实例上。各零售门店通过公共互联网与该 Web 应用程序通信。公司允许每个零售门店注册其本地 ISP 分配给该门店的 IP 地址。

公司的安全团队建议通过将访问限制为仅这些零售门店注册的 IP 地址来提升应用程序端点的安全性。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is building a data analysis platform on AWS by using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from different sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution to prevent access to portions of the data that contain sensitive information. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
options.text_zh: 创建一个包含访问 Lake Formation 表权限的 IAM 角色。

options.text_en: Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
options.text_zh: 创建数据筛选器来实现行级安全和单元格级安全。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在 Lake Formation 接入数据之前先去掉敏感信息。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期查询并从 Lake Formation 表中删除敏感信息。

explanation_en: AWS Lake Formation allows you to create data filters that can be used for row-level security and cell-level security.
explanation_zh: AWS Lake Formation 允许你创建可用于行级安全和单元格级安全的数据筛选器。
stem_zh:
某公司正在使用 AWS Lake Formation 在 AWS 上构建一个数据分析平台。该平台将从 Amazon S3 和 Amazon RDS 等不同来源摄取数据。公司需要一个安全方案，以阻止对包含敏感信息的部分数据的访问。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company deploys Amazon EC2 instances that run in a VPC. The EC2 instances load source data into Amazon S3 buckets so that the data can be processed in the future. According to compliance laws, the data must not be transmitted over the public internet. Servers in the company's on- premises data center will consume the output from an application that runs on the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon EC2. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon EC2 部署一个接口 VPC 端点。在公司与该 VPC 之间建立一条 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。

options.text_en: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and the VPC.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 部署一个网关 VPC 端点。在本地网络与该 VPC 之间搭建一条 AWS Direct Connect 连接。

options.text_en: Set up an AWS Transit Gateway connection from the VPC to the S3 buckets. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.text_zh: 建立一条从该 VPC 到这些 S3 存储桶的 AWS Transit Gateway 连接。在公司与该 VPC 之间建立一条 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。

options.text_en: Set up proxy EC2 instances that have routes to NAT gateways. Configure the proxy EC2 instances to fetch S3 data and feed the application instances.
options.text_zh: 搭建带 NAT 网关路由的代理 EC2 实例。配置这些代理 EC2 实例去拉取 S3 数据并转发给应用实例。

explanation_en:
A gateway VPC endpoint allows communication between resources in your VPC and Amazon S3 without traversing the public internet.
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection from the on-premises data center to the VPC. This dedicated connection enhances security and ensures a reliable and consistent connection between on-premises servers and the EC2 instances in the VPC.
explanation_zh:
网关型 VPC 终端节点允许你 VPC 中的资源与 Amazon S3 通信，而无需经由公共互联网。
AWS Direct Connect 提供从本地数据中心到该 VPC 的专用网络连接。这条专用连接增强了安全性，并确保本地服务器与 VPC 中的 EC2 实例之间连接可靠且稳定。
stem_zh:
某公司部署了运行在一个 VPC 中的 Amazon EC2 实例。这些 EC2 实例将源数据加载到 Amazon S3 存储桶中，以便日后处理。根据合规法规，这些数据不得通过公共互联网传输。公司本地数据中心中的服务器将消费运行在这些 EC2 实例上的应用程序的输出。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has an application with a REST-based interface that allows data to be received in near-real time from a third-party vendor. Once received, the application processes and stores the data for further analysis. The application is running on Amazon EC2 instances. The third-party vendor has received many 503 Service Unavailable Errors when sending data to the application. When the data volume spikes, the compute capacity reaches its maximum limit and the application is unable to process all requests. Which design should a solutions architect recommend to provide a more scalable solution?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Process the data using AWS Lambda functions.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 接入数据。用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据。
