options.text_en: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor.
options.text_zh: 在现有应用之上加一层 Amazon API Gateway。创建一个带配额上限的使用计划给该第三方供应商。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 接入数据。把这些 EC2 实例放到一个 Application Load Balancer 之后的 Auto Scaling 组中。

options.text_en: Repackage the application as a container. Deploy the application using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the EC2 launch type with an Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 把该应用重新打包为容器。用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 的 EC2 启动类型配合 Auto Scaling 组来部署该应用。

explanation_en:
Kinesis Data Streams is designed for ingesting and processing real-time streaming data at scale. It can handle large volumes of data and provides the ability to scale horizontally.
 Using Lambda functions allows for serverless, event-driven processing of the data. Lambda automatically scales based on the number of incoming events, providing the needed elasticity to handle spikes in data volume without the need to manage underlying infrastructure.
explanation_zh:
Kinesis Data Streams 专为大规模摄取和处理实时流数据而设计。它可以处理大容量数据并提供横向扩展的能力。
使用 Lambda 函数可以对数据进行无服务器、事件驱动的处理。Lambda 会根据传入事件数量自动伸缩，提供应对数据量激增所需的弹性，而无需管理底层基础设施。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个带 REST 接口的应用程序，可近实时地接收来自第三方供应商的数据。数据接收后，该应用程序会对其进行处理并存储以供进一步分析。该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。

该第三方供应商在向该应用程序发送数据时收到了大量 503 Service Unavailable 错误。当数据量激增时，计算容量达到上限，应用程序无法处理所有请求。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪种设计来提供更具可扩展性的方案？

stem_en: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. The application needs to process sensitive information from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application must not use the internet to connect to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an internet gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the internet gateway. Update the application to use the new internet gateway.
options.text_zh: 配置一个互联网网关。更新该 S3 存储桶策略允许来自该互联网网关的访问。更新应用改用这个新的互联网网关。

options.text_en: Configure a VPN connection. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPN connection. Update the application to use the new VPN connection.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 VPN 连接。更新该 S3 存储桶策略允许来自该 VPN 连接的访问。更新应用改用这条新的 VPN 连接。

options.text_en: Configure a NAT gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the NAT gateway. Update the application to use the new NAT gateway.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 NAT 网关。更新该 S3 存储桶策略允许来自该 NAT 网关的访问。更新应用改用这个新的 NAT 网关。

options.text_en: Configure a VPC endpoint. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPC endpoint. Update the application to use the new VPC endpoint.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 VPC 端点。更新该 S3 存储桶策略允许来自该 VPC 端点的访问。更新应用改用这个新的 VPC 端点。

explanation_en: VPC Endpoint for S3: A VPC endpoint allows you to privately connect your VPC to supported AWS services, including Amazon S3, without traversing the public internet. This ensures secure and direct access to S3 from within your VPC.
explanation_zh: S3 的 VPC 终端节点：VPC 终端节点允许你将 VPC 私密地连接到受支持的 AWS 服务（包括 Amazon S3），而无需经由公共互联网。这确保从你的 VPC 内部安全且直接地访问 S3。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个运行在私有子网中 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。该应用程序需要处理来自一个 Amazon S3 存储桶的敏感信息。该应用程序不得使用互联网连接到该 S3 存储桶。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to run a container application. The EKS cluster stores sensitive information in the Kubernetes secrets object. The company wants to ensure that the information is encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use the container application to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.text_zh: 由容器应用自己用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来加密这些信息。

options.text_en: Enable secrets encryption in the EKS cluster by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.text_zh: 在该 EKS 集群上用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 启用 secrets 加密。

options.text_en: Implement an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.text_zh: 实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来加密这些信息。

options.text_en: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 配合 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来加密这些信息。

explanation_en: Amazon EKS provides built-in support for encrypting Kubernetes secrets using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). You can enable this feature at the EKS cluster level.
explanation_zh: Amazon EKS 内置支持使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密 Kubernetes secret。你可以在 EKS 集群级别启用此功能。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）运行一个容器应用程序。该 EKS 集群在 Kubernetes secret 对象中存储敏感信息。公司希望确保这些信息被加密。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is designing a new multi-tier web application that consists of the following components: • Web and application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances as part of Auto Scaling groups • An Amazon RDS DB instance for data storage A solutions architect needs to limit access to the application servers so that only the web servers can access them. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy AWS PrivateLink in front of the application servers. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.text_zh: 在应用服务器前面部署 AWS PrivateLink。配置网络 ACL，只允许 Web 服务器访问应用服务器。

options.text_en: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.text_zh: 在应用服务器前面部署一个 VPC 端点。配置安全组，只允许 Web 服务器访问应用服务器。

options.text_en: Deploy a Network Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Network Load Balancer，其目标组包含应用服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。配置网络 ACL，只允许 Web 服务器访问应用服务器。

options.text_en: Deploy an Application Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.text_zh: 部署一个 Application Load Balancer，其目标组包含应用服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。配置安全组，只允许 Web 服务器访问应用服务器。

explanation_en:
An ALB is a load balancer service provided by AWS that allows you to distribute incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as EC2 instances. In this scenario, the ALB is deployed in front of the application servers.
The ALB is configured with a target group that includes the application servers' Auto Scaling group instances. The target group defines where the ALB directs traffic.
explanation_zh:
ALB 是 AWS 提供的一项负载均衡服务，可让你将传入的应用流量分发到多个目标（例如 EC2 实例）。在此场景中，ALB 部署在应用服务器前面。
该 ALB 配置了一个包含应用服务器 Auto Scaling 组实例的目标组。目标组定义了 ALB 将流量导向何处。
stem_zh:
某公司正在设计一个新的多层 Web 应用程序，由以下组件构成：

• 作为 Auto Scaling 组一部分、运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 服务器和应用服务器
• 一个用于数据存储的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例

解决方案架构师需要限制对应用服务器的访问，使只有 Web 服务器能够访问它们。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a critical, customer-facing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application has a microservices architecture. The company needs to implement a solution that collects, aggregates, and summarizes metrics and logs from the application in a centralized location. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Run the Amazon CloudWatch agent in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.
options.text_zh: 在现有 EKS 集群中运行 Amazon CloudWatch 代理。在 CloudWatch 控制台查看指标和日志。

options.text_en: Run AWS App Mesh in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the App Mesh console.
options.text_zh: 在现有 EKS 集群中运行 AWS App Mesh。在 App Mesh 控制台查看指标和日志。

options.text_en: Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture data events. Query CloudTrail by using Amazon OpenSearch Service.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 捕获数据事件。用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 查询 CloudTrail。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.
options.text_zh: 在现有 EKS 集群中配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights。在 CloudWatch 控制台查看指标和日志。

explanation_en: CloudWatch Container Insights is specifically designed for monitoring containerized applications on Amazon EKS and ECS. It provides visibility into the performance of containers, clusters, and microservices.
explanation_zh: CloudWatch Container Insights 专为监控 Amazon EKS 和 ECS 上的容器化应用程序而设计。它提供对容器、集群和微服务性能的可见性。
stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）上运行一个关键的面向客户的应用程序。该应用程序采用微服务架构。公司需要实施一个方案，在一个集中位置收集、聚合和汇总该应用程序的指标与日志。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has deployed its newest product on AWS. The product runs in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer. The company stores the product’s objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company recently experienced malicious attacks against its systems. The company needs a solution that continuously monitors for malicious activity in the AWS account, workloads, and access patterns to the S3 bucket. The solution must also report suspicious activity and display the information on a dashboard. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Macie to monitor and report findings to AWS Config.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Macie 进行监控，并把发现项上报到 AWS Config。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Inspector to monitor and report findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Inspector 进行监控，并把发现项上报到 AWS CloudTrail。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon GuardDuty 进行监控，并把发现项上报到 AWS Security Hub。

options.text_en: Configure AWS Config to monitor and report findings to Amazon EventBridge.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Config 进行监控，并把发现项上报到 Amazon EventBridge。

explanation_en:
Amazon GuardDuty:

GuardDuty is a threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior in your AWS account. It analyzes events, such as API calls and network traffic, to detect potentially malicious activity.
AWS Security Hub:
AWS Security Hub is a comprehensive security service that aggregates and prioritizes security findings from various AWS services, including GuardDuty. It provides a centralized dashboard for security alerts and findings.
explanation_zh:
Amazon GuardDuty：

GuardDuty 是一项威胁检测服务，持续监控你 AWS 账户中的恶意活动和未授权行为。它分析 API 调用和网络流量等事件，以检测潜在的恶意活动。
AWS Security Hub：
AWS Security Hub 是一项全面的安全服务，可聚合并按优先级排列来自包括 GuardDuty 在内的各种 AWS 服务的安全发现结果。它为安全告警和发现结果提供集中式仪表板。
stem_zh:
某公司已在 AWS 上部署了其最新产品。该产品运行在一个 Network Load Balancer 之后的 Auto Scaling 组中。公司将该产品的对象存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

公司最近遭遇了针对其系统的恶意攻击。公司需要一个方案，持续监控 AWS 账户、工作负载中的恶意活动以及对该 S3 存储桶的访问模式。该方案还必须报告可疑活动并在仪表板上展示相关信息。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate an on-premises data center to AWS. The data center hosts a storage server that stores data in an NFS-based file system. The storage server holds 200 GB of data. The company needs to migrate the data without interruption to existing services. Multiple resources in AWS must be able to access the data by using the NFS protocol. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to receive the data.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来接收数据。

options.text_en: Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data into the AWS destination.
options.text_zh: 手动用操作系统的复制命令把数据推送到 AWS 目标位置。

options.text_en: Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Use a DataSync task between the on-premises location and AWS.
options.text_zh: 在本地数据中心安装一个 AWS DataSync 代理。在本地位置与 AWS 之间用一个 DataSync 任务传输数据。

explanation_en:
E. Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Use a DataSync task between the on-premises location and AWS.

Amazon EFS is a scalable, fully managed file system that supports the NFSv4 protocol. It is designed to be highly available and can be mounted on multiple EC2 instances concurrently.
Creating an Amazon EFS file system allows you to easily migrate the data and have multiple AWS resources access it concurrently.
AWS DataSync is a service for efficiently transferring large amounts of data between on-premises storage and AWS. By installing a DataSync agent in the on-premises data center, you can use DataSync to perform the migration task.
DataSync ensures efficient and secure transfer of data, making it suitable for migrating large amounts of data to AWS.
explanation_zh:
E. 在本地数据中心安装一个 AWS DataSync 代理。在本地位置与 AWS 之间使用一个 DataSync 任务。

Amazon EFS 是一个可扩展的全托管文件系统，支持 NFSv4 协议。它被设计为高可用，并可同时挂载到多台 EC2 实例上。
创建 Amazon EFS 文件系统可让你轻松迁移数据，并让多个 AWS 资源并发访问。
AWS DataSync 是一项用于在本地存储与 AWS 之间高效传输大量数据的服务。通过在本地数据中心安装 DataSync 代理，你可以使用 DataSync 执行迁移任务。
DataSync 确保高效且安全的数据传输，因此适合将大量数据迁移到 AWS。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将一个本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该数据中心托管着一台存储服务器，其数据存储在基于 NFS 的文件系统中。该存储服务器保存着 200 GB 数据。公司需要在不中断现有服务的情况下迁移这些数据。AWS 中的多个资源必须能够使用 NFS 协议访问这些数据。

哪些步骤组合能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for its Amazon EC2 instances that have an SMB file share mounted as a volume in the us-east-1 Region. The company has a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes for planned system maintenance or unplanned service disruptions. The company needs to replicate the file system to the us-west-2 Region. The replicated data must not be deleted by any user for 5 years. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 创建一个 Single-AZ 2 部署类型的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。用 AWS Backup 创建一个每日备份计划，其中包含把备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us-west-2 中的目标保管库配置合规模式 (compliance mode) 的 AWS Backup Vault Lock，最短保留期设为 5 年。

options.text_en: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 创建一个多可用区部署类型的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。用 AWS Backup 创建一个每日备份计划，其中包含把备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us-west-2 中的目标保管库配置治理模式 (governance mode) 的 AWS Backup Vault Lock，最短保留期设为 5 年。

options.text_en: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 创建一个多可用区部署类型的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。用 AWS Backup 创建一个每日备份计划，其中包含把备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us-west-2 中的目标保管库配置合规模式 (compliance mode) 的 AWS Backup Vault Lock，最短保留期设为 5 年。

options.text_en: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 创建一个 Single-AZ 2 部署类型的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。用 AWS Backup 创建一个每日备份计划，其中包含把备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us-west-2 中的目标保管库配置治理模式 (governance mode) 的 AWS Backup Vault Lock，最短保留期设为 5 年。

explanation_en:
FSx for Windows File Server:
Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in the us-east-1 Region with a Multi-AZ deployment type. The Multi-AZ deployment type ensures high availability.
AWS Backup:
Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan for the FSx file system. Include a backup rule that copies the backup to the us-west-2 Region. This ensures that a backup is replicated to the us-west-2 Region regularly.
explanation_zh:
FSx for Windows File Server：
在 us-east-1 区域创建一个部署类型为多可用区的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。多可用区部署类型可确保高可用性。
AWS Backup：
使用 AWS Backup 为该 FSx 文件系统创建每日备份计划。加入一条将备份复制到 us-west-2 区域的备份规则。这确保备份定期被复制到 us-west-2 区域。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为其在 us-east-1 区域中将 SMB 文件共享作为卷挂载的 Amazon EC2 实例使用 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。对于计划内系统维护或计划外服务中断，公司的恢复点目标（RPO）为 5 分钟。公司需要将该文件系统复制到 us-west-2 区域。复制的数据在 5 年内不得被任何用户删除。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a security solution for a company that wants to provide developers with individual AWS accounts through AWS Organizations, while also maintaining standard security controls. Because the individual developers will have AWS account root user-level access to their own accounts, the solutions architect wants to ensure that the mandatory AWS CloudTrail configuration that is applied to new developer accounts is not modified. Which action meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an IAM policy that prohibits changes to CloudTrail. and attach it to the root user.
options.text_zh: 创建一条禁止修改 CloudTrail 的 IAM 策略，并把它附加到根用户上。

options.text_en: Create a new trail in CloudTrail from within the developer accounts with the organization trails option enabled.
options.text_zh: 在各开发账户内新建一个 CloudTrail 跟踪，并启用组织跟踪选项。

options.text_en: Create a service control policy (SCP) that prohibits changes to CloudTrail, and attach it the developer accounts.
options.text_zh: 创建一条禁止修改 CloudTrail 的服务控制策略 (SCP)，并把它附加到这些开发账户上。

options.text_en: Create a service-linked role for CloudTrail with a policy condition that allows changes only from an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the management account.
options.text_zh: 为 CloudTrail 创建一个服务相关角色，其策略条件只允许来自管理账户中某个 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN) 的变更。

explanation_en:
SCPs are used in AWS Organizations to set fine-grained permissions and restrictions on AWS accounts within the organization.
By creating an SCP that explicitly prohibits changes to CloudTrail settings, you can enforce this restriction across all developer accounts.
explanation_zh:
SCP 在 AWS Organizations 中用于对组织内的 AWS 账户设置细粒度的权限和限制。
通过创建一条显式禁止更改 CloudTrail 设置的 SCP，你可以在所有开发人员账户中强制实施该限制。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在为某公司设计一个安全方案，该公司希望通过 AWS Organizations 为开发人员提供各自独立的 AWS 账户，同时保持统一的安全控制。由于各开发人员将对自己的账户拥有 AWS 账户 root 用户级别的访问权限，解决方案架构师希望确保应用于新开发人员账户的强制性 AWS CloudTrail 配置不被修改。

哪个操作能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is planning to deploy a business-critical application in the AWS Cloud. The application requires durable storage with consistent, low- latency performance. Which type of storage should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Instance store volume
options.text_zh: 实例存储卷

options.text_en: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster
options.text_zh: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 集群

options.text_en: Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
options.text_zh: 预置 IOPS SSD 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷

options.text_en: Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
options.text_zh: 吞吐量优化型 HDD 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷

explanation_en:
Provisioned IOPS (Input/Output Operations Per Second) SSD volumes are designed to deliver predictable, consistent, and low-latency performance for critical applications.
These volumes allow you to specify the amount of IOPS you need, providing a consistent level of performance regardless of the volume size.
explanation_zh:
预置 IOPS（每秒输入/输出操作数）SSD 卷旨在为关键应用程序提供可预测、稳定且低延迟的性能。
这些卷允许你指定所需的 IOPS 数量，从而无论卷大小如何都能提供稳定的性能水平。
stem_zh:
某公司计划在 AWS 云中部署一个业务关键应用程序。该应用程序需要具备稳定低延迟性能的持久存储。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪种类型的存储来满足这些要求？

stem_en: An online photo-sharing company stores its photos in an Amazon S3 bucket that exists in the us-west-1 Region. The company needs to store a copy of all new photos in the us-east-1 Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.text_en: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 再建一个 S3 存储桶。用 S3 跨区域复制把照片从现有 S3 存储桶复制到第二个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create a cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration of the existing S3 bucket. Specify us-east-1 in the CORS rule's AllowedOrigin element.
options.text_zh: 为现有 S3 存储桶创建跨源资源共享 (CORS) 配置。在 CORS 规则的 AllowedOrigin 元素中指定 us-east-1。

options.text_en: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1 across multiple Availability Zones. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to save photos into the second S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 跨多个可用区再建一个 S3 存储桶。创建一条 S3 生命周期规则把照片存入第二个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 event notifications on object creation and update events to invoke an AWS Lambda function to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在 us-east-1 再建一个 S3 存储桶。为对象创建和更新事件配置 S3 事件通知，调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数把照片从现有 S3 存储桶复制到第二个 S3 存储桶。

explanation_en: S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) is designed specifically for replicating objects across different AWS regions. It is a fully managed feature that automatically replicates objects from the source bucket to the destination bucket in a different region. This requires minimal operational effort as it is a built-in S3 feature for cross-region replication, and you don't have to manually trigger actions or configure additional services.
explanation_zh: S3 跨区域复制（CRR）专为跨不同 AWS 区域复制对象而设计。它是一项全托管功能，可自动将对象从源存储桶复制到位于不同区域的目标存储桶。由于这是 S3 内置的跨区域复制功能，你无需手动触发操作或配置额外服务，因此所需运维工作量极少。
stem_zh:
某在线照片共享公司将其照片存储在位于 us-west-1 区域的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司需要在 us-east-1 区域存储所有新照片的副本。

哪个方案能以最少的运维工作量满足此要求？

stem_en: A company is creating a new web application for its subscribers. The application will consist of a static single page and a persistent database layer. The application will have millions of users for 4 hours in the morning, but the application will have only a few thousand users during the rest of the day. The company's data architects have requested the ability to rapidly evolve their schema. Which solutions will meet these requirements and provide the MOST scalability? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Provision on-demand capacity.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库方案，预置按需容量。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon Aurora as the database solution. Choose the serverless DB engine mode.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Aurora 作为数据库方案，选择无服务器数据库引擎模式。

options.text_en: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Ensure that DynamoDB auto scaling is enabled.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库方案，确保开启 DynamoDB 自动伸缩。

options.text_en: Deploy the static content into an Amazon S3 bucket. Provision an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin.
options.text_zh: 把静态内容部署到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。预置一个以该 S3 存储桶为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

options.text_en: Deploy the web servers for static content across a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. Configure the instances to periodically refresh the content from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume.
options.text_zh: 把承载静态内容的 Web 服务器部署在 Auto Scaling 组的一批 Amazon EC2 实例上。配置这些实例定期从一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷刷新内容。

explanation_en:
DynamoDB auto scaling allows the database to automatically adjust its read and write capacity based on the application's traffic, making it well-suited for varying workloads.

D. Deploy the static content into an Amazon S3 bucket. Provision an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin.

Amazon S3 is a highly scalable and durable object storage service, and using CloudFront, a content delivery network (CDN), helps distribute static content globally, reducing latency and providing scalability.
explanation_zh:
DynamoDB 自动伸缩允许数据库根据应用程序流量自动调整其读写容量，因此非常适合波动的工作负载。

D. 将静态内容部署到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。预置一个以该 S3 存储桶为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

Amazon S3 是一项高度可扩展且持久的对象存储服务，而使用内容分发网络（CDN）CloudFront 有助于在全球分发静态内容，降低延迟并提供可扩展性。
stem_zh:
某公司正在为其订阅用户创建一个新的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将由一个静态单页面和一个持久化数据库层组成。该应用程序在上午的 4 小时内会有数百万用户，但在一天中的其余时间只有几千名用户。公司的数据架构师要求具备快速演进其架构（schema）的能力。

哪些方案能满足这些要求并提供最强的可扩展性？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company uses Amazon API Gateway to manage its REST APIs that third-party service providers access. The company must protect the REST APIs from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure AWS Shield.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Shield。

options.text_en: Configure AWS WAF.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS WAF。

options.text_en: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS Shield in CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 在 API Gateway 前面配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并在 CloudFront 上配置 AWS Shield。

options.text_en: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS WAF in CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 在 API Gateway 前面配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并在 CloudFront 上配置 AWS WAF。

explanation_en: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) is specifically designed to protect web applications from common web exploits like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. By configuring AWS WAF with API Gateway, you can create rules to filter and allow or block requests based on defined conditions, providing protection against various types of attacks.
explanation_zh: AWS WAF（Web 应用防火墙）专为保护 Web 应用免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本（XSS）攻击等常见 Web 漏洞攻击而设计。通过将 AWS WAF 与 API Gateway 配合配置，你可以创建规则，根据定义的条件筛选并允许或阻止请求，从而提供针对各类攻击的防护。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 管理供第三方服务提供商访问的 REST API。公司必须保护这些 REST API 免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击。

满足这些要求的运维效率最高的方案是什么？

stem_en: A company wants to provide users with access to AWS resources. The company has 1,500 users and manages their access to on-premises resources through Active Directory user groups on the corporate network. However, the company does not want users to have to maintain another identity to access the resources. A solutions architect must manage user access to the AWS resources while preserving access to the on- premises resources. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an IAM user for each user in the company. Attach the appropriate policies to each user.
options.text_zh: 为公司里每个用户创建一个 IAM 用户，并给每个用户附加相应的策略。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Cognito with an Active Directory user pool. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon Cognito 搭配 Active Directory 用户池。创建附加了相应策略的角色。

options.text_en: Define cross-account roles with the appropriate policies attached. Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.
options.text_zh: 定义附加了相应策略的跨账户角色，并把这些角色映射到 Active Directory 组。

options.text_en: Configure Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2 0-based federation. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.
options.text_zh: 配置基于安全断言标记语言 (SAML) 2.0 的联合身份验证。创建附加了相应策略的角色，并把这些角色映射到 Active Directory 组。

explanation_en: using SAML 2.0-based federation, which allows you to integrate AWS with your existing Active Directory infrastructure. This approach enables single sign-on (SSO) for users, meaning they can use their existing corporate credentials to access both on-premises and AWS resources without maintaining separate identities.
explanation_zh: 使用基于 SAML 2.0 的联合身份验证，可让你将 AWS 与现有的 Active Directory 基础设施集成。这种做法为用户实现了单点登录（SSO），意味着他们可以使用现有的企业凭证访问本地和 AWS 资源，而无需维护单独的身份。
stem_zh:
某公司希望为用户提供 AWS 资源的访问权限。公司有 1,500 名用户，并通过企业网络上的 Active Directory 用户组管理他们对本地资源的访问。但公司不希望用户为访问这些资源而不得不维护另一套身份。解决方案架构师必须在保留对本地资源访问的同时，管理用户对 AWS 资源的访问。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is hosting a website behind multiple Application Load Balancers. The company has different distribution rights for its content around the world. A solutions architect needs to ensure that users are served the correct content without violating distribution rights. Which configuration should the solutions architect choose to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure Amazon CloudFront with AWS WAF.
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 搭配 AWS WAF。

options.text_en: Configure Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF
options.text_zh: 配置 Application Load Balancer 搭配 AWS WAF。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Route 53 使用地理位置策略。

options.text_en: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geoproximity routing policy
options.text_zh: 配置 Amazon Route 53 使用地理位置临近路由策略。

explanation_en:
Geolocation routing in Amazon Route 53 allows you to route traffic based on the geographic location of the user.
You can create different records for your website content and associate them with specific geographic locations. This way, users from different regions will be directed to the appropriate servers or load balancers hosting the content that adheres to the distribution rights for that region.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Route 53 中的地理位置路由允许你根据用户的地理位置路由流量。
你可以为网站内容创建不同的记录并将它们与特定地理位置关联。这样，来自不同地区的用户将被导向承载符合该地区发行权内容的相应服务器或负载均衡器。
stem_zh:
某公司在多个 Application Load Balancer 之后托管一个网站。公司在全球各地对其内容拥有不同的发行权。解决方案架构师需要确保在不违反发行权的前提下向用户提供正确的内容。

解决方案架构师应选择哪种配置来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores its data on premises. The amount of data is growing beyond the company's available capacity. The company wants to migrate its data from the on-premises location to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs a solution that will automatically validate the integrity of the data after the transfer. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Configure the Snowball Edge device to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge 设备。配置该 Snowball Edge 设备把数据在线传输到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent on premises. Configure the DataSync agent to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在本地部署一个 AWS DataSync 代理。配置该 DataSync 代理把数据在线传输到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises Configure the S3 File Gateway to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.text_zh: 在本地创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway。配置该 S3 File Gateway 把数据在线传输到一个 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Configure an accelerator in Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on premises. Configure the accelerator to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在本地配置一个 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 加速器。配置该加速器把数据在线传输到一个 S3 存储桶。

explanation_en:
AWS DataSync is a service designed for fast and secure online data transfer between on-premises storage and Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, or Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
DataSync automatically performs integrity validation by ensuring that the data transferred to S3 matches the source data. It uses checksums to validate the integrity of the files.
explanation_zh:
AWS DataSync 是一项专为在本地存储与 Amazon S3、Amazon EFS 或 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 之间进行快速安全的在线数据传输而设计的服务。
DataSync 会自动执行完整性验证，确保传输到 S3 的数据与源数据一致。它使用校验和来验证文件的完整性。
stem_zh:
某公司在本地存储其数据。数据量的增长已超出公司的可用容量。

公司希望将其数据从本地位置迁移到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司需要一个能在传输后自动验证数据完整性的方案。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate two DNS servers to AWS. The servers host a total of approximately 200 zones and receive 1 million requests each day on average. The company wants to maximize availability while minimizing the operational overhead that is related to the management of the two servers. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create 200 new hosted zones in the Amazon Route 53 console Import zone files.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon Route 53 控制台中新建 200 个托管区域，并导入区域文件。

options.text_en: Launch a single large Amazon EC2 instance Import zone tiles. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime.
options.text_zh: 启动一台大规格的 Amazon EC2 实例，导入区域文件。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 告警和通知，在出现宕机时提醒公司。

options.text_en: Migrate the servers to AWS by using AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 把这些服务器迁移到 AWS。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 告警和通知，在出现宕机时提醒公司。

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones. Import zone files. Set the desired capacity to 1 and the maximum capacity to 3 for the Auto Scaling group. Configure scaling alarms to scale based on CPU utilization.
options.text_zh: 在跨两个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中启动一台 Amazon EC2 实例，导入区域文件。把该 Auto Scaling 组的期望容量设为 1、最大容量设为 3。配置按 CPU 利用率伸缩的告警。

explanation_en:
Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable domain name system (DNS) web service provided by AWS.
By creating 200 new hosted zones in the Amazon Route 53 console and importing the existing zone files, you can take advantage of the fully managed and highly available nature of Route 53 without the need to manage servers.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Route 53 是 AWS 提供的一项高可用、可扩展的域名系统（DNS）Web 服务。
通过在 Amazon Route 53 控制台中创建 200 个新的托管区域并导入现有区域文件，你可以利用 Route 53 全托管和高可用的特性，而无需管理服务器。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将两台 DNS 服务器迁移到 AWS。这些服务器总共托管约 200 个区域（zone），平均每天接收 100 万次请求。公司希望在最大化可用性的同时，尽量减少与管理这两台服务器相关的运维开销。

解决方案架构师应推荐什么以满足这些要求？

stem_en: A global company runs its applications in multiple AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. The company's applications use multipart uploads to upload data to multiple Amazon S3 buckets across AWS Regions. The company wants to report on incomplete multipart uploads for cost compliance purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Configure AWS Config with a rule to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 AWS Config 规则来报告未完成分段上传的对象数量。

options.text_en: Create a service control policy (SCP) to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.text_zh: 创建一条服务控制策略 (SCP) 来报告未完成分段上传的对象数量。

options.text_en: Configure S3 Storage Lens to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.text_zh: 配置 S3 Storage Lens 来报告未完成分段上传的对象数量。

options.text_en: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 S3 多区域接入点来报告未完成分段上传的对象数量。

explanation_en:
S3 Storage Lens is a feature in Amazon S3 that provides a comprehensive view of your storage usage and activity across multiple accounts. It helps you understand, analyze, and optimize your storage usage.
You can use S3 Storage Lens to generate reports on various metrics, including the incomplete multipart upload object count.
explanation_zh:
S3 Storage Lens 是 Amazon S3 中的一项功能，提供跨多个账户的存储使用情况和活动的全面视图。它帮助你理解、分析和优化存储使用情况。
你可以使用 S3 Storage Lens 生成各类指标的报告，其中包括未完成的分段上传对象数量。
stem_zh:
某跨国公司在 AWS Organizations 中的多个 AWS 账户中运行其应用程序。公司的应用程序使用分段上传将数据上传到跨多个 AWS 区域的多个 Amazon S3 存储桶。出于成本合规目的，公司希望报告未完成的分段上传情况。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a production database on Amazon RDS for MySQL. The company wants to upgrade the database version for security compliance reasons. Because the database contains critical data, the company wants a quick solution to upgrade and test functionality without losing any data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an RDS manual snapshot. Upgrade to the new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 RDS 手动快照，然后升级到新版本的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。

options.text_en: Use native backup and restore. Restore the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.text_zh: 使用原生备份与还原，把数据还原到升级后的新版本 Amazon RDS for MySQL。

options.text_en: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 把数据复制到升级后的新版本 Amazon RDS for MySQL。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments to deploy and test production changes.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon RDS 蓝绿部署来部署并测试生产变更。

stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 上运行一个生产数据库。出于安全合规原因，公司希望升级数据库版本。由于该数据库包含关键数据，公司希望有一个快速的方案来升级并测试功能，同时不丢失任何数据。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect is creating a data processing job that runs once daily and can take up to 2 hours to complete. If the job is interrupted, it has to restart from the beginning. How should the solutions architect address this issue in the MOST cost-effective manner?

options.text_en: Create a script that runs locally on an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance that is triggered by a cron job.
options.text_zh: 编写一个脚本，在一台 Amazon EC2 预留实例上本地运行，由 cron 作业触发。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
options.text_zh: 创建一个由 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件触发的 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Fargate task triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
options.text_zh: 使用一个由 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件触发的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Fargate 任务。

options.text_en: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task running on Amazon EC2 triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
options.text_zh: 使用一个运行在 Amazon EC2 上、由 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件触发的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务。

explanation_en: ECS Fargate is a serverless container service, and it abstracts away the underlying infrastructure. With Fargate, you don't need to manage or provision EC2 instances directly. You can run containers without worrying about the infrastructure, and AWS takes care of scaling and resource allocation.
explanation_zh: ECS Fargate 是一项无服务器容器服务，它屏蔽了底层基础设施。使用 Fargate 时，你无需直接管理或预置 EC2 实例。你可以运行容器而无需担心基础设施，AWS 会负责伸缩和资源分配。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在创建一个每天运行一次的数据处理作业，该作业最长可能需要 2 小时才能完成。如果作业被中断，就必须从头重新开始。

解决方案架构师应如何以最具成本效益的方式处理此问题？

stem_en: A social media company wants to store its database of user profiles, relationships, and interactions in the AWS Cloud. The company needs an application to monitor any changes in the database. The application needs to analyze the relationships between the data entities and to provide recommendations to users. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Neptune 存储这些信息。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 处理数据库中的变更。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Neptune 存储这些信息。用 Neptune Streams 处理数据库中的变更。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) 存储这些信息。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 处理数据库中的变更。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) 存储这些信息。用 Neptune Streams 处理数据库中的变更。

explanation_en:
Amazon Neptune is a fully managed graph database service that is designed for storing and querying highly connected data. It supports the property graph and RDF graph models, making it suitable for scenarios where relationships between data entities need to be analyzed.
Neptune Streams:

Neptune Streams is a feature of Amazon Neptune that allows you to capture changes (inserts, updates, deletes) made to the graph database in a streaming fashion. This streaming capability enables you to react to changes in near real-time and trigger additional processing based on those changes.
explanation_zh:
Amazon Neptune 是一项全托管图数据库服务，专为存储和查询高度关联的数据而设计。它支持属性图和 RDF 图模型，因此适合需要分析数据实体之间关系的场景。
Neptune Streams：

Neptune Streams 是 Amazon Neptune 的一项功能，允许你以流式方式捕获对图数据库所做的变更（插入、更新、删除）。这种流式能力使你能够近实时地响应变更，并基于这些变更触发额外处理。
stem_zh:
某社交媒体公司希望将其用户资料、关系和互动数据库存储在 AWS 云中。公司需要一个应用程序来监控数据库中的任何变更。该应用程序需要分析数据实体之间的关系，并向用户提供推荐。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is creating a new application that will store a large amount of data. The data will be analyzed hourly and will be modified by several Amazon EC2 Linux instances that are deployed across multiple Availability Zones. The needed amount of storage space will continue to grow for the next 6 months. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Store the data in Amazon S3 Glacier. Update the S3 Glacier vault policy to allow access to the application instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据存放在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中。更新 S3 Glacier 保管库策略，允许这些应用实例访问。

options.text_en: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on the application instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据存放在一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。把该 EBS 卷挂载到这些应用实例上。

options.text_en: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the file system on the application instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据存放在一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。把该文件系统挂载到这些应用实例上。

options.text_en: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS volume shared between the application instances.
options.text_zh: 把数据存放在一个由这些应用实例共享的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 预置 IOPS 卷上。

explanation_en: Amazon EFS is a scalable and fully managed file storage service that can be mounted on multiple Amazon EC2 instances simultaneously. It provides a shared file system that can be accessed concurrently from different instances.Amazon EFS can automatically scale its file system capacity to accommodate growing data sets. It can handle a large amount of data and is designed to grow and shrink as needed.
explanation_zh: Amazon EFS 是一项可扩展的全托管文件存储服务，可同时挂载到多台 Amazon EC2 实例上。它提供一个可被不同实例并发访问的共享文件系统。Amazon EFS 可以自动扩展其文件系统容量以容纳不断增长的数据集。它可以处理大量数据，并被设计为按需增长和收缩。
stem_zh:
某公司正在创建一个将存储大量数据的新应用程序。这些数据将每小时被分析一次，并会被部署在多个可用区中的若干 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例修改。所需的存储空间在未来 6 个月内将持续增长。

解决方案架构师应推荐哪种存储方案来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company manages an application that stores data on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Increases in traffic are causing performance problems. The company determines that database queries are the primary reason for the slow performance. What should a solutions architect do to improve the application's performance?

options.text_en: Serve read traffic from the Multi-AZ standby replica.
options.text_zh: 由多可用区的备用副本承担读取流量。

options.text_en: Configure the DB instance to use Transfer Acceleration.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例配置为使用 Transfer Acceleration。

options.text_en: Create a read replica from the source DB instance. Serve read traffic from the read replica.
options.text_zh: 从源数据库实例创建一个只读副本，由该只读副本承担读取流量。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose between the application and Amazon RDS to increase the concurrency of database requests.
options.text_zh: 在应用与 Amazon RDS 之间使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose，以提高数据库请求的并发度。

explanation_en: Creating read replicas allows you to offload read traffic from the primary (master) DB instance to one or more read replicas. Read replicas can serve read-only queries, distributing the load and improving overall query performance.
explanation_zh: 创建只读副本可让你把读流量从主（master）数据库实例卸载到一个或多个只读副本上。只读副本可以处理只读查询，分散负载并提升整体查询性能。
stem_zh:
某公司管理着一个将数据存储在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 多可用区数据库实例上的应用程序。流量增长导致性能问题。公司确定数据库查询是性能缓慢的主要原因。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来提升该应用程序的性能？

stem_en: A company collects 10 GB of telemetry data daily from various machines. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in a source data account. The company has hired several consulting agencies to use this data for analysis. Each agency needs read access to the data for its analysts. The company must share the data from the source data account by choosing a solution that maximizes security and operational efficiency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure S3 global tables to replicate data for each agency.
options.text_zh: 配置 S3 全局表为每家机构复制数据。

options.text_en: Make the S3 bucket public for a limited time. Inform only the agencies.
options.text_zh: 把该 S3 存储桶临时设为公开，只把这件事告知这些机构。

options.text_en: Configure cross-account access for the S3 bucket to the accounts that the agencies own.
options.text_zh: 为该 S3 存储桶配置跨账户访问，开放给这些机构自有的账户。

options.text_en: Set up an IAM user for each analyst in the source data account. Grant each user access to the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 在源数据账户中为每位分析师各设置一个 IAM 用户，并授予每个用户访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。

explanation_en: By configuring cross-account access, you can grant permissions to specific AWS accounts (owned by the consulting agencies) to access the S3 bucket. This allows you to share the data securely with the agencies without making the data public or creating additional IAM users in the source data account.
explanation_zh: 通过配置跨账户访问，你可以向特定的 AWS 账户（由咨询机构拥有）授予访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。这使你能够安全地与这些机构共享数据，而无需将数据公开，也无需在源数据账户中创建额外的 IAM 用户。
stem_zh:
某公司每天从各种机器收集 10 GB 的遥测数据。公司将这些数据存储在一个源数据账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶里。

公司聘请了几家咨询机构使用这些数据进行分析。每家机构都需要为其分析师提供对数据的读取权限。公司必须选择一个能最大化安全性和运维效率的方案，从源数据账户共享这些数据。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP in its primary AWS Region for CIFS and NFS file shares. Applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances access the file shares. The company needs a storage disaster recovery (DR) solution in a secondary Region. The data that is replicated in the secondary Region needs to be accessed by using the same protocols as the primary Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Replicate the S3 bucket to the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数把数据复制到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。把该 S3 存储桶复制到第二区域。

options.text_en: Create a backup of the FSx for ONTAP volumes by using AWS Backup. Copy the volumes to the secondary Region. Create a new FSx for ONTAP instance from the backup.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Backup 为这些 FSx for ONTAP 卷创建备份。把卷复制到第二区域。从备份创建一个新的 FSx for ONTAP 实例。

options.text_en: Create an FSx for ONTAP instance in the secondary Region. Use NetApp SnapMirror to replicate data from the primary Region to the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 在第二区域创建一个 FSx for ONTAP 实例。用 NetApp SnapMirror 把数据从主区域复制到第二区域。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Migrate the current data to the volume. Replicate the volume to the secondary Region.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。把当前数据迁移到该卷，并把该卷复制到第二区域。

explanation_en: FSx for ONTAP supports NetApp SnapMirror, which is a robust data replication technology. You can use SnapMirror to replicate data from the primary FSx for ONTAP instance in the primary Region to an FSx for ONTAP instance in the secondary Region.
explanation_zh: FSx for ONTAP 支持 NetApp SnapMirror，这是一项强大的数据复制技术。你可以使用 SnapMirror 将数据从主区域的 FSx for ONTAP 实例复制到第二个区域的 FSx for ONTAP 实例。
stem_zh:
某公司在其主 AWS 区域使用 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 提供 CIFS 和 NFS 文件共享。运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序访问这些文件共享。公司需要在第二个区域建立一个存储灾难恢复（DR）方案。在第二个区域中复制的数据需要使用与主区域相同的协议进行访问。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A development team is creating an event-based application that uses AWS Lambda functions. Events will be generated when files are added to an Amazon S3 bucket. The development team currently has Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) configured as the event target from Amazon S3. What should a solutions architect do to process the events from Amazon S3 in a scalable way?

options.text_en: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) before the event runs in Lambda.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 SNS 订阅，让事件在进入 Lambda 之前先由 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 处理。

options.text_en: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) before the event runs in Lambda
options.text_zh: 创建一个 SNS 订阅，让事件在进入 Lambda 之前先由 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 处理。

options.text_en: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure the SOS queue to trigger a Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 创建一个把事件发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 的 SNS 订阅。配置该 SQS 队列去触发一个 Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure the Lambda function to poll from the SMS event.
options.text_zh: 创建一个把事件发送到 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 的 SNS 订阅。配置该 Lambda 函数从 SMS 事件中轮询。

stem_zh:
某开发团队正在创建一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数的事件驱动应用程序。当文件被添加到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶时会产生事件。该开发团队目前已将 Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）配置为来自 Amazon S3 的事件目标。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做，才能以可扩展的方式处理来自 Amazon S3 的这些事件？

stem_en: A solutions architect is designing a new service behind Amazon API Gateway. The request patterns for the service will be unpredictable and can change suddenly from 0 requests to over 500 per second. The total size of the data that needs to be persisted in a backend database is currently less than 1 GB with unpredictable future growth. Data can be queried using simple key-value requests. Which combination ofAWS services would meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: AWS Fargate
options.text_zh: AWS Fargate

options.text_en: AWS Lambda
options.text_zh: AWS Lambda

options.text_en: Amazon DynamoDB
options.text_zh: Amazon DynamoDB

options.text_en: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.text_zh: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling

options.text_en: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora
options.text_zh: 兼容 MySQL 的 Amazon Aurora

explanation_en:
AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that automatically scales with the number of incoming requests. It's suitable for unpredictable workloads, as it allows you to run code without provisioning or managing servers. Lambda functions can be triggered by API Gateway for handling HTTP requests.
Amazon DynamoDB (Option C):

DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service that can handle unpredictable and scalable workloads. It provides low-latency, high-throughput performance for simple key-value queries. DynamoDB automatically scales to accommodate varying request rates, and you pay for the throughput you provision.
explanation_zh:
AWS Lambda 是一项无服务器计算服务，会随传入请求数量自动伸缩。它适合不可预测的工作负载，因为它让你无需预置或管理服务器即可运行代码。Lambda 函数可由 API Gateway 触发以处理 HTTP 请求。
Amazon DynamoDB（选项 C）：

DynamoDB 是一项全托管的 NoSQL 数据库服务，可以处理不可预测且可扩展的工作负载。它为简单的键值查询提供低延迟、高吞吐量的性能。DynamoDB 会自动伸缩以适应变化的请求速率，你只需为预置的吞吐量付费。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师正在 Amazon API Gateway 之后设计一项新服务。该服务的请求模式将不可预测，可能从每秒 0 个请求突然变为每秒 500 个以上。目前需要在后端数据库中持久化的数据总量不到 1 GB，未来的增长不可预测。数据可以通过简单的键值请求进行查询。

哪种 AWS 服务组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company collects and shares research data with the company's employees all over the world. The company wants to collect and store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket and process the data in the AWS Cloud. The company will share the data with the company's employees. The company needs a secure solution in the AWS Cloud that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to create an S3 presigned URL. Instruct employees to use the URL.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Lambda 函数生成 S3 预签名 URL，让员工使用该 URL。

options.text_en: Create an IAM user for each employee. Create an IAM policy for each employee to allow S3 access. Instruct employees to use the AWS Management Console.
options.text_zh: 为每位员工创建一个 IAM 用户。为每位员工创建一条允许访问 S3 的 IAM 策略。让员工使用 AWS 管理控制台。

options.text_en: Create an S3 File Gateway. Create a share for uploading and a share for downloading. Allow employees to mount shares on their local computers to use S3 File Gateway.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 S3 File Gateway。分别创建用于上传和下载的共享。允许员工在自己的本地电脑上挂载这些共享来使用 S3 File Gateway。

options.text_en: Configure AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoints. Select the custom identity provider options. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the user credentials Instruct employees to use Transfer Family.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 端点。选择自定义身份提供方选项。用 AWS Secrets Manager 管理用户凭证。让员工使用 Transfer Family。

stem_zh:
某公司收集研究数据并与其遍布全球的员工共享。公司希望将数据收集并存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并在 AWS 云中处理这些数据。公司将把数据共享给员工。公司需要一个在 AWS 云中安全且运维开销最小的方案。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is building a new furniture inventory application. The company has deployed the application on a fleet ofAmazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in their VPC. A solutions architect has observed that incoming traffic seems to favor one EC2 instance, resulting in latency for some requests. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.text_en: Disable session affinity (sticky sessions) on the ALB
options.text_zh: 关闭该 ALB 上的会话亲和性（粘性会话）。

options.text_en: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer
options.text_zh: 把该 ALB 换成 Network Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Increase the number of EC2 instances in each Availability Zone
options.text_zh: 增加每个可用区中的 EC2 实例数量。

options.text_en: Adjust the frequency of the health checks on the ALB's target group
options.text_zh: 调整该 ALB 目标组上运行状况检查的频率。

explanation_en: Session affinity, also known as sticky sessions, directs a client's requests to the same EC2 instance, based on the client's session information. While sticky sessions can be useful in some scenarios, they can lead to uneven distribution of traffic, causing latency for some requests if one EC2 instance is overloaded.
explanation_zh: 会话亲和性（也称为粘性会话）会根据客户端的会话信息将其请求导向同一台 EC2 实例。虽然粘性会话在某些场景下有用，但它可能导致流量分布不均，当某台 EC2 实例过载时会造成部分请求延迟。
stem_zh:
某公司正在构建一个新的家具库存应用程序。公司已将该应用程序部署在跨多个可用区的一组 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些 EC2 实例运行在其 VPC 内的一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）之后。

一位解决方案架构师观察到，传入流量似乎偏向某一台 EC2 实例，导致部分请求出现延迟。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做来解决此问题？

stem_en: A company has an application workflow that uses an AWS Lambda function to download and decrypt files from Amazon S3. These files are encrypted using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that will ensure the required permissions are set correctly. Which combination of actions accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Attach the kms:decrypt permission to the Lambda function’s resource policy
options.text_zh: 把 kms:decrypt 权限加到该 Lambda 函数的资源策略中。

options.text_en: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda IAM role in the KMS key's policy
options.text_zh: 在该 KMS 密钥的策略中，为该 Lambda IAM 角色授予解密权限。

options.text_en: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda resource policy in the KMS key's policy.
options.text_zh: 在该 KMS 密钥的策略中，为该 Lambda 资源策略授予解密权限。

options.text_en: Create a new IAM policy with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the policy to the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 新建一条带 kms:decrypt 权限的 IAM 策略，并把该策略附加到该 Lambda 函数上。

options.text_en: Create a new IAM role with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the execution role to the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 新建一个带 kms:decrypt 权限的 IAM 角色，并把该执行角色附加到该 Lambda 函数上。

explanation_en: E. Create a new IAM role with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the execution role to the Lambda function.
explanation_zh: E. 创建一个具有 kms:decrypt 权限的新 IAM 角色，并将该执行角色附加到该 Lambda 函数。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个应用程序工作流，使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数从 Amazon S3 下载并解密文件。这些文件使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）密钥加密。解决方案架构师需要设计一个方案，确保所需权限设置正确。

哪些操作组合能实现这一点？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company wants to monitor its AWS costs for financial review. The cloud operations team is designing an architecture in the AWS Organizations management account to query AWS Cost and Usage Reports for all member accounts. The team must run this query once a month and provide a detailed analysis of the bill. Which solution is the MOST scalable and cost-effective way to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon EMR for analysis.
options.text_zh: 在管理账户中启用「成本与使用情况报告」。把报告投递到 Amazon Kinesis。用 Amazon EMR 做分析。

options.text_en: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3 Use Amazon Athena for analysis.
options.text_zh: 在管理账户中启用「成本与使用情况报告」。把报告投递到 Amazon S3。用 Amazon Athena 做分析。

options.text_en: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3 Use Amazon Redshift for analysis.
options.text_zh: 为各成员账户启用「成本与使用情况报告」。把报告投递到 Amazon S3。用 Amazon Redshift 做分析。

options.text_en: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon QuickSight tor analysis.
options.text_zh: 为各成员账户启用「成本与使用情况报告」。把报告投递到 Amazon Kinesis。用 Amazon QuickSight 做分析。

explanation_en: Amazon Athena is a serverless query service that allows you to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using SQL queries.
explanation_zh: Amazon Athena 是一项无服务器查询服务，允许你使用 SQL 查询直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据。
stem_zh:
某公司希望监控其 AWS 成本以供财务审阅。云运维团队正在 AWS Organizations 管理账户中设计一个架构，用于查询所有成员账户的 AWS 成本和使用情况报告（Cost and Usage Reports）。该团队必须每月运行一次此查询，并提供账单的详细分析。

哪个方案是满足这些要求最具可扩展性和成本效益的方式？

stem_en: A company wants to run a gaming application on Amazon EC2 instances that are part of an Auto Scaling group in the AWS Cloud. The application will transmit data by using UDP packets. The company wants to ensure that the application can scale out and in as traffic increases and decreases. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Attach a Network Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 给该 Auto Scaling 组挂一个 Network Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 给该 Auto Scaling 组挂一个 Application Load Balancer。

options.text_en: Deploy an Amazon Route 53 record set with a weighted policy to route traffic appropriately.
options.text_zh: 部署一条采用加权策略的 Amazon Route 53 记录集来适当地路由流量。

options.text_en: Deploy a NAT instance that is configured with port forwarding to the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group.
options.text_zh: 部署一台配置了端口转发的 NAT 实例，转发到该 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例。

explanation_en: UDP is a connectionless protocol, and Network Load Balancers (NLB) support UDP, making them suitable for applications that use UDP for transmitting data.
explanation_zh: UDP 是一种无连接协议，而 Network Load Balancer（NLB）支持 UDP，因此适合使用 UDP 传输数据的应用程序。
stem_zh:
某公司希望在 AWS 云中一个 Auto Scaling 组内的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个游戏应用程序。该应用程序将使用 UDP 数据包传输数据。公司希望确保该应用程序能够随流量的增减进行扩容和缩容。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs several websites on AWS for its different brands. Each website generates tens of gigabytes of web traffic logs each day. A solutions architect needs to design a scalable solution to give the company's developers the ability to analyze traffic patterns across all the company's websites. This analysis by the developers will occur on demand once a week over the course of several months. The solution must support queries with standard SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena tor analysis.
options.text_zh: 把日志存放在 Amazon S3 中，用 Amazon Athena 做分析。

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon RDS. Use a database client for analysis.
options.text_zh: 把日志存放在 Amazon RDS 中，用数据库客户端做分析。

options.text_en: Store the logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service for analysis.
options.text_zh: 把日志存放在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 中，用 OpenSearch Service 做分析。

options.text_en: Store the logs in an Amazon EMR cluster Use a supported open-source framework for SQL-based analysis.
options.text_zh: 把日志存放在一个 Amazon EMR 集群中，用其支持的开源框架做基于 SQL 的分析。

explanation_en: Amazon Athena is a serverless query service that allows you to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL queries. It is cost-effective because you pay only for the queries you run, and there is no need to provision or manage infrastructure.
explanation_zh: Amazon Athena 是一项无服务器查询服务，允许你使用标准 SQL 查询直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据。它具有成本效益，因为你只需为运行的查询付费，无需预置或管理基础设施。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上为其不同品牌运行多个网站。每个网站每天产生数十 GB 的 Web 流量日志。解决方案架构师需要设计一个可扩展的方案，让公司的开发人员能够分析所有公司网站的流量模式。开发人员的这项分析将在数月期间每周按需进行一次。该方案必须支持使用标准 SQL 的查询。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: An international company has a subdomain for each country that the company operates in. The subdomains are formatted as example.com, country1.example.com, and country2.example.com. The company's workloads are behind an Application Load Balancer. The company wants to encrypt the website data that is in transit. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public certificate for the apex top domain example com and a wildcard certificate for *.example.com.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 控制台中，为顶级域 example.com 申请一张公有证书，并为 *.example.com 申请一张通配符证书。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a private certificate for the apex top domain example.com and a wildcard certificate for *.example.com.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 控制台中，为顶级域 example.com 申请一张私有证书，并为 *.example.com 申请一张通配符证书。

options.text_en: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public and private certificate for the apex top domain example.com.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 控制台中，为顶级域 example.com 同时申请公有证书和私有证书。

options.text_en: Validate domain ownership by email address. Switch to DNS validation by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider.
options.text_zh: 先用电子邮件地址验证域名所有权，再通过在 DNS 提供商处添加所需的 DNS 记录切换到 DNS 验证。

options.text_en: Validate domain ownership for the domain by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider.
options.text_zh: 通过在 DNS 提供商处添加所需的 DNS 记录来验证该域名的所有权。

explanation_en:
E. Validate domain ownership for the domain by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider.

AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) is a service provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS) that simplifies the process of managing and provisioning SSL/TLS (Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security) certificates for your applications and websites. SSL/TLS certificates are essential for encrypting data in transit and securing communication between clients and servers.

 ACM requires domain ownership validation before issuing certificates. For wildcard certificates, DNS validation is necessary.
explanation_zh:
E. 通过向 DNS 提供商添加所需的 DNS 记录来验证该域名的所有权。

AWS Certificate Manager（ACM）是 Amazon Web Services（AWS）提供的一项服务，简化了为你的应用程序和网站管理和预置 SSL/TLS（安全套接字层/传输层安全）证书的过程。SSL/TLS 证书对于加密传输中的数据以及保护客户端与服务器之间的通信至关重要。

 ACM 在签发证书之前需要验证域名所有权。对于通配符证书，必须使用 DNS 验证。
stem_zh:
某跨国公司为其运营所在的每个国家/地区设有一个子域名。这些子域名的格式为 example.com、country1.example.com 和 country2.example.com。公司的工作负载位于一个 Application Load Balancer 之后。公司希望对传输中的网站数据进行加密。

哪些步骤组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is required to use cryptographic keys in its on-premises key manager. The key manager is outside of the AWS Cloud because of regulatory and compliance requirements. The company wants to manage encryption and decryption by using cryptographic keys that are retained outside of the AWS Cloud and that support a variety of external key managers from different vendors. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use AWS CloudHSM key store backed by a CloudHSM cluster.
options.text_zh: 使用由 CloudHSM 集群支撑的 AWS CloudHSM 密钥存储。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) external key store backed by an external key manager.
options.text_zh: 使用由外部密钥管理器支撑的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 外部密钥存储。

options.text_en: Use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed key store.
options.text_zh: 使用默认的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 托管密钥存储。

options.text_en: Use a custom key store backed by an AWS CloudHSM cluster.
options.text_zh: 使用由 AWS CloudHSM 集群支撑的自定义密钥存储。

stem_zh:
某公司被要求在其本地密钥管理器中使用加密密钥。出于监管和合规要求，该密钥管理器位于 AWS 云之外。公司希望使用保留在 AWS 云之外、并支持来自不同厂商的多种外部密钥管理器的加密密钥来管理加解密。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to host a high performance computing (HPC) workload in the AWS Cloud. The workload will run on hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances and will require parallel access to a shared file system to enable distributed processing of large datasets. Datasets will be accessed across multiple instances simultaneously. The workload requires access latency within 1 ms. After processing has completed, engineers will need access to the dataset for manual postprocessing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) as a shared file system. Access the dataset from Amazon EFS.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作为共享文件系统，从 Amazon EFS 访问数据集。

options.text_en: Mount an Amazon S3 bucket to serve as the shared file system. Perform postprocessing directly from the S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 把一个 Amazon S3 存储桶挂载为共享文件系统，直接从该 S3 存储桶做后处理。

options.text_en: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre as a shared file system. Link the file system to an Amazon S3 bucket for postprocessing.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 作为共享文件系统。把该文件系统链接到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶用于后处理。

options.text_en: Configure AWS Resource Access Manager to share an Amazon S3 bucket so that it can be mounted to all instances for processing and postprocessing.
options.text_zh: 配置 AWS Resource Access Manager 共享一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，使其能挂载到所有实例上用于处理和后处理。

explanation_en: FSx for Lustre is designed for high-performance computing workloads that require fast and scalable shared storage. It provides low-latency access to data and is well-suited for parallel processing across multiple instances.
explanation_zh: FSx for Lustre 专为需要快速可扩展共享存储的高性能计算工作负载而设计。它提供对数据的低延迟访问，非常适合跨多台实例的并行处理。
stem_zh:
一位解决方案架构师需要在 AWS 云中托管一个高性能计算（HPC）工作负载。该工作负载将运行在数百台 Amazon EC2 实例上，并需要对共享文件系统的并行访问，以实现大型数据集的分布式处理。数据集将被多台实例同时访问。该工作负载要求访问延迟在 1 毫秒以内。处理完成后，工程师需要访问该数据集进行手动后处理。

哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A gaming company is building an application with Voice over IP capabilities. The application will serve traffic to users across the world. The application needs to be highly available with an automated failover across AWS Regions. The company wants to minimize the latency of users without relying on IP address caching on user devices. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Global Accelerator with health checks.
options.text_zh: 使用带运行状况检查的 AWS Global Accelerator。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation routing policy.
options.text_zh: 使用采用地理位置路由策略的 Amazon Route 53。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that includes multiple origins.
options.text_zh: 创建一个包含多个源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

options.text_en: Create an Application Load Balancer that uses path-based routing.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用基于路径路由的 Application Load Balancer。

explanation_en: AWS Global Accelerator is a service that provides static IP addresses (Anycast) to route traffic over the AWS global network. It routes traffic over the optimal path to the AWS endpoint, improving availability and performance.
explanation_zh: AWS Global Accelerator 是一项提供静态 IP 地址（任播）以通过 AWS 全球网络路由流量的服务。它沿最优路径将流量路由到 AWS 终端节点，从而提升可用性和性能。
stem_zh:
某游戏公司正在构建一个具备 IP 语音（VoIP）功能的应用程序。该应用程序将为全球用户提供服务。该应用程序需要高可用，并具备跨 AWS 区域的自动故障转移能力。公司希望在不依赖用户设备上 IP 地址缓存的前提下最大限度降低用户延迟。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A weather forecasting company needs to process hundreds of gigabytes of data with sub-millisecond latency. The company has a high performance computing (HPC) environment in its data center and wants to expand its forecasting capabilities. A solutions architect must identify a highly available cloud storage solution that can handle large amounts of sustained throughput. Files that are stored in the solution should be accessible to thousands of compute instances that will simultaneously access and process the entire dataset. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre scratch file systems.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 暂存 (scratch) 文件系统。

options.text_en: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre persistent file systems.
options.text_zh: 使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 持久化 (persistent) 文件系统。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Bursting Throughput mode.
options.text_zh: 使用突增吞吐量模式的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Provisioned Throughput mode.
options.text_zh: 使用预置吞吐量模式的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。

explanation_en: Persistent file systems in FSx for Lustre are designed for longer-term storage needs. They provide a durable and highly available solution for your data. This is important for the weather forecasting company's requirement to handle large amounts of sustained throughput.
explanation_zh: FSx for Lustre 中的持久化文件系统专为较长期的存储需求而设计。它们为你的数据提供持久且高可用的方案。这对于该天气预报公司处理大量持续吞吐量的要求非常重要。
stem_zh:
某天气预报公司需要以亚毫秒级延迟处理数百 GB 数据。公司在其数据中心拥有一套高性能计算（HPC）环境，并希望扩展其预报能力。

解决方案架构师必须找出一个能够处理大量持续吞吐量的高可用云存储方案。存储在该方案中的文件应可被数千台计算实例访问，这些实例将同时访问并处理整个数据集。

解决方案架构师应该怎么做才能满足这些要求？

stem_en: An ecommerce company runs a PostgreSQL database on premises. The database stores data by using high IOPS Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) block storage. The daily peak I/O transactions per second do not exceed 15,000 IOPS. The company wants to migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and provision disk IOPS performance independent of disk storage capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.text_zh: 配置通用型 SSD (gp2) EBS 卷存储类型，并预置 15,000 IOPS。

options.text_en: Configure the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.text_zh: 配置预置 IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷存储类型，并预置 15,000 IOPS。

options.text_en: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.text_zh: 配置通用型 SSD (gp3) EBS 卷存储类型，并预置 15,000 IOPS。

options.text_en: Configure the EBS magnetic volume type to achieve maximum IOPS.
options.text_zh: 配置 EBS 磁介质卷类型以获得最大 IOPS。

explanation_en: Amazon EBS gp3 volumes are designed for general-purpose workloads and offer a balance of price and performance. They allow you to provision IOPS independently of storage capacity, similar to io1 volumes.
explanation_zh: Amazon EBS gp3 卷专为通用型工作负载设计，兼顾价格与性能。它们允许你独立于存储容量预置 IOPS，这一点与 io1 卷类似。
stem_zh:
某电商公司在本地运行一个 PostgreSQL 数据库。该数据库使用高 IOPS 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）块存储来存储数据。每日峰值 I/O 每秒事务数不超过 15,000 IOPS。公司希望将该数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL，并独立于磁盘存储容量预置磁盘 IOPS 性能。

哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to migrate its on-premises Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise edition database to AWS. The company's online application uses the database to process transactions. The data analysis team uses the same production database to run reports for analytical processing. The company wants to reduce operational overhead by moving to managed services wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Migrate to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SOL Server. Use read replicas for reporting purposes
options.text_zh: 迁移到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server，用只读副本承担报表用途。

options.text_en: Migrate to Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2. Use Always On read replicas for reporting purposes
options.text_zh: 迁移到 Amazon EC2 上的 Microsoft SQL Server，用 Always On 只读副本承担报表用途。

options.text_en: Migrate to Amazon DynamoDB. Use DynamoDB on-demand replicas for reporting purposes
options.text_zh: 迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB，用 DynamoDB 按需副本承担报表用途。

options.text_en: Migrate to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Use Aurora read replicas for reporting purposes
options.text_zh: 迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL，用 Aurora 只读副本承担报表用途。

explanation_en: Amazon RDS supports read replicas, allowing you to offload reporting and analytical workloads to replicas without impacting the performance of the primary database. This is a cost-effective and efficient way to handle reporting without affecting transactional processing on the primary database.
explanation_zh: Amazon RDS 支持只读副本，让你能够将报表和分析工作负载卸载到副本上，而不影响主数据库的性能。这是一种在不影响主数据库事务处理的前提下处理报表的高效且具有成本效益的方式。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将其本地的 Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise 版数据库迁移到 AWS。公司的在线应用程序使用该数据库处理交易。数据分析团队使用同一个生产数据库运行报表以进行分析处理。公司希望通过尽可能迁移到托管服务来降低运维开销。

哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores a large volume of image files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The images need to be readily available for the first 180 days. The images are infrequently accessed for the next 180 days. After 360 days, the images need to be archived but must be available instantly upon request. After 5 years, only auditors can access the images. The auditors must be able to retrieve the images within 12 hours. The images cannot be lost during this process. A developer will use S3 Standard storage for the first 180 days. The developer needs to configure an S3 Lifecycle rule. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.text_zh: 180 天后把对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)，360 天后转到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，5 年后转到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.text_zh: 180 天后把对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)，360 天后转到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，5 年后转到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.text_zh: 180 天后把对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，360 天后转到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，5 年后转到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.text_zh: 180 天后把对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，360 天后转到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，5 年后转到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

explanation_en:
S3 Standard-IA (instead of One Zone-IA) ensures high durability across multiple AZs for infrequent access.
Glacier Instant Retrieval meets the "instant availability" requirement after 360 days, while Glacier Deep Archive is cost-effective for audits after 5 years.
(Option A/B use less durable One Zone-IA, and Option D uses slower Glacier Flexible Retrieval, which violates the "instant" requirement.)
explanation_zh:
S3 Standard-IA（而非 One Zone-IA）可为不频繁访问的数据提供跨多个可用区的高持久性。
Glacier Instant Retrieval 满足 360 天后「即时可用」的要求，而 Glacier Deep Archive 对 5 年后的审计场景具有成本效益。
（选项 A/B 使用了持久性较低的 One Zone-IA，选项 D 使用了较慢的 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，违反了「即时」的要求。）
stem_zh: 某公司在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中存放大量图片文件。前 180 天这些图片需要随时可用。接下来的 180 天里访问频率较低。360 天之后这些图片需要归档，但请求时必须能立即取得。5 年之后只有审计员才能访问这些图片，且审计员必须能在 12 小时内取回。整个过程中不能丢失图片。开发人员在前 180 天会使用 S3 Standard 存储。该开发人员需要配置一条 S3 生命周期规则。哪个方案能以最高性价比满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company has a large data workload that runs for 6 hours each day. The company cannot lose any data while the process is running. A solutions architect is designing an Amazon EMR cluster configuration to support this critical data workload. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Configure a long-running cluster that runs the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances and the task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 配置一个长期运行的集群，主节点和核心节点用按需实例，任务节点用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Configure a transient cluster that runs the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances and the task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 配置一个临时集群，主节点和核心节点用按需实例，任务节点用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Configure a transient cluster that runs the primary node on an On-Demand Instance and the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 配置一个临时集群，主节点用按需实例，核心节点和任务节点都用 Spot 实例。

options.text_en: Configure a long-running cluster that runs the primary node on an On-Demand Instance, the core nodes on Spot Instances, and the task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 配置一个长期运行的集群，主节点用按需实例，核心节点用 Spot 实例，任务节点也用 Spot 实例。

explanation_en:
Transient clusters are cost-effective for short workloads. Spot Instances reduce costs for non-critical task nodes.
Long-running clusters (Options A/D) are unnecessary for a 6-hour workload.
explanation_zh:
临时集群对短时工作负载具有成本效益。Spot 实例可降低非关键任务节点的成本。
对于 6 小时的工作负载，长期运行的集群（选项 A/D）没有必要。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个每天运行 6 小时的大型数据工作负载。在该处理过程运行期间，公司不能丢失任何数据。一位解决方案架构师正在设计一个 Amazon EMR 集群配置来支撑这个关键数据工作负载。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company maintains an Amazon RDS database that maps users to cost centers. The company has accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs a solution that will tag all resources that are created in a specific AWS account in the organization. The solution must tag each resource with the cost center ID of the user who created the resource. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Move the specific AWS account to a new organizational unit (OU) in Organizations from the management account. Create a service control policy (SCP) that requires all existing resources to have the correct cost center tag before the resources are created. Apply the SCP to the new OU.
options.text_zh: 从管理账户把这个特定 AWS 账户移到 Organizations 中一个新的组织单位 (OU)。创建一条服务控制策略 (SCP)，要求所有资源在创建前必须带上正确的成本中心标签。把该 SCP 应用到这个新 OU 上。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources after the Lambda function looks up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，先从该 RDS 数据库查出对应的成本中心，再给资源打标签。配置一条响应 AWS CloudTrail 事件的 Amazon EventBridge 规则来调用该 Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to look up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database and to tag resources. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the CloudFormation stack.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈来部署一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数从该 RDS 数据库查出对应的成本中心并给资源打标签。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则来触发该 CloudFormation 堆栈。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources with a default value. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function when a resource is missing the cost center tag.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用默认值给资源打标签。配置一条响应 AWS CloudTrail 事件的 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在资源缺少成本中心标签时调用该 Lambda 函数。

explanation_en:
EventBridge + Lambda automates real-time tagging without manual intervention.
SCPs (Option A) cannot dynamically tag resources, and scheduled rules (Option C) are not event-driven.
