explanation_zh:
EventBridge + Lambda 可在无需人工干预的情况下实现实时自动打标签。
SCP（选项 A）无法动态为资源打标签，而定时规则（选项 C）不是事件驱动的。
stem_zh: 某公司维护着一个把用户映射到成本中心的 Amazon RDS 数据库。该公司在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中拥有多个账户。该公司需要一个方案，对该组织中某个特定 AWS 账户内创建的所有资源自动打标签，标签内容为创建该资源的用户所属的成本中心 ID。哪个方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company recently migrated its web application to the AWS Cloud. The company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run multiple processes to host the application. The processes include an Apache web server that serves static content. The Apache web server makes requests to a PHP application that uses a local Redis server for user sessions. The company wants to redesign the architecture to be highly available and to use AWS managed solutions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to host the static content and the PHP application. Configure Elastic Beanstalk to deploy its EC2 instance into a public subnet. Assign a public IP address.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 承载静态内容和该 PHP 应用。配置 Elastic Beanstalk 把其 EC2 实例部署到公有子网，并分配公有 IP 地址。

options.text_en: Use AWS Lambda to host the static content and the PHP application. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API to proxy requests to the Lambda function. Set the API Gateway CORS configuration to respond to the domain name. Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to handle session information.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Lambda 承载静态内容和该 PHP 应用。用一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 把请求代理给该 Lambda 函数。把 API Gateway 的 CORS 配置设为响应该域名。配置 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 来处理会话信息。

options.text_en: Keep the backend code on the EC2 instance. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that has Multi-AZ enabled. Configure the ElastiCache for Redis cluster in cluster mode. Copy the frontend resources to Amazon S3. Configure the backend code to reference the EC2 instance.
options.text_zh: 后端代码仍留在该 EC2 实例上。创建一个开启了多可用区的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群，并把它配置为集群模式。把前端资源复制到 Amazon S3。配置后端代码引用该 EC2 实例。

options.text_en: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 endpoint to an S3 bucket that is configured to host the static content. Configure an Application Load Balancer that targets an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service that runs AWS Fargate tasks for the PHP application. Configure the PHP application to use an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that runs in multiple Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，其 Amazon S3 端点指向一个配置为承载静态内容的 S3 存储桶。配置一个 Application Load Balancer，目标为运行该 PHP 应用 AWS Fargate 任务的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务。配置该 PHP 应用使用一个跨多个可用区运行的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。

explanation_en:
Fully managed services (ECS, ElastiCache) ensure high availability. CloudFront improves static content delivery.
Elastic Beanstalk (Option A) lacks decoupling, and Lambda (Option B) is unsuitable for PHP sessions.
explanation_zh:
全托管服务（ECS、ElastiCache）确保高可用性。CloudFront 改善静态内容的交付。
Elastic Beanstalk（选项 A）缺乏解耦，而 Lambda（选项 B）不适合 PHP 会话。
stem_zh:
某公司最近将其 Web 应用程序迁移到了 AWS 云。公司使用一台 Amazon EC2 实例运行多个进程来承载该应用程序。这些进程包括一个提供静态内容的 Apache Web 服务器。该 Apache Web 服务器向一个 PHP 应用程序发起请求，该 PHP 应用程序使用本地 Redis 服务器管理用户会话。
公司希望重新设计该架构，使其高可用并使用 AWS 托管方案。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that has a target group. The company designed the application to work with session affinity (sticky sessions) for a better user experience. The application must be available publicly over the internet as an endpoint. A WAF must be applied to the endpoint for additional security. Session affinity (sticky sessions) must be configured on the endpoint. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Create a public Network Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个面向公网的 Network Load Balancer，指定该应用的目标组。

options.text_en: Create a Gateway Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Gateway Load Balancer，指定该应用的目标组。

options.text_en: Create a public Application Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.text_zh: 创建一个面向公网的 Application Load Balancer，指定该应用的目标组。

options.text_en: Create a second target group. Add Elastic IP addresses to the EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 再创建一个目标组，并为这些 EC2 实例分配弹性 IP 地址。

options.text_en: Create a web ACL in AWS WAF. Associate the web ACL with the endpoint
options.text_zh: 在 AWS WAF 中创建一个 Web ACL，并把该 Web ACL 关联到该端点。

explanation_en:
ALB supports sticky sessions (unlike NLB/GWLB). WAF provides security.
Elastic IPs (Option D) are not scalable.
explanation_zh:
ALB 支持粘性会话（NLB/GWLB 不支持）。WAF 提供安全防护。
弹性 IP（选项 D）不具备可扩展性。
stem_zh: 某公司在一个带目标组的 Auto Scaling 组内的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用。为了获得更好的用户体验，该公司把应用设计为配合会话亲和性（粘性会话）工作。该应用必须作为一个端点在互联网上公开可用，并且必须在该端点上应用 WAF 以增强安全性，同时端点上必须配置会话亲和性（粘性会话）。以下哪几步组合能满足这些需求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company runs a website that stores images of historical events. Website users need the ability to search and view images based on the year that the event in the image occurred. On average, users request each image only once or twice a year. The company wants a highly available solution to store and deliver the images to users. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Store images in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
options.text_zh: 把图片存放在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 中。使用运行在 Amazon EC2 上的 Web 服务器。

options.text_en: Store images in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
options.text_zh: 把图片存放在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。使用运行在 Amazon EC2 上的 Web 服务器。

options.text_en: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard. Use S3 Standard to directly deliver images by using a static website.
options.text_zh: 把图片存放在 Amazon S3 Standard 中。用 S3 Standard 通过静态网站直接分发图片。

options.text_en: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use S3 Standard-IA to directly deliver images by using a static website.
options.text_zh: 把图片存放在 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 中。用 S3 Standard-IA 通过静态网站直接分发图片。

explanation_en:
Standard-IA is cost-effective for rarely accessed images. Static websites simplify delivery.
EBS/EFS (Options A/B) are expensive and lack S3’s durability.
explanation_zh:
Standard-IA 对很少访问的图片具有成本效益。静态网站简化了交付。
EBS/EFS（选项 A/B）成本高昂，且不具备 S3 的持久性。
stem_zh:
某公司运营一个存储历史事件图片的网站。网站用户需要能够根据图片中事件发生的年份来搜索和查看图片。平均而言，用户每年只请求每张图片一到两次。公司希望有一个高可用的方案来存储图片并交付给用户。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has multiple AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations that different business units use. The company has multiple offices around the world. The company needs to update security group rules to allow new office CIDR ranges or to remove old CIDR ranges across the organization. The company wants to centralize the management of security group rules to minimize the administrative overhead that updating CIDR ranges requires. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Create VPC security groups in the organization's management account. Update the security groups when a CIDR range update is necessary.
options.text_zh: 在该组织的管理账户中创建 VPC 安全组。需要更新 CIDR 范围时就更新这些安全组。

options.text_en: Create a VPC customer managed prefix list that contains the list of CIDRs. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the prefix list across the organization. Use the prefix list in the security groups across the organization.
options.text_zh: 创建一个包含这些 CIDR 列表的 VPC 客户托管前缀列表。用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 把该前缀列表共享到整个组织。在组织内各处的安全组中引用该前缀列表。

options.text_en: Create an AWS managed prefix list. Use an AWS Security Hub policy to enforce the security group update across the organization. Use an AWS Lambda function to update the prefix list automatically when the CIDR ranges change.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS 托管前缀列表。用 AWS Security Hub 策略在整个组织强制执行安全组更新。用一个 AWS Lambda 函数在 CIDR 范围变化时自动更新前缀列表。

options.text_en: Create security groups in a central administrative AWS account. Create an AWS Firewall Manager common security group policy for the whole organization. Select the previously created security groups as primary groups in the policy.
options.text_zh: 在一个中央管理 AWS 账户中创建安全组。为整个组织创建一条 AWS Firewall Manager 通用安全组策略。在该策略中把先前创建的安全组选为主安全组。

explanation_en:
Prefix lists centralize CIDR management. AWS RAM enables cross-account sharing.
Firewall Manager (Option D) is overkill for CIDR updates.
explanation_zh:
前缀列表可集中管理 CIDR。AWS RAM 支持跨账户共享。
Firewall Manager（选项 D）对于 CIDR 更新来说过于重型。
stem_zh: 某公司在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中拥有多个 AWS 账户，供不同业务部门使用。该公司在全球有多个办公地点。该公司需要在整个组织范围内更新安全组规则，以放通新办公地点的 CIDR 范围或移除旧的 CIDR 范围。该公司希望集中管理安全组规则，以尽量减少更新 CIDR 范围带来的管理开销。哪个方案能以最高性价比满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company uses an on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to provide file shares to its high performance computing (HPC) workloads. The company wants to migrate its latency-sensitive HPC workloads and its storage to the AWS Cloud. The company must be able to provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access from the file system. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group.
options.text_zh: 把计算优化型 EC2 实例部署到一个集群 (cluster) 置放群组中。

options.text_en: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a partition placement group.
options.text_zh: 把计算优化型 EC2 实例部署到一个分区 (partition) 置放群组中。

options.text_en: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例挂到一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统上。

options.text_en: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例挂到一个 Amazon FSx for OpenZFS 文件系统上。

options.text_en: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system.
options.text_zh: 把这些 EC2 实例挂到一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统上。

explanation_en:
Cluster placement minimizes latency. FSx for ONTAP supports multi-protocol (NFS/SMB) access.
Lustre (Option C) lacks SMB support.
explanation_zh:
集群置放可最大限度降低延迟。FSx for ONTAP 支持多协议（NFS/SMB）访问。
Lustre（选项 C）不支持 SMB。
stem_zh: 某公司用本地的网络附加存储 (NAS) 系统为其高性能计算 (HPC) 工作负载提供文件共享。该公司想把这些对延迟敏感的 HPC 工作负载及其存储迁移到 AWS 云。该文件系统必须能同时提供 NFS 和 SMB 多协议访问。以下哪几项组合能以最低延迟满足这些需求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is relocating its data center and wants to securely transfer 50 TB of data to AWS within 2 weeks. The existing data center has a Site-to- Site VPN connection to AWS that is 90% utilized. Which AWS service should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.text_en: AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint
options.text_zh: 带 VPC 端点的 AWS DataSync

options.text_en: AWS Direct Connect
options.text_zh: AWS Direct Connect

options.text_en: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized
options.text_zh: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized

options.text_en: AWS Storage Gateway
options.text_zh: AWS Storage Gateway

explanation_en:
Snowball Edge is ideal for large offline transfers (50 TB in 2 weeks) without VPN bottlenecks.
DataSync (Option A) is for online transfers; Direct Connect (Option B) is too slow.
explanation_zh:
Snowball Edge 非常适合大规模离线传输（2 周内 50 TB），不受 VPN 瓶颈限制。
DataSync（选项 A）用于在线传输；Direct Connect（选项 B）速度太慢。
stem_zh:
某公司正在搬迁其数据中心，希望在 2 周内将 50 TB 数据安全地传输到 AWS。现有数据中心有一条到 AWS 的 Site-to-Site VPN 连接，利用率已达 90%。
解决方案架构师应使用哪项 AWS 服务来满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. Application peak hours occur at the same time each day. Application users report slow application performance at the start of peak hours. The application performs normally 2-3 hours after peak hours begin. The company wants to ensure that the application works properly at the start of peak hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic properly to the instances.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Application Load Balancer 把流量正确地分发到这些实例。

options.text_en: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on memory utilization.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组配置一条按内存利用率启动新实例的动态伸缩策略。

options.text_en: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on CPU utilization.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组配置一条按 CPU 利用率启动新实例的动态伸缩策略。

options.text_en: Configure a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances before peak hours.
options.text_zh: 为该 Auto Scaling 组配置一条计划伸缩策略，在高峰时段之前启动新实例。

explanation_en:
Proactively scales instances to handle predictable traffic spikes.
Dynamic scaling (Options B/C) reacts too slowly for known peaks.
explanation_zh:
主动扩容实例以应对可预测的流量峰值。
动态伸缩（选项 B/C）对已知的高峰反应太慢。
stem_zh:
某公司在一个 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 按需实例上托管一个应用程序。应用程序的高峰时段每天在同一时间出现。应用程序用户反映在高峰时段开始时应用性能缓慢。高峰时段开始 2-3 小时后，应用程序恢复正常。公司希望确保应用程序在高峰时段开始时就能正常工作。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs applications on AWS that connect to the company's Amazon RDS database. The applications scale on weekends and at peak times of the year. The company wants to scale the database more effectively for its applications that connect to the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon DynamoDB with connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the DynamoDB endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库使用带目标组配置和连接池的 Amazon DynamoDB。改造应用改用 DynamoDB 端点。

options.text_en: Use Amazon RDS Proxy with a target group for the database. Change the applications to use the RDS Proxy endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库使用带目标组的 Amazon RDS Proxy。改造应用改用 RDS Proxy 端点。

options.text_en: Use a custom proxy that runs on Amazon EC2 as an intermediary to the database. Change the applications to use the custom proxy endpoint.
options.text_zh: 用一个运行在 Amazon EC2 上的自定义代理作为数据库的中间层。改造应用改用该自定义代理端点。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Lambda function to provide connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Lambda 函数为该数据库提供带目标组配置的连接池。改造应用改用该 Lambda 函数。

explanation_en:
RDS Proxy manages scaling connections with minimal code changes.
DynamoDB (Option A) is incompatible with RDS.
explanation_zh:
RDS Proxy 以极少的代码改动管理伸缩过程中的连接。
DynamoDB（选项 A）与 RDS 不兼容。
stem_zh:
某公司在 AWS 上运行连接到公司 Amazon RDS 数据库的应用程序。这些应用程序在周末和一年中的高峰时期会扩容。公司希望为连接该数据库的应用程序更有效地扩展数据库。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company uses AWS Cost Explorer to monitor its AWS costs. The company notices that Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage and snapshot costs increase every month. However, the company does not purchase additional EBS storage every month. The company wants to optimize monthly costs for its current storage usage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor the storage utilization of Amazon EBS. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志监控 Amazon EBS 的存储使用率。用 Amazon EBS 弹性卷缩小这些 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use a custom script to monitor space usage. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用自定义脚本监控空间使用情况。用 Amazon EBS 弹性卷缩小这些 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Delete all expired and unused snapshots to reduce snapshot costs.
options.text_zh: 删除所有过期和未使用的快照以降低快照成本。

options.text_en: Delete all nonessential snapshots. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create and manage the snapshots according to the company's snapshot policy requirements.
options.text_zh: 删除所有非必要的快照。用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 按公司的快照策略要求来创建和管理快照。

explanation_en:
Automates snapshot retention per policy, reducing costs.
Manual resizing (Options A/B) adds overhead.
explanation_zh:
按策略自动管理快照保留，从而降低成本。
手动调整容量（选项 A/B）会增加开销。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 AWS Cost Explorer 监控其 AWS 成本。公司注意到 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）存储和快照成本每月都在增加。然而，公司并未每月购买额外的 EBS 存储。公司希望针对当前的存储使用情况优化每月成本。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is developing a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster, an Amazon S3 bucket that contains assets for the application, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database that contains the dataset for the application. The dataset contains sensitive information. The company wants to ensure that only the ECS cluster can access the data in the RDS for MySQL database and the data in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the KMS key policy includes encrypt and decrypt permissions for the ECS task execution role.
options.text_zh: 新建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥，用它同时加密该 S3 存储桶和该 RDS for MySQL 数据库。确保该 KMS 密钥策略中包含 ECS 任务执行角色的加密和解密权限。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the S3 bucket policy specifies the ECS task execution role as a user.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管密钥，用它同时加密该 S3 存储桶和该 RDS for MySQL 数据库。确保该 S3 存储桶策略把 ECS 任务执行角色指定为使用者。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in.
options.text_zh: 创建一条把存储桶访问限制给 ECS 任务执行角色的 S3 存储桶策略。为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC 端点。更新 RDS for MySQL 安全组，只允许来自 ECS 集群产生任务的那些子网的访问。

options.text_en: Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC 端点。更新 RDS for MySQL 安全组，只允许来自 ECS 集群产生任务的那些子网的访问。为 Amazon S3 创建一个 VPC 端点。更新该 S3 存储桶策略，只允许来自该 S3 VPC 端点的访问。

explanation_en:
VPC endpoints keep traffic private. Security groups limit access to ECS subnets.
KMS (Options A/B) doesn’t restrict network access.
explanation_zh:
VPC 终端节点使流量保持私有。安全组将访问限制在 ECS 子网范围内。
KMS（选项 A/B）无法限制网络访问。
stem_zh:
某公司正在 AWS 上开发一个新应用程序。该应用程序由一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群、一个包含应用程序资源的 Amazon S3 存储桶，以及一个包含应用程序数据集的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库组成。该数据集包含敏感信息。公司希望确保只有该 ECS 集群能够访问 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的数据以及 S3 存储桶中的数据。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has a web application that runs on premises. The application experiences latency issues during peak hours. The latency issues occur twice each month. At the start of a latency issue, the application's CPU utilization immediately increases to 10 times its normal amount. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS to improve latency. The company also wants to scale the application automatically when application demand increases. The company will use AWS Elastic Beanstalk for application deployment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，使用无限模式的可突增性能实例。把该环境配置为按请求数伸缩。

options.text_en: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，使用计算优化型实例。把该环境配置为按请求数伸缩。

options.text_en: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale on a schedule.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，使用计算优化型实例。把该环境配置为按计划伸缩。

options.text_en: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale on predictive metrics.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，使用无限模式的可突增性能实例。把该环境配置为按预测指标伸缩。

explanation_en:
Burstable instances handle CPU spikes cost-effectively. Request-based scaling matches demand.
Compute-optimized instances (Option B) are overprovisioned for intermittent spikes.
explanation_zh:
可突增实例能以具有成本效益的方式应对 CPU 峰值。基于请求数的伸缩与需求相匹配。
计算优化型实例（选项 B）对于间歇性峰值属于过度预置。
stem_zh:
某公司有一个运行在本地的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序在高峰时段会出现延迟问题。这些延迟问题每月出现两次。延迟问题开始时，应用程序的 CPU 利用率会立即升至正常水平的 10 倍。
公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 AWS 以改善延迟。公司还希望在应用需求增加时自动扩展应用程序。公司将使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署应用程序。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company has customers located across the world. The company wants to use automation to secure its systems and network infrastructure. The company's security team must be able to track and audit all incremental changes to the infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Organizations 搭建基础设施，用 AWS Config 跟踪变更。

options.text_en: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CloudFormation 搭建基础设施，用 AWS Config 跟踪变更。

options.text_en: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Organizations 搭建基础设施，用 AWS Service Catalog 跟踪变更。

options.text_en: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CloudFormation 搭建基础设施，用 AWS Service Catalog 跟踪变更。

explanation_en:
CloudFormation automates infrastructure; Config tracks changes for auditing.
Service Catalog (Options C/D) is for governance, not change tracking.
explanation_zh:
CloudFormation 实现基础设施自动化；Config 跟踪变更以供审计。
Service Catalog（选项 C/D）用于治理，而非变更跟踪。
stem_zh:
某公司的客户遍布全球。公司希望使用自动化手段保护其系统和网络基础设施。公司的安全团队必须能够跟踪和审计基础设施的所有增量变更。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A startup company is hosting a website for its customers on an Amazon EC2 instance. The website consists of a stateless Python application and a MySQL database. The website serves only a small amount of traffic. The company is concerned about the reliability of the instance and needs to migrate to a highly available architecture. The company cannot modify the application code. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to achieve high availability for the website? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Provision an internet gateway in each Availability Zone in use.
options.text_zh: 在每个使用中的可用区各预置一个互联网网关。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到多可用区的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB, and enable DynamoDB auto scaling.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB，并启用 DynamoDB 自动伸缩。

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to synchronize the database data across multiple EC2 instances.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 在多台 EC2 实例之间同步数据库数据。

options.text_en: Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances that are distributed across two Availability Zones.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer，把流量分发到一个跨两个可用区的 EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组。

explanation_en:
RDS Multi-AZ ensures DB high availability. ALB + Auto Scaling distributes traffic across AZs.
DynamoDB (Option C) requires code changes; DataSync (Option D) doesn’t solve HA.
explanation_zh:
RDS 多可用区确保数据库高可用。ALB + Auto Scaling 跨可用区分发流量。
DynamoDB（选项 C）需要修改代码；DataSync（选项 D）无法解决高可用问题。
stem_zh:
一家初创公司在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上为其客户托管一个网站。该网站由一个无状态 Python 应用程序和一个 MySQL 数据库组成。该网站只承载少量流量。公司担心该实例的可靠性，需要迁移到高可用架构。公司无法修改应用程序代码。
解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作组合来实现该网站的高可用？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company is moving its data and applications to AWS during a multiyear migration project. The company wants to securely access data on Amazon S3 from the company's AWS Region and from the company's on-premises location. The data must not traverse the internet. The company has established an AWS Direct Connect connection between its Region and its on-premises location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create gateway endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the gateway endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 创建网关端点。通过这些网关端点从该区域和本地位置安全访问数据。

options.text_en: Create a gateway in AWS Transit Gateway to access Amazon S3 securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Transit Gateway 中创建一个网关，以便从该区域和本地位置安全访问 Amazon S3。

options.text_en: Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the interface endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.text_zh: 为 Amazon S3 创建接口端点。通过这些接口端点从该区域和本地位置安全访问数据。

options.text_en: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to access the data securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.text_zh: 用一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥从该区域和本地位置安全访问数据。

explanation_en:
Gateway endpoints allow secure S3 access via Direct Connect/VPC without internet.
Interface endpoints (Option C) are for private-link services, not S3.
explanation_zh:
网关型终端节点允许通过 Direct Connect/VPC 安全访问 S3，无需经由互联网。
接口型终端节点（选项 C）适用于 PrivateLink 服务，而非 S3。
stem_zh:
某公司正在一个多年期迁移项目中将其数据和应用程序迁移到 AWS。公司希望从其 AWS 区域和本地位置安全地访问 Amazon S3 上的数据。数据不得经由互联网传输。公司已在其区域与本地位置之间建立了一条 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company created a new organization in AWS Organizations. The organization has multiple accounts for the company's development teams. The development team members use AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to access the accounts. For each of the company's applications, the development teams must use a predefined application name to tag resources that are created. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that gives the development team the ability to create resources only if the application name tag has an approved value. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create an IAM group that has a conditional Allow policy that requires the application name tag to be specified for resources to be created.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 IAM 组，其条件式 Allow 策略要求创建资源时必须指定应用名称标签。

options.text_en: Create a cross-account role that has a Deny policy for any resource that has the application name tag.
options.text_zh: 创建一个跨账户角色，其 Deny 策略拒绝任何带应用名称标签的资源。

options.text_en: Create a resource group in AWS Resource Groups to validate that the tags are applied to all resources in all accounts.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS Resource Groups 中创建一个资源组，用来校验所有账户中的所有资源是否都打了标签。

options.text_en: Create a tag policy in Organizations that has a list of allowed application names.
options.text_zh: 在 Organizations 中创建一条标签策略，其中列出允许的应用名称。

explanation_en:
Tag policies enforce standardized tagging across accounts.
IAM policies (Option A) cannot validate tag values.
explanation_zh:
标签策略可在各账户之间强制实施标准化打标签规范。
IAM 策略（选项 A）无法校验标签值。
stem_zh: 某公司在 AWS Organizations 中新建了一个组织，其中为公司的开发团队设立了多个账户。开发团队成员使用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 访问这些账户。对该公司的每个应用，开发团队都必须用预先定义好的应用名称给创建的资源打标签。解决方案架构师需要设计一个方案，让开发团队只有在应用名称标签取值属于已批准范围时才能创建资源。哪个方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company runs its databases on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company wants a secure solution to manage the master user password by rotating the password every 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule a custom AWS Lambda function to rotate the password every 30 days.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon EventBridge 定时调度一个自定义 AWS Lambda 函数，每 30 天轮换一次密码。

options.text_en: Use the modify-db-instance command in the AWS CLI to change the password.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS CLI 的 modify-db-instance 命令来修改密码。

options.text_en: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.
options.text_zh: 把 AWS Secrets Manager 与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 集成，实现密码自动轮换。

options.text_en: Integrate AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.
options.text_zh: 把 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 集成，实现密码自动轮换。

explanation_en:
Secrets Manager automates rotation every 30 days with zero operational effort.
Manual rotation (Option B) or Parameter Store (Option D) lacks automation.
explanation_zh:
Secrets Manager 可零运维投入地每 30 天自动轮换密码。
手动轮换（选项 B）或 Parameter Store（选项 D）缺乏自动化能力。
stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上运行其数据库。公司希望有一个安全方案来管理主用户密码，每 30 天轮换一次密码。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company performs tests on an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The tests run for 4 hours once a week. The company knows how many read and write operations the application performs to the table each second during the tests. The company does not currently use DynamoDB for any other use case. A solutions architect needs to optimize the costs for the table. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Choose on-demand mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.text_zh: 选择按需模式，并适当调整读写容量单位。

options.text_en: Choose provisioned mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.text_zh: 选择预置模式，并适当调整读写容量单位。

options.text_en: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 1-year term.
options.text_zh: 购买 1 年期的 DynamoDB 预留容量。

options.text_en: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 3-year term.
options.text_zh: 购买 3 年期的 DynamoDB 预留容量。

explanation_en:
Provisioned mode is cost-effective for predictable weekly workloads.
On-demand (Option A) is expensive for infrequent use.
explanation_zh:
对于可预测的每周工作负载，预置模式更具成本效益。
按需模式（选项 A）对于不频繁使用来说成本较高。
stem_zh:
某公司对一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表的应用程序进行测试。测试每周运行一次，每次持续 4 小时。公司知道测试期间应用程序每秒对该表执行多少次读写操作。公司目前没有将 DynamoDB 用于任何其他用例。解决方案架构师需要优化该表的成本。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs its applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company performs periodic financial assessments of its AWS costs. The company recently identified unusual spending. The company needs a solution to prevent unusual spending. The solution must monitor costs and notify responsible stakeholders in the event of unusual spending. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use an AWS Budgets template to create a zero spend budget.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Budgets 模板创建一个零支出预算。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitor in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS 账单与成本管理控制台中创建一个 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 监控器。

options.text_en: Create AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for the current running workload pricing details.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Pricing Calculator 为当前运行的工作负载创建定价明细估算。

options.text_en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs and to identify unusual spending.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控成本并识别异常支出。

explanation_en:
Automatically detects and alerts on unusual spending.
CloudWatch (Option D) lacks built-in anomaly detection.
explanation_zh:
自动检测异常支出并发出告警。
CloudWatch（选项 D）不具备内置的异常检测能力。
stem_zh: 某公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用。该公司会定期对 AWS 成本做财务评估，最近发现了异常支出。该公司需要一个能防范异常支出的方案：该方案必须监控成本，并在出现异常支出时通知相关负责人。哪个方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A marketing company receives a large amount of new clickstream data in Amazon S3 from a marketing campaign. The company needs to analyze the clickstream data in Amazon S3 quickly. Then the company needs to determine whether to process the data further in the data pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create external tables in a Spark catalog. Configure jobs in AWS Glue to query the data.
options.text_zh: 在 Spark 目录中创建外部表。在 AWS Glue 中配置作业来查询数据。

options.text_en: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序来爬取数据。配置 Amazon Athena 来查询数据。

options.text_en: Create external tables in a Hive metastore. Configure Spark jobs in Amazon EMR to query the data.
options.text_zh: 在 Hive 元数据存储中创建外部表。在 Amazon EMR 中配置 Spark 作业来查询数据。

options.text_en: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to use SQL to query the data.
options.text_zh: 配置一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序来爬取数据。配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 用 SQL 查询数据。

explanation_en:
Glue catalogs data; Athena provides serverless SQL queries.
EMR (Option C) adds operational overhead.
explanation_zh:
Glue 为数据编目；Athena 提供无服务器的 SQL 查询。
EMR（选项 C）会增加运维开销。
stem_zh:
某营销公司在 Amazon S3 中收到来自一次营销活动的大量新点击流数据。公司需要快速分析 Amazon S3 中的这些点击流数据，然后判断是否在数据管道中对数据做进一步处理。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that the company frequently accesses for up to 7 days after the file creation date. After 7 days, the company needs to be able to access the files with a maximum retrieval time of 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS DataSync 把 SMB 文件服务器上超过 7 天的数据复制到 AWS。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway 来扩充该公司的存储空间。创建一条 S3 生命周期策略，7 天后把数据转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data after 7 days.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon FSx File Gateway 来扩充该公司的存储空间。创建一条 Amazon S3 生命周期策略，7 天后转换数据。

options.text_en: Configure access to Amazon S3 for each user. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.
options.text_zh: 为每位用户配置 Amazon S3 访问权限。创建一条 S3 生命周期策略，7 天后把数据转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

explanation_en:
File Gateway extends on-prem storage; Glacier Deep Archive is cost-effective for archives.
DataSync (Option A) doesn’t automate tiering.
explanation_zh:
File Gateway 扩展了本地存储；Glacier Deep Archive 对归档具有成本效益。
DataSync（选项 A）无法自动进行存储分层。
stem_zh:
某公司在其数据中心运行一台 SMB 文件服务器。该文件服务器存储大文件，公司在文件创建后最多 7 天内会频繁访问它们。7 天之后，公司需要能够以最长 24 小时的检索时间访问这些文件。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses a database that runs on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The application performs slowly when traffic increases. The database experiences a heavy read load during periods of high traffic. Which actions should a solutions architect take to resolve these performance issues? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Turn on auto scaling for the DB instance.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库实例开启自动伸缩。

options.text_en: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Configure the application to send read traffic to the read replica.
options.text_zh: 为该数据库实例创建一个只读副本。配置应用把读取流量发送到该只读副本。

options.text_en: Convert the DB instance to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Configure the application to send read traffic to the standby DB instance.
options.text_zh: 把该数据库实例改为多可用区数据库实例部署。配置应用把读取流量发送到备用数据库实例。

options.text_en: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Configure the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。配置应用把查询结果缓存到该 ElastiCache 集群中。

options.text_en: Configure the Auto Scaling group subnets to ensure that the EC2 instances are provisioned in the same Availability Zone as the DB instance.
options.text_zh: 配置该 Auto Scaling 组的子网，确保 EC2 实例与该数据库实例预置在同一个可用区。

explanation_en:
Read replicas offload read traffic. ElastiCache reduces DB load.
Multi-AZ (Option C) doesn’t scale reads; auto scaling (Option A) isn’t for RDS.
explanation_zh:
只读副本可分流读流量。ElastiCache 可减轻数据库负载。
多可用区（选项 C）无法扩展读能力；自动伸缩（选项 A）不适用于 RDS。
stem_zh: 某公司在一个 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用。该应用使用运行在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例上的数据库。流量增加时该应用变慢，高流量时段数据库承受着很重的读取负载。解决方案架构师应该采取哪几项措施来解决这些性能问题？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to run an application. The company creates one snapshot of each EBS volume every day to meet compliance requirements. The company wants to implement an architecture that prevents the accidental deletion of EBS volume snapshots. The solution must not change the administrative rights of the storage administrator user. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.text_en: Create an IAM role that has permission to delete snapshots. Attach the role to a new EC2 instance. Use the AWS CLI from the new EC2 instance to delete snapshots.
options.text_zh: 创建一个有删除快照权限的 IAM 角色，把该角色附加到一台新的 EC2 实例上。从这台新 EC2 实例用 AWS CLI 删除快照。

options.text_en: Create an IAM policy that denies snapshot deletion. Attach the policy to the storage administrator user.
options.text_zh: 创建一条拒绝删除快照的 IAM 策略，把该策略附加到存储管理员用户上。

options.text_en: Add tags to the snapshots. Create retention rules in Recycle Bin for EBS snapshots that have the tags.
options.text_zh: 给快照打上标签。在回收站 (Recycle Bin) 中为带这些标签的 EBS 快照创建保留规则。

options.text_en: Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion.
options.text_zh: 锁定这些 EBS 快照以防止被删除。

explanation_en:
Prevents accidental deletion without IAM changes.
Recycle Bin (Option C) requires tagging; IAM (Option B) changes permissions.
explanation_zh:
无需更改 IAM 即可防止意外删除。
回收站（选项 C）需要打标签；IAM（选项 B）会更改权限。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷运行一个应用程序。为满足合规要求，公司每天为每个 EBS 卷创建一份快照。公司希望实施一种架构，防止 EBS 卷快照被意外删除。该方案不得更改存储管理员用户的管理权限。
哪个方案能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company's application uses Network Load Balancers, Auto Scaling groups, Amazon EC2 instances, and databases that are deployed in an Amazon VPC. The company wants to capture information about traffic to and from the network interfaces in near real time in its Amazon VPC. The company wants to send the information to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中创建一个日志组。配置 VPC 流日志把日志数据发送到该日志组。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 把日志从该日志组流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。

options.text_en: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
options.text_zh: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中创建一个日志组。配置 VPC 流日志把日志数据发送到该日志组。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 把日志从该日志组流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。

options.text_en: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一个跟踪。配置 VPC 流日志把日志数据发送到该跟踪。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 把日志从该跟踪流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。

options.text_en: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
options.text_zh: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一个跟踪。配置 VPC 流日志把日志数据发送到该跟踪。用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 把日志从该跟踪流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。

explanation_en:
Flow Logs capture traffic; Firehose streams to OpenSearch.
CloudTrail (Options C/D) logs API calls, not network traffic.
explanation_zh:
流日志捕获流量；Firehose 将数据流式传输到 OpenSearch。
CloudTrail（选项 C/D）记录的是 API 调用，而非网络流量。
stem_zh: 某公司的应用使用部署在一个 Amazon VPC 中的 Network Load Balancer、Auto Scaling 组、Amazon EC2 实例和数据库。该公司希望准实时地捕获其 Amazon VPC 中进出各网络接口的流量信息，并把这些信息发送到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 做分析。哪个方案能满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company is developing an application that will run on a production Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS cluster has managed node groups that are provisioned with On-Demand Instances. The company needs a dedicated EKS cluster for development work. The company will use the development cluster infrequently to test the resiliency of the application. The EKS cluster must manage all the nodes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text_en: Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个只包含 Spot 实例的托管节点组。

options.text_en: Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot Instances.
options.text_zh: 创建两个托管节点组：一个用按需实例预置，另一个用 Spot 实例预置。

options.text_en: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch configuration that uses Spot Instances. Configure the user data to add the nodes to the EKS cluster.
options.text_zh: 创建一个使用 Spot 实例启动配置的 Auto Scaling 组。配置用户数据把节点加入该 EKS 集群。

options.text_en: Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.
options.text_zh: 创建一个只包含按需实例的托管节点组。

explanation_en:
Balances cost (Spot) and reliability (On-Demand) for infrequent dev workloads.
All-Spot (Option A) risks interruptions; self-managed ASG (Option C) adds overhead.
explanation_zh:
对于不频繁使用的开发工作负载，在成本（Spot）与可靠性（按需）之间取得平衡。
全部使用 Spot（选项 A）有被中断的风险；自管理的 ASG（选项 C）会增加开销。
stem_zh:
某公司正在开发一个将运行在生产 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）集群上的应用程序。该 EKS 集群拥有以按需实例预置的托管节点组。
公司需要一个专用的 EKS 集群用于开发工作。公司将不定期使用该开发集群来测试应用程序的韧性。该 EKS 集群必须管理所有节点。
哪个方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company stores sensitive data in Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to create an encryption solution. The company needs to fully control the ability of users to create, rotate, and disable encryption keys with minimal effort for any data that must be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Use default server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) to store the sensitive data.
options.text_zh: 使用默认的采用 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）来存储这些敏感数据。

options.text_en: Create a customer managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建一个客户托管密钥。用这个新密钥以采用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）来加密这些 S3 对象。

options.text_en: Create an AWS managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建一个 AWS 托管密钥。用这个新密钥以采用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）来加密这些 S3 对象。

options.text_en: Download S3 objects to an Amazon EC2 instance. Encrypt the objects by using customer managed keys. Upload the encrypted objects back into Amazon S3.
options.text_zh: 把 S3 对象下载到一台 Amazon EC2 实例上，用客户托管密钥加密后再上传回 Amazon S3。

explanation_en:
Grants full control over key rotation/access. SSE-S3 (Option A) lacks key management.
Client-side encryption (Option D) is complex.
explanation_zh:
可获得对密钥轮换/访问的完全控制。SSE-S3（选项 A）缺乏密钥管理能力。
客户端加密（选项 D）过于复杂。
stem_zh:
某公司在 Amazon S3 中存储敏感数据。解决方案架构师需要创建一个加密方案。公司需要以最少的投入完全控制用户为任何必须加密的数据创建、轮换和禁用加密密钥的能力。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company wants to back up its on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to AWS. The company's backup solution exports on-premises backups to an Amazon S3 bucket as objects. The S3 backups must be retained for 30 days and must be automatically deleted after 30 days. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock enabled.
options.text_zh: 创建一个启用了 S3 对象锁定的 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an S3 bucket that has object versioning enabled.
options.text_zh: 创建一个启用了对象版本控制的 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Configure a default retention period of 30 days for the objects.
options.text_zh: 为这些对象配置 30 天的默认保留期。

options.text_en: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to protect the objects for 30 days.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 S3 生命周期策略，把这些对象保护 30 天。

options.text_en: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire the objects after 30 days.
options.text_zh: 配置一条 S3 生命周期策略，让这些对象在 30 天后过期。

options.text_en: Configure the backup solution to tag the objects with a 30-day retention period
options.text_zh: 配置备份方案给这些对象打上 30 天保留期的标签。

explanation_en:
Versioning + retention policies automate compliance. Lifecycle rules expire objects.
Object Lock (Option A) prevents deletion; tagging (Option F) doesn’t enforce retention.
explanation_zh:
版本控制 + 保留策略可实现合规自动化。生命周期规则让对象过期。
Object Lock（选项 A）会阻止删除；打标签（选项 F）无法强制执行保留期。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将其本地虚拟机（VM）备份到 AWS。公司的备份方案将本地备份以对象形式导出到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。这些 S3 备份必须保留 30 天，并在 30 天后自动删除。
哪些步骤组合能满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

stem_en: A solutions architect needs to copy files from an Amazon S3 bucket to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and another S3 bucket. The files must be copied continuously. New files are added to the original S3 bucket consistently. The copied files should be overwritten only if the source file changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer only data that has changed.
options.text_zh: 为目标 S3 存储桶和该 EFS 文件系统各创建一个 AWS DataSync 位置。为目标 S3 存储桶和该 EFS 文件系统各创建一个任务。把传输模式设为只传输发生变化的数据。

options.text_en: Create an AWS Lambda function. Mount the file system to the function. Set up an S3 event notification to invoke the function when files are created and changed in Amazon S3. Configure the function to copy files to the file system and the destination S3 bucket.
options.text_zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，把该文件系统挂载到函数上。设置 S3 事件通知，在 Amazon S3 中有文件创建或变更时调用该函数。配置该函数把文件复制到该文件系统和目标 S3 存储桶。

options.text_en: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer all data.
options.text_zh: 为目标 S3 存储桶和该 EFS 文件系统各创建一个 AWS DataSync 位置。为目标 S3 存储桶和该 EFS 文件系统各创建一个任务。把传输模式设为传输全部数据。

options.text_en: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the same VPC as the file system. Mount the file system. Create a script to routinely synchronize all objects that changed in the origin S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket and the mounted file system.
options.text_zh: 在与该文件系统相同的 VPC 中启动一台 Amazon EC2 实例并挂载该文件系统。编写脚本定期把源 S3 存储桶中发生变化的所有对象同步到目标 S3 存储桶和已挂载的文件系统。

explanation_en:
Continuously syncs only modified files to S3/EFS.
Lambda (Option B) requires custom code; full syncs (Option C) are inefficient.
explanation_zh:
持续地只同步被修改过的文件到 S3/EFS。
Lambda（选项 B）需要自定义代码；全量同步（选项 C）效率低下。
stem_zh: 解决方案架构师需要把文件从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶复制到一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统以及另一个 S3 存储桶。这些文件必须持续复制。原始 S3 存储桶中会不断新增文件。只有当源文件发生变化时，才应覆盖已复制的文件。哪个方案能以最小的运维开销满足这些需求？

stem_en: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and stores data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company must ensure that all data is encrypted at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The company must be able to control rotation of the encryption keys. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text_en: Create a customer managed key. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 创建一个客户托管密钥，用它加密这些 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes. Use the key to configure automatic key rotation.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS 托管密钥加密这些 EBS 卷，并用该密钥配置自动密钥轮换。

options.text_en: Create an external KMS key with imported key material. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 创建一个导入了密钥材料的外部 KMS 密钥，用它加密这些 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use an AWS owned key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS 拥有的密钥加密这些 EBS 卷。

explanation_en: Allows control over key rotation. AWS-managed keys (Option B) limit rotation flexibility.
explanation_zh: 可控制密钥轮换。AWS 托管密钥（选项 B）在轮换灵活性上受限。
stem_zh:
某公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例，并将数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷上。公司必须确保所有数据都使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）进行静态加密。公司必须能够控制加密密钥的轮换。
哪个方案能以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company needs a solution to enforce data encryption at rest on Amazon EC2 instances. The solution must automatically identify noncompliant resources and enforce compliance policies on findings. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.text_en: Use an IAM policy that allows users to create only encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Config and AWS Systems Manager to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 使用一条只允许用户创建加密 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的 IAM 策略。用 AWS Config 和 AWS Systems Manager 自动检测并修复未加密的 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to manage access to encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 管理对加密 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的访问。用 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon EventBridge 自动检测并修复未加密的 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use Amazon Macie to detect unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Systems Manager Automation rules to automatically encrypt existing and new EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Macie 检测未加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 规则自动加密现有和新建的 EBS 卷。

options.text_en: Use Amazon inspector to detect unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Systems Manager Automation rules to automatically encrypt existing and new EBS volumes.
options.text_zh: 用 Amazon Inspector 检测未加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 规则自动加密现有和新建的 EBS 卷。

explanation_en:
Config detects noncompliant volumes; Systems Manager automates remediation.
Macie (Option C) is for data classification, not encryption.
explanation_zh:
Config 检测不合规的卷；Systems Manager 自动执行修复。
Macie（选项 C）用于数据分类，而非加密。
stem_zh:
某公司需要一个方案，在 Amazon EC2 实例上强制实施静态数据加密。该方案必须自动识别不合规资源，并针对发现结果执行合规策略。
哪个方案能以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

stem_en: A company is migrating its multi-tier on-premises application to AWS. The application consists of a single-node MySQL database and a multi-node web tier. The company must minimize changes to the application during the migration. The company wants to improve application resiliency after the migration. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text_en: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 把 Web 层迁移到一个 Application Load Balancer 之后 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一个 Network Load Balancer 之后 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS 多可用区部署。

options.text_en: Migrate the web tier to an AWS Lambda function.
options.text_zh: 把 Web 层迁移到一个 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.text_en: Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.text_zh: 把数据库迁移到一张 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

explanation_en:
Auto Scaling improves web tier resiliency; RDS Multi-AZ ensures DB HA.
Lambda (Option D) requires code changes; DynamoDB (Option E) is incompatible.
explanation_zh:
Auto Scaling 提升 Web 层韧性；RDS 多可用区确保数据库高可用。
Lambda（选项 D）需要修改代码；DynamoDB（选项 E）不兼容。
stem_zh:
某公司正在将其多层本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序由一个单节点 MySQL 数据库和一个多节点 Web 层组成。公司必须在迁移期间尽量减少对应用程序的改动。公司希望在迁移后提升应用程序的韧性。
哪些步骤组合能满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

stem_en: A company wants to migrate its web applications from on premises to AWS. The company is located close to the eu-central-1 Region. Because of regulations, the company cannot launch some of its applications in eu-central-1. The company wants to achieve single-digit millisecond latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text_en: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to an edge location in Amazon CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 把这些应用部署在 eu-central-1，并把该公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 延伸到 Amazon CloudFront 的某个边缘站点。

options.text_en: Deploy the applications in AWS Local Zones by extending the company's VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Local Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 延伸到选定的 AWS Local Zone，并把这些应用部署在该 Local Zone 中。

options.text_en: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the regional edge caches in Amazon CloudFront.
options.text_zh: 把这些应用部署在 eu-central-1，并把该公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 延伸到 Amazon CloudFront 的区域边缘缓存。

options.text_en: Deploy the applications in AWS Wavelength Zones by extending the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Wavelength Zone.
options.text_zh: 把该公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 延伸到选定的 AWS Wavelength Zone，并把这些应用部署在该 Wavelength Zone 中。

explanation_en:
Local Zones provide single-digit latency near eu-central-1 while complying with regulations.
CloudFront (Option A) is for caching, not app hosting.
explanation_zh:
Local Zones 在靠近 eu-central-1 的位置提供个位数毫秒级延迟，同时符合法规要求。
CloudFront（选项 A）用于缓存，而非承载应用程序。
stem_zh:
某公司希望将其 Web 应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。公司位置靠近 eu-central-1 区域。由于法规限制，公司无法在 eu-central-1 中启动其部分应用程序。公司希望实现个位数毫秒级延迟。
哪个方案能满足这些要求？
